units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|log|39|0
units.english: Successfully boarded a Ka'het. It appears to be a single, ship-sized organism that can travel in space using a special exoskeleton.
units.italian: Salita a bordo di un Ka'het riuscita. Sembra essere un singolo organismo delle dimensioni di una nave, capace di viaggiare nello spazio grazie a un esoscheletro speciale.

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|Your ship slowly approaches the <origin>, now floating lifeless near you. As you move closer, you spot a massive hole in the hull of the ship, revealing what appears to be a large, slug-like being. While most of the ship's machinery doesn't seem to have received heavy damage, weapons fire must have hit the slug's vital organs, killing it, after which point the ship seems to have stopped working.|40|0
units.english: Your ship slowly approaches the <origin>, now floating lifeless near you. As you move closer, you spot a massive hole in the hull of the ship, revealing what appears to be a large, slug-like being. While most of the ship's machinery doesn't seem to have received heavy damage, weapons fire must have hit the slug's vital organs, killing it, after which point the ship seems to have stopped working.
units.italian: La tua nave si avvicina lentamente al <origin>, che ora galleggia senza vita accanto a te. Mentre ti avvicini, noti un enorme squarcio nello scafo della nave, che rivela quello che sembra un grande essere simile a una lumaca. Anche se la maggior parte dei macchinari della nave non sembra aver subito danni gravi, il fuoco delle armi deve aver colpito gli organi vitali della lumaca, uccidendola, e da quel momento la nave sembra aver smesso di funzionare.

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|	You have no troubles docking with what seems to be its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Ka'het is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot its outfits.|41|0
units.english: You have no troubles docking with what seems to be its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Ka'het is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot its outfits.
units.italian: Non hai problemi ad attraccare a quello che sembra il suo "esoscheletro", mentre cerchi di decidere cosa fare. Il Ka'het è troppo diverso da una nave normale perché tu possa comandarlo, ma è sicuro dire che ora puoi saccheggiare il suo equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|label|43|0
units.english: boarded aberrant
units.italian: boarded aberrant

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|log|45|0
units.english: Successfully boarded a Ka'het. Like the Aberrant, it appears to be a single, ship-sized organism that can travel in space using a special exoskeleton, but does not seem to induce the same ominous feeling.
units.italian: Salita a bordo di un Ka'het riuscita. Come l'Aberrant, sembra essere un singolo organismo delle dimensioni di una nave capace di viaggiare nello spazio grazie a un esoscheletro speciale, ma non sembra indurre la stessa sensazione inquietante.

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|Your ship slowly approaches the <origin>, now floating lifelessly near you. As you move closer, you spot a massive hole in the hull of the ship, revealing what appears to be a large, slug-like being, very similar to what you found inside the Aberrant. While most of the ship's machinery doesn't seem to have received heavy damage, weapons fire must have hit the slug's vital organs, killing it, after which point the ship seems to have stopped working. Unlike with the Aberrant, you feel no strange presence or ominous feelings as you approach - it is merely a dead animal.|46|0
units.english: Your ship slowly approaches the <origin>, now floating lifelessly near you. As you move closer, you spot a massive hole in the hull of the ship, revealing what appears to be a large, slug-like being, very similar to what you found inside the Aberrant. While most of the ship's machinery doesn't seem to have received heavy damage, weapons fire must have hit the slug's vital organs, killing it, after which point the ship seems to have stopped working. Unlike with the Aberrant, you feel no strange presence or ominous feelings as you approach - it is merely a dead animal.
units.italian: La tua nave si avvicina lentamente al <origin>, che ora galleggia senza vita accanto a te. Mentre ti avvicini, noti un enorme squarcio nello scafo della nave, che rivela quello che sembra un grande essere simile a una lumaca, molto simile a quello che hai trovato dentro l'Aberrant. Anche se la maggior parte dei macchinari della nave non sembra aver subito danni gravi, il fuoco delle armi deve aver colpito gli organi vitali della lumaca, uccidendola, e da quel momento la nave sembra aver smesso di funzionare. A differenza dell'Aberrant, non senti alcuna presenza strana né sensazioni inquietanti mentre ti avvicini: è soltanto un animale morto.

units.id: mission:Disabled Ka'het|	You have no troubles docking with its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Ka'het is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot its outfits.|47|0
units.english: You have no troubles docking with its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Ka'het is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot its outfits.
units.italian: Non hai problemi ad attraccare al suo "esoscheletro", mentre cerchi di decidere cosa fare. Il Ka'het è troppo diverso da una nave normale perché tu possa comandarlo, ma è sicuro dire che ora puoi saccheggiare il suo equipaggiamento.

units.id: conversation:ka'het: remnant|Do you want to ask the Remnant about the section of space south of the Ember Waste, the Graveyard, and its inhabitants?|50|0
units.english: Do you want to ask the Remnant about the section of space south of the Ember Waste, the Graveyard, and its inhabitants?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere ai Remnant della sezione di spazio a sud della Distesa di Braci, il Cimitero, e dei suoi abitanti?

units.id: conversation:ka'het: remnant|	(Yes.)|52|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: conversation:ka'het: remnant|	(Not now.)|53|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: conversation:ka'het: remnant|	You ask around more than a dozen people, but none of them seems to be aware of what you're talking about. Either the information is too confidential to be given to a stranger like you, or you didn't ask the right people.|57|0
units.english: You ask around more than a dozen people, but none of them seems to be aware of what you're talking about. Either the information is too confidential to be given to a stranger like you, or you didn't ask the right people.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro a più di una dozzina di persone, ma nessuna sembra sapere di cosa stai parlando. O l'informazione è troppo riservata per essere data a uno straniero come te, o non hai chiesto alle persone giuste.

units.id: conversation:ka'het: remnant|	You ask around more than a dozen people, but none of them seems to be aware of what you're talking about. Perhaps you might have more luck asking Taely on Viminal.|60|0
units.english: You ask around more than a dozen people, but none of them seems to be aware of what you're talking about. Perhaps you might have more luck asking Taely on Viminal.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro a più di una dozzina di persone, ma nessuna sembra sapere di cosa stai parlando. Forse potresti avere più fortuna chiedendo a Taely su Viminal.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|Do you want to ask Taely about the section of space south of the Ember Waste, the Graveyard, and its inhabitants?|106|0
units.english: Do you want to ask Taely about the section of space south of the Ember Waste, the Graveyard, and its inhabitants?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere a Taely della sezione di spazio a sud della Distesa di Braci, il Cimitero, e dei suoi abitanti?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	(Yes.)|108|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	(Not now.)|109|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	You find Taely inside one of the outer hangars of the shipyard, apparently teaching a small group of people how to make basic repairs on an Albatross. You sit on a bench waiting for her to finish her lesson, after which she walks over to you. "Hello, <first>!" she says. "Is there something I can help you with?"|111|0
units.english: You find Taely inside one of the outer hangars of the shipyard, apparently teaching a small group of people how to make basic repairs on an Albatross. You sit on a bench waiting for her to finish her lesson, after which she walks over to you. "Hello, <first>!" she says. "Is there something I can help you with?"
units.italian: Trovi Taely dentro uno degli hangar esterni del cantiere, che a quanto pare sta insegnando a un piccolo gruppo di persone come fare riparazioni di base su un Albatross. Ti siedi su una panca ad aspettare che finisca la lezione, dopo di che viene verso di te. "Ciao, <first>!" dice. "C'è qualcosa in cui posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"I'm here because I need to ask you a few questions," you reply.|112|0
units.english: "I'm here because I need to ask you a few questions," you reply.
units.italian: "Sono qui perché devo farti qualche domanda," rispondi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	As she sits near you, you start explaining to her the area you reached, including the weird alien ships that attacked you with weapons similar to the ones the Remnant possess, although this doesn't seem to be news for her. "We know of the existence of the Ka'het, the aliens you encountered, since we first reached the Ember Waste. We found many of their shells within our planets, crashed there thousands, perhaps even tens of thousands of years before our arrival, but some of their outfits survived long enough for us to reverse engineer these advanced technologies."|113|0
units.english: As she sits near you, you start explaining to her the area you reached, including the weird alien ships that attacked you with weapons similar to the ones the Remnant possess, although this doesn't seem to be news for her. "We know of the existence of the Ka'het, the aliens you encountered, since we first reached the Ember Waste. We found many of their shells within our planets, crashed there thousands, perhaps even tens of thousands of years before our arrival, but some of their outfits survived long enough for us to reverse engineer these advanced technologies."
units.italian: Mentre si siede accanto a te, cominci a spiegarle la zona che hai raggiunto, comprese le strane navi aliene che ti hanno attaccato con armi simili a quelle dei Remnant, anche se la cosa non sembra una novità per lei. "Conosciamo l'esistenza dei Ka'het, gli alieni che hai incontrato, da quando abbiamo raggiunto la Distesa di Braci. Abbiamo trovato molti dei loro gusci dentro i nostri pianeti, schiantati lì migliaia, forse decine di migliaia di anni prima del nostro arrivo, ma alcuni dei loro equipaggiamenti sono sopravvissuti abbastanza a lungo da permetterci di ricostruire queste tecnologie avanzate."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Then," she continues, "a few hundred years ago, a scout fleet arrived in a system where some Ka'het were still alive. They attacked our fleet instantly with EMP Torpedoes that quickly disabled two Starlings. The Starlings couldn't recover quickly enough to survive, and the only remaining ship could do nothing but flee as soon as possible."|114|0
units.english: "Then," she continues, "a few hundred years ago, a scout fleet arrived in a system where some Ka'het were still alive. They attacked our fleet instantly with EMP Torpedoes that quickly disabled two Starlings. The Starlings couldn't recover quickly enough to survive, and the only remaining ship could do nothing but flee as soon as possible."
units.italian: "Poi," continua, "qualche centinaio di anni fa, una flotta di esplorazione arrivò in un sistema dove alcuni Ka'het erano ancora vivi. Attaccarono subito la nostra flotta con siluri EMP che neutralizzarono in fretta due Starling. Le Starling non riuscirono a riprendersi abbastanza in fretta da sopravvivere, e l'unica nave rimasta non poté fare altro che fuggire il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Which technology did you recover from the crashed Ka'het?"|116|0
units.english: "Which technology did you recover from the crashed Ka'het?"
units.italian: "Quale tecnologia avete recuperato dai Ka'het schiantati?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"|118|0
units.english: "Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, perché li hai chiamati 'gusci' e non navi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Have the Ka'het ever attacked the Remnant planets?"|120|0
units.english: "Have the Ka'het ever attacked the Remnant planets?"
units.italian: "I Ka'het hanno mai attaccato i pianeti dei Remnant?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Actually, we never met any living Ka'het in the Ember Waste at all. The shells we found had similar capabilities to the quantum keystone, meaning they could pass through the wormholes, so we don't know for sure why they remained in the Graveyard. Perhaps they aren't aware of their skills, or maybe they lost them over time."|121|0
units.english: "Actually, we never met any living Ka'het in the Ember Waste at all. The shells we found had similar capabilities to the quantum keystone, meaning they could pass through the wormholes, so we don't know for sure why they remained in the Graveyard. Perhaps they aren't aware of their skills, or maybe they lost them over time."
units.italian: "In realtà non abbiamo mai incontrato nessun Ka'het vivo nella Distesa di Braci. I gusci che abbiamo trovato avevano capacità simili a quelle della Pietra Chiave Quantistica, il che significa che potevano attraversare i cunicoli, quindi non sappiamo con certezza perché siano rimasti nel Cimitero. Forse non sono consapevoli delle loro capacità, o magari le hanno perse col tempo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"|123|0
units.english: "Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, perché li hai chiamati 'gusci' e non navi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Back then we found large numbers of their EMP Torpedoes, most of which were in nearly pristine condition; their internal mechanisms were also simple enough that we were able to reproduce them perfectly. We couldn't do the same with the other surviving systems in the shells, but their tech has been a source of inspiration for centuries."|126|0
units.english: "Back then we found large numbers of their EMP Torpedoes, most of which were in nearly pristine condition; their internal mechanisms were also simple enough that we were able to reproduce them perfectly. We couldn't do the same with the other surviving systems in the shells, but their tech has been a source of inspiration for centuries."
units.italian: "A quei tempi trovammo un gran numero dei loro siluri EMP, la maggior parte in condizioni quasi intatte; anche i loro meccanismi interni erano abbastanza semplici da permetterci di riprodurli perfettamente. Non siamo riusciti a fare lo stesso con gli altri sistemi sopravvissuti nei gusci, ma la loro tecnologia è una fonte di ispirazione da secoli."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"|128|0
units.english: "Wait, why did you call them 'shells' and not ships?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, perché li hai chiamati 'gusci' e non navi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"You see, <first>," she says, "the Ka'het aren't normal spaceships. The debris we found were artificial exoskeletons, built around huge living beings; it's unlikely a species that big could have developed that sort of technology, so we presume someone must have created it for them. We call them the Builders.|130|0
units.english: "You see, <first>," she says, "the Ka'het aren't normal spaceships. The debris we found were artificial exoskeletons, built around huge living beings; it's unlikely a species that big could have developed that sort of technology, so we presume someone must have created it for them. We call them the Builders.
units.italian: "Vedi, <first>," dice, "i Ka'het non sono navi spaziali normali. I detriti che abbiamo trovato erano esoscheletri artificiali, costruiti intorno a enormi esseri viventi; è improbabile che una specie così grande potesse sviluppare quel tipo di tecnologia, quindi presumiamo che qualcuno l'abbia creata per loro. Li chiamiamo i Costruttori.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	"After we lost the first scout ships in the Graveyard, the prefects decided that we should continue to scout the region but take necessary precautions. Thanks to those protocols, some of which are still applied today, we were able to extensively explore most of the Graveyard and decipher a good amount of the written language we found. There is still much we have yet to discover."|131|0
units.english: "After we lost the first scout ships in the Graveyard, the prefects decided that we should continue to scout the region but take necessary precautions. Thanks to those protocols, some of which are still applied today, we were able to extensively explore most of the Graveyard and decipher a good amount of the written language we found. There is still much we have yet to discover."
units.italian: "Dopo aver perso le prime navi di esplorazione nel Cimitero, i prefetti decisero che avremmo continuato a esplorare la regione ma prendendo le precauzioni necessarie. Grazie a quei protocolli, alcuni dei quali sono ancora in uso oggi, siamo riusciti a esplorare a fondo gran parte del Cimitero e a decifrare una buona quantità della lingua scritta che abbiamo trovato. C'è ancora molto che dobbiamo scoprire."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|	You discuss the Graveyard with Taely for a while longer until one of the people she was talking to earlier comes closer and shows her something on a data pad. "I have to go now, Captain," she tells you. "Good luck."|132|0
units.english: You discuss the Graveyard with Taely for a while longer until one of the people she was talking to earlier comes closer and shows her something on a data pad. "I have to go now, Captain," she tells you. "Good luck."
units.italian: Discuti del Cimitero con Taely per un altro po', finché una delle persone con cui parlava prima non si avvicina e le mostra qualcosa su un datapad. "Ora devo andare, capitano," ti dice. "Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|log|135|0
units.english: Asked Taely about the Graveyard and the Ka'het and learned of the Remnant's previous contacts between them.
units.italian: Ho chiesto a Taely del Cimitero e dei Ka'het e ho saputo dei contatti precedenti dei Remnant con loro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Ka'het: Remnant 1B|log|136|0
units.english: The Ka'het are a species which live in the Graveyard, an area south of the Ember Waste. They are large lifeforms which can travel in space using artificial exoskeletons and will attack anyone on sight, even other Ka'het.
units.italian: I Ka'het sono una specie che vive nel Cimitero, una zona a sud della Distesa di Braci. Sono grandi forme di vita che possono viaggiare nello spazio usando esoscheletri artificiali e attaccano chiunque a vista, persino altri Ka'het.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|150|0
units.english: Here the Ka'het attacks were limited to the inhabited settlements; had they also destroyed the mining bases and the unmanned vessels, Parii'het would have run out of supplies thousands of years ago.
units.italian: Qui gli attacchi dei Ka'het si limitarono agli insediamenti abitati; se avessero distrutto anche le basi minerarie e i vascelli senza equipaggio, Parii'het sarebbe rimasta senza rifornimenti migliaia di anni fa.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|152|0
units.english: This planet appears to have been home to one of the largest Builder research centers, which focused on studying the anomaly in the system. Had they found out how to stabilize it and use it as a wormhole, perhaps their species would have survived and spread to the rest of the Ember Waste.
units.italian: Questo pianeta sembra essere stato la sede di uno dei più grandi centri di ricerca dei Costruttori, che si concentrava sullo studio dell'anomalia nel sistema. Se avessero scoperto come stabilizzarla e usarla come cunicolo, forse la loro specie sarebbe sopravvissuta e si sarebbe diffusa nel resto della Distesa di Braci.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|154|0
units.english: The main purpose of Ceilia'sei was to act as some sort of anti-missile platform, but when the Ka'het invaded a second time, the station had no way to defend against their deadly Ravager Beams, and the station's defense systems were subsequently lost forever.
units.italian: Lo scopo principale di Ceilia'sei era fungere da una specie di piattaforma antimissile, ma quando i Ka'het invasero una seconda volta, la stazione non aveva modo di difendersi dai loro letali Raggi Devastatori, e i sistemi difensivi della stazione andarono persi per sempre.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|156|0
units.english: This moon was also home for the second Ka'het wave, which, same as the first, refused to obey their creators. It had been terraformed to make it a more appealing place to live, but after their civilization collapsed the moon began to return to its natural state. When it reverted to its original sub-zero temperatures, the facilities stopped working, and the Ka'het production in this site came to an end.
units.italian: Questa luna fu anche la sede della seconda ondata di Ka'het, che, come la prima, rifiutò di obbedire ai propri creatori. Era stata terraformata per renderla un luogo più attraente dove vivere, ma dopo il crollo della loro civiltà la luna cominciò a tornare al suo stato naturale. Quando tornò alle sue temperature sotto zero originali, le strutture smisero di funzionare, e la produzione di Ka'het in questo sito si fermò.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|158|0
units.english: As it was designed to be crewed as minimally as possible, only a tiny fraction of Letis'sei station was inhabitable. The rest of the station was instead dedicated to advanced computing and targeting systems, most of which are still intact today.
units.italian: Poiché era progettata per avere un equipaggio il più ridotto possibile, solo una piccola frazione della stazione Letis'sei era abitabile. Il resto era invece dedicato a sistemi avanzati di calcolo e puntamento, la maggior parte dei quali è ancora intatta oggi.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|160|0
units.english: For most of the intervening millennia between the Builders' achievement of spaceflight and their extinction, Osaeli was the de facto capital of the Builders, a key part of their economy and society. The first Het station was constructed orbiting this planet's star with the purpose of protecting them from any external threat.
units.italian: Per la maggior parte dei millenni intercorsi tra il raggiungimento del volo spaziale da parte dei Costruttori e la loro estinzione, Osaeli fu la capitale di fatto dei Costruttori, una parte chiave della loro economia e della loro società. La prima stazione Het fu costruita in orbita attorno alla stella di questo pianeta con lo scopo di proteggerli da qualsiasi minaccia esterna.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|162|0
units.english: Thanks to their earlier exploration efforts, this was where the Builders encountered the first lifeforms that evolved outside their home planet. While the climate was drastically different from that of the Builders' homeworld, the fruits the local flora produced were popular enough for Palarei to become a major farming planet.
units.italian: Grazie ai loro precedenti sforzi di esplorazione, fu qui che i Costruttori incontrarono le prime forme di vita evolute fuori dal loro pianeta d'origine. Anche se il clima era radicalmente diverso da quello del mondo natale dei Costruttori, i frutti prodotti dalla flora locale erano abbastanza apprezzati perché Palarei diventasse un importante pianeta agricolo.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|164|0
units.english: Parii'het was almost finished when the invasion broke out, and already capable of creating Ka'het. Thanks to the mining on Alix and the occasional asteroid mine operated by the Mar drones, most of the facilities are still fully operational to this day.
units.italian: Parii'het era quasi finita quando scoppiò l'invasione, e già capace di creare Ka'het. Grazie alle miniere su Alix e alla miniera di asteroidi occasionale gestita dai droni Mar, la maggior parte delle strutture è ancora pienamente operativa oggi.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|166|0
units.english: As it was mainly used for fishing, the settlements on this planet were never as advanced as the ones on nearby worlds, so when the Ka'het arrived, there was basically nothing to stop them: after a few attacks, the planet was uninhabited again.
units.italian: Poiché era usato principalmente per la pesca, gli insediamenti su questo pianeta non furono mai avanzati come quelli dei mondi vicini, quindi quando arrivarono i Ka'het non c'era praticamente nulla a fermarli: dopo qualche attacco, il pianeta tornò disabitato.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|168|0
units.english: This was the only Het station the Builders ever completed, orbiting Giribea. As the young Ka'heta reach their "Age of Assembly," strange, lanky machines start molding an exoskeleton onto their bodies right away. As the Ka'heta grow, their exoskeleton is expanded and various outfits are added, transforming them into living weapons.
units.italian: Questa fu l'unica stazione Het che i Costruttori completarono, in orbita attorno a Giribea. Quando i giovani Ka'heta raggiungono la loro "Età dell'Assemblaggio", strane macchine allampanate cominciano subito a modellare un esoscheletro sui loro corpi. Man mano che i Ka'heta crescono, il loro esoscheletro viene ampliato e vi si aggiungono vari equipaggiamenti, trasformandoli in armi viventi.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|170|0
units.english: This was the Builder homeworld; both the place where their journey began and where it ended. After a dozen millennia of underpopulation, the Ka'het arrival forced them to withdraw from the planet entirely. As one of the few remaining planets capable of sustaining farming, this was their last stronghold, falling centuries after the invasion begun.
units.italian: Questo era il mondo natale dei Costruttori; sia il luogo dove il loro viaggio iniziò sia dove finì. Dopo una dozzina di millenni di spopolamento, l'arrivo dei Ka'het li costrinse a ritirarsi del tutto dal pianeta. Essendo uno dei pochi pianeti rimasti capaci di sostenere l'agricoltura, fu la loro ultima roccaforte, caduta secoli dopo l'inizio dell'invasione.

units.id: event:graveyard insights|add|172|0
units.english: Soon after the beginning the invasion, an attack on some sort of advanced nuclear facility started a meltdown; the fallout quickly spread across most of the planet, leaving all Builder settlements uninhabitable.
units.italian: Poco dopo l'inizio dell'invasione, un attacco a una specie di impianto nucleare avanzato provocò una fusione; le ricadute si diffusero rapidamente su gran parte del pianeta, rendendo inabitabili tutti gli insediamenti dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris|When you enter this suspiciously empty system, your attention is drawn to your ship's scanners. The proximity detection system is going off, suggesting that something sizable is close to your ship, although whatever it is you can't see it as you look out your cockpit.|183|0
units.english: When you enter this suspiciously empty system, your attention is drawn to your ship's scanners. The proximity detection system is going off, suggesting that something sizable is close to your ship, although whatever it is you can't see it as you look out your cockpit.
units.italian: Quando entri in questo sistema sospettosamente vuoto, la tua attenzione è attirata dagli scanner della nave. Il sistema di rilevamento di prossimità impazzisce, suggerendo che qualcosa di considerevole è vicino alla nave, anche se qualunque cosa sia non riesci a vederla guardando fuori dalla cabina.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris|	You turn your ship around and open the hatch of your cargo hold, catching the object. When you go to inspect it, you see a small, extremely dark piece of debris that almost looks to be covered in vantablack, but it doesn't resemble any alloy you've seen on a spaceship or station, bearing semblance to both a crystal and a metallic structure.|184|0
units.english: You turn your ship around and open the hatch of your cargo hold, catching the object. When you go to inspect it, you see a small, extremely dark piece of debris that almost looks to be covered in vantablack, but it doesn't resemble any alloy you've seen on a spaceship or station, bearing semblance to both a crystal and a metallic structure.
units.italian: Giri la nave e apri il portello della stiva, catturando l'oggetto. Quando vai a esaminarlo, vedi un piccolo frammento estremamente scuro che sembra quasi coperto di nerissimo assoluto, ma non assomiglia a nessuna lega che tu abbia visto su una nave o una stazione, e somiglia sia a un cristallo sia a una struttura metallica.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris|	In one particular corner you see that there is a small, barely recognizable tube, badly damaged but with a few intact wires creeping out. After tinkering a bit with the wires, you manage to connect the debris to your ship's secondary power systems. It barely uses any energy at all, but you can feel the air around it starting to get slightly colder.|186|0
units.english: In one particular corner you see that there is a small, barely recognizable tube, badly damaged but with a few intact wires creeping out. After tinkering a bit with the wires, you manage to connect the debris to your ship's secondary power systems. It barely uses any energy at all, but you can feel the air around it starting to get slightly colder.
units.italian: In un angolo in particolare vedi un piccolo tubo a malapena riconoscibile, gravemente danneggiato ma con alcuni fili intatti che ne escono. Dopo aver armeggiato un po' con i fili, riesci a collegare il frammento ai sistemi di alimentazione secondari della nave. Consuma appena un po' di energia, ma senti l'aria intorno diventare leggermente più fredda.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris|	You unplug it and store the debris in a separate part of your ship. Maybe some alien species could tell you about it, if you were to bring it to them.|187|0
units.english: You unplug it and store the debris in a separate part of your ship. Maybe some alien species could tell you about it, if you were to bring it to them.
units.italian: Lo scolleghi e metti il frammento in una parte separata della nave. Forse qualche specie aliena potrebbe dirti qualcosa, se glielo portassi.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|Do you want to show the Remnant the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?|201|0
units.english: Do you want to show the Remnant the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?
units.italian: Vuoi mostrare ai Remnant il frammento che hai trovato nel sistema abbandonato e vuoto, e chiedere cosa sanno?

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|	(Yes.)|203|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|	(Not now.)|204|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|	A group of Remnant researchers quickly come to your ship when you mention you've found an odd piece of technology, but look disappointed and some even frown when they see the debris, as you explain the system you found it and how it reacted to being fed some energy.|206|0
units.english: A group of Remnant researchers quickly come to your ship when you mention you've found an odd piece of technology, but look disappointed and some even frown when they see the debris, as you explain the system you found it and how it reacted to being fed some energy.
units.italian: Un gruppo di ricercatori Remnant arriva in fretta alla tua nave quando dici di aver trovato uno strano pezzo di tecnologia, ma sembrano delusi e alcuni aggrottano le sopracciglia quando vedono il frammento, mentre spieghi in quale sistema l'hai trovato e come ha reagito quando gli hai dato un po' di energia.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|	"We've found many fragments like this one drifting in that system over the decades. It could maybe improve our cooling systems, but we could never begin to comprehend how it works," one of them says.|207|0
units.english: "We've found many fragments like this one drifting in that system over the decades. It could maybe improve our cooling systems, but we could never begin to comprehend how it works," one of them says.
units.italian: "Abbiamo trovato molti frammenti come questo che vagavano in quel sistema nel corso dei decenni. Potrebbe forse migliorare i nostri sistemi di raffreddamento, ma non siamo mai riusciti a capire come funzioni," dice uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Remnant|	They say they don't know any more than you do about the object, but ask that you share with them any information on how it works, should you find out.|208|0
units.english: They say they don't know any more than you do about the object, but ask that you share with them any information on how it works, should you find out.
units.italian: Dicono di non saperne più di te sull'oggetto, ma ti chiedono di condividere con loro qualsiasi informazione su come funziona, se dovessi scoprirlo.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|Do you want to show the Hai the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?|222|0
units.english: Do you want to show the Hai the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?
units.italian: Vuoi mostrare agli Hai il frammento che hai trovato nel sistema abbandonato e vuoto, e chiedere cosa sanno?

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	(Yes.)|224|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	(Not now.)|225|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	You ask around for a bit, and eventually are lead to a workshop where some Hai engineers and shipwrights are gathered.|227|0
units.english: You ask around for a bit, and eventually are lead to a workshop where some Hai engineers and shipwrights are gathered.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro per un po', e alla fine vieni portato in un'officina dove sono radunati alcuni ingegneri e costruttori navali Hai.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	"Greetings, human friend! How may we help you?"|228|0
units.english: "Greetings, human friend! How may we help you?"
units.italian: "Salve, amico umano! Come possiamo aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	You show them the piece of debris, and they observe it for a bit, but after just a few minutes of handling it they conclude they don't have the necessary equipment to analyze it.|229|0
units.english: You show them the piece of debris, and they observe it for a bit, but after just a few minutes of handling it they conclude they don't have the necessary equipment to analyze it.
units.italian: Mostri loro il frammento, e lo osservano per un po', ma dopo appena qualche minuto di manipolazione concludono di non avere l'attrezzatura necessaria per analizzarlo.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Hai|	"Sorry, whatever it is that you've found, it is too advanced a technology for our systems," they say. You thank them for their time, and head back to your ship.|230|0
units.english: "Sorry, whatever it is that you've found, it is too advanced a technology for our systems," they say. You thank them for their time, and head back to your ship.
units.italian: "Scusa, qualunque cosa tu abbia trovato, è una tecnologia troppo avanzata per i nostri sistemi," dicono. Li ringrazi del tempo e torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|Do you want to show the members of the Coalition the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?|244|0
units.english: Do you want to show the members of the Coalition the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?
units.italian: Vuoi mostrare ai membri della Coalizione il frammento che hai trovato nel sistema abbandonato e vuoto, e chiedere cosa sanno?

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	(Yes.)|246|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	(Not now.)|247|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	After asking around, you're directed to a large Heliarch building, where several of them are standing guard, weapons in hand, while others are performing maintenance on a chunk of hull plating. Judging by its size, it may be a warehouse for their weapons and outfits. "Of assistance how may we be, kind visitor?" One of the agents asks.|249|0
units.english: After asking around, you're directed to a large Heliarch building, where several of them are standing guard, weapons in hand, while others are performing maintenance on a chunk of hull plating. Judging by its size, it may be a warehouse for their weapons and outfits. "Of assistance how may we be, kind visitor?" One of the agents asks.
units.italian: Dopo aver chiesto in giro, vieni indirizzato a un grande edificio degli Heliarchs, dove diversi di loro montano la guardia, armi in mano, mentre altri fanno manutenzione su un pezzo di lamiera dello scafo. A giudicare dalle dimensioni, potrebbe essere un magazzino per le loro armi e il loro equipaggiamento. "Di che aiuto possiamo esserle, gentile visitatore?" chiede uno degli agenti.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	You show them the debris, and explain where you've found it. They are shocked when they see it, but don't attempt to perform any tests on it. "A piece of Quarg technology, this is!" they say, asking again for you to explain where exactly you found it, as they make sure to write it all down this time.|250|0
units.english: You show them the debris, and explain where you've found it. They are shocked when they see it, but don't attempt to perform any tests on it. "A piece of Quarg technology, this is!" they say, asking again for you to explain where exactly you found it, as they make sure to write it all down this time.
units.italian: Mostri loro il frammento e spieghi dove l'hai trovato. Restano scioccati quando lo vedono, ma non tentano di fare alcun test. "Un pezzo di tecnologia Quarg, questo è!" dicono, chiedendoti di nuovo di spiegare dove esattamente l'hai trovato, mentre questa volta si assicurano di annotare tutto.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	They then say that they have experience with technology they managed to steal from the Quarg during their war, and that the debris is the remnant of a somewhat common component of Quarg equipment. They also note that what you've found has deteriorated much compared to what they have acquired for themselves, and that it most likely can't even reach a fraction of its optimal cooling output.|251|0
units.english: They then say that they have experience with technology they managed to steal from the Quarg during their war, and that the debris is the remnant of a somewhat common component of Quarg equipment. They also note that what you've found has deteriorated much compared to what they have acquired for themselves, and that it most likely can't even reach a fraction of its optimal cooling output.
units.italian: Dicono poi di avere esperienza con la tecnologia che sono riusciti a rubare ai Quarg durante la loro guerra, e che il frammento è ciò che resta di un componente abbastanza comune dell'equipaggiamento Quarg. Fanno anche notare che quello che hai trovato si è deteriorato molto rispetto a quello che hanno acquisito loro, e che molto probabilmente non riesce nemmeno a raggiungere una frazione della sua capacità di raffreddamento ottimale.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Coalition|	You thank them for their time and the explanation, and head back to your ship.|252|0
units.english: You thank them for their time and the explanation, and head back to your ship.
units.italian: Li ringrazi del tempo e della spiegazione, e torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|Do you want to show the Quarg the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?|267|0
units.english: Do you want to show the Quarg the piece of debris you found in the abandoned, empty system, and ask them what they know about it?
units.italian: Vuoi mostrare ai Quarg il frammento che hai trovato nel sistema abbandonato e vuoto, e chiedere cosa sanno?

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	(Yes.)|269|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	(Not now.)|270|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|log|274|0
units.english: The Builders inhabited the Graveyard millennia ago, but have since become extinct. They developed some sort of weapon, called the "Ka'het," which stopped obeying their orders and rebelled against them.
units.italian: I Costruttori abitarono il Cimitero millenni fa, ma da allora si sono estinti. Svilupparono una specie di arma, chiamata "Ka'het", che smise di obbedire ai loro ordini e si ribellò contro di loro.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|log|275|0
units.english: According to the Quarg, the Ka'het were initially a weapon created by the Builders, which then rebelled and led them to extinction. Even in the millennia that passed, they are still being produced in the Graveyard.
units.italian: Secondo i Quarg, i Ka'het erano inizialmente un'arma creata dai Costruttori, che poi si ribellò e li portò all'estinzione. Anche nei millenni passati, vengono ancora prodotti nel Cimitero.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	Walking down the principal, alien-looking hall, you decide to stop one of the few Quarg you see there. "Hello, human. How may I be of service?" the Quarg says. You show it the piece of debris, and ask what it knows about it. It is momentarily stunned when you show the dark piece of technology, calmly taking it into its own hands after recovering. "A fragment of our ships, is what it is. A remnant of part of our equipment. Thank you for returning it to us."|276|0
units.english: Walking down the principal, alien-looking hall, you decide to stop one of the few Quarg you see there. "Hello, human. How may I be of service?" the Quarg says. You show it the piece of debris, and ask what it knows about it. It is momentarily stunned when you show the dark piece of technology, calmly taking it into its own hands after recovering. "A fragment of our ships, is what it is. A remnant of part of our equipment. Thank you for returning it to us."
units.italian: Percorrendo il corridoio principale, dall'aspetto alieno, decidi di fermare uno dei pochi Quarg che vedi lì. "Salve, umano. Come posso esserti utile?" dice il Quarg. Gli mostri il frammento e chiedi cosa sa. Resta momentaneamente sbalordito quando gli mostri quel pezzo scuro di tecnologia, e dopo essersi ripreso lo prende con calma tra le mani. "Un frammento delle nostre navi, è questo. Ciò che resta di una parte del nostro equipaggiamento. Grazie per avercelo riportato."

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	You continue by telling it about your travels in the section of the galaxy where you found the debris, and asking what it knows of the place and the hostiles that inhabit it.|277|0
units.english: You continue by telling it about your travels in the section of the galaxy where you found the debris, and asking what it knows of the place and the hostiles that inhabit it.
units.italian: Continui raccontandogli dei tuoi viaggi nella sezione della galassia dove hai trovato il frammento, e chiedendo cosa sa del posto e degli ostili che lo abitano.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"Ah, you encountered the remains of the Builders. Millennia ago, they were a flourishing and thoughtful empire, but hostile contacts forced them to grow fearful and hawkish. Although they never did attack us, they always refrained from accepting our aid, and attempted to relocate a greater distance from us and our ringworld there, in worlds easier to maintain than ones they were closer to."|278|0
units.english: "Ah, you encountered the remains of the Builders. Millennia ago, they were a flourishing and thoughtful empire, but hostile contacts forced them to grow fearful and hawkish. Although they never did attack us, they always refrained from accepting our aid, and attempted to relocate a greater distance from us and our ringworld there, in worlds easier to maintain than ones they were closer to."
units.italian: "Ah, hai incontrato i resti dei Costruttori. Millenni fa erano un impero fiorente e riflessivo, ma contatti ostili li costrinsero a diventare timorosi e bellicosi. Anche se non ci attaccarono mai, si astennero sempre dall'accettare il nostro aiuto, e cercarono di trasferirsi a una distanza maggiore da noi e dal nostro mondo ad anello, in mondi più facili da mantenere di quelli vicini a noi."

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"Who were these hostile contacts?"|280|0
units.english: "Who were these hostile contacts?"
units.italian: "Chi erano questi contatti ostili?"

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"What happened to the Builders?"|281|0
units.english: "What happened to the Builders?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo ai Costruttori?"

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"Long ago, few ships coming from a foreign species had reached that region of space, using some of the wormholes leading there. They belonged to a young race who foolishly decided to attack the Builders instead of learning from them. Their ships were stronger than any vessel the Builders possessed at the time, but were also few enough in number to be destroyed by the Builders."|283|0
units.english: "Long ago, few ships coming from a foreign species had reached that region of space, using some of the wormholes leading there. They belonged to a young race who foolishly decided to attack the Builders instead of learning from them. Their ships were stronger than any vessel the Builders possessed at the time, but were also few enough in number to be destroyed by the Builders."
units.italian: "Molto tempo fa, poche navi provenienti da una specie straniera avevano raggiunto quella regione dello spazio, usando alcuni dei cunicoli che portano lì. Appartenevano a una giovane razza che decise scioccamente di attaccare i Costruttori invece di imparare da loro. Le loro navi erano più forti di qualsiasi vascello i Costruttori possedessero allora, ma erano anche abbastanza poche da poter essere distrutte dai Costruttori."

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"What happened after that?"|285|0
units.english: "What happened after that?"
units.italian: "Cosa è successo dopo?"

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	The Quarg stops for a few seconds before continuing, as if it was reflecting on something. "For many millennia they grew, developing brilliant pieces of technology. Then, compelled by their past experiences, they began creating weapons not only to defend themselves, but also to retaliate; these 'Ka'het,' as they named them, turned on their creators shortly after they were complete.|287|0
units.english: The Quarg stops for a few seconds before continuing, as if it was reflecting on something. "For many millennia they grew, developing brilliant pieces of technology. Then, compelled by their past experiences, they began creating weapons not only to defend themselves, but also to retaliate; these 'Ka'het,' as they named them, turned on their creators shortly after they were complete.
units.italian: Il Quarg si ferma per qualche secondo prima di continuare, come se stesse riflettendo su qualcosa. "Per molti millenni crebbero, sviluppando brillanti pezzi di tecnologia. Poi, spinti dalle loro esperienze passate, cominciarono a creare armi non solo per difendersi, ma anche per rappresaglia; questi 'Ka'het', come li chiamarono, si rivoltarono contro i loro creatori poco dopo essere stati completati.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"For a few more centuries the Builders lasted, before falling under their very own hubris. Their space is still populated by the Ka'het they gave birth to through the immense facilities they assembled, a being that does not yet possess a vast intelligence." The Quarg bows, still holding on to the piece of debris, and seems to be preparing to walk away.|288|0
units.english: "For a few more centuries the Builders lasted, before falling under their very own hubris. Their space is still populated by the Ka'het they gave birth to through the immense facilities they assembled, a being that does not yet possess a vast intelligence." The Quarg bows, still holding on to the piece of debris, and seems to be preparing to walk away.
units.italian: "Per qualche altro secolo i Costruttori resistettero, prima di cadere sotto la loro stessa tracotanza. Il loro spazio è ancora popolato dai Ka'het che hanno generato attraverso le immense strutture che avevano assemblato, un essere che non possiede ancora una vasta intelligenza." Il Quarg si inchina, tenendo ancora il frammento, e sembra prepararsi ad allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	"What happened to your ringworld in the Graveyard? Was it in the system I found that thing?"|290|0
units.english: "What happened to your ringworld in the Graveyard? Was it in the system I found that thing?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo al vostro mondo ad anello nel Cimitero? Era nel sistema in cui ho trovato quella cosa?"

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	(Let the Quarg walk away.)|291|0
units.english: (Let the Quarg walk away.)
units.italian: (Lascia che il Quarg se ne vada.)

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|log|294|0
units.english: Asked the Quarg about the history of the Graveyard, and have learned about the previous inhabitants of the region, the Builders.
units.italian: Ho chiesto ai Quarg la storia del Cimitero, e ho saputo dei precedenti abitanti della regione, i Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	For the briefest moment, you see patches of skin all over the Quarg's body radically shift from the usual gray to red and blue, some spots mixing into purple, and you could have sworn you saw some part of the iris on its eyes "open" very slightly.|295|0
units.english: For the briefest moment, you see patches of skin all over the Quarg's body radically shift from the usual gray to red and blue, some spots mixing into purple, and you could have sworn you saw some part of the iris on its eyes "open" very slightly.
units.italian: Per un istante brevissimo, vedi chiazze di pelle su tutto il corpo del Quarg passare radicalmente dal solito grigio al rosso e al blu, con alcune macchie che si mescolano in viola, e giureresti di aver visto una parte dell'iride dei suoi occhi "aprirsi" leggerissimamente.

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	After coming back to normal, it ponders for a second, then says, "It was in that system, and it was lost, millennia after the Builders had perished."|296|0
units.english: After coming back to normal, it ponders for a second, then says, "It was in that system, and it was lost, millennia after the Builders had perished."
units.italian: Dopo essere tornato alla normalità, riflette per un secondo, poi dice: "Era in quel sistema, ed è andato perduto, millenni dopo che i Costruttori erano periti."

units.id: mission:Ringworld Debris: Quarg|	It doesn't seem too inclined on answering any more questions, and swiftly walks away.|297|0
units.english: It doesn't seem too inclined on answering any more questions, and swiftly walks away.
units.italian: Non sembra molto propenso a rispondere ad altre domande, e si allontana in fretta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|name|302|0
units.english: Odd Ka'het
units.italian: Ka'het strano

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|description|303|0
units.english: Find a Remnant who can help you with the downed Ka'het and accompany them to <destination>.
units.italian: Trova un Remnant che possa aiutarti con il Ka'het abbattuto e accompagnalo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|After setting course toward the surface, you feel comfortable enough to leave the control panel and let the autopilot do the job. It's a calm, cloudless night on this part of <planet>; a rare sight in the Graveyard, and indeed in most of the Ember Waste. With all but the essential lights turned off, you catch the opportunity to relax for a few minutes on your chair, watching the evolving landscape below and the night sky above.|317|0
units.english: After setting course toward the surface, you feel comfortable enough to leave the control panel and let the autopilot do the job. It's a calm, cloudless night on this part of <planet>; a rare sight in the Graveyard, and indeed in most of the Ember Waste. With all but the essential lights turned off, you catch the opportunity to relax for a few minutes on your chair, watching the evolving landscape below and the night sky above.
units.italian: Dopo aver impostato la rotta verso la superficie, ti senti abbastanza tranquillo da lasciare il pannello di controllo e lasciar fare al pilota automatico. È una notte calma e senza nuvole in questa parte di <planet>; uno spettacolo raro nel Cimitero, e davvero nella maggior parte della Distesa di Braci. Con tutte le luci tranne quelle essenziali spente, cogli l'occasione per rilassarti qualche minuto sulla sedia, guardando il paesaggio che scorre sotto e il cielo notturno sopra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	Your ship's proximity alert breaks the silence, then falls quiet before you reach the control panel. A quick glance out the window confirms you're still fairly high up, and the ship's radar reveals nothing of interest - at least not currently. You press a couple of buttons to check what your ship recorded, and see what looks like a large mass flicker for a few seconds a hundred meters away from your ship during the alarm.|318|0
units.english: Your ship's proximity alert breaks the silence, then falls quiet before you reach the control panel. A quick glance out the window confirms you're still fairly high up, and the ship's radar reveals nothing of interest - at least not currently. You press a couple of buttons to check what your ship recorded, and see what looks like a large mass flicker for a few seconds a hundred meters away from your ship during the alarm.
units.italian: L'allarme di prossimità della nave rompe il silenzio, poi tace prima che tu raggiunga il pannello di controllo. Una rapida occhiata fuori dal finestrino conferma che sei ancora piuttosto in alto, e il radar della nave non rivela nulla di interessante, almeno non al momento. Premi un paio di pulsanti per controllare cosa ha registrato la nave, e vedi quella che sembra una grande massa tremolare per qualche secondo a cento metri dalla nave durante l'allarme.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Continue the descent.)|320|0
units.english: (Continue the descent.)
units.italian: (Continua la discesa.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Stop my ship and prepare for a fight.)|321|0
units.english: (Stop my ship and prepare for a fight.)
units.italian: (Ferma la nave e preparati a combattere.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Turn around and leave.)|322|0
units.english: (Turn around and leave.)
units.italian: (Gira e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	A few seconds pass before the proximity alert sounds again. And this time, you see it. You shine your ship's floodlights at it, revealing the translucent figure of a partly cloaked Maeri'het. It flickers, its various sections becoming more and less transparent seemingly at random.|324|0
units.english: A few seconds pass before the proximity alert sounds again. And this time, you see it. You shine your ship's floodlights at it, revealing the translucent figure of a partly cloaked Maeri'het. It flickers, its various sections becoming more and less transparent seemingly at random.
units.italian: Passano alcuni secondi prima che l'allarme di prossimità suoni di nuovo. E questa volta, lo vedi. Punti i fari della nave su di esso, rivelando la figura traslucida di un Maeri'het parzialmente occultato. Tremola, e le sue varie sezioni diventano più e meno trasparenti apparentemente a caso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	Even stranger, it isn't facing toward you, nor does it appear to have reacted in any way. It is simply floating next to you, slowly descending as it puffs clouds of vapor from its upper body. There is nothing indicating that it might be ready to attack, though that could change in a matter of seconds.|325|0
units.english: Even stranger, it isn't facing toward you, nor does it appear to have reacted in any way. It is simply floating next to you, slowly descending as it puffs clouds of vapor from its upper body. There is nothing indicating that it might be ready to attack, though that could change in a matter of seconds.
units.italian: Ancora più strano, non è rivolto verso di te, né sembra aver reagito in alcun modo. Fluttua semplicemente accanto a te, scendendo lentamente mentre sbuffa nuvole di vapore dalla parte superiore del corpo. Nulla indica che sia pronto ad attaccare, anche se potrebbe cambiare in questione di secondi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Take my chance and attack it.)|327|0
units.english: (Take my chance and attack it.)
units.italian: (Cogli l'occasione e attaccalo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Move closer, carefully.)|331|0
units.english: (Move closer, carefully.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati, con cautela.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Keep my distance.)|332|0
units.english: (Keep my distance.)
units.italian: (Mantieni la distanza.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Turn around and leave.)|333|0
units.english: (Turn around and leave.)
units.italian: (Gira e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	Minutes pass, and the Maeri'het continues to show no reaction of any kind to your presence. By the time you complete a fly-around, you both have almost reached the ground; a few metallic panels detach from the Ka'het's shell just as it touches down, and balloons start inflating out of the resulting holes.|335|0
units.english: Minutes pass, and the Maeri'het continues to show no reaction of any kind to your presence. By the time you complete a fly-around, you both have almost reached the ground; a few metallic panels detach from the Ka'het's shell just as it touches down, and balloons start inflating out of the resulting holes.
units.italian: Passano i minuti, e il Maeri'het continua a non mostrare alcuna reazione alla tua presenza. Quando completi un giro, siete entrambi quasi a terra; alcuni pannelli metallici si staccano dal guscio del Ka'het proprio mentre tocca il suolo, e dai buchi che si aprono cominciano a gonfiarsi dei palloni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	You warm up your weapons and set the targeting computer on the enemy. With the press of a button you unleash all your wrath on the Ka'het - so much that the first shot seems to encounter no shield, penetrating deep beneath the skin of the slug. The Maeri'het lists to starboard and starts falling rapidly; a few metallic panels detach from its shell right before it reaches the ground, and balloons rapidly inflate out of the resulting holes.|340|0
units.english: You warm up your weapons and set the targeting computer on the enemy. With the press of a button you unleash all your wrath on the Ka'het - so much that the first shot seems to encounter no shield, penetrating deep beneath the skin of the slug. The Maeri'het lists to starboard and starts falling rapidly; a few metallic panels detach from its shell right before it reaches the ground, and balloons rapidly inflate out of the resulting holes.
units.italian: Scaldi le armi e imposti il computer di puntamento sul nemico. Con la pressione di un pulsante scateni tutta la tua furia sul Ka'het, così tanta che il primo colpo sembra non incontrare alcuno scudo, penetrando in profondità sotto la pelle della lumaca. Il Maeri'het si inclina a dritta e comincia a cadere rapidamente; alcuni pannelli metallici si staccano dal suo guscio proprio prima che raggiunga il suolo, e dai buchi che si aprono si gonfiano rapidamente dei palloni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|label|342|0
units.english: attack fleet
units.italian: attack fleet

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	You warm up your weapons and set the targeting computer on the enemy. You unleash all your fleet's wrath on the Ka'het - so much that the first shot seems to encounter no shield, penetrating deep beneath the skin of the slug. The Maeri'het lists to starboard and starts falling rapidly; a few metallic panels detach from its shell right before it reaches the ground, and balloons rapidly inflate out of the resulting holes.|343|0
units.english: You warm up your weapons and set the targeting computer on the enemy. You unleash all your fleet's wrath on the Ka'het - so much that the first shot seems to encounter no shield, penetrating deep beneath the skin of the slug. The Maeri'het lists to starboard and starts falling rapidly; a few metallic panels detach from its shell right before it reaches the ground, and balloons rapidly inflate out of the resulting holes.
units.italian: Scaldi le armi e imposti il computer di puntamento sul nemico. Scateni tutta la furia della tua flotta sul Ka'het, così tanta che il primo colpo sembra non incontrare alcuno scudo, penetrando in profondità sotto la pelle della lumaca. Il Maeri'het si inclina a dritta e comincia a cadere rapidamente; alcuni pannelli metallici si staccano dal suo guscio proprio prima che raggiunga il suolo, e dai buchi che si aprono si gonfiano rapidamente dei palloni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	The Ka'het at last emits an uncomfortably loud whistle, reducing in intensity before disappearing completely. It sits motionless at the bottom of what looks like a dry riverbed, surrounded by nothing but you and the calm night sky.|345|0
units.english: The Ka'het at last emits an uncomfortably loud whistle, reducing in intensity before disappearing completely. It sits motionless at the bottom of what looks like a dry riverbed, surrounded by nothing but you and the calm night sky.
units.italian: Il Ka'het emette finalmente un fischio scomodamente forte, che si attenua prima di sparire del tutto. Resta immobile sul fondo di quello che sembra un letto di fiume prosciugato, circondato da nient'altro che te e il calmo cielo notturno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Report it to the Remnant.)|347|0
units.english: (Report it to the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Riportalo ai Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Blow it into pieces.)|349|0
units.english: (Blow it into pieces.)
units.italian: (Fallo a pezzi.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	(Land next to it and don my EVA suit.)|353|0
units.english: (Land next to it and don my EVA suit.)
units.italian: (Atterra accanto e indossa la tuta EVA.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	You instinctively check your sidearm while walking down the stairway, despite knowing how futile it would be. Despite being the smallest type of Ka'het you have seen, the Maeri'het is still intimidatingly large. No longer cloaked, you notice a fluid coming down from its sides that originates from the slug itself. It covers the entire landing zone, and some of it has almost reached your ship.|354|0
units.english: You instinctively check your sidearm while walking down the stairway, despite knowing how futile it would be. Despite being the smallest type of Ka'het you have seen, the Maeri'het is still intimidatingly large. No longer cloaked, you notice a fluid coming down from its sides that originates from the slug itself. It covers the entire landing zone, and some of it has almost reached your ship.
units.italian: Controlli istintivamente l'arma da fianco mentre scendi le scale, pur sapendo quanto sarebbe inutile. Nonostante sia il tipo più piccolo di Ka'het che tu abbia visto, il Maeri'het è comunque intimidatoriamente grande. Non più occultato, noti un fluido che scende dai suoi fianchi e che proviene dalla lumaca stessa. Copre tutta la zona di atterraggio, e una parte ha quasi raggiunto la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	For an instant, you entertain the thought of looting its outfits. But as if it was reading your mind, the Maeri'het hits you with another cloud of warm, pale vapor, triggering your suit's overheat warning. Defeated, you turn around and climb back to your cockpit.|355|0
units.english: For an instant, you entertain the thought of looting its outfits. But as if it was reading your mind, the Maeri'het hits you with another cloud of warm, pale vapor, triggering your suit's overheat warning. Defeated, you turn around and climb back to your cockpit.
units.italian: Per un istante accarezzi l'idea di saccheggiare il suo equipaggiamento. Ma come se ti leggesse nel pensiero, il Maeri'het ti investe con un'altra nuvola di vapore caldo e pallido, facendo scattare l'allarme di surriscaldamento della tuta. Sconfitto, ti volti e risali in cabina.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	Once the engines are back running you take a second to reason over the best course of action. The choice falls on a trip to Aventine: if there's anyone who will want to hear about this, it has to be Plume's laboratory.|357|0
units.english: Once the engines are back running you take a second to reason over the best course of action. The choice falls on a trip to Aventine: if there's anyone who will want to hear about this, it has to be Plume's laboratory.
units.italian: Una volta riavviati i motori ti prendi un secondo per ragionare sul da farsi. La scelta cade su un viaggio verso Aventine: se c'è qualcuno che vorrà saperne, deve essere il laboratorio di Plume.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|	The Ka'het crumbles under the strength of your firepower, collapsing onto itself within seconds. Some parts of its body are blown away from the carcass, still mostly intact, while the machinery takes more effort to destroy; by the time you're done, nothing is left of it but a puddle of organic material and some scrap metal. After searching through the debris, you eventually find some materials precious enough to sell raw.|364|0
units.english: The Ka'het crumbles under the strength of your firepower, collapsing onto itself within seconds. Some parts of its body are blown away from the carcass, still mostly intact, while the machinery takes more effort to destroy; by the time you're done, nothing is left of it but a puddle of organic material and some scrap metal. After searching through the debris, you eventually find some materials precious enough to sell raw.
units.italian: Il Ka'het crolla sotto la potenza del tuo fuoco, collassando su se stesso in pochi secondi. Alcune parti del corpo vengono staccate dal carcame, ancora in gran parte intatte, mentre i macchinari richiedono più sforzo per essere distrutti; quando hai finito, non resta altro che una pozza di materiale organico e un po' di rottame. Dopo aver frugato tra i detriti, trovi infine alcuni materiali abbastanza preziosi da vendere grezzi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|dialog|367|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you haven't met up with Plume on Aventine, or his ship hasn't arrived yet.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai incontrato Plume su Aventine, o la sua nave non è ancora arrivata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 1|dialog|376|0
units.english: A quick check of the ship identifiers reveals that Plume's ship is currently landing at Pantica. You seize the chance to hail them and bring them up to date with your findings.
units.italian: Un rapido controllo degli identificativi delle navi rivela che la nave di Plume sta atterrando a Pantica. Cogli l'occasione per contattarli e aggiornarli sulle tue scoperte.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|It must be winter here on <planet>: the chilly valleys that normally surround the starport are covered by a thick layer of snow, and you can see your ship's anti-icing fluids being sprayed automatically over the cockpit window. You find Plume waiting for you right on the landing pad he indicated to you on your way down, not far from a group of Pelicans and a lone Gull.|387|0
units.english: It must be winter here on <planet>: the chilly valleys that normally surround the starport are covered by a thick layer of snow, and you can see your ship's anti-icing fluids being sprayed automatically over the cockpit window. You find Plume waiting for you right on the landing pad he indicated to you on your way down, not far from a group of Pelicans and a lone Gull.
units.italian: Qui dev'essere inverno su <planet>: le valli fredde che di solito circondano lo scalo sono coperte da uno spesso strato di neve, e vedi i liquidi antighiaccio della nave spruzzati automaticamente sul finestrino della cabina. Trovi Plume ad aspettarti proprio sulla piattaforma che ti aveva indicato durante la discesa, non lontano da un gruppo di Pelican e da un Gull solitario.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"No better time to skip the pleasantries," he begins, rubbing his arms in the cold. He seems severely under-dressed for the weather. You invite him to come aboard, but he stops at the airlock's door. "I am sorry. This time I already have my ride for the mission. We have prepared the Gull based on your instructions - the machinery we intend to recover from the slug will need an appropriately large cargo hold."|388|0
units.english: "No better time to skip the pleasantries," he begins, rubbing his arms in the cold. He seems severely under-dressed for the weather. You invite him to come aboard, but he stops at the airlock's door. "I am sorry. This time I already have my ride for the mission. We have prepared the Gull based on your instructions - the machinery we intend to recover from the slug will need an appropriately large cargo hold."
units.italian: "Nessun momento migliore per saltare le formalità," esordisce, strofinandosi le braccia per il freddo. Sembra vestito in modo gravemente inadeguato per il clima. Lo inviti a salire a bordo, ma si ferma davanti alla porta della camera di equilibrio. "Mi dispiace. Questa volta ho già il mio mezzo per la missione. Abbiamo preparato il Gull seguendo le tue istruzioni: i macchinari che intendiamo recuperare dalla lumaca avranno bisogno di una stiva adeguatamente grande."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"What happened with that Maeri'het?"|390|0
units.english: "What happened with that Maeri'het?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo con quel Maeri'het?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"My fleet would have sufficed."|392|0
units.english: "My fleet would have sufficed."
units.italian: "Sarebbe bastata la mia flotta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"My ship would have sufficed."|395|0
units.english: "My ship would have sufficed."
units.italian: "Sarebbe bastata la mia nave."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"I can believe that!" he replies, quickly glancing around the payload bay. "But outfitting a ship for the mission would take time that we do not have right now.|398|0
units.english: "I can believe that!" he replies, quickly glancing around the payload bay. "But outfitting a ship for the mission would take time that we do not have right now.
units.italian: "Ci credo!" risponde, dando una rapida occhiata alla stiva. "Ma equipaggiare una nave per la missione richiederebbe un tempo che ora non abbiamo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"The Ka'het, as you know, are part mechanical and part biological. What may be news to you, however, is that their biological self is suppressed most of the time: we have been able to determine that their stellar navigation and system management is completely left to their programming," he signs, with an unusual look of aversion in his eyes.|400|0
units.english: "The Ka'het, as you know, are part mechanical and part biological. What may be news to you, however, is that their biological self is suppressed most of the time: we have been able to determine that their stellar navigation and system management is completely left to their programming," he signs, with an unusual look of aversion in his eyes.
units.italian: "I Ka'het, come sai, sono in parte meccanici e in parte biologici. Quello che potrebbe esserti nuovo, però, è che la loro parte biologica è soppressa per la maggior parte del tempo: siamo riusciti a stabilire che la loro navigazione stellare e la gestione dei sistemi sono completamente affidate alla loro programmazione," accenna, con uno strano sguardo di avversione negli occhi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"Still, like most biological beings, after their nominal lifetime of hundreds of years, they can start dying of old age. When this happens, they enter a hibernation state, calling for a Builder in the hope of being rescued. Of course, no help is coming.|401|0
units.english: "Still, like most biological beings, after their nominal lifetime of hundreds of years, they can start dying of old age. When this happens, they enter a hibernation state, calling for a Builder in the hope of being rescued. Of course, no help is coming.
units.italian: "Tuttavia, come la maggior parte degli esseri biologici, dopo la loro vita nominale di centinaia di anni possono cominciare a morire di vecchiaia. Quando succede, entrano in uno stato di ibernazione, chiamando un Costruttore nella speranza di essere salvati. Naturalmente, nessun aiuto arriverà.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	"We have observed," he continues while reading from a datapad, "other Ka'het try to patch them up as best as they can after some time, presumably following their own programming to do so. It is very unusual to find the corpse of one just laying around alone. We are interested in anything that usually will not survive critical battle damage. Memory banks, logic terminals, and in general, all parts of their mechanical brain."|402|0
units.english: "We have observed," he continues while reading from a datapad, "other Ka'het try to patch them up as best as they can after some time, presumably following their own programming to do so. It is very unusual to find the corpse of one just laying around alone. We are interested in anything that usually will not survive critical battle damage. Memory banks, logic terminals, and in general, all parts of their mechanical brain."
units.italian: "Abbiamo osservato," continua leggendo da un datapad, "che altri Ka'het cercano di rattopparli come possono dopo un po' di tempo, presumibilmente seguendo la propria programmazione. È molto inusuale trovare il cadavere di uno semplicemente abbandonato da solo. Ci interessa tutto ciò che di solito non sopravvive ai danni critici di battaglia. Banchi di memoria, terminali logici e, in generale, tutte le parti del loro cervello meccanico."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 2|	Despite the sign language, you notice that he seems strikingly halfhearted compared to the previous times you have encountered him. He heads toward his Gull, the Late Season Dancing.|403|0
units.english: Despite the sign language, you notice that he seems strikingly halfhearted compared to the previous times you have encountered him. He heads toward his Gull, the Late Season Dancing.
units.italian: Nonostante la lingua dei segni, noti che sembra sorprendentemente svogliato rispetto alle altre volte in cui l'hai incontrato. Si dirige verso il suo Gull, il Late Season Dancing.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|name|408|0
units.english: Angry Ka'het
units.italian: Ka'het furioso

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|description|409|0
units.english: Destroy the Telis'het in <system> to prevent it from destroying the Maeri'het on the surface of <planet>.
units.italian: Distruggi il Telis'het in <system> per impedirgli di distruggere il Maeri'het sulla superficie di <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|The sun is high overhead as you descend through the air toward the place you were last time. Flying in formation with the Late Season Dancing, you spot the Maeri'het on the ground easily: it has spread a pair of enormous solar wings, at least thrice as long as the body of the Ka'het itself. A look at your radar reveals more, however - there is a second Ka'het hovering above the downed one, classified by your IFF as a Telis.|414|0
units.english: The sun is high overhead as you descend through the air toward the place you were last time. Flying in formation with the Late Season Dancing, you spot the Maeri'het on the ground easily: it has spread a pair of enormous solar wings, at least thrice as long as the body of the Ka'het itself. A look at your radar reveals more, however - there is a second Ka'het hovering above the downed one, classified by your IFF as a Telis.
units.italian: Il sole è alto sopra di te mentre scendi nell'aria verso il posto in cui sei stato l'ultima volta. Volando in formazione con il Late Season Dancing, individui facilmente il Maeri'het a terra: ha dispiegato un paio di enormi ali solari, almeno tre volte più lunghe del corpo del Ka'het stesso. Un'occhiata al radar rivela di più, però: c'è un secondo Ka'het che aleggia sopra quello abbattuto, classificato dal tuo IFF come Telis.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"It is trying to reanimate the Maeri'het," Plume chants over the intercom, "but I do not think it can do so. It has been too long since you found it for repairs to have any effect." Among the smoke clouds, you make out pairs of tiny arms protruding from the bottom of the Telis'het, pressing against the corpse beneath it.
