Your ship records electric shocks moving between them, but the Maeri'het does not react.|415|0
units.english: "It is trying to reanimate the Maeri'het," Plume chants over the intercom, "but I do not think it can do so. It has been too long since you found it for repairs to have any effect." Among the smoke clouds, you make out pairs of tiny arms protruding from the bottom of the Telis'het, pressing against the corpse beneath it. Your ship records electric shocks moving between them, but the Maeri'het does not react.
units.italian: "Sta cercando di rianimare il Maeri'het," intona Plume dall'interfono, "ma non credo che ci riuscirà. È passato troppo tempo da quando l'hai trovato perché le riparazioni abbiano qualche effetto." Tra le nuvole di fumo, distingui paia di piccole braccia che sporgono dal fondo del Telis'het, premendo contro il cadavere sotto di esso. La nave registra scosse elettriche che si muovono tra loro, ma il Maeri'het non reagisce.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"Let's wait for it to leave then."|417|0
units.english: "Let's wait for it to leave then."
units.italian: "Aspettiamo che se ne vada, allora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"Should I engage it?"|418|0
units.english: "Should I engage it?"
units.italian: "Devo attaccarlo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"It is not that easy. Its programming may be telling it to heal the Maeri'het, but the slug will grow more frustrated with each failed attempt. You see, one of the functions left under the control of the biological side is combat. It may not be able to decide to stop trying to heal it, but it can decide to register the Maeri'het as a foe, destroy it, and then leave freely as if it were never there," he concludes with a cold chant.|420|0
units.english: "It is not that easy. Its programming may be telling it to heal the Maeri'het, but the slug will grow more frustrated with each failed attempt. You see, one of the functions left under the control of the biological side is combat. It may not be able to decide to stop trying to heal it, but it can decide to register the Maeri'het as a foe, destroy it, and then leave freely as if it were never there," he concludes with a cold chant.
units.italian: "Non è così semplice. La sua programmazione potrebbe dirgli di curare il Maeri'het, ma la lumaca diventerà sempre più frustrata a ogni tentativo fallito. Vedi, una delle funzioni rimaste sotto il controllo della parte biologica è il combattimento. Potrebbe non essere in grado di decidere di smettere di tentare di curarlo, ma può decidere di registrare il Maeri'het come nemico, distruggerlo, e poi andarsene liberamente come se non fosse mai stato lì," conclude con un canto freddo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"I am afraid so. Its programming may be telling it to heal the Maeri'het, but the slug will grow more frustrated with each failed attempt. You see, one of the functions left under the control of the biological side is combat. It may not be able to decide to stop trying to heal the Maeri'het, but it can decide to register it as a foe, destroy it, and then leave freely as if it were never there," he concludes with a cold chant.|423|0
units.english: "I am afraid so. Its programming may be telling it to heal the Maeri'het, but the slug will grow more frustrated with each failed attempt. You see, one of the functions left under the control of the biological side is combat. It may not be able to decide to stop trying to heal the Maeri'het, but it can decide to register it as a foe, destroy it, and then leave freely as if it were never there," he concludes with a cold chant.
units.italian: "Temo di sì. La sua programmazione potrebbe dirgli di curare il Maeri'het, ma la lumaca diventerà sempre più frustrata a ogni tentativo fallito. Vedi, una delle funzioni rimaste sotto il controllo della parte biologica è il combattimento. Potrebbe non essere in grado di decidere di smettere di tentare di curarlo, ma può decidere di registrarlo come nemico, distruggerlo, e poi andarsene liberamente come se non fosse mai stato lì," conclude con un canto freddo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"And thus, the Telis is a threat to the Remnant's xenobiological interests. If you have enough firepower to do so, I ask you to attack the Ka'het and lead it away, so that we can loot the carcass while it is still useful."|425|0
units.english: "And thus, the Telis is a threat to the Remnant's xenobiological interests. If you have enough firepower to do so, I ask you to attack the Ka'het and lead it away, so that we can loot the carcass while it is still useful."
units.italian: "E quindi il Telis è una minaccia per gli interessi xenobiologici dei Remnant. Se hai abbastanza potenza di fuoco per farlo, ti chiedo di attaccare il Ka'het e allontanarlo, così possiamo saccheggiare il carcame finché è ancora utile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	(Open fire.)|427|0
units.english: (Open fire.)
units.italian: (Apri il fuoco.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"Sorry, but I'm not prepared for such a fight."|428|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not prepared for such a fight."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono preparato a un combattimento del genere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	You put one hand on the throttle, and with the other pitch down toward the surface. The Gull engages its cloak as you fire the first shot, missing both Ka'het by a few meters to avoid damaging the corpse of the Maeri. Soon, a furious Telis follows you back into space, and the real battle begins.|430|0
units.english: You put one hand on the throttle, and with the other pitch down toward the surface. The Gull engages its cloak as you fire the first shot, missing both Ka'het by a few meters to avoid damaging the corpse of the Maeri. Soon, a furious Telis follows you back into space, and the real battle begins.
units.italian: Metti una mano sulla manetta e con l'altra scendi in picchiata verso la superficie. Il Gull attiva il suo occultamento mentre spari il primo colpo, mancando entrambi i Ka'het di qualche metro per non danneggiare il cadavere del Maeri. Ben presto un Telis furioso ti segue nello spazio, e la vera battaglia comincia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"Neither are we," other voices on the intercom chant in unison. "This project is thus aborted, seeing as there is no practical way to complete it. Our group can split here: the return route is well explored, and our tanks have enough propellant to stay cloaked until reaching safer territory."|433|0
units.english: "Neither are we," other voices on the intercom chant in unison. "This project is thus aborted, seeing as there is no practical way to complete it. Our group can split here: the return route is well explored, and our tanks have enough propellant to stay cloaked until reaching safer territory."
units.italian: "Neanche noi," intonano in coro altre voci sull'interfono. "Questo progetto è quindi annullato, visto che non c'è modo pratico di completarlo. Il nostro gruppo può separarsi qui: la rotta di ritorno è ben esplorata, e i nostri serbatoi hanno abbastanza propellente per restare occultati fino a raggiungere territorio più sicuro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	"Captain <first>," Plume continues in a subdued tone, "I ask you to leave this planet with us as well. For as long as we stay here, even at this distance, some of the Maeri'het's biological self will remain active to keep an eye on our intentions, and will continue to do so until it finally dies. I would rather have them be inhibited during their end than fully conscious - for a lack of better word, it is more humane." He bids you farewell, and the Gull disappears after a short climb into the sky.|434|0
units.english: "Captain <first>," Plume continues in a subdued tone, "I ask you to leave this planet with us as well. For as long as we stay here, even at this distance, some of the Maeri'het's biological self will remain active to keep an eye on our intentions, and will continue to do so until it finally dies. I would rather have them be inhibited during their end than fully conscious - for a lack of better word, it is more humane." He bids you farewell, and the Gull disappears after a short climb into the sky.
units.italian: "Capitano <first>," continua Plume con tono sommesso, "ti chiedo di lasciare questo pianeta insieme a noi. Finché restiamo qui, anche a questa distanza, una parte della parte biologica del Maeri'het resterà attiva per sorvegliare le nostre intenzioni, e continuerà a farlo finché non morirà. Preferirei che fossero inibiti durante la loro fine piuttosto che del tutto coscienti: per mancanza di termini migliori, è più umano." Ti saluta, e il Gull sparisce dopo una breve salita nel cielo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	(Fly back to orbit.)|436|0
units.english: (Fly back to orbit.)
units.italian: (Torna in orbita.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	(Stay and see what happens.)|438|0
units.english: (Stay and see what happens.)
units.italian: (Resta e guarda cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	Half an hour passes without either of the Ka'het making a move. Then, right after your external sensors record a low hum, the Telis lifts up in the air and rotates upside down. It fires three times: one beam to each side of the head, and another in the middle of the abdomen. Had the Maeri'het not started to collapse in upon itself, most of the outfits would have probably survived intact.|439|0
units.english: Half an hour passes without either of the Ka'het making a move. Then, right after your external sensors record a low hum, the Telis lifts up in the air and rotates upside down. It fires three times: one beam to each side of the head, and another in the middle of the abdomen. Had the Maeri'het not started to collapse in upon itself, most of the outfits would have probably survived intact.
units.italian: Passa mezz'ora senza che nessuno dei due Ka'het faccia una mossa. Poi, subito dopo che i tuoi sensori esterni registrano un ronzio basso, il Telis si solleva in aria e ruota a testa in giù. Spara tre volte: un raggio per ciascun lato della testa, e un altro al centro dell'addome. Se il Maeri'het non avesse cominciato a collassare su se stesso, la maggior parte degli equipaggiamenti sarebbe probabilmente sopravvissuta intatta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|	When the spectacle is over, you command the autopilot back toward orbit and leave before the Telis decides to engage you as well.|440|0
units.english: When the spectacle is over, you command the autopilot back toward orbit and leave before the Telis decides to engage you as well.
units.italian: Quando lo spettacolo è finito, comandi al pilota automatico di tornare in orbita e te ne vai prima che il Telis decida di attaccare anche te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|dialog|446|0
units.english: You have destroyed the Ka'het ship. You can now return to <planet> to meet up with Plume.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la nave Ka'het. Ora puoi tornare su <planet> per incontrare Plume.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 3|dialog|448|0
units.english: You try to return to the Maeri'het, but the Telis follows you! You need to destroy it if you want to approach safely.
units.italian: Provi a tornare al Maeri'het, ma il Telis ti segue! Devi distruggerlo se vuoi avvicinarti in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|name|452|0
units.english: Disassembled Ka'het
units.italian: Ka'het smontato

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|description|453|0
units.english: Escort Plume and his crew back to <destination> safely while they transport the Ka'het components gathered during the mission on <origin>.
units.italian: Scorta Plume e il suo equipaggio fino a <destination> in sicurezza mentre trasportano i componenti del Ka'het raccolti durante la missione su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|The face of the Maeri'het has been pried open, showing a complex grid of wires running all over the flesh of the slug. Machinery of all kinds surround the ship, from sets of cylinders making a faint, purplish glow to spherical containers covered in a blue liquid of some kind.|459|0
units.english: The face of the Maeri'het has been pried open, showing a complex grid of wires running all over the flesh of the slug. Machinery of all kinds surround the ship, from sets of cylinders making a faint, purplish glow to spherical containers covered in a blue liquid of some kind.
units.italian: Il volto del Maeri'het è stato scoperchiato, mostrando una complessa griglia di fili che corre su tutta la carne della lumaca. Macchinari di ogni tipo circondano la nave, da serie di cilindri che emettono un debole bagliore purpureo a contenitori sferici coperti di un liquido blu di qualche tipo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	The largest components have been moved atop some sort of anti-gravity plating, lifting them above the terrain but otherwise requiring a human to push them somewhere. You give the Remnant a hand transporting a few pieces out of the carcass; despite the help of the plating, their sheer inertia makes the activity exhausting. Once inside their Gull, the Remnant attach the Ka'het machinery to the adapters onboard and power them with their instrumentation.|460|0
units.english: The largest components have been moved atop some sort of anti-gravity plating, lifting them above the terrain but otherwise requiring a human to push them somewhere. You give the Remnant a hand transporting a few pieces out of the carcass; despite the help of the plating, their sheer inertia makes the activity exhausting. Once inside their Gull, the Remnant attach the Ka'het machinery to the adapters onboard and power them with their instrumentation.
units.italian: I componenti più grandi sono stati spostati su una specie di piastra antigravità, che li solleva sopra il terreno ma per il resto richiede una persona che li spinga. Dài una mano ai Remnant a trasportare qualche pezzo fuori dal carcame; nonostante l'aiuto della piastra, la loro pura inerzia rende l'attività estenuante. Una volta dentro il loro Gull, i Remnant fissano i macchinari del Ka'het agli adattatori di bordo e li alimentano con la loro strumentazione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"According to the transponder, its name was Nona-caci'het," reveals Plume. "It had lived for just over 500 years, almost as long as we Remnant have existed. It fought thousands of battles, the last of which," he reads stoically from a datapad, "was with another Maeri'het just over two months ago. Since then, the only other lifeform it has seen was when it descended into a planetary atmosphere to shell a few specimens of an amphibian animal it classified as a foe."|461|0
units.english: "According to the transponder, its name was Nona-caci'het," reveals Plume. "It had lived for just over 500 years, almost as long as we Remnant have existed. It fought thousands of battles, the last of which," he reads stoically from a datapad, "was with another Maeri'het just over two months ago. Since then, the only other lifeform it has seen was when it descended into a planetary atmosphere to shell a few specimens of an amphibian animal it classified as a foe."
units.italian: "Secondo il trasponder, il suo nome era Nona-caci'het," rivela Plume. "Ha vissuto poco più di 500 anni, quasi quanto esistiamo noi Remnant. Ha combattuto migliaia di battaglie, l'ultima delle quali," legge stoicamente da un datapad, "è stata con un altro Maeri'het poco più di due mesi fa. Da allora, l'unica altra forma di vita che ha visto è stata quando è scesa nell'atmosfera di un pianeta per bombardare alcuni esemplari di un animale anfibio che ha classificato come nemico."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Why did it die?"|463|0
units.english: "Why did it die?"
units.italian: "Perché è morto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"I did not know they did that."|464|0
units.english: "I did not know they did that."
units.italian: "Non sapevo che facessero così."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Are its outfits intact?"|466|0
units.english: "Are its outfits intact?"
units.italian: "I suoi equipaggiamenti sono intatti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Ah, hard to say. They suffer so much battle damage over their lifetimes that their entire bodies get covered with patches and scars. Still, we have run some scans so that the laboratory back on <planet> can determine more."|468|0
units.english: "Ah, hard to say. They suffer so much battle damage over their lifetimes that their entire bodies get covered with patches and scars. Still, we have run some scans so that the laboratory back on <planet> can determine more."
units.italian: "Ah, difficile dirlo. Subiscono così tanti danni di battaglia nel corso della loro vita che interi corpi finiscono coperti di toppe e cicatrici. Abbiamo comunque fatto alcune scansioni, così il laboratorio su <planet> potrà determinare di più."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Oh, not only do they, but the vast majority of Ka'het attack victims are surface-dwelling animals. Countless species have been driven to extinction over the past tens of thousands of years by their hunting. For the foreseeable future, the Graveyard will continue to live up to its name."|471|0
units.english: "Oh, not only do they, but the vast majority of Ka'het attack victims are surface-dwelling animals. Countless species have been driven to extinction over the past tens of thousands of years by their hunting. For the foreseeable future, the Graveyard will continue to live up to its name."
units.italian: "Oh, non solo lo fanno, ma la stragrande maggioranza delle vittime dei Ka'het sono animali che vivono in superficie. Innumerevoli specie sono state spinte all'estinzione negli ultimi decine di migliaia di anni dalla loro caccia. Per il futuro prevedibile, il Cimitero continuerà a meritare il suo nome."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	He shrugs. "I have a hard time considering the Ka'het in the same way as most lifeforms. They appear to flout the principles of evolution: they do not materially vary, dilapidated factories prevent heritability, and what's more, natural selection as we understand it appears impossible! Their internal organs are not arranged like any living being we know, but like a spaceship, shaped for ease of maintenance and replacement.|473|0
units.english: He shrugs. "I have a hard time considering the Ka'het in the same way as most lifeforms. They appear to flout the principles of evolution: they do not materially vary, dilapidated factories prevent heritability, and what's more, natural selection as we understand it appears impossible! Their internal organs are not arranged like any living being we know, but like a spaceship, shaped for ease of maintenance and replacement.
units.italian: Scrolla le spalle. "Faccio fatica a considerare i Ka'het allo stesso modo della maggior parte delle forme di vita. Sembrano sfidare i principi dell'evoluzione: non variano in modo sostanziale, le fabbriche fatiscenti impediscono l'ereditarietà, e per di più la selezione naturale come la intendiamo sembra impossibile! I loro organi interni non sono disposti come quelli di qualsiasi essere vivente che conosciamo, ma come quelli di una nave spaziale, sagomati per facilità di manutenzione e sostituzione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Void Sprite research has only restarted recently, as you know. As such, the typical curriculum of a xenobiologist focuses on symbionts, Korath, creatures indigenous to Ember Waste planets, and lastly the Ka'het. But in reality, little of the Ka'het's design or behavior can be described by biology. Most discoveries in that field were made decades, if not centuries ago - it is a straightforward, even mechanical, design. There is a reason that our engineers can specialize in the Ka'het, while no branch of xenobiology covers them in detail."|474|0
units.english: "Void Sprite research has only restarted recently, as you know. As such, the typical curriculum of a xenobiologist focuses on symbionts, Korath, creatures indigenous to Ember Waste planets, and lastly the Ka'het. But in reality, little of the Ka'het's design or behavior can be described by biology. Most discoveries in that field were made decades, if not centuries ago - it is a straightforward, even mechanical, design. There is a reason that our engineers can specialize in the Ka'het, while no branch of xenobiology covers them in detail."
units.italian: "La ricerca sugli spettri del vuoto è ricominciata solo di recente, come sai. Per questo il curriculum tipico di uno xenobiologo si concentra sui simbionti, sui Korath, sulle creature indigene dei pianeti della Distesa di Braci e, infine, sui Ka'het. Ma in realtà poco del progetto o del comportamento dei Ka'het può essere descritto dalla biologia. La maggior parte delle scoperte in quel campo è stata fatta decenni, se non secoli, fa: è un progetto lineare, persino meccanico. C'è un motivo se i nostri ingegneri possono specializzarsi nei Ka'het, mentre nessun ramo della xenobiologia li copre in dettaglio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"I see."|476|0
units.english: "I see."
units.italian: "Capisco."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"What is the difference with Remnant ships?"|478|0
units.english: "What is the difference with Remnant ships?"
units.italian: "Qual è la differenza con le navi dei Remnant?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"We have not quite gotten to the point of true live ships," he replies with a quick glance at his Gull, "but we should be close, from what I have seen.|483|0
units.english: "We have not quite gotten to the point of true live ships," he replies with a quick glance at his Gull, "but we should be close, from what I have seen.
units.italian: "Non siamo ancora arrivati al punto di vere navi viventi," risponde con una rapida occhiata al suo Gull, "ma dovremmo esserci vicini, da quello che ho visto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"As far as I am concerned, the key difference lies in the role left to the being in question. Our paradigm is not to take an organism, inhibit it when we don't need it, and build around it the true spaceship. No, our whole ship is built in the same manner as a biological organism, to the point where their similarity to living beings is an emergent property arising from mechanical components. The relationship between the crew and the ship will never go beyond what is between a Remnant and their symbiont: both capable of going their own way, but mutually benefiting from their relationship."|485|0
units.english: "As far as I am concerned, the key difference lies in the role left to the being in question. Our paradigm is not to take an organism, inhibit it when we don't need it, and build around it the true spaceship. No, our whole ship is built in the same manner as a biological organism, to the point where their similarity to living beings is an emergent property arising from mechanical components. The relationship between the crew and the ship will never go beyond what is between a Remnant and their symbiont: both capable of going their own way, but mutually benefiting from their relationship."
units.italian: "Per quanto mi riguarda, la differenza chiave sta nel ruolo lasciato all'essere in questione. Il nostro paradigma non è prendere un organismo, inibirlo quando non ci serve, e costruirgli intorno la vera nave spaziale. No, l'intera nostra nave è costruita allo stesso modo di un organismo biologico, al punto che la loro somiglianza con gli esseri viventi è una proprietà emergente che nasce da componenti meccanici. Il rapporto tra l'equipaggio e la nave non andrà mai oltre quello tra un Remnant e il suo simbionte: entrambi capaci di andare per la propria strada, ma traendo beneficio reciproco dal loro rapporto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	He seems amused. "I had a feeling you would wonder about that. No need to worry, <first>, we have left something for you as well."|488|0
units.english: He seems amused. "I had a feeling you would wonder about that. No need to worry, <first>, we have left something for you as well."
units.italian: Sembra divertito. "Avevo il presentimento che te lo saresti chiesto. Non preoccuparti, <first>, abbiamo lasciato qualcosa anche per te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	He accompanies you toward two large containers, conveniently placed next to your ship, and unlocks the doors: one contains a pair of MHD Generators, and the other a pair of Shield Restorers. "We had to uninstall a number of systems to gain access to the ones we were looking for. Most of them were damaged in the process, but we made sure to keep these intact as a way to thank you for your contribution before leaving for <planet>."|490|0
units.english: He accompanies you toward two large containers, conveniently placed next to your ship, and unlocks the doors: one contains a pair of MHD Generators, and the other a pair of Shield Restorers. "We had to uninstall a number of systems to gain access to the ones we were looking for. Most of them were damaged in the process, but we made sure to keep these intact as a way to thank you for your contribution before leaving for <planet>."
units.italian: Ti accompagna verso due grandi contenitori, comodamente sistemati accanto alla tua nave, e apre le porte: uno contiene un paio di generatori MHD, l'altro un paio di Ripristinatori di Scudi. "Abbiamo dovuto disinstallare diversi sistemi per accedere a quelli che cercavamo. La maggior parte è stata danneggiata nel processo, ma ci siamo assicurati di tenere questi intatti come ringraziamento per il tuo contributo prima di partire per <planet>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Thank you."|495|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"I may not have enough space for them."|497|0
units.english: "I may not have enough space for them."
units.italian: "Potrei non avere abbastanza spazio per loro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Oh, I am sure an experienced captain like you will be able to find a place to hide a stash of them around these parts," he signs in an amused fashion. "See you on <planet>!"|498|0
units.english: "Oh, I am sure an experienced captain like you will be able to find a place to hide a stash of them around these parts," he signs in an amused fashion. "See you on <planet>!"
units.italian: "Oh, sono sicuro che un capitano esperto come te troverà un posto dove nascondere una scorta da queste parti," accenna divertito. "Ci vediamo su <planet>!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|You wait for Plume next to the ramp of his Gull. When you see him, he is discussing the destination of the Ka'het machinery with another Remnant.|504|0
units.english: You wait for Plume next to the ramp of his Gull. When you see him, he is discussing the destination of the Ka'het machinery with another Remnant.
units.italian: Aspetti Plume accanto alla rampa del suo Gull. Quando lo vedi, sta discutendo la destinazione dei macchinari del Ka'het con un altro Remnant.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|You wait for Plume next to the ramp of his Gull. When you see him, he is discussing the destination of the Ka'het machinery with another Remnant, whom you recognize as the man who had helped you with your Void Rifle.|507|0
units.english: You wait for Plume next to the ramp of his Gull. When you see him, he is discussing the destination of the Ka'het machinery with another Remnant, whom you recognize as the man who had helped you with your Void Rifle.
units.italian: Aspetti Plume accanto alla rampa del suo Gull. Quando lo vedi, sta discutendo la destinazione dei macchinari del Ka'het con un altro Remnant, che riconosci come l'uomo che ti aveva aiutato con il tuo Fucile del Vuoto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	"Oh, Captain," Plume turns to you contentedly, "Thank you once again for your help. I have been trying to make some arrangements in order to simplify things in the future. The technician I was just speaking with has shown interest in the Ka'het, and kindly accepted the job of putting their machinery in safe storage whenever you bring more of it."|509|0
units.english: "Oh, Captain," Plume turns to you contentedly, "Thank you once again for your help. I have been trying to make some arrangements in order to simplify things in the future. The technician I was just speaking with has shown interest in the Ka'het, and kindly accepted the job of putting their machinery in safe storage whenever you bring more of it."
units.italian: "Oh, capitano," Plume si volta verso di te soddisfatto, "grazie ancora una volta per il tuo aiuto. Ho cercato di prendere qualche accordo per semplificare le cose in futuro. Il tecnico con cui stavo parlando ha mostrato interesse per i Ka'het, e ha gentilmente accettato l'incarico di mettere al sicuro i loro macchinari ogni volta che me ne porterai altri."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	He hands you a small data crystal, shaped like an icosahedron. "This contains a series of short videos on how to use the tools in a Research Laboratory, if you were to be carrying one aboard, to extract some of the most essential components out of a hibernated Ka'het. You will need practice, of course, but the procedure is not too dissimilar from that of looting a standard ship. If it happens again, as long as you leave 40 to 50 tons of space in your payload bay, you will be able to do most of what we did today without wasting a second to call us!"|510|0
units.english: He hands you a small data crystal, shaped like an icosahedron. "This contains a series of short videos on how to use the tools in a Research Laboratory, if you were to be carrying one aboard, to extract some of the most essential components out of a hibernated Ka'het. You will need practice, of course, but the procedure is not too dissimilar from that of looting a standard ship. If it happens again, as long as you leave 40 to 50 tons of space in your payload bay, you will be able to do most of what we did today without wasting a second to call us!"
units.italian: Ti consegna un piccolo cristallo dati, a forma di icosaedro. "Questo contiene una serie di brevi video su come usare gli strumenti di un Laboratorio di Ricerca, se ne avessi uno a bordo, per estrarre alcuni dei componenti essenziali da un Ka'het in ibernazione. Ti servirà pratica, naturalmente, ma la procedura non è troppo diversa da quella di saccheggiare una nave normale. Se dovesse succedere di nuovo, finché lasci 40-50 tonnellate di spazio nella stiva, potrai fare la maggior parte di quello che abbiamo fatto oggi senza perdere un secondo a chiamarci!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|	After spending some more time discussing the procedure to follow the next time you encounter a hibernated Ka'het, you bid each other farewell with a short bow and part ways.|511|0
units.english: After spending some more time discussing the procedure to follow the next time you encounter a hibernated Ka'het, you bid each other farewell with a short bow and part ways.
units.italian: Dopo aver passato un altro po' di tempo a discutere la procedura da seguire la prossima volta che incontrerai un Ka'het in ibernazione, vi congedate con un breve inchino e vi separate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4A|dialog|513|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but Plume's Gull hasn't arrived yet.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma il Gull di Plume non è ancora arrivato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Death in the Graveyard 4B|As you are about to leave the cockpit, the screen atop the transponder starts beeping. It is a message from Plume. "Captain <first>, I have been trying to make some arrangements in order to simplify things in the future. I am transmitting you a series of short videos on how to use the tools in a Research Laboratory, if you were to be carrying one aboard, to extract the most important components out of a hibernated Ka'het. You will need practice, of course, but the procedure is not too dissimilar from that of looting a standard ship. They are going to be some heavy pieces; I recommend leaving at least 40 or 50 tons of cargo space free for such an eventuality.|528|0
units.english: As you are about to leave the cockpit, the screen atop the transponder starts beeping. It is a message from Plume. "Captain <first>, I have been trying to make some arrangements in order to simplify things in the future. I am transmitting you a series of short videos on how to use the tools in a Research Laboratory, if you were to be carrying one aboard, to extract the most important components out of a hibernated Ka'het. You will need practice, of course, but the procedure is not too dissimilar from that of looting a standard ship. They are going to be some heavy pieces; I recommend leaving at least 40 or 50 tons of cargo space free for such an eventuality.
units.italian: Mentre stai per lasciare la cabina, lo schermo sopra il trasponder comincia a bippare. È un messaggio di Plume. "Capitano <first>, ho cercato di prendere qualche accordo per semplificare le cose in futuro. Ti sto trasmettendo una serie di brevi video su come usare gli strumenti di un Laboratorio di Ricerca, se ne avessi uno a bordo, per estrarre i componenti più importanti da un Ka'het in ibernazione. Ti servirà pratica, naturalmente, ma la procedura non è troppo diversa da quella di saccheggiare una nave normale. Saranno pezzi pesanti; ti consiglio di lasciare almeno 40 o 50 tonnellate di spazio di carico libero per una tale eventualità.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1A|	Following Plume's videos step by step, the whole procedure turns out to be quite straightforward and clean. After a little more than an hour your cargo bay has filled with Ka'het machinery of all kinds, connected to the Research Laboratory with a series of increasingly cumbersome adapters. You label them with the name of the Ka'het, which appears to have been ${ka'het}. Now that the job is done, you could spend some more time looting the slug's conventional outfits - with the caveat that the chances of another Ka'het noticing your presence would be quite high.|600|0
units.context: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1A
units.english: Following Plume's videos step by step, the whole procedure turns out to be quite straightforward and clean. After a little more than an hour your cargo bay has filled with Ka'het machinery of all kinds, connected to the Research Laboratory with a series of increasingly cumbersome adapters. You label them with the name of the Ka'het, which appears to have been ${ka'het}. Now that the job is done, you could spend some more time looting the slug's conventional outfits - with the caveat that the chances of another Ka'het noticing your presence would be quite high.
units.italian: Seguendo i video di Plume passo per passo, l'intera procedura si rivela piuttosto semplice e pulita. Dopo poco più di un'ora la tua stiva si è riempita di macchinari Ka'het di ogni tipo, collegati al Laboratorio di Ricerca con una serie di adattatori sempre più ingombranti. Li etichetti con il nome del Ka'het, che a quanto pare era ${ka'het}. Ora che il lavoro è fatto, potresti passare altro tempo a saccheggiare gli equipaggiamenti convenzionali della lumaca, con l'avvertenza che le probabilità che un altro Ka'het noti la tua presenza sarebbero piuttosto alte.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1A|	As you expected, before you have the chance to bring out any of its outfits your radar registers another Ka'het coming into the atmosphere with guns raised. units.context: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1A
units.english: As you expected, before you have the chance to bring out any of its outfits your radar registers another Ka'het coming into the atmosphere with guns raised. You will need to fight it if you want the chance to loot the downed slug - or else, it will reach it by itself and likely destroy it.
units.italian: Come previsto, prima che tu abbia la possibilità di tirar fuori uno dei suoi equipaggiamenti il radar registra un altro Ka'het che entra nell'atmosfera con le armi alzate. Dovrai combatterlo se vuoi la possibilità di saccheggiare la lumaca abbattuta, altrimenti arriverà da sola e probabilmente la distruggerà.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1A|You meet up with the Remnant technician at the indicated coordinates and drop the cargo you have gathered one by one. units.id: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1B|With the Ka'het destroyed, you return to the site where the other slug lies defenseless. units.context: mission:Ka'het: Another Death in the Graveyard 1B
units.english: With the Ka'het destroyed, you return to the site where the other slug lies defenseless. While the battle did not touch it, you notice that a number of components show superficial damage, either due to your extraction job or previous battle damage. It would be best to focus on looting just one area and disregarding the rest to avoid risking its collapse.
units.italian: Con il Ka'het distrutto, torni sul posto dove giace l'altra lumaca, indifesa. Anche se la battaglia non l'ha toccata, noti che diversi componenti mostrano danni superficiali, dovuti al tuo lavoro di estrazione o a danni di battaglia precedenti. Sarebbe meglio concentrarti su una sola zona e trascurare il resto, per evitare di rischiare che collassi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Reveal|As the jumping sequence comes to an end, you find yourself orbiting a small black hole, surrounded by nothing but countless asteroids and debris. Even more interesting is the fact that the asteroid belt appears to be populated by small spaceships, similar in appearance to the Ka'het that infest the nearby systems but at the same time unlike any of the types you had seen before. Perhaps the Remnant can tell you more about this system and its sudden appearance.|895|0
units.english: As the jumping sequence comes to an end, you find yourself orbiting a small black hole, surrounded by nothing but countless asteroids and debris. Even more interesting is the fact that the asteroid belt appears to be populated by small spaceships, similar in appearance to the Ka'het that infest the nearby systems but at the same time unlike any of the types you had seen before. Perhaps the Remnant can tell you more about this system and its sudden appearance.
units.italian: Mentre la sequenza di salto volge al termine, ti ritrovi in orbita attorno a un piccolo buco nero, circondato da nient'altro che innumerevoli asteroidi e detriti. Ancora più interessante è il fatto che la cintura di asteroidi sembra popolata da piccole navi spaziali, simili nell'aspetto ai Ka'het che infestano i sistemi vicini ma allo stesso tempo diverse da qualsiasi tipo tu abbia visto prima. Forse i Remnant possono dirti qualcosa su questo sistema e sulla sua comparsa improvvisa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|name|906|0
units.english: Visit <waypoints>
units.italian: Visita <waypoints>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|description|907|0
units.english: Bring Taely with you to visit the <waypoints> system before going to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Taely con te a visitare il sistema <waypoints> prima di andare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|Do you want to look for Taely to tell her about the new system that appeared in the Graveyard?|918|0
units.english: Do you want to look for Taely to tell her about the new system that appeared in the Graveyard?
units.italian: Vuoi cercare Taely per parlarle del nuovo sistema apparso nel Cimitero?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	(Sure.)|920|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	(Not right now.)|921|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	You aren't surprised to find Taely in the local shipyard, overseeing the welding of some kind of unmanned satellite. Though not familiar enough with Remnant technology to understand its function, you identify a large crystal placed near what you presume to be the front of the probe as a Quantum Key Stone, or at least a derivative of it.|924|0
units.english: You aren't surprised to find Taely in the local shipyard, overseeing the welding of some kind of unmanned satellite. Though not familiar enough with Remnant technology to understand its function, you identify a large crystal placed near what you presume to be the front of the probe as a Quantum Key Stone, or at least a derivative of it.
units.italian: Non ti sorprende trovare Taely nel cantiere locale, che sovrintende alla saldatura di una specie di satellite senza equipaggio. Anche se non conosci abbastanza la tecnologia dei Remnant per capirne la funzione, riconosci un grande cristallo posto vicino a quella che supponi sia la parte anteriore della sonda come una Pietra Chiave Quantistica, o almeno un suo derivato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	When Taely notices you walking towards her, she waves at you. "<first>! It has been a while. Were you looking for me?"|925|0
units.english: When Taely notices you walking towards her, she waves at you. "<first>! It has been a while. Were you looking for me?"
units.italian: Quando Taely ti nota avvicinarti, ti saluta con la mano. "<first>! È passato un po' di tempo. Mi cercavi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I have some news. A new black hole suddenly appeared near the Graveyard, the same way Ssil Vida did."|927|0
units.english: "I have some news. A new black hole suddenly appeared near the Graveyard, the same way Ssil Vida did."
units.italian: "Ho una notizia. Un nuovo buco nero è apparso all'improvviso vicino al Cimitero, nello stesso modo in cui è apparso Ssil Vida."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"What's the purpose of that satellite?"|929|0
units.english: "What's the purpose of that satellite?"
units.italian: "Qual è lo scopo di quel satellite?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"She is a beauty, is she not? The discovery of the star systems beyond Postverta spurred a large request for exploration probes, more than we've had in decades. This one was my own proposal: she is going to make precise LIDAR scans of the four planets most similar to the worlds we found alien settlements on, searching for relics and ancient artifacts! It is unbelievably exciting to see an idea that you came up with become reality right in front of you."|930|0
units.english: "She is a beauty, is she not? The discovery of the star systems beyond Postverta spurred a large request for exploration probes, more than we've had in decades. This one was my own proposal: she is going to make precise LIDAR scans of the four planets most similar to the worlds we found alien settlements on, searching for relics and ancient artifacts! It is unbelievably exciting to see an idea that you came up with become reality right in front of you."
units.italian: "È una bellezza, no? La scoperta dei sistemi stellari oltre Postverta ha suscitato una grande richiesta di sonde di esplorazione, più di quante ne avessimo da decenni. Questa è stata una mia proposta: farà scansioni LIDAR precise dei quattro pianeti più simili ai mondi su cui abbiamo trovato insediamenti alieni, cercando reliquie e manufatti antichi! È incredibilmente emozionante vedere un'idea tua diventare realtà proprio davanti a te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	She pauses to stare at the probe with pride.|931|0
units.english: She pauses to stare at the probe with pride.
units.italian: Si ferma a fissare la sonda con orgoglio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Funny you mention Postverta," you say. "A new black hole has just appeared near the Graveyard, the same way Ssil Vida did."|932|0
units.english: "Funny you mention Postverta," you say. "A new black hole has just appeared near the Graveyard, the same way Ssil Vida did."
units.italian: "Strano che tu nomini Postverta," dici. "Un nuovo buco nero è appena apparso vicino al Cimitero, nello stesso modo in cui è apparso Ssil Vida."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	You try to explain the system and its inhabitants as best you can. Taely looks intrigued. "Can you show me what your ship recorded of that system?" she asks. After spending a few minutes checking your ship's registers, she appears even more astonished than before. "This is incredible! It opens so many questions. What if it was the Builders who built Ssil Vida? We thought they never left the Graveyard, but this could change everything. And look at the gravitational slipstreams: this system has no hyperlane connections, at least for the moment. We need to know more." She pauses for a second to think. "Come with me, <first>."|934|0
units.english: You try to explain the system and its inhabitants as best you can. Taely looks intrigued. "Can you show me what your ship recorded of that system?" she asks. After spending a few minutes checking your ship's registers, she appears even more astonished than before. "This is incredible! It opens so many questions. What if it was the Builders who built Ssil Vida? We thought they never left the Graveyard, but this could change everything. And look at the gravitational slipstreams: this system has no hyperlane connections, at least for the moment. We need to know more." She pauses for a second to think. "Come with me, <first>."
units.italian: Cerchi di spiegare il sistema e i suoi abitanti come meglio puoi. Taely sembra incuriosita. "Puoi mostrarmi cosa ha registrato la tua nave di quel sistema?" chiede. Dopo aver passato qualche minuto a controllare i registri della nave, sembra ancora più sbalordita di prima. "È incredibile! Apre così tante domande. E se fossero stati i Costruttori a costruire Ssil Vida? Pensavamo che non avessero mai lasciato il Cimitero, ma questo potrebbe cambiare tutto. E guarda le correnti gravitazionali: questo sistema non ha collegamenti ipervia, almeno per il momento. Dobbiamo saperne di più." Si ferma un secondo a pensare. "Vieni con me, <first>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	You follow Taely into a large elevator at the other end of the building. After a short trip, you find yourself in a large underground hangar, full of oddly shaped dishes and complex pieces of machinery. "We use these old shelters to store the parts we do not need anymore. Sometimes they are still handy for replacing broken machinery, so instead of disassembling them we keep them here for a few years. And this," she says, pointing at an array of cylindrical objects, "is the reason we are here."|935|0
units.english: You follow Taely into a large elevator at the other end of the building. After a short trip, you find yourself in a large underground hangar, full of oddly shaped dishes and complex pieces of machinery. "We use these old shelters to store the parts we do not need anymore. Sometimes they are still handy for replacing broken machinery, so instead of disassembling them we keep them here for a few years. And this," she says, pointing at an array of cylindrical objects, "is the reason we are here."
units.italian: Segui Taely in un grande ascensore all'altro capo dell'edificio. Dopo un breve tragitto, ti ritrovi in un grande hangar sotterraneo, pieno di parabole di forma strana e pezzi complessi di macchinari. "Usiamo questi vecchi rifugi per immagazzinare i pezzi di cui non abbiamo più bisogno. A volte sono ancora utili per sostituire macchinari rotti, quindi invece di smontarli li teniamo qui per qualche anno. E questo," dice, indicando una serie di oggetti cilindrici, "è il motivo per cui siamo qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"What is that?"|937|0
units.english: "What is that?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"A bunch of rods?"|938|0
units.english: "A bunch of rods?"
units.italian: "Un mucchio di aste?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"It is an old tracking and surveillance device, developed specifically for the Graveyard," she says. "It was supposed to track all Ka'het it could find and make detailed imagery of their actions, in order to find the patterns that they follow or ways to exploit their controls. The mission was a long-term one, so when an urgent project came up, resources were diverted away from it, leaving some sensors unused.|939|0
units.english: "It is an old tracking and surveillance device, developed specifically for the Graveyard," she says. "It was supposed to track all Ka'het it could find and make detailed imagery of their actions, in order to find the patterns that they follow or ways to exploit their controls. The mission was a long-term one, so when an urgent project came up, resources were diverted away from it, leaving some sensors unused.
units.italian: "È un vecchio dispositivo di tracciamento e sorveglianza, sviluppato appositamente per il Cimitero," dice. "Doveva tracciare tutti i Ka'het che riusciva a trovare e produrre immagini dettagliate delle loro azioni, per individuare gli schemi che seguono o i modi per sfruttare i loro controlli. La missione era a lungo termine, quindi quando è arrivato un progetto urgente, le risorse sono state dirottate altrove, lasciando alcuni sensori inutilizzati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"My plan is to install some in the <ship> and go to <waypoints> to find out more about the ships there. It needs to be calibrated precisely before use, but luckily for you, I was the person who developed the deployment procedures," she says with a smirk on her face. "Are you ready?"|940|0
units.english: "My plan is to install some in the <ship> and go to <waypoints> to find out more about the ships there. It needs to be calibrated precisely before use, but luckily for you, I was the person who developed the deployment procedures," she says with a smirk on her face. "Are you ready?"
units.italian: "Il mio piano è installarne alcuni sulla <ship> e andare su <waypoints> per scoprire di più sulle navi che ci sono. Va calibrato con precisione prima dell'uso, ma per tua fortuna ero io la persona che ha sviluppato le procedure di dispiegamento," dice con un sorrisetto. "Sei pronto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Let's go!"|942|0
units.english: "Let's go!"
units.italian: "Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"How did the attempt at tracking the Ka'het go?"|944|0
units.english: "How did the attempt at tracking the Ka'het go?"
units.italian: "Com'è andato il tentativo di tracciare i Ka'het?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Sorry, but I can't help you this time. You're going to have to find somebody else."|945|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I can't help you this time. You're going to have to find somebody else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma questa volta non posso aiutarti. Dovrai trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Oh, the scanner is working perfectly. But the Ka'het, as far as we could see, seem to follow no patterns but the most basic ones. I guess you could compare them to simple animals, searching for food and fighting each other for their territory. They seem to have some sort of 'imprinting' towards the stations that breed them, but other than that, they have not shown any other particular behavior yet."|947|0
units.english: "Oh, the scanner is working perfectly. But the Ka'het, as far as we could see, seem to follow no patterns but the most basic ones. I guess you could compare them to simple animals, searching for food and fighting each other for their territory. They seem to have some sort of 'imprinting' towards the stations that breed them, but other than that, they have not shown any other particular behavior yet."
units.italian: "Oh, lo scanner funziona perfettamente. Ma i Ka'het, da quello che abbiamo potuto vedere, non sembrano seguire alcuno schema se non i più elementari. Direi che puoi paragonarli ad animali semplici, che cercano cibo e combattono tra loro per il territorio. Sembrano avere una specie di 'imprinting' verso le stazioni che li generano, ma a parte questo non hanno mostrato altri comportamenti particolari."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Alright, let's mount the scanner!"|949|0
units.english: "Alright, let's mount the scanner!"
units.italian: "Va bene, montiamo lo scanner!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Sorry, but I can't help you this time. You're going to have to find somebody else."|950|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I can't help you this time. You're going to have to find somebody else."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma questa volta non posso aiutarti. Dovrai trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	Taely replies, "I will gather a team to install the scanning system. We should be done in around an hour." She leaves the warehouse carrying a scanner, leaving you to prepare your ship for the upcoming mission.|953|0
units.english: Taely replies, "I will gather a team to install the scanning system. We should be done in around an hour." She leaves the warehouse carrying a scanner, leaving you to prepare your ship for the upcoming mission.
units.italian: Taely risponde: "Radunerò una squadra per installare il sistema di scansione. Dovremmo finire in circa un'ora." Esce dal magazzino portando uno scanner, lasciandoti a preparare la nave per la missione imminente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|When you enter the system, Taely is already sitting at the scanner's control console. She starts counting loudly. "External deployment in three... two... one... trackers out. Initiating startup sequence." She begins typing commands on a keyboard. "This is going to take a while, <first>," she says, without taking her eyes off the screen. "It is not normally a one-person job."|958|0
units.english: When you enter the system, Taely is already sitting at the scanner's control console. She starts counting loudly. "External deployment in three... two... one... trackers out. Initiating startup sequence." She begins typing commands on a keyboard. "This is going to take a while, <first>," she says, without taking her eyes off the screen. "It is not normally a one-person job."
units.italian: Quando entri nel sistema, Taely è già seduta alla console di controllo dello scanner. Comincia a contare ad alta voce. "Dispiegamento esterno in tre... due... uno... tracciatori fuori. Avvio della sequenza di avvio." Comincia a digitare comandi su una tastiera. "Ci vorrà un po', <first>," dice, senza staccare gli occhi dallo schermo. "Normalmente non è un lavoro da una sola persona."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Is there anything I can do to help you?"|960|0
units.english: "Is there anything I can do to help you?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che posso fare per aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I'll wait for you to finish in the cockpit."|961|0
units.english: "I'll wait for you to finish in the cockpit."
units.italian: "Aspetterò che tu finisca, in cabina."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I am afraid there is not. Give me, say, half an hour and I will have the results ready."|963|0
units.english: "I am afraid there is not. Give me, say, half an hour and I will have the results ready."
units.italian: "Temo di no. Dammi, diciamo, mezz'ora e avrò i risultati pronti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	Almost an hour passes, but Taely finally responds. "The scan is complete. The system is currently processing all the data it gathered into something usable; there's nothing we can do but wait." She starts staring out of the cockpit windows. "Black holes are such a wonderful phenomenon. They are so mysterious, and each one is peculiar in its own way, this one especially."|965|0
units.english: Almost an hour passes, but Taely finally responds. "The scan is complete. The system is currently processing all the data it gathered into something usable; there's nothing we can do but wait." She starts staring out of the cockpit windows. "Black holes are such a wonderful phenomenon. They are so mysterious, and each one is peculiar in its own way, this one especially."
units.italian: Passa quasi un'ora, ma alla fine Taely risponde. "La scansione è completa. Il sistema sta elaborando tutti i dati raccolti in qualcosa di utilizzabile; non possiamo fare altro che aspettare." Comincia a fissare fuori dai finestrini della cabina. "I buchi neri sono un fenomeno meraviglioso. Sono così misteriosi, e ognuno è peculiare a modo suo, questo in particolare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Did you find anything new on how this system appeared?"|967|0
units.english: "Did you find anything new on how this system appeared?"
units.italian: "Hai scoperto qualcosa di nuovo su come è apparso questo sistema?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Was this one already known to the Remnant?"|969|0
units.english: "Was this one already known to the Remnant?"
units.italian: "Questo era già noto ai Remnant?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"That is the oddest part; it was not. We knew about the existence of the stars beyond Postverta as they could be observed from our own systems; they just were not reachable with a jump drive. But, from what I can tell from these readings, Patir did not exist until a short time ago.|970|0
units.english: "That is the oddest part; it was not. We knew about the existence of the stars beyond Postverta as they could be observed from our own systems; they just were not reachable with a jump drive. But, from what I can tell from these readings, Patir did not exist until a short time ago.
units.italian: "Questa è la parte più strana: no. Sapevamo dell'esistenza delle stelle oltre Postverta perché potevano essere osservate dai nostri sistemi; semplicemente non erano raggiungibili con un motore di salto. Ma, da quello che riesco a capire da queste letture, Patir non esisteva fino a poco tempo fa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Do you have anything on why this system appeared?" you ask.|971|0
units.english: "Do you have anything on why this system appeared?" you ask.
units.italian: "Hai qualcosa sul perché sia apparso questo sistema?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I only have theories for now, none of which can be confirmed. People more knowledgeable than me in the subject are examining the phenomenon right now. But look at this," she says, opening a star map on a holographic projector. "This white dot is Postverta, and we are here. When Ssil Vida first appeared, it released a strong burst of ionizing radiation, and when we were able to calculate its velocity, we found it was going much faster than the speed of light. It is gradually slowing down, so it will not go much further, but exactly the same day that the energy burst was supposed to arrive here, Patir appeared! It would be an incredible coincidence if the two events were not connected.|973|0
units.english: "I only have theories for now, none of which can be confirmed. People more knowledgeable than me in the subject are examining the phenomenon right now. But look at this," she says, opening a star map on a holographic projector. "This white dot is Postverta, and we are here. When Ssil Vida first appeared, it released a strong burst of ionizing radiation, and when we were able to calculate its velocity, we found it was going much faster than the speed of light. It is gradually slowing down, so it will not go much further, but exactly the same day that the energy burst was supposed to arrive here, Patir appeared! It would be an incredible coincidence if the two events were not connected.
units.italian: "Per ora ho solo teorie, nessuna delle quali può essere confermata. Persone più esperte di me sull'argomento stanno esaminando il fenomeno proprio adesso. Ma guarda questo," dice, aprendo una mappa stellare su un proiettore olografico. "Questo punto bianco è Postverta, e noi siamo qui. Quando Ssil Vida è apparso, ha emesso un forte impulso di radiazione ionizzante, e quando siamo riusciti a calcolarne la velocità, abbiamo scoperto che andava molto più veloce della luce. Sta rallentando gradualmente, quindi non andrà molto più lontano, ma esattamente lo stesso giorno in cui l'impulso energetico sarebbe dovuto arrivare qui, Patir è apparso! Sarebbe una coincidenza incredibile se i due eventi non fossero collegati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"We have even less information about how this system disappeared. If I may venture a guess, I would say that the black hole is involved. The Builders never seemed to possess the ability to make a system disappear, and we have seen in the past that some black holes can render any hyperlane they are connected to inaccessible given enough time. Perhaps a young, non-rotating black hole like this one can do even more. There is a part of me that thinks this system could disappear again any moment, but if anything that motivates me to find as much as we can about it in the time we have," she says with a wink.|974|0
units.english: "We have even less information about how this system disappeared. If I may venture a guess, I would say that the black hole is involved. The Builders never seemed to possess the ability to make a system disappear, and we have seen in the past that some black holes can render any hyperlane they are connected to inaccessible given enough time. Perhaps a young, non-rotating black hole like this one can do even more. There is a part of me that thinks this system could disappear again any moment, but if anything that motivates me to find as much as we can about it in the time we have," she says with a wink.
units.italian: "Abbiamo ancora meno informazioni su come questo sistema sia sparito. Se posso azzardare un'ipotesi, direi che c'entra il buco nero. I Costruttori non sembravano mai aver avuto la capacità di far sparire un sistema, e in passato abbiamo visto che alcuni buchi neri possono rendere inaccessibile qualsiasi ipervia a cui sono collegati, dato abbastanza tempo. Forse un buco nero giovane e non rotante come questo può fare anche di più. C'è una parte di me che pensa che questo sistema potrebbe sparire di nuovo da un momento all'altro, ma se mai questo mi motiva a scoprire il più possibile nel tempo che abbiamo," dice con un occhiolino.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Wait, are we in danger?"|976|0
units.english: "Wait, are we in danger?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, siamo in pericolo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"How much will it take to finish processing the data?"|977|0
units.english: "How much will it take to finish processing the data?"
units.italian: "Quanto ci vorrà per finire di elaborare i dati?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Oh, I was just letting my imagination fly. There are thousands of other explanations that are as good as mine, none of which include such a tragic ending. But we can ponder more on those explanations on the way back to <planet>."|979|0
units.english: "Oh, I was just letting my imagination fly. There are thousands of other explanations that are as good as mine, none of which include such a tragic ending. But we can ponder more on those explanations on the way back to <planet>."
units.italian: "Oh, stavo solo lasciando volare la fantasia. Ci sono migliaia di altre spiegazioni buone quanto la mia, nessuna delle quali prevede un finale così tragico. Ma possiamo rifletterci meglio sulla via del ritorno su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"It will take some time before the data is completely analyzed. We should return to <planet> before looking it over, as it should be done by then."|982|0
units.english: "It will take some time before the data is completely analyzed. We should return to <planet> before looking it over, as it should be done by then."
units.italian: "Ci vorrà un po' prima che i dati siano analizzati completamente. Dovremmo tornare su <planet> prima di esaminarli, perché a quel punto dovrebbero essere pronti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|dialog|985|0
units.english: You've arrived at <planet>, but your mission is not complete! Make sure Taely and all the equipment passes through <waypoints>. If they are on an escort, you must wait for it to arrive at <waypoints> before you return to <planet>.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma la missione non è completa! Assicurati che Taely e tutta l'attrezzatura passino per <waypoints>. Se sono su una scorta, devi aspettare che arrivi su <waypoints> prima di tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|Upon your return to <planet>, Taely immediately begins browsing through several images on her console that were compiled by the sensors.|988|0
units.english: Upon your return to <planet>, Taely immediately begins browsing through several images on her console that were compiled by the sensors.
units.italian: Al tuo ritorno su <planet>, Taely comincia subito a sfogliare diverse immagini sulla console, compilate dai sensori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Look at these, <first>. What do you see?" The first image shows a ship like the others you've seen in Patir working on some kind of small structure. In the following pictures, presumably depicting different iterations of the same ship, the structure becomes gradually bigger and more complex until the last one, where a Ka'het-like slug is shown growing inside this shell.|989|0
units.english: "Look at these, <first>. What do you see?" The first image shows a ship like the others you've seen in Patir working on some kind of small structure. In the following pictures, presumably depicting different iterations of the same ship, the structure becomes gradually bigger and more complex until the last one, where a Ka'het-like slug is shown growing inside this shell.
units.italian: "Guarda queste, <first>. Cosa vedi?" La prima immagine mostra una nave come le altre che hai visto a Patir, che lavora su una specie di piccola struttura. Nelle immagini successive, che presumibilmente mostrano iterazioni diverse della stessa nave, la struttura diventa gradualmente più grande e complessa, fino all'ultima, dove si vede una lumaca simile a un Ka'het crescere dentro questo guscio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"The ships, the Fetri'sei, are Von Neumann probes," she says. "Self replicating spacecraft. Unlike the Ka'het, which we found to be unable to reproduce and can only be created in a factory, the Ka'sei can duplicate their own structure with the material harvested from the local asteroids. The process probably takes years, or more, but it is still an incredible achievement."|990|0
units.english: "The ships, the Fetri'sei, are Von Neumann probes," she says. "Self replicating spacecraft. Unlike the Ka'het, which we found to be unable to reproduce and can only be created in a factory, the Ka'sei can duplicate their own structure with the material harvested from the local asteroids. The process probably takes years, or more, but it is still an incredible achievement."
units.italian: "Le navi, i Fetri'sei, sono sonde di von Neumann," dice. "Veicoli spaziali autoreplicanti. A differenza dei Ka'het, che abbiamo scoperto essere incapaci di riprodursi e possono essere creati solo in fabbrica, i Ka'sei possono duplicare la propria struttura con il materiale estratto dagli asteroidi locali. Il processo probabilmente richiede anni, o più, ma resta un risultato incredibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"If they can duplicate themselves, why aren't there more Ka'sei?"|993|0
units.english: "If they can duplicate themselves, why aren't there more Ka'sei?"
units.italian: "Se possono duplicarsi, perché non ci sono più Ka'sei?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"If the Builders were able to make self replicating spacecrafts, why aren't the Ka'het like that as well?"|997|0
units.english: "If the Builders were able to make self replicating spacecrafts, why aren't the Ka'het like that as well?"
units.italian: "Se i Costruttori erano in grado di fare veicoli spaziali autoreplicanti, perché i Ka'het non sono così?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"If they were able to get to Patir, does this suggest they have jump drives?"|1001|0
units.english: "If they were able to get to Patir, does this suggest they have jump drives?"
units.italian: "Se sono riusciti ad arrivare a Patir, questo suggerisce che abbiano motori di salto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Why aren't they in other systems?"|1003|0
units.english: "Why aren't they in other systems?"
units.italian: "Perché non sono in altri sistemi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I imagine the problem would be with their lifespan. The Ka'het can survive for a few hundred years once they become operational; these could potentially last for a much shorter time. Another important factor is that we do not know what happened here in the millennia the system was hidden. Perhaps the Ka'sei went into hibernation waiting for the system to appear again."|1008|0
units.english: "I imagine the problem would be with their lifespan. The Ka'het can survive for a few hundred years once they become operational; these could potentially last for a much shorter time. Another important factor is that we do not know what happened here in the millennia the system was hidden. Perhaps the Ka'sei went into hibernation waiting for the system to appear again."
units.italian: "Immagino che il problema sia la loro durata. I Ka'het possono sopravvivere qualche centinaio di anni una volta operativi; questi potrebbero durare molto meno. Un altro fattore importante è che non sappiamo cosa sia successo qui nei millenni in cui il sistema è rimasto nascosto. Forse i Ka'sei sono entrati in ibernazione aspettando che il sistema riapparisse."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	Taely looks towards the console again. On the screen a tactical view of the Fetri'sei appears. "Well, consider that the Ka'het are true battleships, heavily shielded and always with their weapons ready. These are more akin to reconnaissance and mining probes. Their structure is extremely weak, and they do not have any weapons except the equipment necessary to mine asteroids. I imagine it would take decades for even just a Maeri'het to replicate itself.|1013|0
units.english: Taely looks towards the console again. On the screen a tactical view of the Fetri'sei appears. "Well, consider that the Ka'het are true battleships, heavily shielded and always with their weapons ready. These are more akin to reconnaissance and mining probes. Their structure is extremely weak, and they do not have any weapons except the equipment necessary to mine asteroids. I imagine it would take decades for even just a Maeri'het to replicate itself.
units.italian: Taely guarda di nuovo verso la console. Sullo schermo appare una vista tattica del Fetri'sei. "Beh, considera che i Ka'het sono vere navi da battaglia, pesantemente scudate e sempre con le armi pronte. Queste sono più simili a sonde di ricognizione e di estrazione. La loro struttura è estremamente debole, e non hanno armi se non l'equipaggiamento necessario per estrarre dagli asteroidi. Immagino che anche solo un Maeri'het impiegherebbe decenni per replicarsi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"There is also the tactical problem: forcing a Ka'het to spend such a long time building copies of itself makes them vulnerable to enemy attacks and unable to effectively fight back, making them ill-suited for the job."|1014|0
units.english: "There is also the tactical problem: forcing a Ka'het to spend such a long time building copies of itself makes them vulnerable to enemy attacks and unable to effectively fight back, making them ill-suited for the job."
units.italian: "C'è anche il problema tattico: costringere un Ka'het a passare così tanto tempo a costruire copie di sé lo rende vulnerabile agli attacchi nemici e incapace di rispondere efficacemente, il che lo rende inadatto al compito."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|label|1016|0
units.english: jump drive
units.italian: jump drive

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"They do not have any drives on board, not even a hyperdrive. Limited to sub-light velocity, they would need hundreds of years to pass from one system to another, which is a testament to the Builders' patience. Most species we have encountered abandon any form of sub-light transportation between star systems immediately after developing hyperdrive technology. For all we know, the Ember Waste could have been visited by these Fetri'sei or some other Ka'sei, but they had to leave for some reason we are not aware of. The last Builder died almost 100,000 years ago - so long that having a clear idea of what happened is impossible."|1017|0
units.english: "They do not have any drives on board, not even a hyperdrive. Limited to sub-light velocity, they would need hundreds of years to pass from one system to another, which is a testament to the Builders' patience. Most species we have encountered abandon any form of sub-light transportation between star systems immediately after developing hyperdrive technology. For all we know, the Ember Waste could have been visited by these Fetri'sei or some other Ka'sei, but they had to leave for some reason we are not aware of. The last Builder died almost 100,000 years ago - so long that having a clear idea of what happened is impossible."
units.italian: "Non hanno alcun motore a bordo, nemmeno un'iperguida. Limitati alla velocità subluminale, impiegherebbero centinaia di anni per passare da un sistema all'altro, il che è una prova della pazienza dei Costruttori. La maggior parte delle specie che abbiamo incontrato abbandona qualsiasi forma di trasporto subluminale tra sistemi stellari subito dopo aver sviluppato la tecnologia dell'iperguida. Per quanto ne sappiamo, la Distesa di Braci potrebbe essere stata visitata da questi Fetri'sei o da qualche altro Ka'sei, ma devono essere partiti per qualche motivo che non conosciamo. L'ultimo Costruttore è morto quasi 100.000 anni fa, così tanto tempo che avere un'idea chiara di cosa sia successo è impossibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"What's the difference between Ka'sei and Fetri'sei?"|1019|0
units.english: "What's the difference between Ka'sei and Fetri'sei?"
units.italian: "Qual è la differenza tra Ka'sei e Fetri'sei?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"Well, there is no difference," Taely responds, "not in this case at least. The naming scheme the Builders used is a bit odd: we know that 'Ka,' in their language, has a meaning close to the one of 'group,' 'team,' and sometimes even 'ring,' although it can never be used without a name next to it. So we have 'group mar,' 'group het,' and so on. These are not limited to spaceships: the Ka'het, for example, includes both the biological spacecrafts around the Graveyard and the stations that constructs them, while until now we thought that the Ka'sei included only a handful of large scale construction projects. We know 'Fetri' to be a sort of spaceship sub-classification, but we are not aware of its exact meaning. So the Fetri'sei, or 'ship sei' are a part of the Ka'sei, or 'group sei.' To put it simply, it is similar to how all squares are rectangles, but not all rectangles are squares. It just so happens that everything in this system is classified as a Fetri'sei, so we can use either interchangeably.|1020|0
units.english: "Well, there is no difference," Taely responds, "not in this case at least. The naming scheme the Builders used is a bit odd: we know that 'Ka,' in their language, has a meaning close to the one of 'group,' 'team,' and sometimes even 'ring,' although it can never be used without a name next to it. So we have 'group mar,' 'group het,' and so on. These are not limited to spaceships: the Ka'het, for example, includes both the biological spacecrafts around the Graveyard and the stations that constructs them, while until now we thought that the Ka'sei included only a handful of large scale construction projects. We know 'Fetri' to be a sort of spaceship sub-classification, but we are not aware of its exact meaning. So the Fetri'sei, or 'ship sei' are a part of the Ka'sei, or 'group sei.' To put it simply, it is similar to how all squares are rectangles, but not all rectangles are squares. It just so happens that everything in this system is classified as a Fetri'sei, so we can use either interchangeably.
units.italian: "Beh, non c'è differenza," risponde Taely, "almeno non in questo caso. Lo schema di denominazione usato dai Costruttori è un po' strano: sappiamo che 'Ka', nella loro lingua, ha un significato vicino a quello di 'gruppo', 'squadra', e a volte persino 'anello', anche se non può mai essere usato senza un nome accanto. Quindi abbiamo 'gruppo mar', 'gruppo het' e così via. Non si limitano alle navi spaziali: i Ka'het, per esempio, includono sia le navi spaziali biologiche attorno al Cimitero sia le stazioni che le costruiscono, mentre fino a ora pensavamo che i Ka'sei includessero solo una manciata di progetti di costruzione su larga scala. Sappiamo che 'Fetri' è una specie di sottoclasse di navi spaziali, ma non ne conosciamo il significato esatto. Quindi i Fetri'sei, o 'navi sei', sono una parte dei Ka'sei, o 'gruppo sei'. Per dirla semplice, è come il fatto che tutti i quadrati sono rettangoli, ma non tutti i rettangoli sono quadrati. Capita solo che tutto in questo sistema sia classificato come Fetri'sei, quindi possiamo usare l'uno o l'altro indifferentemente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I know someone who will want to see all this. Meet me in the spaceport when you have the chance."|1023|0
units.english: "I know someone who will want to see all this. Meet me in the spaceport when you have the chance."
units.italian: "Conosco qualcuno che vorrà vedere tutto questo. Incontrami allo spazioporto quando puoi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"I know someone who will want to see all this. You have met Dusk, correct?"|1028|0
units.english: "I know someone who will want to see all this. You have met Dusk, correct?"
units.italian: "Conosco qualcuno che vorrà vedere tutto questo. Hai conosciuto Dusk, giusto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	You nod. "I have, but I believe he's busy at the moment."|1029|0
units.english: You nod. "I have, but I believe he's busy at the moment."
units.italian: Annuisci. "L'ho conosciuto, ma credo che al momento sia occupato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 1|	"That is unfortunate. You should show this to him as soon as he is available," Taely responds. "But I fear I now have to go back to my job now, Captain. I would love to continue the exploration with you, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise."|1030|0
