units.english: "That is unfortunate. You should show this to him as soon as he is available," Taely responds. "But I fear I now have to go back to my job now, Captain. I would love to continue the exploration with you, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise."
units.italian: "Peccato. Dovresti mostrarglielo appena sarà disponibile," risponde Taely. "Ma temo di dover tornare al mio lavoro ora, capitano. Mi piacerebbe continuare l'esplorazione con te, ma ci sono questioni più urgenti che devo risolvere al momento. Terrò d'occhio l'attività a Patir, promesso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|name|1033|0
units.english: Scanners in <system>
units.italian: Scansioni in <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|description|1034|0
units.english: Make detailed scans of the asteroid Dusk indicated in the <system> system.
units.italian: Effettua scansioni dettagliate dell'asteroide indicato da Dusk nel sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|blocked|1038|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> available to carry short range scanners. Return here when you have enough free space.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> disponibile per trasportare scanner a corto raggio. Torna qui quando avrai abbastanza spazio libero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|You find Taely waiting for you in the spaceport alongside a young Remnant with a touchpad. They both wave as you approach.|1049|0
units.english: You find Taely waiting for you in the spaceport alongside a young Remnant with a touchpad. They both wave as you approach.
units.italian: Trovi Taely ad aspettarti allo spazioporto insieme a un giovane Remnant con un touchpad. Vi salutano entrambi mentre vi avvicinate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Captain!" Taely says. "Let me introduce you to Dusk. He is a young researcher who specializes in xenoarchaeology and astrobiology. Dusk, this is <first>, the captain who I told you about earlier. Now I'll leave you two to your work, as I fear I have to go back to my job now. I would love to continue the exploration with you both, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise. May the embers burn bright for you both."|1050|0
units.english: "Captain!" Taely says. "Let me introduce you to Dusk. He is a young researcher who specializes in xenoarchaeology and astrobiology. Dusk, this is <first>, the captain who I told you about earlier. Now I'll leave you two to your work, as I fear I have to go back to my job now. I would love to continue the exploration with you both, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise. May the embers burn bright for you both."
units.italian: "Capitano!" dice Taely. "Ti presento Dusk. È un giovane ricercatore specializzato in xenoarcheologia e astrobiologia. Dusk, questo è <first>, il capitano di cui ti ho parlato prima. Ora vi lascio al vostro lavoro, perché temo di dover tornare al mio. Mi piacerebbe continuare l'esplorazione con voi due, ma ci sono questioni più urgenti che devo risolvere al momento. Terrò d'occhio l'attività a Patir, promesso. Che le braci brucino luminose per voi due."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	As Taely wanders off, you turn to Dusk. "Nice to meet you, Captain!" he says.|1051|0
units.english: As Taely wanders off, you turn to Dusk. "Nice to meet you, Captain!" he says.
units.italian: Mentre Taely si allontana, ti volti verso Dusk. "Piacere di conoscerti, capitano!" dice.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Dusk? Are names like that common?"|1053|0
units.english: "Dusk? Are names like that common?"
units.italian: "Dusk? Nomi così sono comuni?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Pleased to meet you too, Dusk."|1054|0
units.english: "Pleased to meet you too, Dusk."
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerti anche a te, Dusk."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"You mean names of the various phases of daylight? Mmm, I would not say they are common, but nor are they rare, either. Our ancestors devoted their lives, one way or another, to studying the stars and the everchanging light of the universe. It should not be surprising that their vocabulary should be so entwined in our culture.|1056|0
units.english: "You mean names of the various phases of daylight? Mmm, I would not say they are common, but nor are they rare, either. Our ancestors devoted their lives, one way or another, to studying the stars and the everchanging light of the universe. It should not be surprising that their vocabulary should be so entwined in our culture.
units.italian: "Intendi i nomi delle varie fasi della luce del giorno? Mmm, non direi che sono comuni, ma nemmeno rari. I nostri antenati dedicarono la vita, in un modo o nell'altro, a studiare le stelle e la luce sempre cangiante dell'universo. Non dovrebbe sorprendere che il loro vocabolario sia così intrecciato con la nostra cultura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|You find Taely waiting for you in the spaceport alongside Dusk. They both wave as you approach.|1060|0
units.english: You find Taely waiting for you in the spaceport alongside Dusk. They both wave as you approach.
units.italian: Trovi Taely ad aspettarti allo spazioporto insieme a Dusk. Vi salutano entrambi mentre vi avvicinate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Captain!" Taely says. "I believe you already know Dusk. Dusk, I think you should find this to be right in your area of interest. Now I'll leave you two to your work, as I fear I have to go back to my job now. I would love to continue the exploration with you both, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise. May the embers burn bright for you both."|1061|0
units.english: "Captain!" Taely says. "I believe you already know Dusk. Dusk, I think you should find this to be right in your area of interest. Now I'll leave you two to your work, as I fear I have to go back to my job now. I would love to continue the exploration with you both, but there are more pressing issues I have to resolve at the moment. I will keep an eye on the activity in Patir, I promise. May the embers burn bright for you both."
units.italian: "Capitano!" dice Taely. "Credo che tu conosca già Dusk. Dusk, penso che troverai questo proprio nel tuo campo di interesse. Ora vi lascio al vostro lavoro, perché temo di dover tornare al mio. Mi piacerebbe continuare l'esplorazione con voi due, ma ci sono questioni più urgenti che devo risolvere al momento. Terrò d'occhio l'attività a Patir, promesso. Che le braci brucino luminose per voi due."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	As Taely wanders off, you turn to Dusk. "Nice to see you again, Captain!" he says.|1062|0
units.english: As Taely wanders off, you turn to Dusk. "Nice to see you again, Captain!" he says.
units.italian: Mentre Taely si allontana, ti volti verso Dusk. "Piacere di rivederti, capitano!" dice.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|Dusk is no longer busy. Do you want to contact him about Patir, the black hole system in the Graveyard that appeared out of nowhere?|1066|0
units.english: Dusk is no longer busy. Do you want to contact him about Patir, the black hole system in the Graveyard that appeared out of nowhere?
units.italian: Dusk non è più occupato. Vuoi contattarlo per parlare di Patir, il sistema con il buco nero nel Cimitero apparso dal nulla?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	(Sure.)|1068|0
units.english: (Sure.)
units.italian: (Certo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	(Not right now.)|1069|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	You contact Dusk, and he agrees to meet you in the cafeteria. When you spot him, he waves to you. "Nice to meet you again, Captain!" he says.|1072|0
units.english: You contact Dusk, and he agrees to meet you in the cafeteria. When you spot him, he waves to you. "Nice to meet you again, Captain!" he says.
units.italian: Contatti Dusk, e accetta di incontrarti con te in caffetteria. Quando lo individui, ti saluta con la mano. "Piacere di rivederti, capitano!" dice.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Good to see you too, Dusk."|1075|0
units.english: "Good to see you too, Dusk."
units.italian: "Bene rivederti, Dusk."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Has Taely told you about what we found?"|1077|0
units.english: "Has Taely told you about what we found?"
units.italian: "Taely ti ha raccontato cosa abbiamo trovato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Yes, a new system has appeared in the Graveyard. How exciting! Taely sent me the data as soon as she could.|1078|0
units.english: "Yes, a new system has appeared in the Graveyard. How exciting! Taely sent me the data as soon as she could.
units.italian: "Sì, è apparso un nuovo sistema nel Cimitero. Che emozione! Taely mi ha mandato i dati appena ha potuto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"I have found something interesting in the data Taely sent me, Captain." Dusk shows you a map of the system Patir with various lines drawn all over it. "This image shows the route followed by every Ka'sei the scanner was able to track. At first sight they do not seem to have much in common, right? However, upon closer examination, there is something consistent about almost every path: once in a while, every ship spends a few minutes on a single asteroid - one of the biggest in the entire asteroid belt.|1082|0
units.english: "I have found something interesting in the data Taely sent me, Captain." Dusk shows you a map of the system Patir with various lines drawn all over it. "This image shows the route followed by every Ka'sei the scanner was able to track. At first sight they do not seem to have much in common, right? However, upon closer examination, there is something consistent about almost every path: once in a while, every ship spends a few minutes on a single asteroid - one of the biggest in the entire asteroid belt.
units.italian: "Ho trovato qualcosa di interessante nei dati che mi ha mandato Taely, capitano." Dusk ti mostra una mappa del sistema Patir con varie linee tracciate. "Questa immagine mostra la rotta seguita da ogni Ka'sei che lo scanner è riuscito a tracciare. A prima vista non sembrano avere molto in comune, vero? Comunque, guardando meglio, c'è qualcosa di coerente in quasi tutti i percorsi: ogni tanto, ogni nave passa qualche minuto su un singolo asteroide, uno dei più grandi dell'intera cintura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"However, this could have easily been just a coincidence; it takes a lot of effort to extract resources from asteroids that size, so maybe they were just combining their forces to harvest it. So, at this point I had an idea." The screen on the touchpad changes, now showing raw numbers separated on a spreadsheet. "The sensors you carried to Patir had various functions, one of which was a high power asteroid scanner. The asteroid in particular was shown to be extremely rich in a particular metal, iridium. There is more iridium in it than the whole of half a dozen Ember Waste systems, planets included. However, here is the odd part: the concentration of iridium on the asteroid when you jumped away was not lower than when the scanning begun, it was higher! For whatever reason, the Fetri'sei are depositing iridium on the asteroid."|1083|0
units.english: "However, this could have easily been just a coincidence; it takes a lot of effort to extract resources from asteroids that size, so maybe they were just combining their forces to harvest it. So, at this point I had an idea." The screen on the touchpad changes, now showing raw numbers separated on a spreadsheet. "The sensors you carried to Patir had various functions, one of which was a high power asteroid scanner. The asteroid in particular was shown to be extremely rich in a particular metal, iridium. There is more iridium in it than the whole of half a dozen Ember Waste systems, planets included. However, here is the odd part: the concentration of iridium on the asteroid when you jumped away was not lower than when the scanning begun, it was higher! For whatever reason, the Fetri'sei are depositing iridium on the asteroid."
units.italian: "Però potrebbe essere stata solo una coincidenza; serve molto sforzo per estrarre risorse da asteroidi di quelle dimensioni, quindi magari stavano solo unendo le forze per raccoglierle. Così, a quel punto, ho avuto un'idea." Lo schermo del touchpad cambia, mostrando ora numeri grezzi separati su un foglio di calcolo. "I sensori che hai portato a Patir avevano varie funzioni, una delle quali era uno scanner per asteroidi ad alta potenza. Quell'asteroide in particolare si è rivelato estremamente ricco di un metallo specifico, l'iridio. Ce n'è più che in mezza dozzina di sistemi della Distesa di Braci, pianeti compresi. Però ecco la parte strana: la concentrazione di iridio sull'asteroide quando sei saltato via non era inferiore a quando è iniziata la scansione, era superiore! Per qualche motivo, i Fetri'sei stanno depositando iridio sull'asteroide."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Are you sure that it isn't just an error in the measurement?"|1085|0
units.english: "Are you sure that it isn't just an error in the measurement?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che non sia solo un errore di misura?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Why are they doing that?"|1086|0
units.english: "Why are they doing that?"
units.italian: "Perché lo fanno?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"Well, it is a possibility; this instrumentation has not been tested in years. But if it is not, this could give us a lot of insight on the real purpose of these Ka'sei and why they are around that black hole. It is at least worth studying!|1088|0
units.english: "Well, it is a possibility; this instrumentation has not been tested in years. But if it is not, this could give us a lot of insight on the real purpose of these Ka'sei and why they are around that black hole. It is at least worth studying!
units.italian: "Beh, è una possibilità; questa strumentazione non viene testata da anni. Ma se non lo è, potrebbe darci molte informazioni sul vero scopo di questi Ka'sei e sul perché stiano attorno a quel buco nero. Vale almeno la pena studiarlo!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"That is what we are going to find out together! The only way we can find insights on their real purpose is to study this asteroid and what the Ka'sei are doing there.|1091|0
units.english: "That is what we are going to find out together! The only way we can find insights on their real purpose is to study this asteroid and what the Ka'sei are doing there.
units.italian: "È quello che scopriremo insieme! L'unico modo per capire il loro vero scopo è studiare questo asteroide e ciò che i Ka'sei stanno facendo lì.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|	"The plan is to take a short range high power scanner and map the entire asteroid to analyze the site where the Ka'sei are bringing the iridium. After you have made extensive scans of the sites I indicate to you, reach me back here on <origin> so that I can analyze the data. If everything goes well, you should be back here in a couple weeks. Now I have already directed the spaceport engineers to install the scanners on your ship. I almost can't wait to see what you find there!" Dusk is so excited that he leaves before you can respond.|1093|0
units.english: "The plan is to take a short range high power scanner and map the entire asteroid to analyze the site where the Ka'sei are bringing the iridium. After you have made extensive scans of the sites I indicate to you, reach me back here on <origin> so that I can analyze the data. If everything goes well, you should be back here in a couple weeks. Now I have already directed the spaceport engineers to install the scanners on your ship. I almost can't wait to see what you find there!" Dusk is so excited that he leaves before you can respond.
units.italian: "Il piano è prendere uno scanner ad alta potenza a corto raggio e mappare l'intero asteroide per analizzare il sito in cui i Ka'sei portano l'iridio. Dopo aver fatto scansioni estese dei siti che ti indico, raggiungimi qui su <origin> così posso analizzare i dati. Se tutto va bene, dovresti essere di ritorno qui in un paio di settimane. Ho già incaricato gli ingegneri dello spazioporto di installare gli scanner sulla tua nave. Non vedo quasi l'ora di sapere cosa troverai!" Dusk è così eccitato che se ne va prima che tu possa rispondere.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|After a brief scan of the system, your ship's computers identify the asteroid that Dusk talked about. Compared to the asteroids you are used to, this one is orders of magnitude bigger, almost the size of a small moon. Land on <planet> in order to get close enough for the short range scanner to analyze it.|1101|0
units.english: After a brief scan of the system, your ship's computers identify the asteroid that Dusk talked about. Compared to the asteroids you are used to, this one is orders of magnitude bigger, almost the size of a small moon. Land on <planet> in order to get close enough for the short range scanner to analyze it.
units.italian: Dopo una breve scansione del sistema, i computer della nave identificano l'asteroide di cui parlava Dusk. Rispetto agli asteroidi a cui sei abituato, questo è ordini di grandezza più grande, quasi la dimensione di una piccola luna. Atterra su <planet> per avvicinarti abbastanza perché lo scanner a corto raggio possa analizzarlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 2|dialog|1103|0
units.english: You've arrived, but you realize your escort carrying the <commodity> has not yet entered the system! Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei arrivato, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con <commodity> non è ancora entrata nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|name|1111|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|description|1112|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to show the results of your scans of the large asteroid in Patir to Dusk.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per mostrare a Dusk i risultati delle tue scansioni del grande asteroide di Patir.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|Your initial scans suggest that the asteroid is slowly rotating like a moon or planet. You set your ship on a polar orbit around it and activate the sensors that Dusk gave you, hopefully to find some answers to all the questions raised by Patir's mysterious appearance.|1120|0
units.english: Your initial scans suggest that the asteroid is slowly rotating like a moon or planet. You set your ship on a polar orbit around it and activate the sensors that Dusk gave you, hopefully to find some answers to all the questions raised by Patir's mysterious appearance.
units.italian: Le tue prime scansioni suggeriscono che l'asteroide ruota lentamente come una luna o un pianeta. Metti la nave in orbita polare attorno a esso e attivi i sensori che ti ha dato Dusk, sperando di trovare qualche risposta a tutte le domande sollevate dall'apparizione misteriosa di Patir.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	You start your exploration from the dark side of the asteroid, and from the little you can see, its surface appears to be completely covered in regolith of little importance. But soon after passing the terminator, you see an extremely reflective patch near the horizon. As you get closer, it becomes clear that this is the storage of iridium that Dusk was talking about: an enormous solidified lake of the reflective metal extending for kilometers in every direction inside a gigantic hole the Ka'sei have dug in the terrain.|1121|0
units.english: You start your exploration from the dark side of the asteroid, and from the little you can see, its surface appears to be completely covered in regolith of little importance. But soon after passing the terminator, you see an extremely reflective patch near the horizon. As you get closer, it becomes clear that this is the storage of iridium that Dusk was talking about: an enormous solidified lake of the reflective metal extending for kilometers in every direction inside a gigantic hole the Ka'sei have dug in the terrain.
units.italian: Cominci l'esplorazione dal lato scuro dell'asteroide, e da quel poco che riesci a vedere, la sua superficie sembra completamente coperta di regolite di scarsa importanza. Ma poco dopo aver superato il terminatore, vedi una chiazza estremamente riflettente vicino all'orizzonte. Avvicinandoti, diventa chiaro che è il deposito di iridio di cui parlava Dusk: un enorme lago solidificato di quel metallo riflettente che si estende per chilometri in ogni direzione dentro un gigantesco buco che i Ka'sei hanno scavato nel terreno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	In a few hours, you are able to check every site you were told to scan, but most of the surface still remains an unknown.|1122|0
units.english: In a few hours, you are able to check every site you were told to scan, but most of the surface still remains an unknown.
units.italian: In qualche ora riesci a controllare ogni sito che ti è stato detto di scansionare, ma gran parte della superficie resta sconosciuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	(Continue my exploration of the asteroid.)|1124|0
units.english: (Continue my exploration of the asteroid.)
units.italian: (Continua la mia esplorazione dell'asteroide.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	(Leave and return to Aventine.)|1126|0
units.english: (Leave and return to Aventine.)
units.italian: (Parti e torna su Aventine.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	As you are preparing to jump away, an artificial structure near the edge of the iridium storage catches your eye, and you decide to bring your ship in closer.|1127|0
units.english: As you are preparing to jump away, an artificial structure near the edge of the iridium storage catches your eye, and you decide to bring your ship in closer.
units.italian: Mentre ti prepari a saltare via, una struttura artificiale vicino al bordo del deposito di iridio attira la tua attenzione, e decidi di avvicinare la nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	While you are setting up a new route to pass above as much terrain as possible, your eye is caught by an artificial structure near the edge of the iridium storage.|1130|0
units.english: While you are setting up a new route to pass above as much terrain as possible, your eye is caught by an artificial structure near the edge of the iridium storage.
units.italian: Mentre stai impostando una nuova rotta per passare sopra quanta più superficie possibile, il tuo sguardo è catturato da una struttura artificiale vicino al bordo del deposito di iridio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	The first thing you notice is an array of extremely tall pylons arranged into two parallel lines. When you approach to get a better angle, you discover a large cupola towering over the area. Although understanding its scale without a reference point is hard, you estimate it must be at least a kilometer in diameter.|1133|0
units.english: The first thing you notice is an array of extremely tall pylons arranged into two parallel lines. When you approach to get a better angle, you discover a large cupola towering over the area. Although understanding its scale without a reference point is hard, you estimate it must be at least a kilometer in diameter.
units.italian: La prima cosa che noti è una serie di piloni estremamente alti disposti in due linee parallele. Quando ti avvicini per avere un'angolazione migliore, scopri una grande cupola che torreggia sull'area. Anche se capirne la scala senza un punto di riferimento è difficile, stimi che debba avere almeno un chilometro di diametro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	You wonder if you should get closer, but the Ka'sei may not take kindly to you approaching their structure.|1134|0
units.english: You wonder if you should get closer, but the Ka'sei may not take kindly to you approaching their structure.
units.italian: Ti chiedi se avvicinarti, ma i Ka'sei potrebbero non gradire che ti avvicini alla loro struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	(Collect measurements at a safe distance.)|1136|0
units.english: (Collect measurements at a safe distance.)
units.italian: (Raccogli misurazioni a distanza di sicurezza.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	(Go near the structure, regardless of the risk.)|1137|0
units.english: (Go near the structure, regardless of the risk.)
units.italian: (Vai vicino alla struttura, qualunque sia il rischio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	The data that Dusk's scanners will gather will not be perfect, but it is better than having to risk getting close to something you know so little about. After a few minutes, the scan completes, and you are ready to return to <planet>.|1139|0
units.english: The data that Dusk's scanners will gather will not be perfect, but it is better than having to risk getting close to something you know so little about. After a few minutes, the scan completes, and you are ready to return to <planet>.
units.italian: I dati che gli scanner di Dusk raccoglieranno non saranno perfetti, ma è meglio che dover rischiare di avvicinarsi a qualcosa di cui sai così poco. Dopo qualche minuto la scansione è completa, e sei pronto a tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|	You carefully position your ship above the structure and activate the sensors. As the scan proceeds, you monitor the position of the Ka'sei fleet. Some of the Fetri'sei nearest to you have stopped their standard activities and are standing by, perhaps observing your actions the same way you are observing theirs. Luckily, after a few minutes the sensors complete their analysis of the structure and you are ready to return to <planet> unmolested.|1144|0
units.english: You carefully position your ship above the structure and activate the sensors. As the scan proceeds, you monitor the position of the Ka'sei fleet. Some of the Fetri'sei nearest to you have stopped their standard activities and are standing by, perhaps observing your actions the same way you are observing theirs. Luckily, after a few minutes the sensors complete their analysis of the structure and you are ready to return to <planet> unmolested.
units.italian: Posizioni con cura la nave sopra la struttura e attivi i sensori. Mentre la scansione procede, monitori la posizione della flotta di Ka'sei. Alcuni dei Fetri'sei più vicini a te hanno smesso le loro attività abituali e restano in attesa, forse osservando le tue azioni nello stesso modo in cui tu osservi le loro. Per fortuna, dopo qualche minuto i sensori completano l'analisi della struttura e sei pronto a tornare su <planet> indisturbato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|dialog|1147|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you realize your escort carrying the <commodity> has not yet entered the system! Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con <commodity> non è ancora entrata nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 3|Near the landing area, you discuss with Dusk what you have found next to the iridium storage. "This is fantastic! It is so much more than I hoped to find with this expedition. Give me a few hours to analyze the data and meet me in the spaceport."|1150|0
units.english: Near the landing area, you discuss with Dusk what you have found next to the iridium storage. "This is fantastic! It is so much more than I hoped to find with this expedition. Give me a few hours to analyze the data and meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Vicino all'area di atterraggio, discuti con Dusk di quello che hai trovato accanto al deposito di iridio. "È fantastico! È molto più di quanto sperassi di trovare con questa spedizione. Dammi qualche ora per analizzare i dati e incontrami allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|name|1153|0
units.english: Visit the asteroid
units.italian: Visita l'asteroide

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|description|1154|0
units.english: Bring Dusk to <system> to visit the ancient Builder settlement.
units.italian: Porta Dusk su <system> per visitare l'antico insediamento dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|blocked|1158|0
units.english: You'll need <capacity> available so Dusk can join you on your mission. Return with the available space to continue.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> disponibile perché Dusk possa unirsi a te nella missione. Torna con lo spazio disponibile per continuare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|You meet Dusk again in the cafeteria with his touchpad, as usual. "Thank you again for your help, <first>. There is a lot we can learn about the Builders with this discovery." He shows you a black and white image of a building inside a hemispherical dome. The complex appears to be made of interconnected cylinders, presumably habitation modules.|1163|0
units.english: You meet Dusk again in the cafeteria with his touchpad, as usual. "Thank you again for your help, <first>. There is a lot we can learn about the Builders with this discovery." He shows you a black and white image of a building inside a hemispherical dome. The complex appears to be made of interconnected cylinders, presumably habitation modules.
units.italian: Incontri di nuovo Dusk in caffetteria con il suo touchpad, come al solito. "Grazie ancora per il tuo aiuto, <first>. C'è molto che possiamo imparare sui Costruttori con questa scoperta." Ti mostra un'immagine in bianco e nero di un edificio dentro una cupola emisferica. Il complesso sembra fatto di cilindri interconnessi, presumibilmente moduli abitativi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"What is that?"|1165|0
units.english: "What is that?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"Oh, it is the scan you made of the Builder structure. Here, look: the external cupola is completely pressurized, which could give us insights about the biology of the Builders. The composition of the atmosphere on their planets is likely to have changed after so much time, and every manned station the Ka'het could reach was long destroyed. This is the first time we have the possibility to study the gases they could breathe without having the results compromised by millennia of biological activity. Inside the cupola there is also a large intact complex, which could give us more answers about all of this.|1166|0
units.english: "Oh, it is the scan you made of the Builder structure. Here, look: the external cupola is completely pressurized, which could give us insights about the biology of the Builders. The composition of the atmosphere on their planets is likely to have changed after so much time, and every manned station the Ka'het could reach was long destroyed. This is the first time we have the possibility to study the gases they could breathe without having the results compromised by millennia of biological activity. Inside the cupola there is also a large intact complex, which could give us more answers about all of this.
units.italian: "Oh, è la scansione che hai fatto della struttura dei Costruttori. Ecco, guarda: la cupola esterna è completamente pressurizzata, il che potrebbe darci informazioni sulla biologia dei Costruttori. La composizione dell'atmosfera sui loro pianeti è probabilmente cambiata dopo tanto tempo, e ogni stazione con equipaggio che i Ka'het potevano raggiungere è stata distrutta da tempo. È la prima volta che abbiamo la possibilità di studiare i gas che potevano respirare senza che i risultati siano compromessi da millenni di attività biologica. Dentro la cupola c'è anche un grande complesso intatto, che potrebbe darci più risposte su tutto questo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"If you can bring me to the asteroid, I could be able use the controls and enter in the cupola to measure the composition of the atmosphere."|1167|0
units.english: "If you can bring me to the asteroid, I could be able use the controls and enter in the cupola to measure the composition of the atmosphere."
units.italian: "Se riesci a portarmi sull'asteroide, potrei usare i controlli ed entrare nella cupola per misurare la composizione dell'atmosfera."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"I'm ready to go."|1169|0
units.english: "I'm ready to go."
units.italian: "Sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"Wait, are you saying that you can read the Builder language?"|1171|0
units.english: "Wait, are you saying that you can read the Builder language?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, stai dicendo che sai leggere la lingua dei Costruttori?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|	"Very approximately, but yes. We have been studying every piece of written language we could find from their cities, mostly inside sealed containers. It is very hard to understand full phrases or even what they mean at times, but we can reliably translate most of the common words and phrases, which will hopefully be enough for our mission."|1172|0
units.english: "Very approximately, but yes. We have been studying every piece of written language we could find from their cities, mostly inside sealed containers. It is very hard to understand full phrases or even what they mean at times, but we can reliably translate most of the common words and phrases, which will hopefully be enough for our mission."
units.italian: "Molto approssimativamente, ma sì. Abbiamo studiato ogni pezzo di lingua scritta che siamo riusciti a trovare nelle loro città, per lo più dentro contenitori sigillati. È molto difficile capire frasi intere o persino cosa significhino a volte, ma riusciamo a tradurre in modo affidabile la maggior parte delle parole e delle frasi comuni, il che speriamo basti per la nostra missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 4|dialog|1175|0
units.english: You've arrived, but you realize your escort carrying Dusk has not yet entered the system! Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei arrivato, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Dusk non è ancora entrata nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|name|1179|0
units.english: First contact
units.italian: Primo contatto

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|description|1180|0
units.english: After the tumultuous first contact, return to <destination> without hurting any Ka'sei, even if they attack you.
units.italian: Dopo il turbolento primo contatto, torna su <destination> senza ferire nessun Ka'sei, anche se ti attaccano.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|As you approach the structure, Dusk stops preparing the equipment to observe it from the window. "It is a fascinating structure. I've only seen a small number of Builder buildings, but this looks different from anything I have seen. Perhaps it is more structurally similar to their stations than their outposts given the almost negligible gravity, or they had other asteroid colonies that have been gradually lost over time. It would be worth doing a serious exploration of the asteroid belts in the Graveyard at some point."|1189|0
units.english: As you approach the structure, Dusk stops preparing the equipment to observe it from the window. "It is a fascinating structure. I've only seen a small number of Builder buildings, but this looks different from anything I have seen. Perhaps it is more structurally similar to their stations than their outposts given the almost negligible gravity, or they had other asteroid colonies that have been gradually lost over time. It would be worth doing a serious exploration of the asteroid belts in the Graveyard at some point."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini alla struttura, Dusk smette di preparare l'attrezzatura per osservarla dal finestrino. "È una struttura affascinante. Ho visto solo un piccolo numero di edifici dei Costruttori, ma questo sembra diverso da tutto ciò che ho visto. Forse è strutturalmente più simile alle loro stazioni che ai loro avamposti, data la gravità quasi trascurabile, o avevano altre colonie sugli asteroidi che sono andate perse nel tempo. Varrebbe la pena fare un'esplorazione seria delle cinture di asteroidi del Cimitero, prima o poi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"You have been on Builder planets?"|1191|0
units.english: "You have been on Builder planets?"
units.italian: "Sei stato su pianeti dei Costruttori?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"How far have the Remnant explored the Graveyard?"|1193|0
units.english: "How far have the Remnant explored the Graveyard?"
units.italian: "Quanto lontano hanno esplorato i Remnant nel Cimitero?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Do you have all the equipment ready?"|1194|0
units.english: "Do you have all the equipment ready?"
units.italian: "Hai tutta l'attrezzatura pronta?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"I presume Taely already told you about the troubled beginnings we had in exploring the area; as a consequence of that, we had to reevaluate the procedures for exploring the nearby systems and species, especially beyond the Ossipago wormhole. Every scout ship entering the area has to always remain cloaked to prevent attacks from the countless Ka'het patrolling the area; this means that the further we need to travel to reach the destination, the more fuel we have to spend to return home, which considerably impacts the time we can spend cloaked in the destination. Some of the systems at the other end of the Graveyard have seen very few Starlings, most of them staying for less than a day.|1197|0
units.english: "I presume Taely already told you about the troubled beginnings we had in exploring the area; as a consequence of that, we had to reevaluate the procedures for exploring the nearby systems and species, especially beyond the Ossipago wormhole. Every scout ship entering the area has to always remain cloaked to prevent attacks from the countless Ka'het patrolling the area; this means that the further we need to travel to reach the destination, the more fuel we have to spend to return home, which considerably impacts the time we can spend cloaked in the destination. Some of the systems at the other end of the Graveyard have seen very few Starlings, most of them staying for less than a day.
units.italian: "Immagino che Taely ti abbia già raccontato degli inizi travagliati che abbiamo avuto esplorando la zona; di conseguenza abbiamo dovuto rivedere le procedure per esplorare i sistemi e le specie vicini, soprattutto oltre il cunicolo di Ossipago. Ogni nave di esplorazione che entra nella zona deve restare sempre occultata per evitare gli attacchi degli innumerevoli Ka'het che pattugliano l'area; questo significa che più lontano dobbiamo andare per raggiungere la destinazione, più carburante dobbiamo spendere per tornare a casa, il che incide considerevolmente sul tempo che possiamo restare occultati nella destinazione. Alcuni sistemi dall'altra parte del Cimitero hanno visto pochissime Starling, la maggior parte delle quali resta meno di un giorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Still, even with these limitations we were able to make considerable progress. We can read some of the words in their language, and we were able to retrieve a countless number of partly intact Builder artifacts. Perhaps some day we will be able to understand how to control the Ka'het. Who knows?|1198|0
units.english: "Still, even with these limitations we were able to make considerable progress. We can read some of the words in their language, and we were able to retrieve a countless number of partly intact Builder artifacts. Perhaps some day we will be able to understand how to control the Ka'het. Who knows?
units.italian: "Eppure, anche con questi limiti siamo riusciti a fare progressi considerevoli. Sappiamo leggere alcune parole della loro lingua, e siamo riusciti a recuperare un numero incalcolabile di manufatti dei Costruttori parzialmente intatti. Forse un giorno saremo in grado di capire come controllare i Ka'het. Chissà?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Oh I have, many times. I have never been on a Builder station, but on a few occasions I have participated to expeditions to newly discovered cities or semi-submersed bunkers. I presume Taely already told you about the troubled beginnings we had in exploring the area; as a consequence of that, we had to reevaluate the procedures for exploring the nearby systems and species, especially beyond the Ossipago wormhole. Every scout ship entering the area has to always remain cloaked for safety; this means that exploring planets is only possible for a limited time and that you cannot leave your ship if you do not have a means of hiding yourself from them.|1202|0
units.english: "Oh I have, many times. I have never been on a Builder station, but on a few occasions I have participated to expeditions to newly discovered cities or semi-submersed bunkers. I presume Taely already told you about the troubled beginnings we had in exploring the area; as a consequence of that, we had to reevaluate the procedures for exploring the nearby systems and species, especially beyond the Ossipago wormhole. Every scout ship entering the area has to always remain cloaked for safety; this means that exploring planets is only possible for a limited time and that you cannot leave your ship if you do not have a means of hiding yourself from them.
units.italian: "Oh, sì, molte volte. Non sono mai stato su una stazione dei Costruttori, ma in alcune occasioni ho partecipato a spedizioni verso città scoperte di recente o bunker semisommersi. Immagino che Taely ti abbia già raccontato degli inizi travagliati che abbiamo avuto esplorando la zona; di conseguenza abbiamo dovuto rivedere le procedure per esplorare i sistemi e le specie vicini, soprattutto oltre il cunicolo di Ossipago. Ogni nave di esplorazione che entra nella zona deve restare sempre occultata, per sicurezza; questo significa che esplorare i pianeti è possibile solo per un tempo limitato e che non puoi lasciare la nave se non hai un modo per nasconderti da loro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Because of this, most of the planetary exploration is done with robotic probes. The Ka'het are able to detect and destroy devices that use faster than light communication, so only remote control with a Starling in the same system is possible. There are a lot of compromises that must be taken, but we can still make considerable progress even with these restrictions.|1203|0
units.english: "Because of this, most of the planetary exploration is done with robotic probes. The Ka'het are able to detect and destroy devices that use faster than light communication, so only remote control with a Starling in the same system is possible. There are a lot of compromises that must be taken, but we can still make considerable progress even with these restrictions.
units.italian: "Per questo, la maggior parte dell'esplorazione planetaria viene fatta con sonde robotiche. I Ka'het sono in grado di rilevare e distruggere i dispositivi che usano comunicazioni più veloci della luce, quindi è possibile solo il controllo remoto con una Starling nello stesso sistema. Ci sono molti compromessi da accettare, ma riusciamo comunque a fare progressi considerevoli anche con queste restrizioni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"I need to prepare a few more instruments before we land," Dusk says as he stops staring at the dome and returns to his equipment. As you reach the complex, you do a few flights around it in search for a good landing site. Dusk points out a spot right next to a set of small circular indentations on the structure. After touching down, you and Dusk don extravehicular suits and start walking towards the cupola. He stops in front of a ring on its surface and starts looking through his equipment.|1206|0
units.english: "I need to prepare a few more instruments before we land," Dusk says as he stops staring at the dome and returns to his equipment. As you reach the complex, you do a few flights around it in search for a good landing site. Dusk points out a spot right next to a set of small circular indentations on the structure. After touching down, you and Dusk don extravehicular suits and start walking towards the cupola. He stops in front of a ring on its surface and starts looking through his equipment.
units.italian: "Devo preparare qualche altro strumento prima di atterrare," dice Dusk, smettendo di fissare la cupola e tornando alla sua attrezzatura. Quando raggiungi il complesso, fai qualche giro intorno in cerca di un buon punto di atterraggio. Dusk ne indica uno proprio accanto a una serie di piccole rientranze circolari sulla struttura. Dopo l'atterraggio, tu e Dusk indossate le tute extraveicolari e cominciate a camminare verso la cupola. Lui si ferma davanti a un anello sulla superficie e comincia a frugare nella sua attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"What is that?"|1208|0
units.english: "What is that?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Well, I obviously cannot be sure, but given its location and that on the other side there is a pressurized area, it should be an airlock. I have seen scans of the Builder stations, and they look quite similar." He takes a heavy-looking scanner, puts it on the wall of the structure and starts moving it around. "If I am right, this way should have a control station hidden inside the wall - and here it is!" he sings with satisfaction.|1209|0
units.english: "Well, I obviously cannot be sure, but given its location and that on the other side there is a pressurized area, it should be an airlock. I have seen scans of the Builder stations, and they look quite similar." He takes a heavy-looking scanner, puts it on the wall of the structure and starts moving it around. "If I am right, this way should have a control station hidden inside the wall - and here it is!" he sings with satisfaction.
units.italian: "Beh, ovviamente non posso esserne certo, ma vista la posizione e il fatto che dall'altra parte c'è un'area pressurizzata, dovrebbe essere una camera di equilibrio. Ho visto scansioni delle stazioni dei Costruttori, e sono piuttosto simili." Prende uno scanner dall'aria pesante, lo appoggia alla parete della struttura e comincia a muoverlo. "Se ho ragione, da questa parte dovrebbe esserci una stazione di controllo nascosta nel muro... ed eccola!" canta soddisfatto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Using a small instrument similar in appearance to a crowbar, Dusk slowly pulls out a section from the wall, kicking off a good amount of dust in the process. The control station is a two-sided panel, full of switches and buttons with small alien markings above each of them.|1210|0
units.english: Using a small instrument similar in appearance to a crowbar, Dusk slowly pulls out a section from the wall, kicking off a good amount of dust in the process. The control station is a two-sided panel, full of switches and buttons with small alien markings above each of them.
units.italian: Usando un piccolo strumento dall'aspetto simile a un piede di porco, Dusk estrae lentamente una sezione dal muro, sollevando in tal modo una buona quantità di polvere. La stazione di controllo è un pannello a due facce, pieno di interruttori e pulsanti con piccole scritte aliene sopra ciascuno di essi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Can you read them?"|1212|0
units.english: "Can you read them?"
units.italian: "Sai leggerle?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Can you open the airlock?"|1213|0
units.english: "Can you open the airlock?"
units.italian: "Puoi aprire la camera di equilibrio?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Are you sure this won't put us in danger?"|1215|0
units.english: "Are you sure this won't put us in danger?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che non ci metterà in pericolo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"I can, yes. The first row of switches controls the lights inside the complex, the second row controls redundant pressurization systems, and there are similar such operations controlled by the rest of the panel.|1217|0
units.english: "I can, yes. The first row of switches controls the lights inside the complex, the second row controls redundant pressurization systems, and there are similar such operations controlled by the rest of the panel.
units.italian: "Sì, posso. La prima fila di interruttori controlla le luci dentro il complesso, la seconda controlla i sistemi di pressurizzazione ridondanti, e operazioni simili sono controllate dal resto del pannello.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"There is no way to be certain, but this is the only possible way to get in without destroying half of the complex.|1220|0
units.english: "There is no way to be certain, but this is the only possible way to get in without destroying half of the complex.
units.italian: "Non c'è modo di esserne certi, ma è l'unico modo possibile per entrare senza distruggere metà del complesso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"This," Dusk says as he presses a switch in the middle of the panel, "is what we were looking for." Soon after, the door in front of you opens, revealing a small room with another door at the opposite end. You follow Dusk inside, where he takes out the scanner again to look for another control panel. Once that is open, another switch allows him to close the door. Only the lights on your helmet keep you from being submerged in complete darkness. Looking around, you notice that the architecture is distinctly alien, with rounded angles on every side of the room and buttresses on either side of the doors. The ring itself is too small for you to pass through it standing upright, but the low gravity of the asteroid lets you almost fly through it without much trouble. "We now have to wait for the room to pressurize," he tells you.|1222|0
units.english: "This," Dusk says as he presses a switch in the middle of the panel, "is what we were looking for." Soon after, the door in front of you opens, revealing a small room with another door at the opposite end. You follow Dusk inside, where he takes out the scanner again to look for another control panel. Once that is open, another switch allows him to close the door. Only the lights on your helmet keep you from being submerged in complete darkness. Looking around, you notice that the architecture is distinctly alien, with rounded angles on every side of the room and buttresses on either side of the doors. The ring itself is too small for you to pass through it standing upright, but the low gravity of the asteroid lets you almost fly through it without much trouble. "We now have to wait for the room to pressurize," he tells you.
units.italian: "Questo," dice Dusk premendo un interruttore al centro del pannello, "è quello che cercavamo." Poco dopo, la porta davanti a voi si apre, rivelando una piccola stanza con un'altra porta all'estremità opposta. Segui Dusk dentro, dove tira di nuovo fuori lo scanner per cercare un altro pannello di controllo. Una volta aperto, un altro interruttore gli permette di chiudere la porta. Solo le luci sul tuo casco ti impediscono di essere immerso nel buio totale. Guardandoti intorno, noti che l'architettura è decisamente aliena, con angoli arrotondati su ogni lato della stanza e contrafforti ai lati delle porte. L'anello stesso è troppo piccolo perché tu possa passarci in piedi, ma la bassa gravità dell'asteroide ti permette quasi di volarci attraverso senza troppa fatica. "Ora dobbiamo aspettare che la stanza si pressurizzi," ti dice.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"How long do you think it will it take?"|1224|0
units.english: "How long do you think it will it take?"
units.italian: "Quanto pensi che ci vorrà?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Would it be safe to remove our helmets after that?"|1225|0
units.english: "Would it be safe to remove our helmets after that?"
units.italian: "Sarebbe sicuro toglierci i caschi dopo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"I have no idea. Usually it is a matter of a few minutes, but we know next to nothing about this tech. We will have to wait and see. In the meanwhile," he says as he begins to activate another scanner, "I can analyze the atmosphere that is starting to fill this room. It should save us some time to do it here, as well as being safer, should it be dangerous to our suits."|1227|0
units.english: "I have no idea. Usually it is a matter of a few minutes, but we know next to nothing about this tech. We will have to wait and see. In the meanwhile," he says as he begins to activate another scanner, "I can analyze the atmosphere that is starting to fill this room. It should save us some time to do it here, as well as being safer, should it be dangerous to our suits."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea. Di solito è questione di qualche minuto, ma non sappiamo quasi nulla di questa tecnologia. Dovremo aspettare e vedere. Nel frattempo," dice cominciando ad attivare un altro scanner, "posso analizzare l'atmosfera che comincia a riempire questa stanza. Dovrebbe farci risparmiare tempo farlo qui, oltre a essere più sicuro, nel caso sia pericolosa per le nostre tute."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Dusk gives you an odd look. "Of course not <first>; it would almost certainly kill you. Such an alien atmosphere is unlikely to be breathable for a human, and even if it was we could not be sure until we analyze it extensively." He begins to activate another scanner, "Speaking of which, I can start analyzing the atmosphere that is starting to fill this room. It should save us some time to do it here, as well as also safer, should it be dangerous to our suits."|1230|0
units.english: Dusk gives you an odd look. "Of course not <first>; it would almost certainly kill you. Such an alien atmosphere is unlikely to be breathable for a human, and even if it was we could not be sure until we analyze it extensively." He begins to activate another scanner, "Speaking of which, I can start analyzing the atmosphere that is starting to fill this room. It should save us some time to do it here, as well as also safer, should it be dangerous to our suits."
units.italian: Dusk ti lancia uno sguardo strano. "Ovviamente no, <first>; ti ucciderebbe quasi certamente. Un'atmosfera così aliena è improbabile che sia respirabile per un umano, e anche se lo fosse non potremmo esserne certi finché non l'avessimo analizzata a fondo." Comincia ad attivare un altro scanner: "A proposito, posso iniziare ad analizzare l'atmosfera che comincia a riempire questa stanza. Dovrebbe farci risparmiare tempo farlo qui, oltre a essere più sicuro, nel caso sia pericolosa per le nostre tute."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Dusk continues working on the atmospheric analyzer for about five minutes without anything happening. You try to connect to the scanner on your ship to check the position of the nearby Fetri'sei, but the dome seems to jam all communication with the outside. Suddenly, you hear a loud "pop," and the door that leads inside the dome recesses a few centimeters. "Just in time," Dusk says. "My analysis of the atmosphere has finished. Let us go take a look inside." After a brief look at the writing on the door, he grabs a handle on it and slides it to the left. The hatch starts to slowly open inwards. When you come closer to the entrance you are instantly blinded by a strong light coming from the other side of the door. After lowering the sun shield on your helmet, your eyes start adapting to the new light level, and it takes you a few seconds to realize what is now in front of you. Landed inside the cupola, right in front of the airlock, is a Fetri'sei - a Ka'sei probe - pointed at you and Dusk.|1232|0
units.english: Dusk continues working on the atmospheric analyzer for about five minutes without anything happening. You try to connect to the scanner on your ship to check the position of the nearby Fetri'sei, but the dome seems to jam all communication with the outside. Suddenly, you hear a loud "pop," and the door that leads inside the dome recesses a few centimeters. "Just in time," Dusk says. "My analysis of the atmosphere has finished. Let us go take a look inside." After a brief look at the writing on the door, he grabs a handle on it and slides it to the left. The hatch starts to slowly open inwards. When you come closer to the entrance you are instantly blinded by a strong light coming from the other side of the door. After lowering the sun shield on your helmet, your eyes start adapting to the new light level, and it takes you a few seconds to realize what is now in front of you. Landed inside the cupola, right in front of the airlock, is a Fetri'sei - a Ka'sei probe - pointed at you and Dusk.
units.italian: Dusk continua a lavorare sull'analizzatore atmosferico per circa cinque minuti senza che succeda nulla. Provi a collegarti allo scanner della nave per controllare la posizione dei Fetri'sei vicini, ma la cupola sembra bloccare ogni comunicazione con l'esterno. All'improvviso senti un forte "pop", e la porta che conduce dentro la cupola rientra di qualche centimetro. "Proprio in tempo," dice Dusk. "La mia analisi dell'atmosfera è finita. Andiamo a dare un'occhiata dentro." Dopo una breve occhiata alle scritte sulla porta, afferra una maniglia e la fa scorrere a sinistra. Il portello comincia ad aprirsi lentamente verso l'interno. Quando ti avvicini all'ingresso vieni accecato all'istante da una luce intensa che arriva dall'altra parte della porta. Dopo aver abbassato la visiera parasole del casco, i tuoi occhi cominciano ad adattarsi al nuovo livello di luce, e ti servono alcuni secondi per capire cosa hai davanti. Atterrato dentro la cupola, proprio davanti alla camera di equilibrio, c'è un Fetri'sei, una sonda Ka'sei, puntata su di te e su Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Both you and Dusk stand still in front of it without saying a word. Out of the corner of your eye, you can see his hands shivering. All of a sudden, the Ka'sei starts emitting a very high pitched sound, very hard to hear, frequently changing in intensity. This lasts only for a few seconds, then abruptly stops.|1233|0
units.english: Both you and Dusk stand still in front of it without saying a word. Out of the corner of your eye, you can see his hands shivering. All of a sudden, the Ka'sei starts emitting a very high pitched sound, very hard to hear, frequently changing in intensity. This lasts only for a few seconds, then abruptly stops.
units.italian: Tu e Dusk restate immobili davanti a essa senza dire una parola. Con la coda dell'occhio vedi le sue mani tremare. All'improvviso, il Ka'sei comincia a emettere un suono molto acuto, difficilissimo da sentire, che cambia frequentemente d'intensità. Dura solo qualche secondo, poi si interrompe bruscamente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Run back in the airlock.)|1235|0
units.english: (Run back in the airlock.)
units.italian: (Corri di nuovo nella camera di equilibrio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Stay still and wait.)|1237|0
units.english: (Stay still and wait.)
units.italian: (Resta fermo e aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	The whole cupola falls silent. What feels like hours pass before the Ka'sei swiftly lifts off in front of you, hovering a few meters above the terrain. Just like the previous time, it starts emitting the same sequence of sounds as the last time, followed by a clicking sound. Dusk turns towards you.|1238|0
units.english: The whole cupola falls silent. What feels like hours pass before the Ka'sei swiftly lifts off in front of you, hovering a few meters above the terrain. Just like the previous time, it starts emitting the same sequence of sounds as the last time, followed by a clicking sound. Dusk turns towards you.
units.italian: L'intera cupola cade nel silenzio. Passano quelle che sembrano ore prima che il Ka'sei si sollevi rapidamente davanti a voi, librandosi qualche metro sopra il terreno. Proprio come la volta precedente, comincia a emettere la stessa sequenza di suoni dell'ultima volta, seguita da un clic. Dusk si volta verso di te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Run back in the airlock.)|1240|0
units.english: (Run back in the airlock.)
units.italian: (Corri di nuovo nella camera di equilibrio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Keep staying still.)|1242|0
units.english: (Keep staying still.)
units.italian: (Continua a restare fermo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Try shooting at the hover engines of the Ka'sei with my sidearm.)|1244|0
units.english: (Try shooting at the hover engines of the Ka'sei with my sidearm.)
units.italian: (Prova a sparare ai motori di sollevamento del Ka'sei con l'arma da fianco.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	You take out your gun and start aiming for the Fetri'sei's side pods. Your first shot misses it completely, but after that you are able to make three full hits on the hover engines. Almost instantly, the Ka'sei starts emitting a loud siren. The ship fires a beam just to the left of you, letting out an ear-piercing wail. Both you and Dusk jump back to the airlock as fast as possible, but you are too far away to reach it in time before a Ravager beam tears through your suit. The last thing you see is Dusk closing the airlock.|1245|0
units.english: You take out your gun and start aiming for the Fetri'sei's side pods. Your first shot misses it completely, but after that you are able to make three full hits on the hover engines. Almost instantly, the Ka'sei starts emitting a loud siren. The ship fires a beam just to the left of you, letting out an ear-piercing wail. Both you and Dusk jump back to the airlock as fast as possible, but you are too far away to reach it in time before a Ravager beam tears through your suit. The last thing you see is Dusk closing the airlock.
units.italian: Estrai la pistola e cominci a mirare alle capsule laterali del Fetri'sei. Il primo colpo lo manca del tutto, ma dopo riesci a mettere a segno tre colpi pieni sui motori di sollevamento. Quasi all'istante, il Ka'sei comincia a emettere una sirena assordante. La nave spara un raggio appena alla tua sinistra, con un ululato che perfora le orecchie. Tu e Dusk saltate indietro verso la camera di equilibrio il più in fretta possibile, ma siete troppo lontani per arrivarci in tempo prima che un raggio Devastatore vi trapassi la tuta. L'ultima cosa che vedi è Dusk che chiude la camera di equilibrio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	After another short silence, the Ka'sei starts emitting a loud siren. You hear the screech of Ravager fire as an angry energy beam sears through the air to your left, just barely missing you. Both you and Dusk jump back to the airlock, slamming the door closed. You can still feel the crackle of the Ravager cannons from the other side the door, and after a second, the door begins to glow.|1249|0
units.english: After another short silence, the Ka'sei starts emitting a loud siren. You hear the screech of Ravager fire as an angry energy beam sears through the air to your left, just barely missing you. Both you and Dusk jump back to the airlock, slamming the door closed. You can still feel the crackle of the Ravager cannons from the other side the door, and after a second, the door begins to glow.
units.italian: Dopo un altro breve silenzio, il Ka'sei comincia a emettere una sirena assordante. Senti lo stridio del fuoco dei Devastatori mentre un raggio energetico rabbioso attraversa l'aria alla tua sinistra, mancandoti per un soffio. Tu e Dusk saltate indietro verso la camera di equilibrio, sbattendo la porta chiusa. Senti ancora il crepitare dei cannoni Devastatori dall'altra parte della porta, e dopo un secondo la porta comincia a brillare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Open the exit door, even with the airlock full of air.)|1251|0
units.english: (Open the exit door, even with the airlock full of air.)
units.italian: (Apri la porta d'uscita, anche con la camera di equilibrio piena d'aria.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Wait for the airlock to empty.)|1253|0
units.english: (Wait for the airlock to empty.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che la camera di equilibrio si svuoti.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	After waiting a few seconds, Dusk hurries towards the control station. "Hold on to something, I ha-" Suddenly, he is interrupted by a burst of light coming from where the door of the airlock used to be. Your suit provides little protection from the full force of the Ravager beams.|1254|0
units.english: After waiting a few seconds, Dusk hurries towards the control station. "Hold on to something, I ha-" Suddenly, he is interrupted by a burst of light coming from where the door of the airlock used to be. Your suit provides little protection from the full force of the Ravager beams.
units.italian: Dopo aver aspettato qualche secondo, Dusk si precipita verso la stazione di controllo. "Reggiti a qualcosa, ho-" All'improvviso viene interrotto da un'esplosione di luce proveniente da dove prima c'era la porta della camera di equilibrio. La tua tuta offre poca protezione contro tutta la forza dei raggi Devastatori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	You reach the control station as fast as you can and press the switch that Dusk had used when you first came in. The blast is not as strong as you imagined, but in a few seconds you are thrown out of the airlock by the sheer force of the air leaving from the breach. Both of you touch down after a few meters, crashing hard in the terrain that surrounds the cupola. Out of the corner of your eye, you see that there's still air coming out of the airlock, signifying that the interior door has been breached. It is very lucky that your suit has not been punctured.|1258|0
units.english: You reach the control station as fast as you can and press the switch that Dusk had used when you first came in. The blast is not as strong as you imagined, but in a few seconds you are thrown out of the airlock by the sheer force of the air leaving from the breach. Both of you touch down after a few meters, crashing hard in the terrain that surrounds the cupola. Out of the corner of your eye, you see that there's still air coming out of the airlock, signifying that the interior door has been breached. It is very lucky that your suit has not been punctured.
units.italian: Raggiungi la stazione di controllo il più in fretta possibile e premi l'interruttore che Dusk aveva usato quando siete entrati. L'esplosione non è forte come immaginavi, ma in pochi secondi venite spinti fuori dalla camera di equilibrio dalla pura forza dell'aria che esce dalla breccia. Atterrate entrambi dopo qualche metro, schiantandovi duramente sul terreno che circonda la cupola. Con la coda dell'occhio vedi che c'è ancora aria che esce dalla camera di equilibrio, segno che la porta interna è stata aperta. È una gran fortuna che la tua tuta non sia stata perforata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Looking around, you see Dusk laying face down next to you. Thankfully, he begins to stand up as you approach him. When he sees you, he silently pauses for a moment, before jerking his head to the airlock and signing. "We need to run. It could get out of the cupola, or others could arrive, and here in the open we are even easier targets." You nod and start going with him back to your ship.|1259|0
units.english: Looking around, you see Dusk laying face down next to you. Thankfully, he begins to stand up as you approach him. When he sees you, he silently pauses for a moment, before jerking his head to the airlock and signing. "We need to run. It could get out of the cupola, or others could arrive, and here in the open we are even easier targets." You nod and start going with him back to your ship.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno, vedi Dusk sdraiato a faccia in giù accanto a te. Per fortuna comincia ad alzarsi mentre ti avvicini. Quando ti vede, resta in silenzio per un momento, poi scatta con la testa verso la camera di equilibrio e accenna: "Dobbiamo correre. Potrebbe uscire dalla cupola, o potrebbero arrivare altri, e qui allo scoperto siamo bersagli ancora più facili." Annuisci e cominci a seguirlo verso la nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Running at full speed, it takes the two of you only a few minutes to reach the <ship>. Once safely in the cockpit, you sit down to catch your breath. After a moment, Dusk begins searching nervously for something on his suit. He takes out the atmospheric scanner he used earlier, but the screen is cracked and the external sensors are bent. "It must have been destroyed when we fell on the ground. I hope that at least its memory is still intact."|1260|0
units.english: Running at full speed, it takes the two of you only a few minutes to reach the <ship>. Once safely in the cockpit, you sit down to catch your breath. After a moment, Dusk begins searching nervously for something on his suit. He takes out the atmospheric scanner he used earlier, but the screen is cracked and the external sensors are bent. "It must have been destroyed when we fell on the ground. I hope that at least its memory is still intact."
units.italian: Correndo a tutta velocità, vi servono solo pochi minuti per raggiungere la <ship>. Una volta al sicuro in cabina, vi sedete a riprendere fiato. Dopo un momento, Dusk comincia a cercare nervosamente qualcosa sulla tuta. Tira fuori lo scanner atmosferico usato prima, ma lo schermo è crepato e i sensori esterni sono piegati. "Dev'essersi distrutto quando siamo caduti a terra. Spero che almeno la memoria sia ancora intatta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	You start running towards the airlock as fast as you can. Initially, Dusk tries to resist, but you drag him by force and lock the door behind you. Everything falls into silence again for half a minute while you are waiting for the room to depressurize, but suddenly the sound of a Ravager cannon cuts through the silence, and the inner airlock door begins to glow as it takes fire.|1264|0
units.english: You start running towards the airlock as fast as you can. Initially, Dusk tries to resist, but you drag him by force and lock the door behind you. Everything falls into silence again for half a minute while you are waiting for the room to depressurize, but suddenly the sound of a Ravager cannon cuts through the silence, and the inner airlock door begins to glow as it takes fire.
units.italian: Cominci a correre verso la camera di equilibrio il più in fretta che puoi. All'inizio Dusk cerca di resistere, ma lo trascini con la forza e chiudi la porta alle vostre spalle. Tutto torna nel silenzio per mezzo minuto mentre aspettate che la stanza si depressurizzi, ma all'improvviso il suono di un cannone Devastatore squarcia il silenzio, e la porta interna della camera di equilibrio comincia a brillare mentre viene colpita.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Open the exit door, even with the airlock full of air.)|1266|0
units.english: (Open the exit door, even with the airlock full of air.)
units.italian: (Apri la porta d'uscita, anche con la camera di equilibrio piena d'aria.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	(Wait for the airlock to empty.)|1268|0
units.english: (Wait for the airlock to empty.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che la camera di equilibrio si svuoti.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	After a few seconds of waiting, Dusk hurries towards the control station. "I have an idea," he says as he presses a few switches on the panel. "I can open a vent to expel the air out of here into the void, and get us out of here in a few seconds."|1269|0
units.english: After a few seconds of waiting, Dusk hurries towards the control station. "I have an idea," he says as he presses a few switches on the panel. "I can open a vent to expel the air out of here into the void, and get us out of here in a few seconds."
units.italian: Dopo qualche secondo di attesa, Dusk si precipita verso la stazione di controllo. "Ho un'idea," dice premendo alcuni interruttori sul pannello. "Posso aprire una valvola per espellere l'aria da qui nel vuoto, e farci uscire in pochi secondi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	You reach the control station as fast as you can and tell Dusk to hold on to something, but he stops you. "I have a better idea," he says as he presses a few switches on the panel. "I can open a vent to expel the air out of here into the void, and get us out of here in a few seconds."|1272|0
units.english: You reach the control station as fast as you can and tell Dusk to hold on to something, but he stops you. "I have a better idea," he says as he presses a few switches on the panel. "I can open a vent to expel the air out of here into the void, and get us out of here in a few seconds."
units.italian: Raggiungi la stazione di controllo il più in fretta possibile e dici a Dusk di reggersi a qualcosa, ma lui ti ferma. "Ho un'idea migliore," dice premendo alcuni interruttori sul pannello. "Posso aprire una valvola per espellere l'aria da qui nel vuoto, e farci uscire in pochi secondi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Soon after, the frontal door recedes. You two run out of the airlock as fast as possible. Behind you, you hear the roar of metal melting as a rush of air passes you by. You start running back to your ship with Dusk, hoping that the Ka'sei will not get out of the building before you are safe.|1274|0
units.english: Soon after, the frontal door recedes. You two run out of the airlock as fast as possible. Behind you, you hear the roar of metal melting as a rush of air passes you by. You start running back to your ship with Dusk, hoping that the Ka'sei will not get out of the building before you are safe.
units.italian: Poco dopo, la porta frontale rientra. Uscite di corsa dalla camera di equilibrio il più in fretta possibile. Dietro di voi sentite il boato del metallo che fonde mentre un getto d'aria vi passa accanto. Cominci a correre verso la nave con Dusk, sperando che il Ka'sei non esca dall'edificio prima che siate al sicuro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Running at full speed, it takes the two of you only a few minutes to reach the <ship>. Once safely in the cockpit, you sit down to catch your breath. After a moment, Dusk begins searching nervously for something on his suit. He takes out the atmospheric scanner he used earlier and turns it on. "Phew. I was afraid it had broken down when we had to run away, but maybe we can still get the data we need."|1275|0
units.english: Running at full speed, it takes the two of you only a few minutes to reach the <ship>. Once safely in the cockpit, you sit down to catch your breath. After a moment, Dusk begins searching nervously for something on his suit. He takes out the atmospheric scanner he used earlier and turns it on. "Phew. I was afraid it had broken down when we had to run away, but maybe we can still get the data we need."
units.italian: Correndo a tutta velocità, vi servono solo pochi minuti per raggiungere la <ship>. Una volta al sicuro in cabina, vi sedete a riprendere fiato. Dopo un momento, Dusk comincia a cercare nervosamente qualcosa sulla tuta. Tira fuori lo scanner atmosferico usato prima e lo accende. "Fiu. Temevo si fosse rotto quando siamo dovuti scappare, ma forse possiamo ancora ottenere i dati che ci servono."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	Dusk is interrupted by the shrieking wail of your ship's proximity alert as a hostile object appears on the radar screen. As Dusk suspected, the Fetri'sei must have tracked your movements after leaving the cupola. You start to ready your ship for combat, but Dusk interrupts you. "You cannot kill them, <first>. Do you remember the high pitched sound it emitted before shooting? He was trying to speak with us, Captain. Only a few words, maybe even pre-programmed for this kind of interaction, but still a complete phrase or more in pure Builder language. In decades of xenoarchaeological research, this is the first time that it occurs. These ships are an incredible discovery. They may be the only thing still capable of speaking that language in the entire Graveyard. You cannot destroy it, and disabling one is more a matter of luck than skill."|1280|0
units.english: Dusk is interrupted by the shrieking wail of your ship's proximity alert as a hostile object appears on the radar screen. As Dusk suspected, the Fetri'sei must have tracked your movements after leaving the cupola. You start to ready your ship for combat, but Dusk interrupts you. "You cannot kill them, <first>. Do you remember the high pitched sound it emitted before shooting? He was trying to speak with us, Captain. Only a few words, maybe even pre-programmed for this kind of interaction, but still a complete phrase or more in pure Builder language. In decades of xenoarchaeological research, this is the first time that it occurs. These ships are an incredible discovery. They may be the only thing still capable of speaking that language in the entire Graveyard. You cannot destroy it, and disabling one is more a matter of luck than skill."
units.italian: Dusk viene interrotto dall'ululato acuto dell'allarme di prossimità della nave mentre un oggetto ostile appare sullo schermo radar. Come Dusk sospettava, il Fetri'sei deve aver tracciato i vostri movimenti dopo l'uscita dalla cupola. Cominci a preparare la nave al combattimento, ma Dusk ti interrompe. "Non puoi ucciderli, <first>. Ricordi il suono acuto che ha emesso prima di sparare? Stava cercando di parlare con noi, capitano. Solo poche parole, forse persino preprogrammate per questo tipo di interazione, ma comunque una frase completa o più in pura lingua dei Costruttori. In decenni di ricerca xenoarcheologica, è la prima volta che accade. Queste navi sono una scoperta incredibile. Potrebbero essere l'unica cosa ancora capace di parlare quella lingua in tutto il Cimitero. Non puoi distruggerla, e metterne una fuori combattimento è più questione di fortuna che di abilità."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"What should I do then?"|1282|0
units.english: "What should I do then?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovrei fare allora?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|	"Well, I can only suggest to depart from here and set a route straight back to Aventine, while avoiding the Ka'sei. Sorry <first>, but it is preferable that we leave them alone." After all the risk you had to take, you cannot help but nod if this means getting as far from here as possible.|1283|0
units.english: "Well, I can only suggest to depart from here and set a route straight back to Aventine, while avoiding the Ka'sei. Sorry <first>, but it is preferable that we leave them alone." After all the risk you had to take, you cannot help but nod if this means getting as far from here as possible.
