units.italian: "Beh, posso solo suggerirti di partire da qui e impostare una rotta dritta per Aventine, evitando i Ka'sei. Scusa <first>, ma è preferibile lasciarli in pace." Dopo tutto il rischio che hai dovuto correre, non puoi fare a meno di annuire, se questo significa allontanarsi il più possibile da qui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|Soon after departing, your ship warns you that a large number of ships are targeting you. It appears the other Ka'sei are also going to attack.|1298|0
units.english: Soon after departing, your ship warns you that a large number of ships are targeting you. It appears the other Ka'sei are also going to attack.
units.italian: Poco dopo la partenza, la nave ti avverte che un gran numero di navi ti sta prendendo di mira. A quanto pare anche gli altri Ka'sei attaccheranno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|dialog|1300|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you realize your escort carrying Dusk has not yet entered the system! Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Dusk non è ancora entrata nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|You disembark from your ship with Dusk, discussing the events that occurred in Patir. "Thank you for keeping the Ka'sei alive, <first>. They might be exactly what our Builder research needs, and I really hope I can continue exploring that place with you in the future. I will study what we have gathered in the last days trying to find anything that could give us more clues about them." He waves at you and starts walking towards the exit from the spaceport. "I will contact you again when I find something worth looking at. May the Embers burn bright for you, <first>."|1309|0
units.english: You disembark from your ship with Dusk, discussing the events that occurred in Patir. "Thank you for keeping the Ka'sei alive, <first>. They might be exactly what our Builder research needs, and I really hope I can continue exploring that place with you in the future. I will study what we have gathered in the last days trying to find anything that could give us more clues about them." He waves at you and starts walking towards the exit from the spaceport. "I will contact you again when I find something worth looking at. May the Embers burn bright for you, <first>."
units.italian: Scendi dalla nave con Dusk, discutendo degli eventi accaduti a Patir. "Grazie per aver lasciato vivi i Ka'sei, <first>. Potrebbero essere esattamente ciò di cui la nostra ricerca sui Costruttori ha bisogno, e spero davvero di poter continuare a esplorare quel posto con te in futuro. Studierò quello che abbiamo raccolto negli ultimi giorni cercando qualcosa che possa darci più indizi su di loro." Ti saluta con la mano e si incammina verso l'uscita dello spazioporto. "Ti contatterò di nuovo quando troverò qualcosa che valga la pena guardare. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te, <first>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 5|You disembark from your ship with Dusk, who is visible angry that you destroyed one of the Ka'sei. "I told you not to attack them! I told you of their importance!" he signs harshly while pacing back and forth. "Oh my, oh my, we can only hope that this does not close any doors for us. Perhaps we can attempt to communicate with them? Tell them it was an accident?" He looks to you as if searching for some reassurance, but you have none to give. "Forget it. I will study what we have gathered, but I am afraid that it will be all that we will ever gather from that system." Dusk storms off without saying goodbye, typing away on his touchpad as he goes.|1315|0
units.english: You disembark from your ship with Dusk, who is visible angry that you destroyed one of the Ka'sei. "I told you not to attack them! I told you of their importance!" he signs harshly while pacing back and forth. "Oh my, oh my, we can only hope that this does not close any doors for us. Perhaps we can attempt to communicate with them? Tell them it was an accident?" He looks to you as if searching for some reassurance, but you have none to give. "Forget it. I will study what we have gathered, but I am afraid that it will be all that we will ever gather from that system." Dusk storms off without saying goodbye, typing away on his touchpad as he goes.
units.italian: Scendi dalla nave con Dusk, visibilmente arrabbiato perché hai distrutto uno dei Ka'sei. "Ti avevo detto di non attaccarli! Ti avevo detto della loro importanza!" accenna duramente mentre va avanti e indietro. "Oh cielo, oh cielo, possiamo solo sperare che questo non ci chiuda delle porte. Forse possiamo tentare di comunicare con loro? Dirgli che è stato un incidente?" Ti guarda come se cercasse rassicurazione, ma non ne hai da dargli. "Lascia perdere. Studierò quello che abbiamo raccolto, ma temo che sarà tutto ciò che riusciremo mai a raccogliere da quel sistema." Dusk se ne va senza salutare, digitando sul touchpad mentre cammina.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|name|1350|0
units.english: Second contact
units.italian: Secondo contatto

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|description|1351|0
units.english: Return to <system> with Dusk and four other xenoarchaeologists to continue your exploration of the <planet>. You will need to be cloaked as you enter to avoid alerting the Ka'sei.
units.italian: Torna in <system> con Dusk e altri quattro xenoarcheologi per continuare l'esplorazione del <planet>. Dovrai essere occultato mentre entri per non allertare i Ka'sei.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|blocked|1358|0
units.english: As soon as you arrive, Dusk contacts you again. "Welcome back, <first>! We should be ready for the next Patir expedition, but we need at least five free bunks to attempt it, and at least 2 tons of cargo space for samples."
units.italian: Appena arrivi, Dusk ti contatta di nuovo. "Bentornato, <first>! Dovremmo essere pronti per la prossima spedizione su Patir, ma ci servono almeno cinque cuccette libere per tentarla, e almeno 2 tonnellate di spazio di carico per i campioni."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|It doesn't take long for you to be noticed in the crowded, yet quiet, starport of <origin>. You feel a tap on your shoulder and turn around to see Dusk, accompanied by a group of four. "Good to see you here again, <first>! Do you remember our exploration of the Patir black hole?"|1366|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for you to be noticed in the crowded, yet quiet, starport of <origin>. You feel a tap on your shoulder and turn around to see Dusk, accompanied by a group of four. "Good to see you here again, <first>! Do you remember our exploration of the Patir black hole?"
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché tu venga notato nello spazioporto affollato ma silenzioso di <origin>. Senti un tocco sulla spalla e ti volti: è Dusk, accompagnato da un gruppo di quattro. "Bello rivederti qui, <first>! Ricordi la nostra esplorazione del buco nero di Patir?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	One of the other Remnant shows you a hologram of the system, with what looks like the Builder settlement you visited earlier highlighted by a yellow glow. "After studying the data we gathered during our last visit, we may have devised a way to enter the structure undisturbed! Based on our recordings, the Fetri'sei that attacked us in the structure was gathering materials from the asteroid belt with its fellow Ka'sei, and only moved inside the dome when it spotted us."|1369|0
units.english: One of the other Remnant shows you a hologram of the system, with what looks like the Builder settlement you visited earlier highlighted by a yellow glow. "After studying the data we gathered during our last visit, we may have devised a way to enter the structure undisturbed! Based on our recordings, the Fetri'sei that attacked us in the structure was gathering materials from the asteroid belt with its fellow Ka'sei, and only moved inside the dome when it spotted us."
units.italian: Uno degli altri Remnant ti mostra un ologramma del sistema, con quello che sembra l'insediamento dei Costruttori che hai visitato prima evidenziato da un bagliore giallo. "Dopo aver studiato i dati raccolti durante la nostra ultima visita, forse abbiamo ideato un modo per entrare nella struttura indisturbati! In base alle nostre registrazioni, il Fetri'sei che ci ha attaccato nella struttura stava raccogliendo materiali dalla cintura di asteroidi con gli altri Ka'sei, e si è spostato dentro la cupola solo quando ci ha individuati."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|label|1372|0
units.english: atmospheric data
units.italian: atmospheric data

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	One of the other Remnant shows you a hologram of the system, with what looks like the Builder settlement you visited earlier highlighted by a yellow light. "First of all, we have transferred <payment> to your logistics account for saving the data on the dome's atmosphere. It is only thanks to you that we were able to learn more about what kind of atmosphere the Builders may have lived in."|1375|0
units.english: One of the other Remnant shows you a hologram of the system, with what looks like the Builder settlement you visited earlier highlighted by a yellow light. "First of all, we have transferred <payment> to your logistics account for saving the data on the dome's atmosphere. It is only thanks to you that we were able to learn more about what kind of atmosphere the Builders may have lived in."
units.italian: Uno degli altri Remnant ti mostra un ologramma del sistema, con quello che sembra l'insediamento dei Costruttori che hai visitato prima evidenziato da una luce gialla. "Prima di tutto, abbiamo trasferito <payment> sul tuo conto logistico per aver salvato i dati sull'atmosfera della cupola. È solo grazie a te che abbiamo potuto saperne di più su che tipo di atmosfera potessero vivere i Costruttori."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Thank you."|1377|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Can you tell me more about that?"|1379|0
units.english: "Can you tell me more about that?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi di più in proposito?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"The air in the settlement we visited was almost evenly split between oxygen and argon, while containing very little nitrogen. Despite its differences, it is interesting to note that such a composition is breathable by human standards."|1380|0
units.english: "The air in the settlement we visited was almost evenly split between oxygen and argon, while containing very little nitrogen. Despite its differences, it is interesting to note that such a composition is breathable by human standards."
units.italian: "L'aria nell'insediamento che abbiamo visitato era quasi equamente divisa tra ossigeno e argon, con pochissimo azoto. Nonostante le differenze, è interessante notare che una composizione del genere è respirabile secondo gli standard umani."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"We could have removed our helmets after the airlock?" you ask.|1381|0
units.english: "We could have removed our helmets after the airlock?" you ask.
units.italian: "Avremmo potuto toglierci i caschi dopo la camera di equilibrio?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"It is a bit more complicated than that. We found that the pressure inside the complex was much, much lower than what we are used to - less than a sixteenth of an atmosphere. On most Earth-like planets, you would only find such pressures at over 20,000 meters. There are two possibilities: either the Builders were born in a thin atmosphere, or the life support system failed some time ago and the structure has been slowly losing air ever since. We hope to find the answer soon enough.|1382|0
units.english: "It is a bit more complicated than that. We found that the pressure inside the complex was much, much lower than what we are used to - less than a sixteenth of an atmosphere. On most Earth-like planets, you would only find such pressures at over 20,000 meters. There are two possibilities: either the Builders were born in a thin atmosphere, or the life support system failed some time ago and the structure has been slowly losing air ever since. We hope to find the answer soon enough.
units.italian: "È un po' più complicato di così. Abbiamo scoperto che la pressione dentro il complesso era molto, molto inferiore a quella a cui siamo abituati: meno di un sedicesimo di atmosfera. Sulla maggior parte dei pianeti simili alla Terra, pressioni del genere si trovano solo oltre i 20.000 metri. Ci sono due possibilità: o i Costruttori sono nati in un'atmosfera sottile, o il sistema di supporto vitale si è guastato tempo fa e la struttura perde aria da allora. Speriamo di trovare la risposta presto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|label|1384|0
units.english: skip dialog
units.italian: skip dialog

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"On top of that, we have learned that the Fetri'sei that attacked us was not waiting in the structure when we first entered the system; it was gathering materials from the asteroid belt together with the rest of its fellow Ka'sei, and only moved inside the dome when it spotted us."|1385|0
units.english: "On top of that, we have learned that the Fetri'sei that attacked us was not waiting in the structure when we first entered the system; it was gathering materials from the asteroid belt together with the rest of its fellow Ka'sei, and only moved inside the dome when it spotted us."
units.italian: "Inoltre, abbiamo scoperto che il Fetri'sei che ci ha attaccato non stava aspettando nella struttura quando siamo entrati nel sistema la prima volta; stava raccogliendo materiali dalla cintura di asteroidi insieme al resto dei suoi simili Ka'sei, e si è spostato dentro la cupola solo quando ci ha individuati."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"What are you suggesting?"|1389|0
units.english: "What are you suggesting?"
units.italian: "Cosa stai suggerendo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"And?"|1390|0
units.english: "And?"
units.italian: "E quindi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Cloaking is the key. If we can stay hidden as we enter Patir and land, then the Fetri'sei should stay outside of the settlement, letting us explore further. Make sure your ship has enough fuel for the journey, however; if you drop your cloak at any time in Patir, then the Ka'sei will block our progress again."|1391|0
units.english: "Cloaking is the key. If we can stay hidden as we enter Patir and land, then the Fetri'sei should stay outside of the settlement, letting us explore further. Make sure your ship has enough fuel for the journey, however; if you drop your cloak at any time in Patir, then the Ka'sei will block our progress again."
units.italian: "L'occultamento è la chiave. Se riusciamo a restare nascosti mentre entriamo a Patir e atterriamo, il Fetri'sei dovrebbe restare fuori dall'insediamento, lasciandoci esplorare più a fondo. Assicurati però che la nave abbia abbastanza carburante per il viaggio: se togli l'occultamento in qualsiasi momento a Patir, i Ka'sei bloccheranno di nuovo i nostri progressi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	After he finishes signing, he makes a few quick gestures toward the projector, enlarging the hologram of the Builder settlement and revealing what looks like a flight path. "You are going to land roughly where we did last time, carrying me and four other xenoarcheologists. If you accept, I should be able to allocate 100,000 credits to help you buy the necessary equipment for this mission."|1392|0
units.english: After he finishes signing, he makes a few quick gestures toward the projector, enlarging the hologram of the Builder settlement and revealing what looks like a flight path. "You are going to land roughly where we did last time, carrying me and four other xenoarcheologists. If you accept, I should be able to allocate 100,000 credits to help you buy the necessary equipment for this mission."
units.italian: Dopo aver finito di accennare, fa qualche gesto rapido verso il proiettore, ingrandendo l'ologramma dell'insediamento dei Costruttori e rivelando quella che sembra una rotta di volo. "Atterrerai più o meno dove siamo atterrati l'ultima volta, portando me e altri quattro xenoarcheologi. Se accetti, dovrei riuscire a destinare 100.000 crediti per aiutarti a comprare l'equipaggiamento necessario per questa missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"I'm in."|1394|0
units.english: "I'm in."
units.italian: "Ci sto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"What if they detect us while inside the structure?"|1396|0
units.english: "What if they detect us while inside the structure?"
units.italian: "E se ci rilevano mentre siamo dentro la struttura?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Sorry, but I don't think it is a good idea to return there."|1397|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't think it is a good idea to return there."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo sia una buona idea tornarci."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"It is a possibility, yes. It is also quite problematic because communication between the inside and the outside of the structure is impossible. I think the best course of action would be to place a scanner that keeps an eye on the large airlocks on the upper side of the dome, the ones the Ka'sei used last time. If I am right, it should give us around a quarter of an hour to get back in the airlock and escape."|1399|0
units.english: "It is a possibility, yes. It is also quite problematic because communication between the inside and the outside of the structure is impossible. I think the best course of action would be to place a scanner that keeps an eye on the large airlocks on the upper side of the dome, the ones the Ka'sei used last time. If I am right, it should give us around a quarter of an hour to get back in the airlock and escape."
units.italian: "È una possibilità, sì. È anche piuttosto problematico, perché la comunicazione tra l'interno e l'esterno della struttura è impossibile. Credo che la cosa migliore sia piazzare uno scanner che sorvegli i grandi portelli sul lato superiore della cupola, quelli che i Ka'sei hanno usato l'ultima volta. Se ho ragione, dovrebbe darci un quarto d'ora circa per rientrare nella camera di equilibrio e scappare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Alright, let's do it."|1401|0
units.english: "Alright, let's do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamolo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|	"Sorry, but I don't think it is a good idea to return there."|1403|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't think it is a good idea to return there."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo sia una buona idea tornarci."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|You have approached the Builder Settlement uncloaked, making the Ka'sei follow you, or the escort that was carrying the Remnant scientists has been destroyed, or the escort that was carrying the mission cargo was destroyed. You have failed this mission.|1414|0
units.english: You have approached the Builder Settlement uncloaked, making the Ka'sei follow you, or the escort that was carrying the Remnant scientists has been destroyed, or the escort that was carrying the mission cargo was destroyed. You have failed this mission.
units.italian: Ti sei avvicinato all'Insediamento dei Costruttori senza occultamento, facendo seguirti dai Ka'sei, oppure la scorta che trasportava gli scienziati Remnant è stata distrutta, oppure la scorta che trasportava il carico della missione è stata distrutta. Hai fallito questa missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 6|dialog|1416|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but not all of the cargo and passengers are in the system! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system. Remember that your escorts need to be cloaked as well. You may want to park your escorts that are incapable of cloaking.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutto il carico e i passeggeri sono nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare. Ricorda che anche le tue scorte devono essere occultate. Potresti voler parcheggiare le scorte incapaci di occultarsi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|name|1427|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|description|1428|0
units.english: Take Dusk and the other researchers, as well as <cargo>, back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Dusk e gli altri ricercatori, insieme a <cargo>, su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|As you slowly descend toward the surface of the planetoid, most of the Fetri'sei continue to orbit Patir, going in and out of the asteroid belt to mine precious metals from it. The few around the planetoid travel not towards the ruins of the Builder settlement, but rather to the massive stockpile of iridium situated nearby. After a final pass around the dome to ensure none of them have begun following you, you land near the imprint your spaceship left in the dusty regolith the last time you came here.|1437|0
units.english: As you slowly descend toward the surface of the planetoid, most of the Fetri'sei continue to orbit Patir, going in and out of the asteroid belt to mine precious metals from it. The few around the planetoid travel not towards the ruins of the Builder settlement, but rather to the massive stockpile of iridium situated nearby. After a final pass around the dome to ensure none of them have begun following you, you land near the imprint your spaceship left in the dusty regolith the last time you came here.
units.italian: Mentre scendi lentamente verso la superficie del planetoide, la maggior parte dei Fetri'sei continua a orbitare attorno a Patir, entrando e uscendo dalla cintura di asteroidi per estrarne metalli preziosi. I pochi che sono attorno al planetoide non si dirigono verso le rovine dell'insediamento dei Costruttori, ma verso l'enorme scorta di iridio lì vicino. Dopo un ultimo passaggio attorno alla cupola per assicurarti che nessuno abbia cominciato a seguirti, atterri vicino all'impronta che la tua nave ha lasciato nella regolite polverosa l'ultima volta che sei venuto qui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Great work, Captain. We are ready to start our mission." Dusk and his team are carrying with them a set of instruments similar to the first time you were here, from compact laser scanners to a pair of large crowbars. On the crew's backs are cylinders of varying dimensions, with the largest being almost a meter wide. You follow them through the ship's airlock onto the surface and begin the walk towards the complex. Halfway to the dome, Dusk speaks over the radio. "<first>, before we arrive there, do you have any further questions on the mission plan?"|1438|0
units.english: "Great work, Captain. We are ready to start our mission." Dusk and his team are carrying with them a set of instruments similar to the first time you were here, from compact laser scanners to a pair of large crowbars. On the crew's backs are cylinders of varying dimensions, with the largest being almost a meter wide. You follow them through the ship's airlock onto the surface and begin the walk towards the complex. Halfway to the dome, Dusk speaks over the radio. "<first>, before we arrive there, do you have any further questions on the mission plan?"
units.italian: "Ottimo lavoro, capitano. Siamo pronti a iniziare la missione." Dusk e la sua squadra portano con sé una serie di strumenti simili a quelli della prima volta che sei stato qui, da compatti scanner laser a un paio di grandi piedi di porco. Sulle schiene dell'equipaggio ci sono cilindri di dimensioni varie, il più grande largo quasi un metro. Li segui attraverso la camera di equilibrio della nave fino alla superficie e cominciate a camminare verso il complesso. A metà strada verso la cupola, Dusk parla alla radio. "<first>, prima di arrivare, hai altre domande sul piano della missione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What should I do once we are inside?"|1440|0
units.english: "What should I do once we are inside?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare una volta dentro?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What are you and your team going to do in the complex?"|1442|0
units.english: "What are you and your team going to do in the complex?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farai tu e la tua squadra nel complesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Do you think the Ka'sei are going to leave us alone the entire time?"|1444|0
units.english: "Do you think the Ka'sei are going to leave us alone the entire time?"
units.italian: "Pensi che i Ka'sei ci lasceranno in pace per tutto il tempo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Don't worry, I'll figure it out."|1446|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'll figure it out."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, ci penserò io."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Well, I really hope so!" Dusk replies, grinning behind the glass of his helmet.|1447|0
units.english: "Well, I really hope so!" Dusk replies, grinning behind the glass of his helmet.
units.italian: "Beh, lo spero davvero!" risponde Dusk, sorridendo dietro il vetro del casco.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Well, that is up to you. From the brief scans I made of the structure it does not seem to have particularly thick internal walls, so communication between us within the dome should be feasible. You could come with me inside the structure to help identify what we find, or if you prefer you could also remain near the airlocks and keep an eye out for incoming Fetri'sei. As I said, the choice is yours."|1451|0
units.english: "Well, that is up to you. From the brief scans I made of the structure it does not seem to have particularly thick internal walls, so communication between us within the dome should be feasible. You could come with me inside the structure to help identify what we find, or if you prefer you could also remain near the airlocks and keep an eye out for incoming Fetri'sei. As I said, the choice is yours."
units.italian: "Beh, dipende da te. Dalle brevi scansioni che ho fatto della struttura non sembra avere pareti interne particolarmente spesse, quindi la comunicazione tra noi dentro la cupola dovrebbe essere possibile. Potresti venire con me dentro la struttura per aiutare a identificare quello che troviamo, oppure, se preferisci, potresti restare vicino alle camere di equilibrio e tenere d'occhio l'arrivo di eventuali Fetri'sei. Come ho detto, la scelta è tua."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"It depends. Here, look," he says, passing you a data pad with a rather blurry picture. "It is a still image taken from the recording of our encounter with the Fetri'sei. The strong lights ruined most of the video, so we will to have to settle for this picture, but look at the background: do you see that curved board on the left? The quality of the video is too low to be sure, but I think it could be a map of the complex. If I am right, we could split into groups and cover more ground in the few hours we are going to spend here."|1455|0
units.english: "It depends. Here, look," he says, passing you a data pad with a rather blurry picture. "It is a still image taken from the recording of our encounter with the Fetri'sei. The strong lights ruined most of the video, so we will to have to settle for this picture, but look at the background: do you see that curved board on the left? The quality of the video is too low to be sure, but I think it could be a map of the complex. If I am right, we could split into groups and cover more ground in the few hours we are going to spend here."
units.italian: "Dipende. Ecco, guarda," dice, passandoti un tablet con un'immagine piuttosto sfocata. "È un fermo immagine tratto dalla registrazione del nostro incontro con il Fetri'sei. Le luci forti hanno rovinato gran parte del video, quindi dovremo accontentarci di questa immagine, ma guarda lo sfondo: vedi quel pannello curvo sulla sinistra? La qualità del video è troppo bassa per esserne certi, ma credo che potrebbe essere una mappa del complesso. Se ho ragione, potremmo dividerci in gruppi e coprire più terreno nelle poche ore che passeremo qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Honestly? At this point, I am positive they will. The last time we came here, they had already found us and were probably starting to enter the dome. Right now, they are still in the asteroid belt continuing their mission. There's the possibility that the airlock will alert them of our arrival, but at this point it is unlikely. In either case, I will be sure to keep an eye on the airlock once we are inside the dome."|1459|0
units.english: "Honestly? At this point, I am positive they will. The last time we came here, they had already found us and were probably starting to enter the dome. Right now, they are still in the asteroid belt continuing their mission. There's the possibility that the airlock will alert them of our arrival, but at this point it is unlikely. In either case, I will be sure to keep an eye on the airlock once we are inside the dome."
units.italian: "Sinceramente? A questo punto, sono certo che lo faranno. L'ultima volta che siamo venuti, ci avevano già trovati e probabilmente stavano cominciando a entrare nella cupola. In questo momento sono ancora nella cintura di asteroidi a continuare la loro missione. C'è la possibilità che la camera di equilibrio li avvisi del nostro arrivo, ma a questo punto è improbabile. In ogni caso, una volta dentro la cupola mi assicurerò di tenere d'occhio la camera di equilibrio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	It doesn't take long to reach the airlock ring in front of the dome. The airlock you used last time is still open, and its control panel is visible next to it. Dusk, following your gaze, quickly stops you. "I doubt it would be a good idea to pass through the same airlock we used last time, <first>," he says. "It looks like the structure's automated systems patched up the hole left by the Ka'sei, but I would never trust it as a pressure vessel at this point. Plus, I count at least six more airlocks we could use."|1461|0
units.english: It doesn't take long to reach the airlock ring in front of the dome. The airlock you used last time is still open, and its control panel is visible next to it. Dusk, following your gaze, quickly stops you. "I doubt it would be a good idea to pass through the same airlock we used last time, <first>," he says. "It looks like the structure's automated systems patched up the hole left by the Ka'sei, but I would never trust it as a pressure vessel at this point. Plus, I count at least six more airlocks we could use."
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto per raggiungere l'anello della camera di equilibrio davanti alla cupola. La camera che hai usato l'ultima volta è ancora aperta, e il suo pannello di controllo è visibile accanto. Dusk, seguendo il tuo sguardo, ti ferma subito. "Dubito che sia una buona idea passare dalla stessa camera di equilibrio che abbiamo usato l'ultima volta, <first>," dice. "Sembra che i sistemi automatici della struttura abbiano riparato il foro lasciato dai Ka'sei, ma non mi fiderei mai di questo come recipiente a pressione, a questo punto. Inoltre, conto almeno altre sei camere di equilibrio che potremmo usare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	He and another member of the group move to the opposite side of the control station next to the airlock, then flip one of the switches on the panel. Just like last time, a door opens next to them, revealing another on the opposite side of the small room. There is space only for three crew members at a time; you, Dusk, and another Remnant enter the airlock, while the other three wait their turn. The door closes, and Dusk flips the switch to begin the pressurization procedure. Suddenly, the lights inside the module turn on, emitting a bright, azure light.|1462|0
units.english: He and another member of the group move to the opposite side of the control station next to the airlock, then flip one of the switches on the panel. Just like last time, a door opens next to them, revealing another on the opposite side of the small room. There is space only for three crew members at a time; you, Dusk, and another Remnant enter the airlock, while the other three wait their turn. The door closes, and Dusk flips the switch to begin the pressurization procedure. Suddenly, the lights inside the module turn on, emitting a bright, azure light.
units.italian: Lui e un altro membro del gruppo si spostano sul lato opposto della stazione di controllo accanto alla camera, poi azionano uno degli interruttori sul pannello. Proprio come l'ultima volta, una porta si apre accanto a loro, rivelando un'altra porta sul lato opposto della piccola stanza. C'è spazio solo per tre membri dell'equipaggio alla volta; tu, Dusk e un altro Remnant entrate nella camera di equilibrio, mentre gli altri tre aspettano il loro turno. La porta si chiude, e Dusk aziona l'interruttore per avviare la procedura di pressurizzazione. All'improvviso le luci dentro il modulo si accendono, emettendo una luce azzurra e intensa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Did you do that?"|1464|0
units.english: "Did you do that?"
units.italian: "Sei stato tu?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What happened?"|1465|0
units.english: "What happened?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I am not sure. Wait." Moving to the opposite side of the airlock, he uses a crowbar to open another hidden control station, which slides out of the wall to reveal a rather large screen scrolling through some alien writing. After reading through it with some difficulty, Dusk breathes a sigh of relief and pulls it back to its original location. "I think it is nothing," he adds, "at least I hope so. From what I could gather, the lights being switched on were a normal, timed event in the commanded startup sequence - why they did not turn on last time is beyond me, but nothing seems to be out of the ordinary. Perhaps they were just broken."|1466|0
units.english: "I am not sure. Wait." Moving to the opposite side of the airlock, he uses a crowbar to open another hidden control station, which slides out of the wall to reveal a rather large screen scrolling through some alien writing. After reading through it with some difficulty, Dusk breathes a sigh of relief and pulls it back to its original location. "I think it is nothing," he adds, "at least I hope so. From what I could gather, the lights being switched on were a normal, timed event in the commanded startup sequence - why they did not turn on last time is beyond me, but nothing seems to be out of the ordinary. Perhaps they were just broken."
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro. Aspetta." Spostandosi sul lato opposto della camera di equilibrio, usa un piede di porco per aprire un'altra stazione di controllo nascosta, che scorre fuori dalla parete rivelando un grande schermo che fa scorrere delle scritte aliene. Dopo averle lette con qualche difficoltà, Dusk tira un sospiro di sollievo e lo riporta nella sua posizione originale. "Credo che non sia niente," aggiunge, "almeno lo spero. Da quello che ho potuto capire, l'accensione delle luci era un evento normale e a tempo nella sequenza di avvio comandata. Perché non si siano accese l'ultima volta è per me un mistero, ma nulla sembra fuori dall'ordinario. Forse erano semplicemente rotte."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	A few minutes later, pressurization finishes, and the interior door opens. You follow Dusk out of the airlock and find yourself in front of a large area, likely the same place the encounter with the Fetri'sei took place. "The moment of truth," exclaims Dusk, placing down a heavy scanner, similar to a short telescope. "This is a low-power laser system, capable of measuring the density of the atmosphere anywhere within 10 kilometers. If a Fetri'sei was alerted when we crossed the airlock, by now the large airlock will be filling up with oxygen and argon to allow it to pass through, and this sensor here will register it. Let's see." A tense silence ensues as the machine boots up.|1467|0
units.english: A few minutes later, pressurization finishes, and the interior door opens. You follow Dusk out of the airlock and find yourself in front of a large area, likely the same place the encounter with the Fetri'sei took place. "The moment of truth," exclaims Dusk, placing down a heavy scanner, similar to a short telescope. "This is a low-power laser system, capable of measuring the density of the atmosphere anywhere within 10 kilometers. If a Fetri'sei was alerted when we crossed the airlock, by now the large airlock will be filling up with oxygen and argon to allow it to pass through, and this sensor here will register it. Let's see." A tense silence ensues as the machine boots up.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, la pressurizzazione termina e la porta interna si apre. Segui Dusk fuori dalla camera di equilibrio e ti ritrovi davanti a una grande area, probabilmente lo stesso luogo in cui è avvenuto l'incontro con il Fetri'sei. "Il momento della verità," esclama Dusk, posando a terra uno scanner pesante, simile a un piccolo cannocchiale. "È un sistema laser a bassa potenza, in grado di misurare la densità dell'atmosfera ovunque entro 10 chilometri. Se un Fetri'sei è stato avvisato quando abbiamo attraversato la camera di equilibrio, ormai la grande camera si starà riempiendo di ossigeno e argon per permettergli di passare, e questo sensore lo registrerà. Vediamo." Segue un silenzio teso mentre la macchina si avvia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What does it say?"|1469|0
units.english: "What does it say?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dice?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What are the readings?"|1470|0
units.english: "What are the readings?"
units.italian: "Quali sono le letture?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Dusk smiles. "The airlock is still empty. It looks like we can finally begin exploring the facility." When the rest of the group finishes crossing the airlock, you all start moving toward a curved board, placed equidistant from each of the entrances. After scrutinizing the writings on it for a few seconds, one of the Remnant exclaims, "A map!" Dusk starts discussing something with the rest of his team, but from your position you can't see what they're signing.|1471|0
units.english: Dusk smiles. "The airlock is still empty. It looks like we can finally begin exploring the facility." When the rest of the group finishes crossing the airlock, you all start moving toward a curved board, placed equidistant from each of the entrances. After scrutinizing the writings on it for a few seconds, one of the Remnant exclaims, "A map!" Dusk starts discussing something with the rest of his team, but from your position you can't see what they're signing.
units.italian: Dusk sorride. "La camera di equilibrio è ancora vuota. A quanto pare possiamo finalmente cominciare a esplorare la struttura." Quando il resto del gruppo finisce di attraversare la camera di equilibrio, vi muovete tutti verso un pannello curvo, posto a uguale distanza da ciascuno degli ingressi. Dopo aver scrutato le scritte per qualche secondo, uno dei Remnant esclama: "Una mappa!" Dusk comincia a discutere qualcosa con il resto della sua squadra, ma dalla tua posizione non riesci a vedere cosa si stanno accennando.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Wait for them to finish their discussion.)|1473|0
units.english: (Wait for them to finish their discussion.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che finiscano la discussione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Move closer to try to follow the conversation.)|1474|0
units.english: (Move closer to try to follow the conversation.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati per cercare di seguire la conversazione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Try to get Dusk's attention.)|1475|0
units.english: (Try to get Dusk's attention.)
units.italian: (Prova a catturare l'attenzione di Dusk.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Dusk turns around to you. "So, <first>," he asks, "what do you think? This is indeed a map of the Builder complex. The team and I have split the exploration in four groups - one going to the armory, one visiting the underground facilities and another visiting someplace that roughly translates to 'part cycler.' If you want to come with me, we can choose between the general storage area and what seem to be some kind of elevated gardens. Or you could remain here to keep an eye on the laser scanner if you wish; the choice is yours."|1476|0
units.english: Dusk turns around to you. "So, <first>," he asks, "what do you think? This is indeed a map of the Builder complex. The team and I have split the exploration in four groups - one going to the armory, one visiting the underground facilities and another visiting someplace that roughly translates to 'part cycler.' If you want to come with me, we can choose between the general storage area and what seem to be some kind of elevated gardens. Or you could remain here to keep an eye on the laser scanner if you wish; the choice is yours."
units.italian: Dusk si volta verso di te. "Allora, <first>," chiede, "che cosa ne pensi? Questa è davvero una mappa del complesso dei Costruttori. Io e la squadra abbiamo diviso l'esplorazione in quattro gruppi: uno va all'armeria, uno visita gli impianti sotterranei e un altro va in un posto che si traduce più o meno con 'ciclatore di parti'. Se vuoi venire con me, possiamo scegliere tra l'area di stoccaggio generale e quelli che sembrano una specie di giardini sopraelevati. Oppure puoi restare qui a tenere d'occhio lo scanner laser, se preferisci; la scelta è tua."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Let's go to the storage."|1478|0
units.english: "Let's go to the storage."
units.italian: "Andiamo allo stoccaggio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I think it is best to visit the elevated gardens."|1480|0
units.english: "I think it is best to visit the elevated gardens."
units.italian: "Credo che sia meglio visitare i giardini sopraelevati."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Sorry, but the Ka'sei are too much of a danger. I will stay here."|1482|0
units.english: "Sorry, but the Ka'sei are too much of a danger. I will stay here."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma i Ka'sei sono un pericolo troppo grande. Resto qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Alright." Dusk and the rest of the team split toward different buildings in the complex, disappearing behind large armored doors. The next hours pass slowly as you stand outside the complex, surrounded by complete silence interrupted only by short updates from those exploring the buildings. Almost four hours later, while checking the atmospheric density scanner yet again, you notice a blinking yellow light, placed near the bottom of the control panel.|1483|0
units.english: "Alright." Dusk and the rest of the team split toward different buildings in the complex, disappearing behind large armored doors. The next hours pass slowly as you stand outside the complex, surrounded by complete silence interrupted only by short updates from those exploring the buildings. Almost four hours later, while checking the atmospheric density scanner yet again, you notice a blinking yellow light, placed near the bottom of the control panel.
units.italian: "Va bene." Dusk e il resto della squadra si dividono verso edifici diversi del complesso, sparendo dietro grandi porte corazzate. Le ore successive passano lentamente mentre te ne stai fuori dal complesso, circondato da un silenzio totale interrotto solo dai brevi aggiornamenti di chi esplora gli edifici. Quasi quattro ore dopo, mentre controlli ancora una volta lo scanner di densità atmosferica, noti una luce gialla lampeggiante, posta vicino al fondo del pannello di controllo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Call Dusk with the radio.)|1485|0
units.english: (Call Dusk with the radio.)
units.italian: (Chiama Dusk alla radio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Ignore it.)|1487|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignorala.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	As the time passes, the light dims and blinks slower. It takes almost half an hour, but the yellow light finally turns off entirely.|1488|0
units.english: As the time passes, the light dims and blinks slower. It takes almost half an hour, but the yellow light finally turns off entirely.
units.italian: Col passare del tempo, la luce si affievolisce e lampeggia più lentamente. Ci vuole quasi mezz'ora, ma alla fine la luce gialla si spegne del tutto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Some time later the group returns, satisfied with what they've found inside. "It was an interesting trip for sure, Captain," Dusk tells you. "Did anything of note happen out here?"|1489|0
units.english: Some time later the group returns, satisfied with what they've found inside. "It was an interesting trip for sure, Captain," Dusk tells you. "Did anything of note happen out here?"
units.italian: Qualche tempo dopo il gruppo torna, soddisfatto di quello che ha trovato dentro. "È stato di certo un viaggio interessante, capitano," ti dice Dusk. "È successo qualcosa di notevole qui fuori?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Tell him about the light.)|1491|0
units.english: (Tell him about the light.)
units.italian: (Gli parlo della luce.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Not much. It was a bit boring."|1493|0
units.english: "Not much. It was a bit boring."
units.italian: "Non molto. È stato un po' noioso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I imagine so. You would have been more helpful in the complex together with me." After picking up the scanners, you begin to pass through the airlocks, three people at a time. After a few minutes, you're all back outside the dome, ready to finally return to <planet>.|1494|0
units.english: "I imagine so. You would have been more helpful in the complex together with me." After picking up the scanners, you begin to pass through the airlocks, three people at a time. After a few minutes, you're all back outside the dome, ready to finally return to <planet>.
units.italian: "Immagino. Saresti stato più utile dentro il complesso, con me." Dopo aver recuperato gli scanner, cominciate ad attraversare le camere di equilibrio, tre persone alla volta. Dopo qualche minuto siete tutti fuori dalla cupola, pronti a tornare finalmente su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	As you tell him about the blinking light, he interrupts you and announces to the rest of the group that they are leaving. "The yellow light is an indicator that the battery is running out," he explains hurriedly. "I should have checked our equipment better. Soon, the starship airlock will be unwatched." Instead of going through a single airlock, the group splits, half going into one airlock and half into another. When you're finally all outside of the dome, the tense mood dissipates.|1498|0
units.english: As you tell him about the blinking light, he interrupts you and announces to the rest of the group that they are leaving. "The yellow light is an indicator that the battery is running out," he explains hurriedly. "I should have checked our equipment better. Soon, the starship airlock will be unwatched." Instead of going through a single airlock, the group splits, half going into one airlock and half into another. When you're finally all outside of the dome, the tense mood dissipates.
units.italian: Mentre gli racconti della luce lampeggiante, lui ti interrompe e annuncia al resto del gruppo che stanno partendo. "La luce gialla è un indicatore che la batteria si sta esaurendo," spiega in fretta. "Avrei dovuto controllare meglio la nostra attrezzatura. Presto la camera di equilibrio della nave resterà incustodita." Invece di passare da un'unica camera di equilibrio, il gruppo si divide, metà in una e metà in un'altra. Quando siete finalmente tutti fuori dalla cupola, l'atmosfera tesa si dissolve.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	As you tell him about the blinking light, his expression changes. "You should have called me! We could have died!" He moves to the console on the laser scanner, which stays dark. "The yellow light was an indicator that the battery was running out," he says. "I should have checked our equipment better. The starship airlock may have remained unwatched for hours now. We need to leave." Instead of going through a single airlock, the group splits, half going into one airlock and half into another. When you're finally all outside of the dome, the tense mood dissipates.|1502|0
units.english: As you tell him about the blinking light, his expression changes. "You should have called me! We could have died!" He moves to the console on the laser scanner, which stays dark. "The yellow light was an indicator that the battery was running out," he says. "I should have checked our equipment better. The starship airlock may have remained unwatched for hours now. We need to leave." Instead of going through a single airlock, the group splits, half going into one airlock and half into another. When you're finally all outside of the dome, the tense mood dissipates.
units.italian: Mentre gli racconti della luce lampeggiante, la sua espressione cambia. "Avresti dovuto chiamarmi! Avremmo potuto morire!" Si sposta verso la console dello scanner laser, che resta spenta. "La luce gialla era un indicatore che la batteria si stava esaurendo," dice. "Avrei dovuto controllare meglio la nostra attrezzatura. La camera di equilibrio della nave potrebbe essere rimasta incustodita per ore ormai. Dobbiamo andarcene." Invece di passare da un'unica camera di equilibrio, il gruppo si divide, metà in una e metà in un'altra. Quando siete finalmente tutti fuori dalla cupola, l'atmosfera tesa si dissolve.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	While walking back to the ship, Dusk continues talking about the mission. He explains that they found that the Patir settlement had never been visited in its history - not even by the Builders themselves. "I did not expect to find a thriving colony inside, but this is perplexing. A possible theory is that the settlement was built by the Ka'sei themselves, but the variety of designs inside and the way everything was assembled contradicts everything we know about their capabilities. Perhaps the buildings were transported here together with them - or perhaps even the entire asteroid was brought here from a Graveyard system, though that seems unlikely. There is a lot we still have to learn about Patir."|1505|0
units.english: While walking back to the ship, Dusk continues talking about the mission. He explains that they found that the Patir settlement had never been visited in its history - not even by the Builders themselves. "I did not expect to find a thriving colony inside, but this is perplexing. A possible theory is that the settlement was built by the Ka'sei themselves, but the variety of designs inside and the way everything was assembled contradicts everything we know about their capabilities. Perhaps the buildings were transported here together with them - or perhaps even the entire asteroid was brought here from a Graveyard system, though that seems unlikely. There is a lot we still have to learn about Patir."
units.italian: Mentre tornate alla nave, Dusk continua a parlare della missione. Spiega che hanno scoperto che l'insediamento di Patir non era mai stato visitato nella sua storia, nemmeno dai Costruttori stessi. "Non mi aspettavo di trovare una colonia fiorente all'interno, ma questo è sconcertante. Una teoria possibile è che l'insediamento sia stato costruito dai Ka'sei stessi, ma la varietà di progetti all'interno e il modo in cui tutto è stato assemblato contraddicono tutto ciò che sappiamo sulle loro capacità. Forse gli edifici sono stati trasportati qui insieme a loro, o forse persino l'intero asteroide è stato portato qui da un sistema del Cimitero, anche se sembra improbabile. C'è ancora molto da imparare su Patir."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Once you're back inside the <ship>, the team moves to their rooms to continue discussing theories about the Builder settlement here. Next destination: <planet>.|1506|0
units.english: Once you're back inside the <ship>, the team moves to their rooms to continue discussing theories about the Builder settlement here. Next destination: <planet>.
units.italian: Una volta rientrati nella <ship>, la squadra si ritira nelle proprie stanze per continuare a discutere le teorie sull'insediamento dei Costruttori. Prossima destinazione: <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Dusk takes the lead, and you reach a large building on the opposite side of the dome. The towering cubical structure has multiple doors on the sides, each of them taller than the one before; its walls are light, of a pale blue, with gold and brown finishes around the signs scattered across the area. Dusk stops in front of one of the smallest doors, only a few centimeters taller than you, and starts pushing it to the side to make it slide. Slowly but surely, it starts to move. Dusk enters first, and you follow.|1510|0
units.english: Dusk takes the lead, and you reach a large building on the opposite side of the dome. The towering cubical structure has multiple doors on the sides, each of them taller than the one before; its walls are light, of a pale blue, with gold and brown finishes around the signs scattered across the area. Dusk stops in front of one of the smallest doors, only a few centimeters taller than you, and starts pushing it to the side to make it slide. Slowly but surely, it starts to move. Dusk enters first, and you follow.
units.italian: Dusk prende la guida, e raggiungete un grande edificio sul lato opposto della cupola. L'imponente struttura cubica ha più porte sui lati, ognuna più alta della precedente; le pareti sono chiare, di un azzurro pallido, con finiture dorate e brune attorno alle insegne sparse per l'area. Dusk si ferma davanti a una delle porte più piccole, alta solo pochi centimetri più di te, e comincia a spingerla di lato per farla scorrere. Lentamente ma inesorabilmente, comincia a muoversi. Dusk entra per primo, e tu lo segui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	If the depot seemed large from the outside, it's even more impressive seen from the inside; massive, sturdy shelves tower left and right, surrounded by odd machinery and cylindrical containers. While you're still studying the structure, Dusk calls you over. "Look here, <first>," he says, indicating the lower shelves in front of him. "What do you see?" It isn't easy to inspect the shelves with just your helmet lights, but you notice they're all empty. "This is not what I would expect from a settlement that used to be inhabited."|1511|0
units.english: If the depot seemed large from the outside, it's even more impressive seen from the inside; massive, sturdy shelves tower left and right, surrounded by odd machinery and cylindrical containers. While you're still studying the structure, Dusk calls you over. "Look here, <first>," he says, indicating the lower shelves in front of him. "What do you see?" It isn't easy to inspect the shelves with just your helmet lights, but you notice they're all empty. "This is not what I would expect from a settlement that used to be inhabited."
units.italian: Se il deposito sembrava grande dall'esterno, è ancora più impressionante visto da dentro: enormi e robusti scaffali torreggiano a destra e a sinistra, circondati da macchinari strani e contenitori cilindrici. Mentre stai ancora studiando la struttura, Dusk ti chiama. "Guarda qui, <first>," dice, indicando gli scaffali più bassi davanti a lui. "Cosa vedi?" Non è facile ispezionare gli scaffali solo con le luci del casco, ma noti che sono tutti vuoti. "Questo non è quello che mi aspetterei da un insediamento che un tempo era abitato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What do you think happened here?"|1513|0
units.english: "What do you think happened here?"
units.italian: "Che cosa pensi sia successo qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Maybe the rest of the depot will have something."|1515|0
units.english: "Maybe the rest of the depot will have something."
units.italian: "Forse il resto del deposito avrà qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Is it possible that they just emptied the storage when they left?"|1517|0
units.english: "Is it possible that they just emptied the storage when they left?"
units.italian: "È possibile che abbiano semplicemente svuotato il magazzino quando se ne sono andati?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Maybe. But look at how pristine this place is. There is no dirt or dust anywhere I can see, and everything seems to be exactly where it should. It seems more as if it was never inhabited in the first place. There are far too many unknowns about Patir and this settlement to be certain of anything, though." He pulls another instrument from a waist pouch, then begins gathering samples from around the depot, both from the ground and on the shelves. The procedure takes a few minutes; he then puts the samples in one of the cylinders on his back and starts moving to the next room, signing for you to follow him.|1518|0
units.english: "Maybe. But look at how pristine this place is. There is no dirt or dust anywhere I can see, and everything seems to be exactly where it should. It seems more as if it was never inhabited in the first place. There are far too many unknowns about Patir and this settlement to be certain of anything, though." He pulls another instrument from a waist pouch, then begins gathering samples from around the depot, both from the ground and on the shelves. The procedure takes a few minutes; he then puts the samples in one of the cylinders on his back and starts moving to the next room, signing for you to follow him.
units.italian: "Forse. Ma guarda quanto è immacolato questo posto. Non c'è sporco né polvere da nessuna parte per quanto riesca a vedere, e tutto sembra essere esattamente dove dovrebbe. Sembra piuttosto che non sia mai stato abitato. Ci sono troppe incognite su Patir e su questo insediamento per essere certi di qualsiasi cosa." Tira fuori un altro strumento da una tasca in vita, poi comincia a raccogliere campioni in giro per il deposito, sia dal pavimento sia dagli scaffali. La procedura richiede qualche minuto; poi mette i campioni in uno dei cilindri sulla schiena e comincia a spostarsi nella stanza successiva, accennandoti di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"At first I thought they abandoned this place and took everything with them, but look: there is no dirt or dust anywhere I can see, and everything seems to be exactly where it should. It seems more as if it was never inhabited in the first place. There are far too many unknowns about Patir and this settlement to be certain of anything, though." He pulls another instrument from a waist pouch, then begins gathering samples from around the depot, both from the ground and on the shelves. The procedure takes a few minutes; he then puts them in one of the cylinders on his back and starts moving to the next room, signing for you to follow him.|1522|0
units.english: "At first I thought they abandoned this place and took everything with them, but look: there is no dirt or dust anywhere I can see, and everything seems to be exactly where it should. It seems more as if it was never inhabited in the first place. There are far too many unknowns about Patir and this settlement to be certain of anything, though." He pulls another instrument from a waist pouch, then begins gathering samples from around the depot, both from the ground and on the shelves. The procedure takes a few minutes; he then puts them in one of the cylinders on his back and starts moving to the next room, signing for you to follow him.
units.italian: "All'inizio pensavo che avessero abbandonato questo posto e portato via tutto, ma guarda: non c'è sporco né polvere da nessuna parte per quanto riesca a vedere, e tutto sembra essere esattamente dove dovrebbe. Sembra piuttosto che non sia mai stato abitato. Ci sono troppe incognite su Patir e su questo insediamento per essere certi di qualsiasi cosa." Tira fuori un altro strumento da una tasca in vita, poi comincia a raccogliere campioni in giro per il deposito, sia dal pavimento sia dagli scaffali. La procedura richiede qualche minuto; poi li mette in uno dei cilindri sulla schiena e comincia a spostarsi nella stanza successiva, accennandoti di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Maybe, but I would not get my hopes up if I were you." Sitting down, Dusk takes out of his waist pouch a slim, organic-looking instrument, connected with a cable to a larger box still inside the bag. He takes samples from everywhere in the room: the shelves, the door, the walls, even some from the floor. After enclosing everything inside cylindrical containers, he tells you to get ready to move to another compartment.|1526|0
units.english: "Maybe, but I would not get my hopes up if I were you." Sitting down, Dusk takes out of his waist pouch a slim, organic-looking instrument, connected with a cable to a larger box still inside the bag. He takes samples from everywhere in the room: the shelves, the door, the walls, even some from the floor. After enclosing everything inside cylindrical containers, he tells you to get ready to move to another compartment.
units.italian: "Forse, ma se fossi in te non ci farei troppo affidamento." Sedendosi, Dusk tira fuori dalla tasca in vita uno strumento sottile dall'aspetto organico, collegato con un cavo a una scatola più grande ancora nella borsa. Prende campioni ovunque nella stanza: dagli scaffali, dalla porta, dalle pareti, persino un po' dal pavimento. Dopo aver chiuso tutto in contenitori cilindrici, ti dice di prepararti a passare a un altro compartimento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	You follow Dusk around the building, but the results are the same. The depot is full of empty, untouched containers and barren racks in an incredible state of preservation. After Dusk gathers the last samples, you follow him outside, where you join the other teams leaving the building with their samples. Next stop: <planet>.|1528|0
units.english: You follow Dusk around the building, but the results are the same. The depot is full of empty, untouched containers and barren racks in an incredible state of preservation. After Dusk gathers the last samples, you follow him outside, where you join the other teams leaving the building with their samples. Next stop: <planet>.
units.italian: Segui Dusk in giro per l'edificio, ma i risultati sono gli stessi. Il deposito è pieno di contenitori vuoti e intatti e di scaffali spogli in uno stato di conservazione incredibile. Dopo che Dusk ha raccolto gli ultimi campioni, lo segui fuori, dove vi unite agli altri gruppi che escono dall'edificio con i loro campioni. Prossima tappa: <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I agree, it feels the more interesting of the two." The two of you follow the route indicated on the map for a while before reaching the entrance: a slender, sturdy-looking pillar roughly two meters wide with a circular opening on one side. Moving closer you can see the end of a shallow ramp right beyond the door, swirling upwards inside of the column and likely reaching the top of the dome.|1534|0
units.english: "I agree, it feels the more interesting of the two." The two of you follow the route indicated on the map for a while before reaching the entrance: a slender, sturdy-looking pillar roughly two meters wide with a circular opening on one side. Moving closer you can see the end of a shallow ramp right beyond the door, swirling upwards inside of the column and likely reaching the top of the dome.
units.italian: "Sono d'accordo, mi sembra il più interessante dei due." Seguite per un po' la rotta indicata sulla mappa prima di raggiungere l'ingresso: un pilastro snello e robusto largo circa due metri, con un'apertura circolare su un lato. Avvicinandoti vedi la fine di una rampa poco profonda appena oltre la porta, che sale a spirale dentro la colonna e probabilmente raggiunge la cima della cupola.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"If this is supposed to be the exit of the garden," Dusk says, "I fail to see where the entrance should be. We are going to have to walk up it instead."|1535|0
units.english: "If this is supposed to be the exit of the garden," Dusk says, "I fail to see where the entrance should be. We are going to have to walk up it instead."
units.italian: "Se questa dovrebbe essere l'uscita del giardino," dice Dusk, "non vedo dove dovrebbe essere l'ingresso. Dovremo salire da qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Alright, let's go."|1537|0
units.english: "Alright, let's go."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I would rather keep searching for the entrance."|1539|0
units.english: "I would rather keep searching for the entrance."
units.italian: "Preferirei continuare a cercare l'ingresso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	You and Dusk keep walking around the structure for almost half an hour to no avail; with no other choices left but going up the ramp, you give up and decide to follow it up the pillar. Going through it is simpler than it looked, as the surface of the floor is ribbed in a peculiar way so that gripping onto it becomes rather effortless. Despite this, it takes half an hour to reach the garden, and the roof of the dome still lies well above.|1540|0
units.english: You and Dusk keep walking around the structure for almost half an hour to no avail; with no other choices left but going up the ramp, you give up and decide to follow it up the pillar. Going through it is simpler than it looked, as the surface of the floor is ribbed in a peculiar way so that gripping onto it becomes rather effortless. Despite this, it takes half an hour to reach the garden, and the roof of the dome still lies well above.
units.italian: Tu e Dusk continuate a girare attorno alla struttura per quasi mezz'ora, invano; senza altre scelte se non salire la rampa, vi arrendete e decidete di seguirla su per il pilastro. Attraversarla è più semplice di quanto sembrasse, perché la superficie del pavimento è scanalata in modo peculiare, così da renderne la presa piuttosto agevole. Nonostante questo, ci vuole mezz'ora per raggiungere il giardino, e il tetto della cupola è ancora ben più in alto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	You follow Dusk up along the ramp, the length of it making the ascent quite tiresome. Luckily, going through it is simple, as the surface of the floor is ribbed in a peculiar way so that gripping onto it becomes rather effortless. Even so, though the garden is nowhere near the top of the dome, it takes another half an hour to reach it.|1544|0
units.english: You follow Dusk up along the ramp, the length of it making the ascent quite tiresome. Luckily, going through it is simple, as the surface of the floor is ribbed in a peculiar way so that gripping onto it becomes rather effortless. Even so, though the garden is nowhere near the top of the dome, it takes another half an hour to reach it.
units.italian: Segui Dusk su per la rampa, la cui lunghezza rende l'ascesa piuttosto faticosa. Per fortuna attraversarla è semplice, perché la superficie del pavimento è scanalata in modo peculiare, così da renderne la presa piuttosto agevole. Anche così, benché il giardino sia ben lontano dalla cima della cupola, ci vuole un'altra mezz'ora per raggiungerlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	The view at the top is disappointing. In front of you, there are only rows upon rows of long racks with a dry, light gray material on the top and bottom of each shelf. Interspersed between the rows there is some Builder equipment, in which you only recognize large unlit lamps connected to the rest of the structure. Despite all of this, there are no plants anywhere, as far as the eye can see. "I believe we have stumbled upon some kind of hydroponics facility," Dusk says. "I think I have mistranslated the label on the map; this is more like a field than a simple garden."|1546|0
units.english: The view at the top is disappointing. In front of you, there are only rows upon rows of long racks with a dry, light gray material on the top and bottom of each shelf. Interspersed between the rows there is some Builder equipment, in which you only recognize large unlit lamps connected to the rest of the structure. Despite all of this, there are no plants anywhere, as far as the eye can see. "I believe we have stumbled upon some kind of hydroponics facility," Dusk says. "I think I have mistranslated the label on the map; this is more like a field than a simple garden."
units.italian: La vista dalla cima è deludente. Davanti a te ci sono solo file su file di lunghi scaffali con un materiale secco e grigio chiaro sopra e sotto ogni ripiano. Tra le file c'è qualche attrezzatura dei Costruttori, in cui riconosci solo grandi lampade spente collegate al resto della struttura. Nonostante tutto questo, non ci sono piante da nessuna parte, per quanto l'occhio possa vedere. "Credo che ci siamo imbattuti in una specie di impianto idroponico," dice Dusk. "Penso di aver tradotto male l'etichetta sulla mappa; questo è più un campo che un semplice giardino."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What is the plan now?"|1548|0
units.english: "What is the plan now?"
units.italian: "Qual è il piano adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Why are there no plants growing?"|1550|0
units.english: "Why are there no plants growing?"
units.italian: "Perché non ci crescono piante?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"It has probably been around a hundred thousand years since the last time a sapient being was anywhere near this structure. If we were on an Earth-like planet, the plants would have completely covered any artificial structure, but here on an asteroid in the middle of nowhere? Whatever water supply this place had likely ran out when the Builders were still alive." After stopping to think for a few seconds, Dusk continues.|1551|0
units.english: "It has probably been around a hundred thousand years since the last time a sapient being was anywhere near this structure. If we were on an Earth-like planet, the plants would have completely covered any artificial structure, but here on an asteroid in the middle of nowhere? Whatever water supply this place had likely ran out when the Builders were still alive." After stopping to think for a few seconds, Dusk continues.
units.italian: "Probabilmente sono passati circa centomila anni dall'ultima volta che un essere senziente è stato vicino a questa struttura. Se fossimo su un pianeta simile alla Terra, le piante avrebbero ricoperto completamente qualsiasi struttura artificiale, ma qui su un asteroide in mezzo al nulla? Qualunque riserva d'acqua avesse questo posto probabilmente si è esaurita quando i Costruttori erano ancora vivi." Dopo essersi fermato a pensare qualche secondo, Dusk continua.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Even if there are no plants, there must be containers with seeds and fertilizers somewhere around here. We have already wasted a lot of time coming up here; if you go look for those while I gather samples from the abandoned hydroponics, we will cover more terrain in the time we have left." As Dusk begins to prepare the sampling vials and the rest of the equipment, you walk toward the back of the "fields." You enter a series of tall rooms parallel to the hydroponics, none of which contain anything of note - all except the last room, which contains numerous hexagonal containers stacked on top of each other.|1553|0
units.english: "Even if there are no plants, there must be containers with seeds and fertilizers somewhere around here. We have already wasted a lot of time coming up here; if you go look for those while I gather samples from the abandoned hydroponics, we will cover more terrain in the time we have left." As Dusk begins to prepare the sampling vials and the rest of the equipment, you walk toward the back of the "fields." You enter a series of tall rooms parallel to the hydroponics, none of which contain anything of note - all except the last room, which contains numerous hexagonal containers stacked on top of each other.
units.italian: "Anche se non ci sono piante, da qualche parte qui intorno devono esserci contenitori con semi e fertilizzanti. Abbiamo già perso molto tempo a salire quassù; se vai a cercarli mentre io raccolgo campioni dall'idroponica abbandonata, copriremo più terreno nel tempo che ci resta." Mentre Dusk comincia a preparare le fiale per i campioni e il resto dell'attrezzatura, ti incammini verso il fondo dei "campi". Entri in una serie di stanze alte parallele all'idroponica, nessuna delle quali contiene qualcosa di rilevante, tranne l'ultima, che contiene numerosi contenitori esagonali impilati uno sull'altro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Call Dusk.)|1555|0
units.english: (Call Dusk.)
units.italian: (Chiama Dusk.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	(Open one of the boxes.)|1557|0
units.english: (Open one of the boxes.)
units.italian: (Apri una delle casse.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	You take one of the boxes from the top of the stack. It seems very heavy for its size, but with the help of the almost negligible gravity of the asteroid, you eventually succeed in taking it down to the floor. Opening it is even harder, as the box seems to have been sealed shut hermetically. After a lot of struggle, it opens to reveal a mass of spherical, light blue seeds tightly packed together.|1558|0
units.english: You take one of the boxes from the top of the stack. It seems very heavy for its size, but with the help of the almost negligible gravity of the asteroid, you eventually succeed in taking it down to the floor. Opening it is even harder, as the box seems to have been sealed shut hermetically. After a lot of struggle, it opens to reveal a mass of spherical, light blue seeds tightly packed together.
units.italian: Prendi una delle casse dalla cima della pila. Sembra molto pesante per le sue dimensioni, ma con l'aiuto della gravità quasi trascurabile dell'asteroide riesci infine a portarla a terra. Aprirla è ancora più difficile, perché la cassa sembra essere stata sigillata ermeticamente. Dopo molta fatica, si apre rivelando una massa di semi sferici azzurro chiaro, strettamente ammassati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Dusk reaches you shortly thereafter, but he doesn't seem too happy. "I have few pressurized containers with me, <first>. We cannot expose the seeds to the vacuum of space without the risk of killing them, and we are going to need as many chances as possible to make something grow." Taking another box from the stack, he continues, "We ought to leave this one here for a future expedition and grab another one instead."|1559|0
units.english: Dusk reaches you shortly thereafter, but he doesn't seem too happy. "I have few pressurized containers with me, <first>. We cannot expose the seeds to the vacuum of space without the risk of killing them, and we are going to need as many chances as possible to make something grow." Taking another box from the stack, he continues, "We ought to leave this one here for a future expedition and grab another one instead."
units.italian: Dusk ti raggiunge poco dopo, ma non sembra troppo contento. "Ho pochi contenitori pressurizzati con me, <first>. Non possiamo esporre i semi al vuoto dello spazio senza rischiare di ucciderli, e ci serviranno quante più occasioni possibili per far crescere qualcosa." Prendendo un'altra cassa dalla pila, continua: "Dovremmo lasciare questa qui per una spedizione futura e prendere invece un'altra."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	It doesn't take long for Dusk to reach you. "Great find, <first>." After glancing at boxes on various piles, he finally settles for one on the top of a nearby stack and brings it down. "From the labels on its back, it seems to contain three different kinds of seeds."|1563|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for Dusk to reach you. "Great find, <first>." After glancing at boxes on various piles, he finally settles for one on the top of a nearby stack and brings it down. "From the labels on its back, it seems to contain three different kinds of seeds."
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché Dusk ti raggiunga. "Ottima scoperta, <first>." Dopo aver dato un'occhiata alle casse di varie pile, sceglie infine quella in cima a una pila vicina e la porta giù. "Dalle etichette sul retro, sembra che contenga tre tipi diversi di semi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	As you awkwardly scoot down the slide with the seeds, the same corrugated texture that made it possible to climb now working against you, Dusk continues his explanation. "It seems odd how none of the boxes you found were empty, or even unsealed. The hydroponics fields were in a similar situation; you would expect to find at least traces indicating the place used to be full of plants, but there was nothing of that sort. I am starting to believe this place was never inhabited in the first place, but assembling this facility would go far beyond the known capabilities of the Ka'sei."|1565|0
units.english: As you awkwardly scoot down the slide with the seeds, the same corrugated texture that made it possible to climb now working against you, Dusk continues his explanation. "It seems odd how none of the boxes you found were empty, or even unsealed. The hydroponics fields were in a similar situation; you would expect to find at least traces indicating the place used to be full of plants, but there was nothing of that sort. I am starting to believe this place was never inhabited in the first place, but assembling this facility would go far beyond the known capabilities of the Ka'sei."
units.italian: Mentre scivoli goffamente giù per la rampa con i semi, la stessa texture corrugata che rendeva possibile la salita ora lavora contro di te, Dusk continua la sua spiegazione. "Sembra strano che nessuna delle casse che hai trovato fosse vuota, o anche solo non sigillata. I campi idroponici erano in una situazione simile; ti aspetteresti di trovare almeno tracce che indicano che il posto era pieno di piante, ma non c'era nulla del genere. Comincio a credere che questo posto non sia mai stato abitato, ma assemblare una struttura del genere andrebbe ben oltre le capacità note dei Ka'sei."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Shortly after reaching the end, you meet up with the rest of the team, who all describe situations similar to the one you found. It takes a while to reach your ship outside the dome, but finally everything is ready to return to Remnant space. Next stop: <planet>.|1566|0
