units.english: Shortly after reaching the end, you meet up with the rest of the team, who all describe situations similar to the one you found. It takes a while to reach your ship outside the dome, but finally everything is ready to return to Remnant space. Next stop: <planet>.
units.italian: Poco dopo aver raggiunto la fine, vi riunite con il resto della squadra, che descrive tutti situazioni simili a quella che hai trovato. Ci vuole un po' per raggiungere la nave fuori dalla cupola, ma alla fine tutto è pronto per tornare nello spazio dei Remnant. Prossima tappa: <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|After disembarking from the <ship>, you help the Remnant carry out what they found in the Builder settlement. The other teams gathered a lot of artifacts during the trip, from oddly shaped vials to tall pieces of alien machinery; you help Dusk carry a small crate, containing a dozen or so cylindrical objects roughly as large as your hand behind a transparent lid. "Thank you for your help, Captain."|1573|0
units.english: After disembarking from the <ship>, you help the Remnant carry out what they found in the Builder settlement. The other teams gathered a lot of artifacts during the trip, from oddly shaped vials to tall pieces of alien machinery; you help Dusk carry a small crate, containing a dozen or so cylindrical objects roughly as large as your hand behind a transparent lid. "Thank you for your help, Captain."
units.italian: Dopo essere sceso dalla <ship>, aiuti i Remnant a scaricare quello che hanno trovato nell'insediamento dei Costruttori. Gli altri gruppi hanno raccolto molti manufatti durante il viaggio, da fiale di forma strana a pezzi alti di macchinari alieni; aiuti Dusk a portare una piccola cassa, contenente una dozzina circa di oggetti cilindrici grandi più o meno come la tua mano dietro un coperchio trasparente. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, capitano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What is the next move?"|1575|0
units.english: "What is the next move?"
units.italian: "Qual è la prossima mossa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"What is in that crate?"|1577|0
units.english: "What is in that crate?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è in quella cassa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Oh, these? They are a Builder sidearm - a weapon capable of emitting short-ranged electrical bursts strong enough to incapacitate or kill your target. We discovered a few hundred of them inside some bunkers in the Graveyard long ago. If you would like, I would not mind misplacing one, as a token of thanks for all your help here."|1578|0
units.english: "Oh, these? They are a Builder sidearm - a weapon capable of emitting short-ranged electrical bursts strong enough to incapacitate or kill your target. We discovered a few hundred of them inside some bunkers in the Graveyard long ago. If you would like, I would not mind misplacing one, as a token of thanks for all your help here."
units.italian: "Oh, questi? Sono un'arma da fianco dei Costruttori: un'arma capace di emettere scariche elettriche a corto raggio abbastanza forti da incapacitare o uccidere il bersaglio. Ne abbiamo scoperti qualche centinaio dentro alcuni bunker del Cimitero molto tempo fa. Se vuoi, non mi dispiacerebbe perderne una, come segno di ringraziamento per tutto il tuo aiuto qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Thank you. How do I use it?"|1581|0
units.english: "Thank you. How do I use it?"
units.italian: "Grazie. Come si usa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"I'd rather be paid in credits instead."|1583|0
units.english: "I'd rather be paid in credits instead."
units.italian: "Preferirei essere pagato in crediti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Oh, I have already transferred 50,000 credits to your account. I need to organize some things for our next mission; if you meet me in the spaceport a few hours from now, I should have everything ready."|1584|0
units.english: "Oh, I have already transferred 50,000 credits to your account. I need to organize some things for our next mission; if you meet me in the spaceport a few hours from now, I should have everything ready."
units.italian: "Oh, ho già trasferito 50.000 crediti sul tuo conto. Devo organizzare alcune cose per la nostra prossima missione; se mi incontri allo spazioporto tra qualche ora, dovrei avere tutto pronto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	Dusk quickly explains how to use the Ka'het weapon; its short cylindrical shape is evidently not made for human hands and proves to be quite hard to use, but you eventually figure out how to hold it while still being able to readily press the trigger. While they may not be the best weapon to capture an enemy ship, they're surely going to be very handy from a defensive position inside your own.|1590|0
units.english: Dusk quickly explains how to use the Ka'het weapon; its short cylindrical shape is evidently not made for human hands and proves to be quite hard to use, but you eventually figure out how to hold it while still being able to readily press the trigger. While they may not be the best weapon to capture an enemy ship, they're surely going to be very handy from a defensive position inside your own.
units.italian: Dusk spiega rapidamente come usare l'arma dei Ka'het; la sua forma cilindrica e corta evidentemente non è fatta per mani umane e si rivela piuttosto difficile da usare, ma alla fine capisci come impugnarla riuscendo comunque a premere agevolmente il grilletto. Anche se non sarà l'arma migliore per catturare una nave nemica, sarà di certo molto utile da una posizione difensiva dentro la propria.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 7|	"Now that we know how to safely access the site, I am going to need to organize our next mission. If you meet me in the spaceport a few hours from now I should have everything ready. In the meanwhile, make sure to prepare a large enough freighter for takeoff - chances are we will need at least a hundred tons of free space in the cargo hold for the complete payload."|1592|0
units.english: "Now that we know how to safely access the site, I am going to need to organize our next mission. If you meet me in the spaceport a few hours from now I should have everything ready. In the meanwhile, make sure to prepare a large enough freighter for takeoff - chances are we will need at least a hundred tons of free space in the cargo hold for the complete payload."
units.italian: "Ora che sappiamo come accedere al sito in sicurezza, dovrò organizzare la nostra prossima missione. Se mi incontri allo spazioporto tra qualche ora dovrei avere tutto pronto. Nel frattempo, assicurati di preparare un mercantile abbastanza grande per il decollo: molto probabilmente ci serviranno almeno cento tonnellate di spazio libero nella stiva per il carico completo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|name|1595|0
units.english: Take the lab
units.italian: Prendi il laboratorio

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|description|1596|0
units.english: Take the ground lab (weighing 97 tons) from <destination> to prepare for the next expedition.
units.italian: Porta il laboratorio terrestre (97 tonnellate) da <destination> per preparare la prossima spedizione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|blocked|1600|0
units.english: Dusk contacts you soon after you reach the spaceport. "<first>, we will need at least five free bunks for the mission we are preparing."
units.italian: Dusk ti contatta poco dopo che hai raggiunto lo spazioporto. "<first>, ci serviranno almeno cinque cuccette libere per la missione che stiamo preparando."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|It doesn't take long for you to see Dusk; he's waiting for you under a canopy next to your landing pad, right at the edge of Aventine's starport. "We are almost ready to go," he says, "but I have run into a problem. My plan for our next mission was to have a repeat of the last expedition, but this time carrying a temporary laboratory to the Builder site. I was able to gather most of the instruments I was looking for in the local scientific facilities, but none of the mobile laboratories I am authorized to requisition by default were in good enough condition to fly.|1605|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for you to see Dusk; he's waiting for you under a canopy next to your landing pad, right at the edge of Aventine's starport. "We are almost ready to go," he says, "but I have run into a problem. My plan for our next mission was to have a repeat of the last expedition, but this time carrying a temporary laboratory to the Builder site. I was able to gather most of the instruments I was looking for in the local scientific facilities, but none of the mobile laboratories I am authorized to requisition by default were in good enough condition to fly.
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché tu veda Dusk; ti aspetta sotto una pensilina accanto alla tua piazzola di atterraggio, proprio al bordo dello spazioporto di Aventine. "Siamo quasi pronti a partire," dice, "ma ho incontrato un problema. Il mio piano per la prossima missione era ripetere l'ultima spedizione, ma questa volta portando un laboratorio temporaneo al sito dei Costruttori. Sono riuscito a raccogliere la maggior parte degli strumenti che cercavo nelle strutture scientifiche locali, ma nessuno dei laboratori mobili che sono autorizzato a requisire per default era in condizioni abbastanza buone per volare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|	"Because of that, before we can start our mission, we will need to make a stopover at <destination> - I was able to convince the prefects on Viminal to reallocate one of the outposts that they had just delivered there to our mission, given it has higher priority than the mining expeditions they are setting up. After outfitting it with our research equipment, it has reached a mass of 97 tons."|1606|0
units.english: "Because of that, before we can start our mission, we will need to make a stopover at <destination> - I was able to convince the prefects on Viminal to reallocate one of the outposts that they had just delivered there to our mission, given it has higher priority than the mining expeditions they are setting up. After outfitting it with our research equipment, it has reached a mass of 97 tons."
units.italian: "Per questo, prima di poter iniziare la missione, dovremo fare scalo su <destination>: sono riuscito a convincere i prefetti di Viminal a riassegnare alla nostra missione uno degli avamposti che avevano appena consegnato lì, dato che ha priorità più alta delle spedizioni minerarie che stanno allestendo. Dopo averlo dotato della nostra attrezzatura di ricerca, ha raggiunto una massa di 97 tonnellate."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|	You help Dusk transport the chosen instruments to your ship; you also make sure to leave enough space for the facilities you're going to take from <planet>. As you're walking back to the ship's controls, Dusk reminds you to bring as many ramscoops with you as possible - you're going to need them in order to complete the mission plan while cloaked.|1607|0
units.english: You help Dusk transport the chosen instruments to your ship; you also make sure to leave enough space for the facilities you're going to take from <planet>. As you're walking back to the ship's controls, Dusk reminds you to bring as many ramscoops with you as possible - you're going to need them in order to complete the mission plan while cloaked.
units.italian: Aiuti Dusk a trasportare sulla nave gli strumenti scelti; ti assicuri anche di lasciare spazio sufficiente per le strutture che prenderai da <planet>. Mentre torni ai comandi della nave, Dusk ti ricorda di portare con te quanti più ramscoop possibile: ti serviranno per completare il piano della missione restando occultato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|Dusk's coordinates indicate the border of a large canyon near the equator of <planet>. Unlike most cracks on the surface, this one shows signs of geological activity: you only narrowly avoid a stream ejecting from a geyser in the canyon as you pass overhead. As you land, a row of Remnant structures are clearly visible running parallel to the cliff.|1613|0
units.english: Dusk's coordinates indicate the border of a large canyon near the equator of <planet>. Unlike most cracks on the surface, this one shows signs of geological activity: you only narrowly avoid a stream ejecting from a geyser in the canyon as you pass overhead. As you land, a row of Remnant structures are clearly visible running parallel to the cliff.
units.italian: Le coordinate di Dusk indicano il bordo di un grande canyon vicino all'equatore di <planet>. A differenza della maggior parte delle fratture sulla superficie, questa mostra segni di attività geologica: eviti per un soffio un getto eruttato da un geyser nel canyon mentre passi sopra. Mentre atterri, una fila di strutture dei Remnant è chiaramente visibile, parallela alla scogliera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8A|	The local crew assist in loading the modular laboratory split across three pallets; with them arrives a separate package, containing a surveillance satellite to be deployed near Patir while cloaked.|1614|0
units.english: The local crew assist in loading the modular laboratory split across three pallets; with them arrives a separate package, containing a surveillance satellite to be deployed near Patir while cloaked.
units.italian: L'equipaggio locale aiuta a caricare il laboratorio modulare, diviso su tre pallet; insieme a esso arriva un pacco separato, contenente un satellite di sorveglianza da schierare vicino a Patir restando occultati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|name|1623|0
units.english: Lab deployment
units.italian: Schierare il laboratorio

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|description|1624|0
units.english: Reach <system> and land while still cloaked in order to set up the Remnant laboratory.
units.italian: Raggiungi <system> e atterra restando occultato per installare il laboratorio dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|blocked|1629|0
units.english: Dusk contacts you soon after you reach the spaceport. "<first>, this mission is going to require <capacity>."
units.italian: Dusk ti contatta poco dopo che hai raggiunto lo spazioporto. "<first>, questa missione richiederà <capacity>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|The probe slowly moves away from your ship, opening its external panels and the instrumentation; as you watch it turn into a dim point of light, the Remnant team confirms that it is functioning correctly. Time to land on the asteroid.|1634|0
units.english: The probe slowly moves away from your ship, opening its external panels and the instrumentation; as you watch it turn into a dim point of light, the Remnant team confirms that it is functioning correctly. Time to land on the asteroid.
units.italian: La sonda si allontana lentamente dalla nave, aprendo i pannelli esterni e la strumentazione; mentre la guardi trasformarsi in un debole punto di luce, la squadra Remnant conferma che funziona correttamente. È ora di atterrare sull'asteroide.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|You have approached the Builder Settlement uncloaked, making the Ka'sei follow you, or the escort that was carrying the Remnant scientists has been destroyed, or the escort that was carrying the mission cargo was destroyed. You have failed this mission.|1640|0
units.english: You have approached the Builder Settlement uncloaked, making the Ka'sei follow you, or the escort that was carrying the Remnant scientists has been destroyed, or the escort that was carrying the mission cargo was destroyed. You have failed this mission.
units.italian: Ti sei avvicinato all'Insediamento dei Costruttori senza occultamento, facendo seguirti dai Ka'sei, oppure la scorta che trasportava gli scienziati Remnant è stata distrutta, oppure la scorta che trasportava il carico della missione è stata distrutta. Hai fallito questa missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 8B|dialog|1642|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but not all of the cargo and passengers are in the system! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system. Remember that your escorts need to be cloaked as well. You may want to park your escorts that are incapable of cloaking.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutto il carico e i passeggeri sono nel sistema! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare. Ricorda che anche le tue scorte devono essere occultate. Potresti voler parcheggiare le scorte incapaci di occultarsi.

units.id: outfit:Asteroid Weapon Super|display name|1705|0
mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|name|1742|0
units.english: Explore the neighborhood
units.italian: Esplora i dintorni

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|description|1743|0
units.english: Visit every system around <system> you can reach, then return to Dusk.
units.italian: Visita ogni sistema attorno a <system> che riesci a raggiungere, poi torna da Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|Approaching the settlement from the northeast, you park the <ship> once again next to the airlock array; it's almost starting to become a familiar sight by now. With the cargo ramp pointed toward the entrance and the post-flight checklist completed, the Remnant team begins to deploy the lab while you remain in the cockpit, keeping an eye on Ka'sei activity. The researchers work quickly and nearly without issue in the light gravity of the asteroid, besides the occasional lost screw. However, the construction job still takes nearly the entire day.|1759|0
units.english: Approaching the settlement from the northeast, you park the <ship> once again next to the airlock array; it's almost starting to become a familiar sight by now. With the cargo ramp pointed toward the entrance and the post-flight checklist completed, the Remnant team begins to deploy the lab while you remain in the cockpit, keeping an eye on Ka'sei activity. The researchers work quickly and nearly without issue in the light gravity of the asteroid, besides the occasional lost screw. However, the construction job still takes nearly the entire day.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti all'insediamento da nord-est, parcheggi di nuovo la <ship> accanto alla serie di camere di equilibrio; ormai sta quasi diventando una vista familiare. Con la rampa di carico puntata verso l'ingresso e la lista di controllo post-volo completata, la squadra Remnant comincia a schierare il laboratorio mentre tu resti in cabina, tenendo d'occhio l'attività dei Ka'sei. I ricercatori lavorano in fretta e quasi senza problemi nella debole gravità dell'asteroide, a parte qualche vite persa. Tuttavia, il lavoro di costruzione richiede comunque quasi un giorno intero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	With the Ka'sei still oblivious, and the lab set up, you take advantage of the opportunity to stretch your legs and pay a visit to the researchers in the new outpost. "So, Captain," asks Dusk, meeting you at the entrance, "what do you think of it?"|1760|0
units.english: With the Ka'sei still oblivious, and the lab set up, you take advantage of the opportunity to stretch your legs and pay a visit to the researchers in the new outpost. "So, Captain," asks Dusk, meeting you at the entrance, "what do you think of it?"
units.italian: Con i Ka'sei ancora ignari e il laboratorio installato, cogli l'occasione per sgranchirti le gambe e fare visita ai ricercatori nel nuovo avamposto. "Allora, capitano," chiede Dusk, incontrandoti all'ingresso, "che cosa ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"It is beautiful."|1763|0
units.english: "It is beautiful."
units.italian: "È bellissimo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Well, it seems rather functional."|1765|0
units.english: "Well, it seems rather functional."
units.italian: "Beh, sembra piuttosto funzionale."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"That is all?"|1767|0
units.english: "That is all?"
units.italian: "Tutto qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Admittedly, the research-focused part in it is rather limited - it is a repurposed mining hub, after all - but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."|1768|0
units.english: "Admittedly, the research-focused part in it is rather limited - it is a repurposed mining hub, after all - but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."
units.italian: "Va detto che la parte dedicata alla ricerca è piuttosto limitata; dopo tutto è un hub minerario riadattato. Ma dovrebbe ospitare comodamente qualche persona per tutto il tempo necessario. Inoltre," aggiunge, "c'è tutto lo spazio che vuoi per sgranchirti le gambe dentro la cupola."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Hopefully! It is a repurposed mining hub, after all, so its capabilities will be quite limited as a laboratory, but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."|1772|0
units.english: "Hopefully! It is a repurposed mining hub, after all, so its capabilities will be quite limited as a laboratory, but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."
units.italian: "Lo spero! Dopo tutto è un hub minerario riadattato, quindi le sue capacità come laboratorio saranno piuttosto limitate, ma dovrebbe ospitare comodamente qualche persona per tutto il tempo necessario. Inoltre," aggiunge, "c'è tutto lo spazio che vuoi per sgranchirti le gambe dentro la cupola."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	He smiles. "It has a certain charm for sure. As a repurposed mining hub, its capabilities will be quite limited for a laboratory, but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."|1775|0
units.english: He smiles. "It has a certain charm for sure. As a repurposed mining hub, its capabilities will be quite limited for a laboratory, but it should comfortably house a few people for as long as needed. Besides," he adds, "there is all the space you could ask for to stretch your legs inside the dome."
units.italian: Sorride. "Ha di certo un suo fascino. Essendo un hub minerario riadattato, le sue capacità come laboratorio saranno piuttosto limitate, ma dovrebbe ospitare comodamente qualche persona per tutto il tempo necessario. Inoltre," aggiunge, "c'è tutto lo spazio che vuoi per sgranchirti le gambe dentro la cupola."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	You step inside the lab's internal door, removing your helmet now that the atmosphere is breathable. Dusk takes you around the cylindrical hub to show the various sections of it: the sleeping quarters, small but not cramped; the extravehicular research module, a flexible corridor connecting it with the airlock and housing spacesuits with rather unwieldy instruments, and so on. As the tour comes to an end, you and Dusk return to the entrance, where the rest of the team is split between checking the expedition's equipment and preparing something to eat. "We are about to dine now," Dusk mentions. "There is an extra seat in case you would like to join us."|1777|0
units.english: You step inside the lab's internal door, removing your helmet now that the atmosphere is breathable. Dusk takes you around the cylindrical hub to show the various sections of it: the sleeping quarters, small but not cramped; the extravehicular research module, a flexible corridor connecting it with the airlock and housing spacesuits with rather unwieldy instruments, and so on. As the tour comes to an end, you and Dusk return to the entrance, where the rest of the team is split between checking the expedition's equipment and preparing something to eat. "We are about to dine now," Dusk mentions. "There is an extra seat in case you would like to join us."
units.italian: Entri dalla porta interna del laboratorio, togliendoti il casco ora che l'atmosfera è respirabile. Dusk ti accompagna in giro per l'hub cilindrico per mostrarti le varie sezioni: gli alloggi, piccoli ma non angusti; il modulo di ricerca extraveicolare, un corridoio flessibile che lo collega alla camera di equilibrio e ospita tute spaziali con strumenti piuttosto ingombranti, e così via. Mentre il giro volge al termine, tu e Dusk tornate all'ingresso, dove il resto della squadra è diviso tra il controllo dell'attrezzatura della spedizione e la preparazione di qualcosa da mangiare. "Stiamo per cenare," accenna Dusk. "C'è un posto in più, se ti va di unirti a noi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"I would be happy to."|1779|0
units.english: "I would be happy to."
units.italian: "Ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"What comes next?"|1781|0
units.english: "What comes next?"
units.italian: "Che cosa viene dopo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"If that is all, I'd rather move back to my ship to prepare for liftoff."|1783|0
units.english: "If that is all, I'd rather move back to my ship to prepare for liftoff."
units.italian: "Se è tutto, preferirei tornare alla nave per prepararmi al decollo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Alright, Captain," Dusk replies. "I will contact you when we need a ride back. Our current plan is to remain at the outpost for one or two months, exploring the Builder settlement and studying everything it has to offer. Do not go too far, though - emergencies can always happen, after all."|1784|0
units.english: "Alright, Captain," Dusk replies. "I will contact you when we need a ride back. Our current plan is to remain at the outpost for one or two months, exploring the Builder settlement and studying everything it has to offer. Do not go too far, though - emergencies can always happen, after all."
units.italian: "Va bene, capitano," risponde Dusk. "Ti contatterò quando avremo bisogno di tornare a casa. Il nostro piano attuale è restare all'avamposto per uno o due mesi, esplorando l'insediamento dei Costruttori e studiando tutto ciò che ha da offrire. Non allontanarti troppo, però: le emergenze possono sempre capitare, dopo tutto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	Lacking a true dining room, the meal has been set up on a table between the bunks of the researchers. It takes a few tries to find a position in which everyone is at least somewhat comfortable and the dinner can finally begin. You notice that the portions of the rather unappealing Remnant food are much smaller than what you're used to seeing them eat - similar to yours, in fact. One of the researchers notices you looking at her plate, and replies, "I assume you have been told about the symbionts and their increased nutritional needs by now? The four of us have been selected for the mission in part because of the fact that we are part of the small number of scientists that do not wear one, which makes us better suited for expeditions with limited supplies."|1788|0
units.english: Lacking a true dining room, the meal has been set up on a table between the bunks of the researchers. It takes a few tries to find a position in which everyone is at least somewhat comfortable and the dinner can finally begin. You notice that the portions of the rather unappealing Remnant food are much smaller than what you're used to seeing them eat - similar to yours, in fact. One of the researchers notices you looking at her plate, and replies, "I assume you have been told about the symbionts and their increased nutritional needs by now? The four of us have been selected for the mission in part because of the fact that we are part of the small number of scientists that do not wear one, which makes us better suited for expeditions with limited supplies."
units.italian: Mancando una vera sala da pranzo, il pasto è stato apparecchiato su un tavolo tra le cuccette dei ricercatori. Ci vogliono alcuni tentativi per trovare una posizione in cui tutti siano almeno un po' comodi e la cena possa finalmente cominciare. Noti che le porzioni del cibo Remnant, piuttosto poco invitante, sono molto più piccole di quelle che sei abituato a vederli mangiare; simili alle tue, in effetti. Una delle ricercatrici si accorge che stai guardando il suo piatto e risponde: "Immagino che ormai ti abbiano parlato dei simbionti e del loro maggior fabbisogno nutrizionale? Noi quattro siamo stati scelti per la missione anche perché facciamo parte del piccolo numero di scienziati che non ne indossano uno, il che ci rende più adatti a spedizioni con scorte limitate."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"What is your reason for not having a symbiont?"|1790|0
units.english: "What is your reason for not having a symbiont?"
units.italian: "Qual è il tuo motivo per non avere un simbionte?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Do you have a symbiont, Dusk?"|1792|0
units.english: "Do you have a symbiont, Dusk?"
units.italian: "Tu hai un simbionte, Dusk?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	(Just finish the dinner and leave.)|1794|0
units.english: (Just finish the dinner and leave.)
units.italian: (Finisci la cena e vai.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	The rest of the dinner passes rather quickly, and within half an hour you're ready to return to your ship. At the entrance, Dusk approaches you.|1795|0
units.english: The rest of the dinner passes rather quickly, and within half an hour you're ready to return to your ship. At the entrance, Dusk approaches you.
units.italian: Il resto della cena passa piuttosto in fretta, e nel giro di mezz'ora sei pronto a tornare alla nave. All'ingresso, Dusk si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|label|1797|0
units.english: dusk symbiont
units.italian: dusk symbiont

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"I do have one - right under the cervical vertebrae, at the top of my back. Being the lead researcher of this mission, there was not much choice left; removing it at this point wasn't an acceptable option, and switching positions this late into the program would have been much more harmful than increasing the reserves planned to the right level." As the dinner comes to an end, you and Dusk move back near the entrance.|1798|0
units.english: "I do have one - right under the cervical vertebrae, at the top of my back. Being the lead researcher of this mission, there was not much choice left; removing it at this point wasn't an acceptable option, and switching positions this late into the program would have been much more harmful than increasing the reserves planned to the right level." As the dinner comes to an end, you and Dusk move back near the entrance.
units.italian: "Io ne ho uno, proprio sotto le vertebre cervicali, in cima alla schiena. Essendo il ricercatore capo di questa missione, non c'era molta scelta; rimuoverlo a questo punto non era un'opzione accettabile, e cambiare posizione a questo punto del programma sarebbe stato molto più dannoso che aumentare le riserve pianificate al livello giusto." Mentre la cena volge al termine, tu e Dusk vi spostate vicino all'ingresso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"For me, the reason is medical. My body rejected the symbiont quite violently shortly after the initial operation, to the point that even attempting to install another would be very risky. But if you ask around, the causes are quite varied." As the dinner comes to an end, you and Dusk move back near the entrance.|1802|0
units.english: "For me, the reason is medical. My body rejected the symbiont quite violently shortly after the initial operation, to the point that even attempting to install another would be very risky. But if you ask around, the causes are quite varied." As the dinner comes to an end, you and Dusk move back near the entrance.
units.italian: "Per me il motivo è medico. Il mio corpo ha respinto il simbionte in modo piuttosto violento poco dopo l'operazione iniziale, al punto che persino tentare di installarne un altro sarebbe molto rischioso. Ma se chiedi in giro, le cause sono piuttosto varie." Mentre la cena volge al termine, tu e Dusk vi spostate vicino all'ingresso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Our current plan is to remain at the outpost for one or two months, exploring the Builder settlement and studying everything it has to offer. Do not go too far in the meanwhile, though - emergencies can always happen, and you are supposed to be our ride back when the time comes." He pauses for a few seconds to think. "If you are interested, perhaps you could remain here with us to help with the research. You would need to sleep in your starship, of course, and the supplies would be slightly more limited, but neither issue is a showstopper. It is up to you, <first>."|1804|0
units.english: "Our current plan is to remain at the outpost for one or two months, exploring the Builder settlement and studying everything it has to offer. Do not go too far in the meanwhile, though - emergencies can always happen, and you are supposed to be our ride back when the time comes." He pauses for a few seconds to think. "If you are interested, perhaps you could remain here with us to help with the research. You would need to sleep in your starship, of course, and the supplies would be slightly more limited, but neither issue is a showstopper. It is up to you, <first>."
units.italian: "Il nostro piano attuale è restare all'avamposto per uno o due mesi, esplorando l'insediamento dei Costruttori e studiando tutto ciò che ha da offrire. Non allontanarti troppo, però: le emergenze possono sempre capitare, e quando sarà il momento dovresti essere tu a riportarci indietro." Si ferma qualche secondo a pensare. "Se ti interessa, potresti restare qui con noi ad aiutare con la ricerca. Dovresti dormire nella tua nave, naturalmente, e le scorte sarebbero un po' più limitate, ma nessuno dei due problemi è insormontabile. Dipende da te, <first>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	(Accept the offer.)|1806|0
units.english: (Accept the offer.)
units.italian: (Accetta l'offerta.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	(Decline the offer.)|1807|0
units.english: (Decline the offer.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta l'offerta.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Perfect then," Dusk replies. "See you tomorrow!" You move back aboard your ship and walk up to the bunks to prepare for the night; however, you notice out of a window that the full Remnant team has come out of the lab, staring up at the sky. You attempt to contact them, but the only result is an eerie quiet. All of a sudden, you realize what is wrong: the starry night is gone, and a sky of an overwhelming black now surrounds everything and everyone.|1809|0
units.english: "Perfect then," Dusk replies. "See you tomorrow!" You move back aboard your ship and walk up to the bunks to prepare for the night; however, you notice out of a window that the full Remnant team has come out of the lab, staring up at the sky. You attempt to contact them, but the only result is an eerie quiet. All of a sudden, you realize what is wrong: the starry night is gone, and a sky of an overwhelming black now surrounds everything and everyone.
units.italian: "Perfetto allora," risponde Dusk. "A domani!" Torni a bordo della nave e sali alle cuccette per prepararti alla notte; tuttavia noti da un finestrino che l'intera squadra Remnant è uscita dal laboratorio, fissando il cielo. Cerchi di contattarli, ma l'unico risultato è un silenzio inquietante. All'improvviso capisci cosa non va: la notte stellata è sparita, e un cielo di un nero opprimente ora circonda tutto e tutti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"I understand. See you in a few weeks then, Captain, and may the Embers guide you." You move back aboard your ship and walk up to the cockpit to prepare for liftoff; however, you notice out of the corner of your eye that the full Remnant team has donned their spacesuits, and is standing outside the lab. For a split second you think that they've come outside to watch the liftoff, but they aren't looking at your ship; they're staring up, at the sky. You attempt to contact them, but the only result is an eerie quiet. All of a sudden, you realize what is wrong: the starry night is gone, and a sky of an overwhelming black now surrounds everything and everyone.|1813|0
units.english: "I understand. See you in a few weeks then, Captain, and may the Embers guide you." You move back aboard your ship and walk up to the cockpit to prepare for liftoff; however, you notice out of the corner of your eye that the full Remnant team has donned their spacesuits, and is standing outside the lab. For a split second you think that they've come outside to watch the liftoff, but they aren't looking at your ship; they're staring up, at the sky. You attempt to contact them, but the only result is an eerie quiet. All of a sudden, you realize what is wrong: the starry night is gone, and a sky of an overwhelming black now surrounds everything and everyone.
units.italian: "Capisco. Allora ci vediamo tra qualche settimana, capitano, e che le Braci ti guidino." Torni a bordo della nave e sali in cabina per prepararti al decollo; tuttavia noti con la coda dell'occhio che l'intera squadra Remnant ha indossato le tute spaziali ed è in piedi fuori dal laboratorio. Per un istante pensi che siano usciti a guardare il decollo, ma non stanno guardando la tua nave; stanno fissando il cielo. Cerchi di contattarli, ma l'unico risultato è un silenzio inquietante. All'improvviso capisci cosa non va: la notte stellata è sparita, e un cielo di un nero opprimente ora circonda tutto e tutti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	As your eyes adapt to a featureless sky, you notice brief, nearly imperceptible white streaks passing past your field of view in an instant. The lines become more and more visible, almost like stars during a hyperjump, when your attention is captured by a white mass slightly above the horizon. It starts as a tiny dot in the distance, then becomes bigger and bigger, until it covers the entire sky. The extreme light it produces forces you to look away for a second, and when you look back, there are even more streaks in the sky, to the point of making you feel nauseous.|1815|0
units.english: As your eyes adapt to a featureless sky, you notice brief, nearly imperceptible white streaks passing past your field of view in an instant. The lines become more and more visible, almost like stars during a hyperjump, when your attention is captured by a white mass slightly above the horizon. It starts as a tiny dot in the distance, then becomes bigger and bigger, until it covers the entire sky. The extreme light it produces forces you to look away for a second, and when you look back, there are even more streaks in the sky, to the point of making you feel nauseous.
units.italian: Mentre i tuoi occhi si adattano a un cielo senza tratti distintivi, noti brevi strisce bianche, quasi impercettibili, che attraversano il tuo campo visivo in un istante. Le linee diventano sempre più visibili, quasi come stelle durante un salto iperspaziale, quando la tua attenzione viene catturata da una massa bianca poco sopra l'orizzonte. Comincia come un minuscolo punto in lontananza, poi diventa sempre più grande, finché copre l'intero cielo. La luce estrema che produce ti costringe a distogliere lo sguardo per un secondo, e quando guardi di nuovo ci sono ancora più strisce nel cielo, al punto da farti sentire nauseato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	You can't tell how much time has passed since the phenomenon began, but it finally starts to show signs that it's coming to an end: the streaks become shorter and last longer in the sky, and the number of stars you can see becomes less and less. You begin noticing more and more details; some streaks seem to end before reaching the horizon, while others follow a curved or even cyclical pattern around Patir. Eventually, the stars come to a standstill, and everything returns to normal.|1816|0
units.english: You can't tell how much time has passed since the phenomenon began, but it finally starts to show signs that it's coming to an end: the streaks become shorter and last longer in the sky, and the number of stars you can see becomes less and less. You begin noticing more and more details; some streaks seem to end before reaching the horizon, while others follow a curved or even cyclical pattern around Patir. Eventually, the stars come to a standstill, and everything returns to normal.
units.italian: Non sai dire quanto tempo sia passato da quando è iniziato il fenomeno, ma finalmente comincia a mostrare segni che sta per finire: le strisce diventano più corte e durano più a lungo nel cielo, e il numero di stelle che riesci a vedere diventa sempre minore. Cominci a notare sempre più dettagli; alcune strisce sembrano finire prima di raggiungere l'orizzonte, mentre altre seguono un percorso curvo o persino ciclico attorno a Patir. Alla fine le stelle si fermano, e tutto torna alla normalità.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	Still dizzy from the experience, you carefully walk back down outside to speak with the Remnant. By the time you've reached them, they seem to have recomposed themselves and have started studying some sort of holographic stellar map.|1817|0
units.english: Still dizzy from the experience, you carefully walk back down outside to speak with the Remnant. By the time you've reached them, they seem to have recomposed themselves and have started studying some sort of holographic stellar map.
units.italian: Ancora stordito dall'esperienza, torni giù con cautela per parlare con i Remnant. Quando li raggiungi, sembrano essersi ricomposti e hanno cominciato a studiare una specie di mappa stellare olografica.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"What was that?"|1821|0
units.english: "What was that?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è stato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Is everyone okay?"|1823|0
units.english: "Is everyone okay?"
units.italian: "State tutti bene?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"We are all shaken by the experience, but we have much bigger problems to think about now," Dusk replies. "Something is not right with the sky."|1824|0
units.english: "We are all shaken by the experience, but we have much bigger problems to think about now," Dusk replies. "Something is not right with the sky."
units.italian: "Siamo tutti scossi dall'esperienza, ma ora abbiamo problemi molto più grandi a cui pensare," risponde Dusk. "Qualcosa non va con il cielo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"I wish I knew. And the worst may have yet to come," Dusk replies. "Something is not right with the sky."|1827|0
units.english: "I wish I knew. And the worst may have yet to come," Dusk replies. "Something is not right with the sky."
units.italian: "Vorrei saperlo. E il peggio potrebbe ancora dover venire," risponde Dusk. "Qualcosa non va con il cielo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	He points at the projector. "Do you see those two triangular formations near the top of the star map? That is something we called the Ember Prism - a constellation of six stars of similar magnitude, located far from the Wastes and close to each other. While it is not visible from Earth, it should be recognizable from almost every system here, including Patir, but no longer. And that is not all. None of the constellations in this star map can be found anywhere in the sky." He stops for a second, giving a worried look to the rest of the team. "We are no longer in the Ember Waste."|1829|0
units.english: He points at the projector. "Do you see those two triangular formations near the top of the star map? That is something we called the Ember Prism - a constellation of six stars of similar magnitude, located far from the Wastes and close to each other. While it is not visible from Earth, it should be recognizable from almost every system here, including Patir, but no longer. And that is not all. None of the constellations in this star map can be found anywhere in the sky." He stops for a second, giving a worried look to the rest of the team. "We are no longer in the Ember Waste."
units.italian: Indica il proiettore. "Vedi quelle due formazioni triangolari vicino alla sommità della mappa stellare? È quella che chiamavamo Prisma di Brace: una costellazione di sei stelle di magnitudine simile, lontane dalla Distesa e vicine tra loro. Anche se non è visibile dalla Terra, dovrebbe essere riconoscibile da quasi ogni sistema qui, compreso Patir, ma non lo è più. E non è tutto. Nessuna delle costellazioni di questa mappa stellare si trova più nel cielo." Si ferma un secondo, lanciando uno sguardo preoccupato al resto della squadra. "Non siamo più nella Distesa di Braci."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"How is that possible?"|1831|0
units.english: "How is that possible?"
units.italian: "Com'è possibile?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Where are we then?"|1832|0
units.english: "Where are we then?"
units.italian: "Dove siamo allora?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"How do we get back?"|1833|0
units.english: "How do we get back?"
units.italian: "Come torniamo indietro?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"Was that a hyperspace jump then?"|1834|0
units.english: "Was that a hyperspace jump then?"
units.italian: "Allora è stato un salto iperspaziale?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|	"I have no idea, <first>. What I can tell you for now is that we need to get a clearer idea of what we have around before deciding the next step, and there is no way to get that from here. You need to explore as far as possible in this new sector, and return once you either find a way out or run out of systems. I promise we will have a plan ready by the time you're back."|1835|0
units.english: "I have no idea, <first>. What I can tell you for now is that we need to get a clearer idea of what we have around before deciding the next step, and there is no way to get that from here. You need to explore as far as possible in this new sector, and return once you either find a way out or run out of systems. I promise we will have a plan ready by the time you're back."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea, <first>. Quello che posso dirti per ora è che dobbiamo farci un'idea più chiara di ciò che abbiamo intorno prima di decidere il passo successivo, e non c'è modo di ottenerla da qui. Devi esplorare il più possibile in questo nuovo settore e tornare quando avrai trovato una via d'uscita o finito i sistemi. Prometto che avremo un piano pronto quando tornerai."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|As soon as you enter Chanai, your sensors detect a massive structure of artificial nature, apparently a station of some kind.|1839|0
units.english: As soon as you enter Chanai, your sensors detect a massive structure of artificial nature, apparently a station of some kind.
units.italian: Appena entri in Chanai, i tuoi sensori rilevano un'enorme struttura di natura artificiale, apparentemente una stazione di qualche tipo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|As you enter the system, your sensors lose any trace of the wormhole you passed from. There doesn't seem to be a way to pass through it again from this end.|1842|0
units.english: As you enter the system, your sensors lose any trace of the wormhole you passed from. There doesn't seem to be a way to pass through it again from this end.
units.italian: Mentre entri nel sistema, i tuoi sensori perdono ogni traccia del cunicolo da cui sei passato. Non sembra esserci un modo per attraversarlo di nuovo da questo lato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9|Observing the systems you have mapped, Dusk seems disappointed. "There must be a way to reach the other systems. Please look everywhere you can for a passage; there has to be something."|1845|0
units.english: Observing the systems you have mapped, Dusk seems disappointed. "There must be a way to reach the other systems. Please look everywhere you can for a passage; there has to be something."
units.italian: Osservando i sistemi che hai mappato, Dusk sembra deluso. "Deve esserci un modo per raggiungere gli altri sistemi. Ti prego, cerca ovunque un passaggio; deve esserci qualcosa."

units.id: event:Patir spaceport|spaceport|1856|0
units.english: The Remnant laboratory merges oddly well with the rest of the environment, similar in color and design to the Builder structures around here. The spaceport consists only of a flat strip of regolith near the settlement, hastily cleaned of the debris that covers most of the terrain.
units.italian: Il laboratorio dei Remnant si fonde stranamente bene con il resto dell'ambiente, simile per colore e design alle strutture dei Costruttori qui intorno. Lo spazioporto consiste solo in una striscia piatta di regolite vicino all'insediamento, ripulita in fretta dai detriti che coprono la maggior parte del terreno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|name|1861|0
units.english: Gather data
units.italian: Raccogli dati

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|description|1862|0
units.english: Board the Remnant satellite in orbit around <system> to learn more about the odd creatures around here.
units.italian: Abborda il satellite dei Remnant in orbita attorno a <system> per saperne di più sulle strane creature di questa zona.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|blocked|1865|0
units.english: Right as you touch down, you notice a message coming in from Dusk. "<first>, we will need at least a free bunk for the mission we are preparing."
units.italian: Appena atterri, noti un messaggio in arrivo da Dusk. "<first>, ci servirà almeno una cuccetta libera per la missione che stiamo preparando."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|By the time you land, the Remnant are already discussing their analysis of the data recorded and transmitted by your ship. When they notice you, they abandon their current conversation and move closer to speak with you in person.|1870|0
units.english: By the time you land, the Remnant are already discussing their analysis of the data recorded and transmitted by your ship. When they notice you, they abandon their current conversation and move closer to speak with you in person.
units.italian: Quando atterri, i Remnant stanno già discutendo la loro analisi dei dati registrati e trasmessi dalla tua nave. Quando ti notano, abbandonano la conversazione in corso e si avvicinano per parlarti di persona.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	They listen carefully as you detail your journey: the Ghila ringworld, the one-way wormholes, the Chanai station, and the many oddities in each of these systems. From the questions they ask you, they seem to be particularly interested about the asteroid-looking creatures roaming this sector. By the time you've finished recounting the last events, almost an hour has passed.|1871|0
units.english: They listen carefully as you detail your journey: the Ghila ringworld, the one-way wormholes, the Chanai station, and the many oddities in each of these systems. From the questions they ask you, they seem to be particularly interested about the asteroid-looking creatures roaming this sector. By the time you've finished recounting the last events, almost an hour has passed.
units.italian: Ascoltano con attenzione mentre racconti il tuo viaggio: il mondo ad anello di Ghila, i cunicoli a senso unico, la stazione di Chanai e le molte stranezze in ciascuno di questi sistemi. Dalle domande che ti fanno, sembrano particolarmente interessati alle creature dall'aspetto di asteroide che vagano in questo settore. Quando hai finito di raccontare gli ultimi eventi, è passata quasi un'ora.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Interesting," Dusk signs in response. "It is disappointing to hear that there is not a clear way out, but everything else here is intriguing - perhaps one of them is the key to finding a passage back. Our attempts at communicating with the Ember Waste have been unsuccessful; I fear we will have to be completely on our own this time."|1872|0
units.english: "Interesting," Dusk signs in response. "It is disappointing to hear that there is not a clear way out, but everything else here is intriguing - perhaps one of them is the key to finding a passage back. Our attempts at communicating with the Ember Waste have been unsuccessful; I fear we will have to be completely on our own this time."
units.italian: "Interessante," accenna Dusk in risposta. "È deludente sentire che non c'è una via d'uscita chiara, ma tutto il resto qui è intrigante; forse uno di questi elementi è la chiave per trovare un passaggio di ritorno. I nostri tentativi di comunicare con la Distesa di Braci non hanno avuto successo; temo che questa volta dovremo essere completamente soli."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Have you identified anything of note here?"|1874|0
units.english: "Have you identified anything of note here?"
units.italian: "Avete identificato qualcosa di rilevante qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Do you have a plan?"|1875|0
units.english: "Do you have a plan?"
units.italian: "Avete un piano?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Did you find out what this place is?"|1877|0
units.english: "Did you find out what this place is?"
units.italian: "Avete scoperto che cos'è questo posto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Unfortunately, you seem to have learned a lot more than we did staying here in Patir. We do not have enough information to say anything beyond that we are not in the Milky Way anymore. We were able to re-enter the settlement and access the computers that control the structure, but unfortunately a lot of them are malfunctioning or broken. From what we were able to gather, they seem to be entirely unaware of what has happened.|1878|0
units.english: "Unfortunately, you seem to have learned a lot more than we did staying here in Patir. We do not have enough information to say anything beyond that we are not in the Milky Way anymore. We were able to re-enter the settlement and access the computers that control the structure, but unfortunately a lot of them are malfunctioning or broken. From what we were able to gather, they seem to be entirely unaware of what has happened.
units.italian: "Purtroppo sembra che tu abbia imparato molto più di noi restando qui a Patir. Non abbiamo abbastanza informazioni per dire altro se non che non siamo più nella Via Lattea. Siamo riusciti a rientrare nell'insediamento e ad accedere ai computer che controllano la struttura, ma purtroppo molti sono malfunzionanti o rotti. Da quello che siamo riusciti a raccogliere, sembrano del tutto ignari di ciò che è successo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"For now, only vague ideas. I was hoping we could determine a clear, identifiable origin of our accidental jump, but we have nothing of that sort for now. While you were away, we were able to re-enter the settlement and access the computers that control the structure, but unfortunately a lot of them are malfunctioning or broken. From what we were able to gather, they seem to be entirely unaware of what has happened.|1882|0
units.english: "For now, only vague ideas. I was hoping we could determine a clear, identifiable origin of our accidental jump, but we have nothing of that sort for now. While you were away, we were able to re-enter the settlement and access the computers that control the structure, but unfortunately a lot of them are malfunctioning or broken. From what we were able to gather, they seem to be entirely unaware of what has happened.
units.italian: "Per ora solo idee vaghe. Speravo che potessimo determinare un'origine chiara e identificabile del nostro salto accidentale, ma per ora non abbiamo nulla del genere. Mentre eri via, siamo riusciti a rientrare nell'insediamento e ad accedere ai computer che controllano la struttura, ma purtroppo molti sono malfunzionanti o rotti. Da quello che siamo riusciti a raccogliere, sembrano del tutto ignari di ciò che è successo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"The time spent inside the lab was more productive. After a few days, one of the creatures you have encountered jumped in - and a few minutes after, every Fetri'sei around us went dormant. They stopped their engines, ceased mining and just drifted without any sign of life. But as soon as the creature left the system, they returned to their normal activities as if nothing happened.|1884|0
units.english: "The time spent inside the lab was more productive. After a few days, one of the creatures you have encountered jumped in - and a few minutes after, every Fetri'sei around us went dormant. They stopped their engines, ceased mining and just drifted without any sign of life. But as soon as the creature left the system, they returned to their normal activities as if nothing happened.
units.italian: "Il tempo passato dentro il laboratorio è stato più produttivo. Dopo qualche giorno, una delle creature che hai incontrato è saltata dentro, e pochi minuti dopo ogni Fetri'sei attorno a noi è andato in dormienza. Hanno fermato i motori, smesso di estrarre e si sono limitati a vagare senza alcun segno di vita. Ma appena la creatura ha lasciato il sistema, sono tornati alle loro attività normali come se nulla fosse.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Going forward, we need to determine a list of possible causes for the event that brought us here, and investigate the most likely one. If we dock to the satellite we launched at the beginning of this mission and recover everything it recorded during the encounter, it could help us understand them better than we can from the ground.|1885|0
units.english: "Going forward, we need to determine a list of possible causes for the event that brought us here, and investigate the most likely one. If we dock to the satellite we launched at the beginning of this mission and recover everything it recorded during the encounter, it could help us understand them better than we can from the ground.
units.italian: "Andando avanti, dobbiamo determinare una lista di possibili cause dell'evento che ci ha portati qui e indagare la più probabile. Se ci agganciamo al satellite che abbiamo lanciato all'inizio di questa missione e recuperiamo tutto ciò che ha registrato durante l'incontro, potrebbe aiutarci a capirli meglio di quanto possiamo fare da terra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Besides that, we have also confirmed you no longer need to cloak when landing here; when you approach the lab with your ship, you are too far away from the settlement for the Ka'sei to understand that you are coming to visit it, as long as we explore the Builder base only when your spaceship isn't landed here. It should save you some fuel, hopefully. Any questions?"|1886|0
units.english: "Besides that, we have also confirmed you no longer need to cloak when landing here; when you approach the lab with your ship, you are too far away from the settlement for the Ka'sei to understand that you are coming to visit it, as long as we explore the Builder base only when your spaceship isn't landed here. It should save you some fuel, hopefully. Any questions?"
units.italian: "Inoltre, abbiamo anche confermato che non hai più bisogno di occultarti quando atterri qui; quando ti avvicini al laboratorio con la nave, sei troppo lontano dall'insediamento perché i Ka'sei capiscano che vieni a visitarlo, a patto che esploriamo la base dei Costruttori solo quando la tua nave non è atterrata qui. Dovrebbe farti risparmiare un po' di carburante, speriamo. Domande?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"No, I am ready to go."|1888|0
units.english: "No, I am ready to go."
units.italian: "No, sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"I think it would be quicker if we went straight to the station."|1890|0
units.english: "I think it would be quicker if we went straight to the station."
units.italian: "Credo che sarebbe più rapido andare dritti alla stazione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"Maybe, but that might be an unnecessary risk. First things first, <first>; there is no need to rush anything."|1891|0
units.english: "Maybe, but that might be an unnecessary risk. First things first, <first>; there is no need to rush anything."
units.italian: "Forse, ma potrebbe essere un rischio inutile. Prima le cose importanti, <first>; non c'è bisogno di correre."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|dialog|1899|0
units.english: From the open cargo bay, you watch as the satellite moves up inside your ship. You split up tasks between yourself and Dusk, keeping the satellite stabilized while he downloads the data. In a few minutes the process is over, and you can return the probe to its original mission.
units.italian: Dal vano di carico aperto, guardi il satellite salire dentro la nave. Vi dividete i compiti con Dusk, mantenendo il satellite stabilizzato mentre lui scarica i dati. In pochi minuti la procedura è finita, e puoi restituire la sonda alla sua missione originale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|Walking down your ship's stairway, Dusk thanks you again for your help. You hand him a datapad with the information gathered, as well as the equipment he brought with him to pick up the satellite's signal.|1905|0
units.english: Walking down your ship's stairway, Dusk thanks you again for your help. You hand him a datapad with the information gathered, as well as the equipment he brought with him to pick up the satellite's signal.
units.italian: Scendendo dalla scaletta della nave, Dusk ti ringrazia di nuovo per il tuo aiuto. Gli consegni un tablet con le informazioni raccolte, oltre all'attrezzatura che aveva portato con sé per captare il segnale del satellite.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10|	"I will join the rest of the team to start analysis," he signs in response. "We have a lot of data to examine, and not much time. Meet us in the lab in a few hours."|1906|0
units.english: "I will join the rest of the team to start analysis," he signs in response. "We have a lot of data to examine, and not much time. Meet us in the lab in a few hours."
units.italian: "Mi unirò al resto della squadra per iniziare l'analisi," accenna in risposta. "Abbiamo molti dati da esaminare, e non molto tempo. Ci vediamo nel laboratorio tra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|name|1923|0
units.english: Gather more data
units.italian: Raccogli altri dati

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|description|1924|0
units.english: Visit <waypoints>'s neutron star to study the mysterious creatures living around it.
units.italian: Visita la stella di neutroni di <waypoints> per studiare le misteriose creature che vivono attorno a essa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|Compared to its cleanliness at the start of the mission, the lab is in chaos: pieces of Remnant devices and Builder objects lie all over the floor and tables, leaving only a small footpath to connect the various sections. The team is gathered on the opposite end of the building, discussing the results of the mission with disappointed expressions.|1931|0
units.english: Compared to its cleanliness at the start of the mission, the lab is in chaos: pieces of Remnant devices and Builder objects lie all over the floor and tables, leaving only a small footpath to connect the various sections. The team is gathered on the opposite end of the building, discussing the results of the mission with disappointed expressions.
units.italian: Rispetto alla pulizia dell'inizio della missione, il laboratorio è nel caos: pezzi di dispositivi Remnant e oggetti dei Costruttori giacciono ovunque sul pavimento e sui tavoli, lasciando solo uno stretto passaggio per collegare le varie sezioni. La squadra è riunita all'estremità opposta dell'edificio, a discutere i risultati della missione con espressioni deluse.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"Bad news, Captain," Dusk says, turning to you. "Both our ground scanners and the orbiting satellite recorded the same amount of information about these beings: nothing at all. For the entire duration of the encounter, the only information gathered on them was their position. Something in their construction makes it impossible to infer anything about their internal structure.|1932|0
units.english: "Bad news, Captain," Dusk says, turning to you. "Both our ground scanners and the orbiting satellite recorded the same amount of information about these beings: nothing at all. For the entire duration of the encounter, the only information gathered on them was their position. Something in their construction makes it impossible to infer anything about their internal structure.
units.italian: "Cattive notizie, capitano," dice Dusk, voltandosi verso di te. "Sia i nostri scanner a terra sia il satellite in orbita hanno registrato la stessa quantità di informazioni su questi esseri: nessuna. Per tutta la durata dell'incontro, l'unica informazione raccolta su di loro è stata la loro posizione. Qualcosa nella loro costruzione rende impossibile dedurre qualsiasi cosa sulla loro struttura interna.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"If we do not find a way to learn more about them, we have few options left, and all rather dangerous."|1933|0
units.english: "If we do not find a way to learn more about them, we have few options left, and all rather dangerous."
units.italian: "Se non troviamo un modo per saperne di più su di loro, ci restano poche opzioni, e tutte piuttosto pericolose."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"Do you have any ideas?"|1935|0
units.english: "Do you have any ideas?"
units.italian: "Hai qualche idea?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"Well, there's still other places we could visit."|1936|0
units.english: "Well, there's still other places we could visit."
units.italian: "Beh, ci sono ancora altri posti che potremmo visitare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"We are evaluating our options. The Ghila ringworld is too large and distant; the risk of an accident overshadows the possibility of discovering anything useful. On the other hand, the station in Chanai is very close to where Patir is now - a couple jumps, both ways.|1937|0
units.english: "We are evaluating our options. The Ghila ringworld is too large and distant; the risk of an accident overshadows the possibility of discovering anything useful. On the other hand, the station in Chanai is very close to where Patir is now - a couple jumps, both ways.
units.italian: "Stiamo valutando le nostre opzioni. Il mondo ad anello di Ghila è troppo grande e lontano; il rischio di un incidente offusca la possibilità di scoprire qualcosa di utile. D'altra parte, la stazione di Chanai è molto vicina a dove si trova ora Patir: un paio di salti, andata e ritorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"However, there are downsides. Exploring it would mean exposing ourselves to any device or trap inside the station; our explorations of Builder stations back in the Graveyard have had body counts." Dusk stops for a few seconds, immersed into his thoughts. "For now, boarding the station is too much of a risk."|1938|0
units.english: "However, there are downsides. Exploring it would mean exposing ourselves to any device or trap inside the station; our explorations of Builder stations back in the Graveyard have had body counts." Dusk stops for a few seconds, immersed into his thoughts. "For now, boarding the station is too much of a risk."
units.italian: "Tuttavia ci sono degli svantaggi. Esplorarla significherebbe esporci a qualsiasi dispositivo o trappola dentro la stazione; le nostre esplorazioni delle stazioni dei Costruttori nel Cimitero hanno avuto vittime." Dusk si ferma qualche secondo, immerso nei suoi pensieri. "Per ora, abbordare la stazione è un rischio troppo grande."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	After searching a large bag on the ground, one of the Remnant brings out another holographic projector. She tinkers with it for a bit until it focuses on the neutron star you visited earlier, Lathia. "This is our safest bet at learning more about these creatures," she signs. "According to your data, this system has by far the highest number and diversity of them. If you pass through the system while cloaked and use our sensors, you may be able to obtain enough information without putting yourself at risk."|1939|0
units.english: After searching a large bag on the ground, one of the Remnant brings out another holographic projector. She tinkers with it for a bit until it focuses on the neutron star you visited earlier, Lathia. "This is our safest bet at learning more about these creatures," she signs. "According to your data, this system has by far the highest number and diversity of them. If you pass through the system while cloaked and use our sensors, you may be able to obtain enough information without putting yourself at risk."
units.italian: Dopo aver frugato in una grande borsa a terra, uno dei Remnant tira fuori un altro proiettore olografico. Lo armeggia un po' finché non si concentra sulla stella di neutroni che hai visitato prima, Lathia. "Questa è la nostra scommessa più sicura per saperne di più su queste creature," accenna. "Secondo i tuoi dati, questo sistema ha di gran lunga il maggior numero e la maggior varietà di esse. Se attraversi il sistema occultato e usi i nostri sensori, potresti riuscire a ottenere abbastanza informazioni senza metterti in pericolo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"If those scanners did not work on them here, why would it be different in Lathia?"|1941|0
units.english: "If those scanners did not work on them here, why would it be different in Lathia?"
units.italian: "Se quegli scanner non hanno funzionato su di loro qui, perché dovrebbe essere diverso a Lathia?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"What if I run out of fuel?"|1943|0
units.english: "What if I run out of fuel?"
units.italian: "E se finisco il carburante?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"What happens if this fails as well?"|1945|0
units.english: "What happens if this fails as well?"
units.italian: "Che succede se fallisce anche questo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"That is a distinct possibility," Dusk replies, "but we must investigate every avenue before we resort to risking personnel."|1946|0
units.english: "That is a distinct possibility," Dusk replies, "but we must investigate every avenue before we resort to risking personnel."
units.italian: "È una possibilità concreta," risponde Dusk, "ma dobbiamo indagare ogni via prima di ricorrere a rischiare del personale."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"It will only take a few minutes to determine whether our equipment can see through the exterior of these beings," Dusk replies. "I suggest filling your fuel tanks near Patir before leaving."|1950|0
units.english: "It will only take a few minutes to determine whether our equipment can see through the exterior of these beings," Dusk replies. "I suggest filling your fuel tanks near Patir before leaving."
units.italian: "Ci vorranno solo pochi minuti per determinare se la nostra attrezzatura riesce a vedere attraverso l'esterno di questi esseri," risponde Dusk. "Ti suggerisco di riempire i serbatoi vicino a Patir prima di partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	"It is a shot in the dark," Dusk replies. "Being able to scan even just one of these beings would be a great leap forward - perhaps one without external shielding, or damaged in such a way that permits us to analyze them."|1953|0
units.english: "It is a shot in the dark," Dusk replies. "Being able to scan even just one of these beings would be a great leap forward - perhaps one without external shielding, or damaged in such a way that permits us to analyze them."
units.italian: "È un tiro al buio," risponde Dusk. "Riuscire a scansionare anche solo uno di questi esseri sarebbe un grande passo avanti: forse uno senza schermatura esterna, o danneggiato in modo da permetterci di analizzarlo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|	The Remnant begin to mount and wire all the scanning equipment on the <ship>. After a few hours, you're ready to take off once again.|1955|0
units.english: The Remnant begin to mount and wire all the scanning equipment on the <ship>. After a few hours, you're ready to take off once again.
units.italian: I Remnant cominciano a montare e collegare tutta l'attrezzatura di scansione sulla <ship>. Dopo qualche ora, siete pronti a decollare di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|A dull hum from below the cockpit signals that the scanners have activated. You take the opportunity to observe the mesmerizing colors of the neutron star, beautiful and terrifying at the same time. After a few minutes, a beeping sound alerts you that the scan is complete, and you can return to <system>.|1959|0
units.english: A dull hum from below the cockpit signals that the scanners have activated. You take the opportunity to observe the mesmerizing colors of the neutron star, beautiful and terrifying at the same time. After a few minutes, a beeping sound alerts you that the scan is complete, and you can return to <system>.
units.italian: Un cupo ronzio da sotto la cabina segnala che gli scanner si sono attivati. Cogli l'occasione per osservare i colori ipnotici della stella di neutroni, belli e terrificanti allo stesso tempo. Dopo qualche minuto, un segnale acustico ti avvisa che la scansione è completa, e puoi tornare su <system>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11|dialog|1961|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you haven't visited <waypoints> yet! Better depart and make sure you visit the system.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora visitato <waypoints>! Meglio partire e assicurarti di visitare il sistema.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|name|1977|0
units.english: The <system> station
units.italian: La stazione di <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|description|1978|0
units.english: Investigate the station in <system> for a way to return to the Milky Way with the five Remnant scientists.
units.italian: Indaga la stazione in <system> per trovare un modo di tornare nella Via Lattea con i cinque scienziati Remnant.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|blocked|1982|0
units.english: Right as you touch down, you notice a message coming in from Dusk. "<first>, we will need at least five free bunks for the mission we are preparing."
units.italian: Appena atterri, noti un messaggio in arrivo da Dusk. "<first>, ci serviranno almeno cinque cuccette libere per la missione che stiamo preparando."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|The Remnant are already standing outside the lab, waiting for your arrival. Dusk meets you in the cockpit right as you've finished safing your ship.|1987|0
units.english: The Remnant are already standing outside the lab, waiting for your arrival. Dusk meets you in the cockpit right as you've finished safing your ship.
units.italian: I Remnant sono già in piedi fuori dal laboratorio, in attesa del tuo arrivo. Dusk ti incontra in cabina appena hai finito di mettere in sicurezza la nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"It does not look promising, <first>. Just as with the satellite, nothing beyond basic orbital information was recorded by the scanners we gave you. Maybe we could understand something about these beings after in-depth analysis, but nothing that could help us in our search.|1988|0
units.english: "It does not look promising, <first>. Just as with the satellite, nothing beyond basic orbital information was recorded by the scanners we gave you. Maybe we could understand something about these beings after in-depth analysis, but nothing that could help us in our search.
units.italian: "Non sembra promettente, <first>. Proprio come con il satellite, gli scanner che ti abbiamo dato non hanno registrato nulla oltre alle informazioni orbitali di base. Forse potremmo capire qualcosa su questi esseri dopo un'analisi approfondita, ma niente che possa aiutarci nella nostra ricerca.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"One of the few discoveries we could make is the existence of a particular asteroid around Lathia - on an order of magnitude larger than the rest of the fleet, but still belonging to the same species. It appears to be completely still, unlike its kin, and does not show any external activity; this might make it fit for a surface expedition, but doing that on what appears to be a living being is nevertheless extremely dangerous.|1989|0
units.english: "One of the few discoveries we could make is the existence of a particular asteroid around Lathia - on an order of magnitude larger than the rest of the fleet, but still belonging to the same species. It appears to be completely still, unlike its kin, and does not show any external activity; this might make it fit for a surface expedition, but doing that on what appears to be a living being is nevertheless extremely dangerous.
units.italian: "Una delle poche scoperte che abbiamo potuto fare è l'esistenza di un particolare asteroide attorno a Lathia: di un ordine di grandezza più grande del resto della flotta, ma appartenente alla stessa specie. Sembra del tutto immobile, a differenza dei suoi simili, e non mostra alcuna attività esterna; questo potrebbe renderlo adatto a una spedizione di superficie, ma farlo su quello che sembra un essere vivente è comunque estremamente pericoloso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Still, our options are limited. I have mentioned previously the possibility of exploring the station in Chanai; it would definitely be risky, but it may be something we are unable to avoid if no safer alternative can be found. While you were away, however, part of the team developed a second mission plan. We came to the realization that if these beings can stop the Fetri'sei, there must be some sort of connection between them. If we could somehow intercept this link, it would let us study more than our sensors could, and perhaps even communicate with them."|1990|0
units.english: "Still, our options are limited. I have mentioned previously the possibility of exploring the station in Chanai; it would definitely be risky, but it may be something we are unable to avoid if no safer alternative can be found. While you were away, however, part of the team developed a second mission plan. We came to the realization that if these beings can stop the Fetri'sei, there must be some sort of connection between them. If we could somehow intercept this link, it would let us study more than our sensors could, and perhaps even communicate with them."
units.italian: "Eppure le nostre opzioni sono limitate. Ho già accennato alla possibilità di esplorare la stazione di Chanai; sarebbe di certo rischioso, ma potrebbe essere qualcosa che non possiamo evitare se non si trova un'alternativa più sicura. Mentre eri via, però, una parte della squadra ha sviluppato un secondo piano di missione.
