Ci siamo resi conto che, se questi esseri possono fermare i Fetri'sei, deve esserci una sorta di connessione tra loro. Se riuscissimo in qualche modo a intercettare questo legame, ci permetterebbe di studiare più di quanto possano i nostri sensori, e forse persino di comunicare con loro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"How do you propose to do that?"|1992|0
units.english: "How do you propose to do that?"
units.italian: "Come pensate di farlo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Can you do that from here?"|1994|0
units.english: "Can you do that from here?"
units.italian: "Potete farlo da qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Unfortunately, that goes far beyond our area of expertise," Dusk replies, "if it is even possible in the first place. It would be more feasible to connect to this signal physically. We know that the Ka'sei will remain dormant for the entire time the being remains in this system. If the <ship> was close enough to a Fetri'sei when the being arrives, we would have around half an hour to access its internal computer and connect to its communication system. However, this exposes us to significant danger if the being leaves the system prematurely, or if accessing the Fetri'sei reactivates it.|1995|0
units.english: "Unfortunately, that goes far beyond our area of expertise," Dusk replies, "if it is even possible in the first place. It would be more feasible to connect to this signal physically. We know that the Ka'sei will remain dormant for the entire time the being remains in this system. If the <ship> was close enough to a Fetri'sei when the being arrives, we would have around half an hour to access its internal computer and connect to its communication system. However, this exposes us to significant danger if the being leaves the system prematurely, or if accessing the Fetri'sei reactivates it.
units.italian: "Purtroppo questo va ben oltre le nostre competenze," risponde Dusk, "ammesso che sia possibile in primo luogo. Sarebbe più fattibile collegarsi a questo segnale fisicamente. Sappiamo che i Ka'sei resteranno in dormienza per tutto il tempo in cui l'essere resta in questo sistema. Se la <ship> fosse abbastanza vicina a un Fetri'sei quando l'essere arriva, avremmo circa mezz'ora per accedere al suo computer interno e collegarci al suo sistema di comunicazione. Tuttavia questo ci espone a un pericolo considerevole se l'essere lascia il sistema in anticipo, o se accedere al Fetri'sei lo riattiva.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"In our opinion," Dusk replies, "connecting to it physically seems like the most feasible option we have. We know that the Ka'sei will remain dormant for the entire time the being remains in this system. If the <ship> was close enough to a Fetri'sei when the being arrives, we would have around half an hour to access its internal computer and connect to its communication system. However, this exposes us to significant danger if the being leaves the system prematurely, or if accessing the Fetri'sei reactivates it.|1999|0
units.english: "In our opinion," Dusk replies, "connecting to it physically seems like the most feasible option we have. We know that the Ka'sei will remain dormant for the entire time the being remains in this system. If the <ship> was close enough to a Fetri'sei when the being arrives, we would have around half an hour to access its internal computer and connect to its communication system. However, this exposes us to significant danger if the being leaves the system prematurely, or if accessing the Fetri'sei reactivates it.
units.italian: "A nostro parere," risponde Dusk, "collegarci fisicamente sembra l'opzione più fattibile che abbiamo. Sappiamo che i Ka'sei resteranno in dormienza per tutto il tempo in cui l'essere resta in questo sistema. Se la <ship> fosse abbastanza vicina a un Fetri'sei quando l'essere arriva, avremmo circa mezz'ora per accedere al suo computer interno e collegarci al suo sistema di comunicazione. Tuttavia questo ci espone a un pericolo considerevole se l'essere lascia il sistema in anticipo, o se accedere al Fetri'sei lo riattiva.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Even still, we believe this approach is safer than exploring Chanai. You have seen what happened the first time we tried to explore Patir; the structures in this part of space are guarded by lethal force. In contrast, if our new plan goes south, we will at least be able to quickly return to the lab. Of course, it may be that neither of these options will help us escape," he adds, somewhat frustrated. "The team is at a standstill, with both options having more cons than pros. The choice is yours, Captain."|2001|0
units.english: "Even still, we believe this approach is safer than exploring Chanai. You have seen what happened the first time we tried to explore Patir; the structures in this part of space are guarded by lethal force. In contrast, if our new plan goes south, we will at least be able to quickly return to the lab. Of course, it may be that neither of these options will help us escape," he adds, somewhat frustrated. "The team is at a standstill, with both options having more cons than pros. The choice is yours, Captain."
units.italian: "Anche così, crediamo che questo approccio sia più sicuro che esplorare Chanai. Hai visto cosa è successo la prima volta che abbiamo provato a esplorare Patir; le strutture in questa parte dello spazio sono sorvegliate da una forza letale. Al contrario, se il nostro nuovo piano va storto, potremo almeno tornare rapidamente al laboratorio. Naturalmente può darsi che nessuna delle due opzioni ci aiuti a fuggire," aggiunge, un po' frustrato. "La squadra è in stallo, entrambe le opzioni hanno più contro che pro. La scelta è tua, capitano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Chanai seems to be a better option."|2003|0
units.english: "Chanai seems to be a better option."
units.italian: "Chanai sembra l'opzione migliore."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"The new plan feels more viable to me."|2005|0
units.english: "The new plan feels more viable to me."
units.italian: "Il nuovo piano mi sembra più praticabile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Which option do you prefer?"|2007|0
units.english: "Which option do you prefer?"
units.italian: "Quale opzione preferisci?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"I do not want to influence you in making this choice, <first>. Both options are more dangerous than I am comfortable with, but there is little we can do about that now. It is up to you now."|2008|0
units.english: "I do not want to influence you in making this choice, <first>. Both options are more dangerous than I am comfortable with, but there is little we can do about that now. It is up to you now."
units.italian: "Non voglio influenzarti in questa scelta, <first>. Entrambe le opzioni sono più pericolose di quanto mi piaccia, ma ormai possiamo fare poco al riguardo. Adesso tocca a te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Chanai seems to be a better option."|2010|0
units.english: "Chanai seems to be a better option."
units.italian: "Chanai sembra l'opzione migliore."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"The new plan feels more viable to me."|2012|0
units.english: "The new plan feels more viable to me."
units.italian: "Il nuovo piano mi sembra più praticabile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Alright then. The first step will be deploying some satellites in the nearby systems. To maximize the amount of time we have, we will need preemptive warning on the arrival of these beings. Reusing the sensors we put on your ship and coupling them with the spare parts we have in storage should be enough to assemble a few probes; meet us in the lab in a few hours and we will be ready."|2014|0
units.english: "Alright then. The first step will be deploying some satellites in the nearby systems. To maximize the amount of time we have, we will need preemptive warning on the arrival of these beings. Reusing the sensors we put on your ship and coupling them with the spare parts we have in storage should be enough to assemble a few probes; meet us in the lab in a few hours and we will be ready."
units.italian: "Va bene allora. Il primo passo sarà schierare alcuni satelliti nei sistemi vicini. Per massimizzare il tempo a disposizione, ci servirà un preavviso sull'arrivo di questi esseri. Riutilizzando i sensori che abbiamo messo sulla tua nave e accoppiandoli ai pezzi di ricambio che abbiamo in magazzino dovremmo riuscire ad assemblare qualche sonda; incontraci nel laboratorio tra qualche ora e saremo pronti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Okay then. Most of the equipment we are going to need is the same equipment we used for Patir, so we will be ready to depart in just half an hour." After helping them pack the last few items, you take off and set the course to the new destination: <system>.|2018|0
units.english: "Okay then. Most of the equipment we are going to need is the same equipment we used for Patir, so we will be ready to depart in just half an hour." After helping them pack the last few items, you take off and set the course to the new destination: <system>.
units.italian: "Va bene allora. La maggior parte dell'attrezzatura che ci servirà è la stessa che abbiamo usato per Patir, quindi saremo pronti a partire in appena mezz'ora." Dopo averli aiutati a chiudere gli ultimi oggetti, decolli e imposti la rotta per la nuova destinazione: <system>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|The gargantuan station still sits far away from you, appearing as just a dot in the distance. A long range scan of the structure reveals enough of it for an initial assessment; after a quick discussion, the Remnant pick out an approach vector for you.|2022|0
units.english: The gargantuan station still sits far away from you, appearing as just a dot in the distance. A long range scan of the structure reveals enough of it for an initial assessment; after a quick discussion, the Remnant pick out an approach vector for you.
units.italian: La stazione gargantuesca è ancora lontana da te, e appare solo come un punto in lontananza. Una scansione a lungo raggio della struttura ne rivela abbastanza per una valutazione iniziale; dopo una rapida discussione, i Remnant scelgono per te un vettore di avvicinamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|The external coating of the structure appears pristine and untouched, much like a new spaceship. Orbiting far above a black hole, next to no asteroid moves in an orbit capable of posing a threat to it. Next to you, one of the Remnant researchers points a bulky scanner toward the station; after a few minutes, she indicates a place from which the structure can be accessed.|2027|0
units.english: The external coating of the structure appears pristine and untouched, much like a new spaceship. Orbiting far above a black hole, next to no asteroid moves in an orbit capable of posing a threat to it. Next to you, one of the Remnant researchers points a bulky scanner toward the station; after a few minutes, she indicates a place from which the structure can be accessed.
units.italian: Il rivestimento esterno della struttura appare intatto e immacolato, molto simile a quello di una nave nuova. In orbita molto sopra un buco nero, quasi nessun asteroide si muove su un'orbita capace di rappresentare una minaccia. Accanto a te, una delle ricercatrici Remnant punta uno scanner ingombrante verso la stazione; dopo qualche minuto, indica un punto da cui è possibile accedere alla struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"This is going to be a little different compared to our previous expeditions in Patir, <first>," Dusk remarks while walking toward the ship's airlock. "We cannot even fathom who built this place, let alone understand how to access their systems and control their doors. We will have to use a little more brute force here to move inside the complex." As he says this, he gestures towards the blowtorch-like piece of equipment on his back.|2028|0
units.english: "This is going to be a little different compared to our previous expeditions in Patir, <first>," Dusk remarks while walking toward the ship's airlock. "We cannot even fathom who built this place, let alone understand how to access their systems and control their doors. We will have to use a little more brute force here to move inside the complex." As he says this, he gestures towards the blowtorch-like piece of equipment on his back.
units.italian: "Questa sarà un po' diversa dalle nostre precedenti spedizioni a Patir, <first>," osserva Dusk mentre cammina verso la camera di equilibrio della nave. "Non possiamo nemmeno immaginare chi abbia costruito questo posto, figuriamoci capire come accedere ai loro sistemi e controllare le loro porte. Qui dovremo usare un po' più di forza bruta per muoverci dentro il complesso." Mentre lo dice, accenna all'attrezzo simile a una fiamma ossidrica che porta sulla schiena.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	With the <ship> stationed about a meter away from the structure, the entire team slowly moves out of the airlock with you. Still tethered to the ship for safety, the Remnant swiftly prepare the boarding equipment for the mission, attaching it to the platform in a matter of minutes. "In order to access this module, we are about to melt through its hull," Dusk announces. "Are you ready?"|2029|0
units.english: With the <ship> stationed about a meter away from the structure, the entire team slowly moves out of the airlock with you. Still tethered to the ship for safety, the Remnant swiftly prepare the boarding equipment for the mission, attaching it to the platform in a matter of minutes. "In order to access this module, we are about to melt through its hull," Dusk announces. "Are you ready?"
units.italian: Con la <ship> ferma a circa un metro dalla struttura, l'intera squadra esce lentamente dalla camera di equilibrio insieme a te. Ancora legati alla nave per sicurezza, i Remnant preparano in fretta l'attrezzatura di abbordaggio per la missione, fissandola alla piattaforma in pochi minuti. "Per accedere a questo modulo, stiamo per fondere lo scafo," annuncia Dusk. "Sei pronto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Of course."|2031|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Are you sure this is safe?"|2033|0
units.english: "Are you sure this is safe?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che sia sicuro?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"As far as we can tell. The module is fully depressurized, and it seems to be completely inert from our scans - there are always uncertainties, of course, but this is the most easily accessible spot we could identify in the little time we had."|2034|0
units.english: "As far as we can tell. The module is fully depressurized, and it seems to be completely inert from our scans - there are always uncertainties, of course, but this is the most easily accessible spot we could identify in the little time we had."
units.italian: "Per quanto possiamo dire. Il modulo è completamente depressurizzato, e dalle nostre scansioni sembra del tutto inerte; ci sono sempre incertezze, naturalmente, ma questo è il punto più facilmente accessibile che siamo riusciti a identificare nel poco tempo a disposizione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	A bright flash begins the boarding operations; one of the Remnant, handling the same torch you had seen earlier, slowly cuts a roughly circular hole into the module's whipple shield until it comes off handily. Moving the debris away, the process is then soon repeated with the next layer and again with one right after; the strong vibrations it imparts into the rest of the structure give you a clear hint about the power of this device. Eventually, the innermost layer is removed as well, and you follow the rest of the team inside the alien platform.|2036|0
units.english: A bright flash begins the boarding operations; one of the Remnant, handling the same torch you had seen earlier, slowly cuts a roughly circular hole into the module's whipple shield until it comes off handily. Moving the debris away, the process is then soon repeated with the next layer and again with one right after; the strong vibrations it imparts into the rest of the structure give you a clear hint about the power of this device. Eventually, the innermost layer is removed as well, and you follow the rest of the team inside the alien platform.
units.italian: Un lampo luminoso dà inizio alle operazioni di abbordaggio; uno dei Remnant, maneggiando la stessa torcia che avevi visto prima, taglia lentamente un foro grossomodo circolare nello scudo whipple del modulo finché non si stacca con facilità. Spostati i detriti, la procedura viene presto ripetuta con lo strato successivo e poi con quello subito dopo; le forti vibrazioni che trasmette al resto della struttura ti danno un'idea chiara della potenza di questo dispositivo. Alla fine viene rimosso anche lo strato più interno, e segui il resto della squadra dentro la piattaforma aliena.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Disconnecting from the tether to move further into the opening, you immediately notice the module seems to have some peculiarities. Despite the microgravity in it, no handrails can be found near you, making movement very difficult; as you search for some inside with your flashlight, however, your attention is caught by something more bizarre: an ominous, featureless blob, hovering midair a few meters away from you.|2037|0
units.english: Disconnecting from the tether to move further into the opening, you immediately notice the module seems to have some peculiarities. Despite the microgravity in it, no handrails can be found near you, making movement very difficult; as you search for some inside with your flashlight, however, your attention is caught by something more bizarre: an ominous, featureless blob, hovering midair a few meters away from you.
units.italian: Staccandoti dalla fune per addentrarti nell'apertura, noti subito che il modulo ha alcune particolarità. Nonostante la microgravità al suo interno, non ci sono corrimano vicino a te, il che rende il movimento molto difficile; mentre ne cerchi qualcuno con la torcia, però, la tua attenzione viene catturata da qualcosa di più bizzarro: una massa informe e inquietante, sospesa a mezz'aria a qualche metro da te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The object's surface, only interrupted by a few cyclical ripples, reflects and eerily distorts everything around the room. A complete silence has fallen over the room, as everyone seems to evaluate the situation. After a few seconds, Dusk and two Remnant start moving toward the phenomenon carrying a device in their hands.|2038|0
units.english: The object's surface, only interrupted by a few cyclical ripples, reflects and eerily distorts everything around the room. A complete silence has fallen over the room, as everyone seems to evaluate the situation. After a few seconds, Dusk and two Remnant start moving toward the phenomenon carrying a device in their hands.
units.italian: La superficie dell'oggetto, interrotta solo da qualche increspatura ciclica, riflette e distorce in modo inquietante tutto ciò che è attorno alla stanza. Un silenzio completo è calato sulla stanza, mentre tutti sembrano valutare la situazione. Dopo qualche secondo, Dusk e due Remnant cominciano a muoversi verso il fenomeno portando un dispositivo tra le mani.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"What is that thing?"|2040|0
units.english: "What is that thing?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è quella cosa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Wait and see what happens.)|2042|0
units.english: (Wait and see what happens.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi che succede.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Raise my blaster.)|2044|0
units.english: (Raise my blaster.)
units.italian: (Alzo il blaster.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Noticing your reaction, Dusk gestures you to stop. "Calm down, Captain," he signs, "a handgun would be of little use in this situation." Keeping an eye on the data the other scientists are gathering, he continues. "We seem to have entered the station from one of the fuel tanks. That sphere over there is made of some kind of propellant, though our instruments have some difficulties determining its exact composition.|2045|0
units.english: Noticing your reaction, Dusk gestures you to stop. "Calm down, Captain," he signs, "a handgun would be of little use in this situation." Keeping an eye on the data the other scientists are gathering, he continues. "We seem to have entered the station from one of the fuel tanks. That sphere over there is made of some kind of propellant, though our instruments have some difficulties determining its exact composition.
units.italian: Notando la tua reazione, Dusk ti fa cenno di fermarti. "Calmati, capitano," accenna, "una pistola sarebbe di poco uso in questa situazione." Tenendo d'occhio i dati che gli altri scienziati stanno raccogliendo, continua. "Sembra che siamo entrati nella stazione da uno dei serbatoi di carburante. Quella sfera è fatta di una qualche specie di propellente, anche se i nostri strumenti hanno qualche difficoltà a determinarne la composizione esatta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Interesting," Dusk states, as if immersed in his thoughts. After checking that the device has started gathering data, he continues. "We seem to have entered the station from one of the fuel tanks. That sphere over there is made of some kind of propellant, though our instruments have some difficulties determining its exact composition. It must have an incredibly low vapor pressure to remain liquid in this near vacuum.|2049|0
units.english: "Interesting," Dusk states, as if immersed in his thoughts. After checking that the device has started gathering data, he continues. "We seem to have entered the station from one of the fuel tanks. That sphere over there is made of some kind of propellant, though our instruments have some difficulties determining its exact composition. It must have an incredibly low vapor pressure to remain liquid in this near vacuum.
units.italian: "Interessante," afferma Dusk, come immerso nei suoi pensieri. Dopo aver controllato che il dispositivo abbia iniziato a raccogliere dati, continua. "Sembra che siamo entrati nella stazione da uno dei serbatoi di carburante. Quella sfera è fatta di una qualche specie di propellente, anche se i nostri strumenti hanno qualche difficoltà a determinarne la composizione esatta. Deve avere una pressione di vapore incredibilmente bassa per restare liquida in questo quasi vuoto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"All I can say for certain is that it is not the hyperdrive fuel we use - liquid deuterium would have boiled off long ago. Luckily, we don't need to know what it is; there should be enough space to pass through without touching it." Scouting around the tank for a passage, the team quickly identifies a maintenance hatch, hopefully leading to the crew section, and starts creating another hole to pass through. The whole process is slightly quicker than the first was, but by the time they're done more than a third of the oxygen reserves in your suit are gone.|2051|0
units.english: "All I can say for certain is that it is not the hyperdrive fuel we use - liquid deuterium would have boiled off long ago. Luckily, we don't need to know what it is; there should be enough space to pass through without touching it." Scouting around the tank for a passage, the team quickly identifies a maintenance hatch, hopefully leading to the crew section, and starts creating another hole to pass through. The whole process is slightly quicker than the first was, but by the time they're done more than a third of the oxygen reserves in your suit are gone.
units.italian: "Tutto ciò che posso dire con certezza è che non è il carburante per iperguida che usiamo noi; il deuterio liquido sarebbe evaporato da tempo. Per fortuna non abbiamo bisogno di sapere che cos'è; dovrebbe esserci spazio sufficiente per passare senza toccarlo." Esplorando il serbatoio in cerca di un passaggio, la squadra individua rapidamente un portello di manutenzione, che sperano porti alla sezione dell'equipaggio, e comincia a creare un altro foro per passare. L'intera procedura è un po' più rapida della prima, ma quando hanno finito è andato via più di un terzo delle riserve di ossigeno della tua tuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Moving through the opening, you reach a long, cylindrical corridor, just as dark as the room you just came from. Based on the many handles and scaffolding attached to the surfaces around you, you guess this part of the station used to be inhabited. After following the group through the tunnel for a few minutes, you reach an intersection: the corridor splits into two lateral openings, each of them seemingly as small and endless as the one you're in.|2052|0
units.english: Moving through the opening, you reach a long, cylindrical corridor, just as dark as the room you just came from. Based on the many handles and scaffolding attached to the surfaces around you, you guess this part of the station used to be inhabited. After following the group through the tunnel for a few minutes, you reach an intersection: the corridor splits into two lateral openings, each of them seemingly as small and endless as the one you're in.
units.italian: Attraversando l'apertura, raggiungi un lungo corridoio cilindrico, oscuro quanto la stanza da cui vieni. Basandoti sui molti mancorrenti e sulle impalcature fissate alle superfici attorno a te, supponi che questa parte della stazione fosse abitata. Dopo aver seguito il gruppo nel tunnel per qualche minuto, raggiungete un incrocio: il corridoio si divide in due aperture laterali, ognuna apparentemente piccola e infinita come quella in cui ti trovi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"We only have a limited amount of time for this expedition, <first>. You have seen us work a few times now; can you explore the two tunnels on your own and reach us when you have completed it?" Dusk asks. "We will remain in radio contact the entire time."|2053|0
units.english: "We only have a limited amount of time for this expedition, <first>. You have seen us work a few times now; can you explore the two tunnels on your own and reach us when you have completed it?" Dusk asks. "We will remain in radio contact the entire time."
units.italian: "Abbiamo solo una quantità limitata di tempo per questa spedizione, <first>. Ci hai già visto lavorare un paio di volte; puoi esplorare i due tunnel da solo e raggiungerci quando avrai finito?" chiede Dusk. "Resteremo in contatto radio per tutto il tempo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Accept.)|2055|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetto.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Do you have any information about this section?"|2057|0
units.english: "Do you have any information about this section?"
units.italian: "Avete qualche informazione su questa sezione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Why are you not going to help explore these tunnels?"|2058|0
units.english: "Why are you not going to help explore these tunnels?"
units.italian: "Perché non andate a esplorare questi tunnel con me?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Not much. We only had time for a brief scan during the approach, but based on the volume of these sectors alone, it shouldn't take you more than a couple hours to explore them.|2060|0
units.english: "Not much. We only had time for a brief scan during the approach, but based on the volume of these sectors alone, it shouldn't take you more than a couple hours to explore them.
units.italian: "Non molta. Abbiamo avuto tempo solo per una breve scansione durante l'avvicinamento, ma solo in base al volume di questi settori, non dovresti impiegare più di un paio d'ore a esplorarli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Well, we have our own tunnels to go through," he replies half-seriously. "We have a lot of ground to cover, and only so much air in our suits. The safest way to increase our reach without staying here for weeks is by splitting up, like we did when we first explored the Builder settlement a few weeks ago.|2063|0
units.english: "Well, we have our own tunnels to go through," he replies half-seriously. "We have a lot of ground to cover, and only so much air in our suits. The safest way to increase our reach without staying here for weeks is by splitting up, like we did when we first explored the Builder settlement a few weeks ago.
units.italian: "Beh, abbiamo i nostri tunnel da attraversare," risponde mezzo serio. "Dobbiamo coprire molto terreno, e l'aria nelle nostre tute è limitata. Il modo più sicuro per aumentare la nostra portata senza restare qui per settimane è dividerci, come abbiamo fatto quando abbiamo esplorato l'insediamento dei Costruttori qualche settimana fa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Whenever you reach a new area, take samples and pictures of anything you deem interesting. Never forget to keep an eye on your oxygen: each of us will consume it at slightly different rates, and we should start the trip back as soon as someone has less than a third of a tank left. May the Embers help your search, Captain, and see you soon!"|2065|0
units.english: "Whenever you reach a new area, take samples and pictures of anything you deem interesting. Never forget to keep an eye on your oxygen: each of us will consume it at slightly different rates, and we should start the trip back as soon as someone has less than a third of a tank left. May the Embers help your search, Captain, and see you soon!"
units.italian: "Ogni volta che raggiungi una nuova area, prendi campioni e foto di tutto ciò che ritieni interessante. Non dimenticare mai di tenere d'occhio l'ossigeno: ognuno di noi lo consumerà a ritmi leggermente diversi, e dovremmo iniziare il viaggio di ritorno appena qualcuno ha meno di un terzo della riserva. Che le Braci aiutino la tua ricerca, capitano, e a presto!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Moving in the zero gravity station is quick and relatively easy; despite its length, it only takes you a few minutes to reach the end of the right tunnel. All you can find, however, is a closed hatch. A few tries at forcing it open only serve to confirm that it is locked shut, and you decide to go back and try the other tunnel. This time, your search turns up results, and you end up in a dark, somewhat cramped room.|2066|0
units.english: Moving in the zero gravity station is quick and relatively easy; despite its length, it only takes you a few minutes to reach the end of the right tunnel. All you can find, however, is a closed hatch. A few tries at forcing it open only serve to confirm that it is locked shut, and you decide to go back and try the other tunnel. This time, your search turns up results, and you end up in a dark, somewhat cramped room.
units.italian: Muoversi nella stazione a gravità zero è rapido e relativamente facile; nonostante la lunghezza, ti servono solo pochi minuti per raggiungere la fine del tunnel di destra. Tutto ciò che trovi, però, è un portello chiuso. Qualche tentativo di forzarlo serve solo a confermare che è bloccato, e decidi di tornare indietro e provare l'altro tunnel. Questa volta la ricerca dà risultati, e finisci in una stanza buia e un po' angusta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The room is lavish and dazzling, the walls covered with intricate carvings. It's a striking difference from the gray and slightly coarse material everywhere else in the station, pushing you to gather a few samples to analyze later. To an extent, it reminds you of the Art Deco paintings of ancient humanity. Around the room, alien plants of varying height and shape paint every corner with a reddish hue.|2067|0
units.english: The room is lavish and dazzling, the walls covered with intricate carvings. It's a striking difference from the gray and slightly coarse material everywhere else in the station, pushing you to gather a few samples to analyze later. To an extent, it reminds you of the Art Deco paintings of ancient humanity. Around the room, alien plants of varying height and shape paint every corner with a reddish hue.
units.italian: La stanza è sontuosa e sfarzosa, le pareti coperte di intagli intricati. È una differenza sorprendente rispetto al materiale grigio e un po' grezzo che si trova ovunque nella stazione, e ti spinge a raccogliere qualche campione da analizzare più tardi. In una certa misura, ti ricorda i dipinti Art Déco dell'umanità antica. Attorno alla stanza, piante aliene di altezza e forma varie dipingono ogni angolo di una tonalità rossastra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Quickly take a sample and move on with my mission.)|2069|0
units.english: (Quickly take a sample and move on with my mission.)
units.italian: (Prendi in fretta un campione e proseguo con la missione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Leave them alone.)|2071|0
units.english: (Leave them alone.)
units.italian: (Lasciale stare.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Inspect them closer.)|2073|0
units.english: (Inspect them closer.)
units.italian: (Esaminale più da vicino.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Growing from the vase up to almost the ceiling, the plant you choose to analyze stands at nearly twice your height; despite this, the trunk is only a few millimeters thick, thanks to the lack of gravity aboard the station. Slender, needle-like leaves are spread across the entire stem, contrasting its okra with a red tint.|2074|0
units.english: Growing from the vase up to almost the ceiling, the plant you choose to analyze stands at nearly twice your height; despite this, the trunk is only a few millimeters thick, thanks to the lack of gravity aboard the station. Slender, needle-like leaves are spread across the entire stem, contrasting its okra with a red tint.
units.italian: Crescendo dal vaso fino quasi al soffitto, la pianta che scegli di analizzare è alta quasi il doppio di te; nonostante questo, il fusto è spesso solo qualche millimetro, grazie all'assenza di gravità a bordo della stazione. Foglie sottili, simili ad aghi, sono distribuite su tutto lo stelo, contrastando il suo verde gombo con una sfumatura rossa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	As you try to take a better look at the fronds, the entire trunk breaks in half with minimal pressure. You try to pick up the upper segment before it flies away, but this only splits it into more parts; you decide to observe the resulting pieces from afar instead. To your surprise, the plant is completely hollow, with a large hole inside the stem. You take a few pictures and a couple samples of both the surface and of the vase, then move to the next room.|2075|0
units.english: As you try to take a better look at the fronds, the entire trunk breaks in half with minimal pressure. You try to pick up the upper segment before it flies away, but this only splits it into more parts; you decide to observe the resulting pieces from afar instead. To your surprise, the plant is completely hollow, with a large hole inside the stem. You take a few pictures and a couple samples of both the surface and of the vase, then move to the next room.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di osservare meglio le fronde, l'intero fusto si spezza a metà con una pressione minima. Provi a raccogliere il segmento superiore prima che voli via, ma questo lo divide in più parti; decidi invece di osservare i pezzi risultanti da lontano. Con tua sorpresa, la pianta è completamente cava, con un grande foro dentro lo stelo. Scatti qualche foto e prendi un paio di campioni sia della superficie sia del vaso, poi passi alla stanza successiva.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The rest of the zone isn't as interesting. A series of holes in a wall attract your attention, but they prove too narrow to pass through and too long to see the end; similarly, the corridor at the end of the area is slightly smaller than your suit, preventing you from continuing. As you return back to the rest of the group, however, you notice an unusual drawing.|2077|0
units.english: The rest of the zone isn't as interesting. A series of holes in a wall attract your attention, but they prove too narrow to pass through and too long to see the end; similarly, the corridor at the end of the area is slightly smaller than your suit, preventing you from continuing. As you return back to the rest of the group, however, you notice an unusual drawing.
units.italian: Il resto della zona non è altrettanto interessante. Una serie di fori in una parete attira la tua attenzione, ma si rivelano troppo stretti per passarci e troppo lunghi per vederne la fine; allo stesso modo, il corridoio in fondo all'area è leggermente più piccolo della tua tuta, impedendoti di proseguire. Mentre torni verso il resto del gruppo, però, noti un disegno insolito.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The canvas, attached between various carvings, shows a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo. You pass your glove over its surface, and you notice every part is composed of a different material, smoother and more refined than the walls around it.|2078|0
units.english: The canvas, attached between various carvings, shows a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo. You pass your glove over its surface, and you notice every part is composed of a different material, smoother and more refined than the walls around it.
units.italian: La tela, fissata tra vari intagli, mostra una serie di punti in linea con ogni colore dell'arcobaleno. Mentre le linee sono vicine al fondo del murale, sopra di esse brilla quella che sembra una stella rossa, che manda raggi di luce su ciascuno dei punti colorati e li avvolge tutti in un alone cremisi. Passi il guanto sulla superficie, e noti che ogni parte è composta di un materiale diverso, più liscio e raffinato delle pareti attorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	While the oxygen levels in your suit continue to lower, you follow Dusk's instructions from the radio up and down the maze of tunnels until reaching a large open area where you finally find the Remnant, busy observing a vial of samples. Behind them, you see the start of the giant barrel that composes most of the station's structure.|2079|0
units.english: While the oxygen levels in your suit continue to lower, you follow Dusk's instructions from the radio up and down the maze of tunnels until reaching a large open area where you finally find the Remnant, busy observing a vial of samples. Behind them, you see the start of the giant barrel that composes most of the station's structure.
units.italian: Mentre i livelli di ossigeno della tuta continuano a scendere, segui le istruzioni di Dusk alla radio su e giù per il labirinto di tunnel fino a raggiungere una grande area aperta dove trovi finalmente i Remnant, impegnati a osservare una fiala di campioni. Dietro di loro, vedi l'inizio dell'enorme canna che compone la maggior parte della struttura della stazione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"What is this place?"|2081|0
units.english: "What is this place?"
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"What is inside the vial?"|2083|0
units.english: "What is inside the vial?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è dentro la fiala?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	(Move closer to the barrel.)|2085|0
units.english: (Move closer to the barrel.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati alla canna.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The sheer size of the frame is rather impressive: as you walk toward it, you estimate it must be at least a kilometer from one side to the opposite. At the very end, an enormous lens is attached to the last ring of the barrel; four holes near its center give it a slight resemblance to a cloth button.|2086|0
units.english: The sheer size of the frame is rather impressive: as you walk toward it, you estimate it must be at least a kilometer from one side to the opposite. At the very end, an enormous lens is attached to the last ring of the barrel; four holes near its center give it a slight resemblance to a cloth button.
units.italian: Le dimensioni del telaio sono piuttosto impressionanti: mentre ti avvicini, stimi che debba essere lungo almeno un chilometro da un lato all'altro. All'estremità, un'enorme lente è fissata all'ultimo anello della canna; quattro fori vicino al centro le danno una vaga somiglianza con un bottone di stoffa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"We are most likely in the exhaust chamber of this station's laser system," Dusk says, putting the vial inside a container. "It is impossible to say for certain what its purpose was - hopefully, it was not purely a military system. That being said, we have obtained some info that is far more relevant for our search. Let us get going toward the <ship> first, then I will show you everything we have gathered."|2088|0
units.english: "We are most likely in the exhaust chamber of this station's laser system," Dusk says, putting the vial inside a container. "It is impossible to say for certain what its purpose was - hopefully, it was not purely a military system. That being said, we have obtained some info that is far more relevant for our search. Let us get going toward the <ship> first, then I will show you everything we have gathered."
units.italian: "Siamo molto probabilmente nella camera di scarico del sistema laser di questa stazione," dice Dusk, mettendo la fiala in un contenitore. "È impossibile dire con certezza quale fosse il suo scopo; speriamo che non fosse un sistema puramente militare. Detto questo, abbiamo ottenuto alcune informazioni molto più rilevanti per la nostra ricerca. Andiamo prima verso la <ship>, poi ti mostrerò tutto quello che abbiamo raccolto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Our ticket back, hopefully," Dusk replies with a half smile. "While everything we have seen is interesting in its own way, there is something in particular that gives me hope about finding a way out. But first, we need to start moving back now - we have spent enough time studying this exhaust chamber, and our oxygen margins are starting to worry me."|2092|0
units.english: "Our ticket back, hopefully," Dusk replies with a half smile. "While everything we have seen is interesting in its own way, there is something in particular that gives me hope about finding a way out. But first, we need to start moving back now - we have spent enough time studying this exhaust chamber, and our oxygen margins are starting to worry me."
units.italian: "Il nostro biglietto di ritorno, speriamo," risponde Dusk con mezzo sorriso. "Anche se tutto ciò che abbiamo visto è interessante a modo suo, c'è qualcosa in particolare che mi dà speranza di trovare una via d'uscita. Ma prima dobbiamo cominciare a tornare indietro: abbiamo passato abbastanza tempo a studiare questa camera di scarico, e i nostri margini di ossigeno cominciano a preoccuparmi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	One at a time, the group enters back into the main tunnel, with Dusk at the rear and you right in front of him. You notice the passage at the end doesn't show any blowtorch marks; it seems that the Remnant found it already open when they arrived here.|2094|0
units.english: One at a time, the group enters back into the main tunnel, with Dusk at the rear and you right in front of him. You notice the passage at the end doesn't show any blowtorch marks; it seems that the Remnant found it already open when they arrived here.
units.italian: Uno alla volta, il gruppo rientra nel tunnel principale, con Dusk in fondo e tu proprio davanti a lui. Noti che il passaggio in fondo non mostra segni di fiamma ossidrica; sembra che i Remnant lo abbiano trovato già aperto quando sono arrivati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"While you were exploring that sector, we found a few more tunnels and split up into subgroups to explore each of them. This is how we found the path to the barrel, for instance, as well as many other peculiar areas. And, in one of them," he continues, clumsily passing you a data pad, "this is what we stumbled upon."|2095|0
units.english: "While you were exploring that sector, we found a few more tunnels and split up into subgroups to explore each of them. This is how we found the path to the barrel, for instance, as well as many other peculiar areas. And, in one of them," he continues, clumsily passing you a data pad, "this is what we stumbled upon."
units.italian: "Mentre esploravi quel settore, abbiamo trovato altri tunnel e ci siamo divisi in sottogruppi per esplorarli. È così che abbiamo trovato il percorso verso la canna, per esempio, oltre a molte altre aree peculiari. E, in una di queste," continua, passandoti goffamente un tablet, "ci siamo imbattuti in questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Looking at the screen, you see a photograph of two Remnant standing in front of a large mural, three times as tall as them and far wider. Despite the picture being rather poorly lit, you recognize it as a two-dimensional starmap, carved into the wall of the station. Near the bottom right, a set of circles and unfamiliar markers surround one of the systems indicated.|2096|0
units.english: Looking at the screen, you see a photograph of two Remnant standing in front of a large mural, three times as tall as them and far wider. Despite the picture being rather poorly lit, you recognize it as a two-dimensional starmap, carved into the wall of the station. Near the bottom right, a set of circles and unfamiliar markers surround one of the systems indicated.
units.italian: Guardando lo schermo, vedi la fotografia di due Remnant in piedi davanti a un grande murale, alto tre volte loro e molto più largo. Nonostante la foto sia piuttosto poco illuminata, lo riconosci come una mappa stellare bidimensionale, incisa nella parete della stazione. Vicino al margine inferiore destro, una serie di cerchi e segni sconosciuti circonda uno dei sistemi indicati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Look at the orbital parameters of that system. It is, without a shadow of doubt, indicating Patir. A system they should not be aware of, if it only just arrived here, but it is one they were apparently interested in."|2097|0
units.english: "Look at the orbital parameters of that system. It is, without a shadow of doubt, indicating Patir. A system they should not be aware of, if it only just arrived here, but it is one they were apparently interested in."
units.italian: "Guarda i parametri orbitali di quel sistema. È, senza ombra di dubbio, Patir. Un sistema di cui non dovrebbero essere a conoscenza, se è appena arrivato qui, ma che a quanto pare interessava loro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"It could be a coincidence."|2099|0
units.english: "It could be a coincidence."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere una coincidenza."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Perhaps Patir used to stay here before reaching the Milky Way."|2101|0
units.english: "Perhaps Patir used to stay here before reaching the Milky Way."
units.italian: "Forse Patir era qui prima di raggiungere la Via Lattea."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"For what purpose?"|2103|0
units.english: "For what purpose?"
units.italian: "Con quale scopo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"I would also like to know that. I cannot recognize the language in the text, and deciphering it would be an enormous task - one that would require a vast amount of text to analyze, as well as years of focused effort from the whole community. We must base our decisions only on what we can infer from the graphic itself, which is far from ideal. And then, there is this."|2104|0
units.english: "I would also like to know that. I cannot recognize the language in the text, and deciphering it would be an enormous task - one that would require a vast amount of text to analyze, as well as years of focused effort from the whole community. We must base our decisions only on what we can infer from the graphic itself, which is far from ideal. And then, there is this."
units.italian: "Anche a me piacerebbe saperlo. Non riesco a riconoscere la lingua del testo, e decifrarla sarebbe un compito enorme: richiederebbe una grande quantità di testo da analizzare, oltre ad anni di lavoro concentrato di tutta la comunità. Dobbiamo basare le nostre decisioni solo su ciò che possiamo dedurre dalla grafica stessa, il che è ben lontano dall'ideale. E poi c'è questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"You may be right. I cannot recognize the language in the text, and deciphering it would be an enormous task - one that would require a vast amount of text to analyze, as well as years of focused effort from the whole community. We must base our decisions only on what we can infer from the graphic itself, which is far from ideal. And then, there is this."|2107|0
units.english: "You may be right. I cannot recognize the language in the text, and deciphering it would be an enormous task - one that would require a vast amount of text to analyze, as well as years of focused effort from the whole community. We must base our decisions only on what we can infer from the graphic itself, which is far from ideal. And then, there is this."
units.italian: "Potresti avere ragione. Non riesco a riconoscere la lingua del testo, e decifrarla sarebbe un compito enorme: richiederebbe una grande quantità di testo da analizzare, oltre ad anni di lavoro concentrato di tutta la comunità. Dobbiamo basare le nostre decisioni solo su ciò che possiamo dedurre dalla grafica stessa, il che è ben lontano dall'ideale. E poi c'è questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	"Maybe. Without reading the text surrounding it, which is written neither in Builder nor any language I can recognize, we can only analyze what we can infer from the graphic itself - something far from ideal. But if we take it at face value, it could be the first step towards escape from this sector. And then, there is this."|2110|0
units.english: "Maybe. Without reading the text surrounding it, which is written neither in Builder nor any language I can recognize, we can only analyze what we can infer from the graphic itself - something far from ideal. But if we take it at face value, it could be the first step towards escape from this sector. And then, there is this."
units.italian: "Forse. Senza leggere il testo che lo circonda, scritto né in lingua dei Costruttori né in alcuna lingua che io riconosca, possiamo solo analizzare ciò che deduciamo dalla grafica stessa, cosa ben lontana dall'ideale. Ma prendendolo per buono, potrebbe essere il primo passo verso la fuga da questo settore. E poi c'è questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	Dusk hands you the vial from earlier, which, despite its size, feels rather heavy in your hand. Inside is a grainy dust interspersed with small, violet crystals of various shapes. "We found a similar powder on the ground of a number of rooms inside the station. We have not explored the entire complex, of course, but if the pattern repeats we expect there to be something similar around the entire barrel."|2112|0
units.english: Dusk hands you the vial from earlier, which, despite its size, feels rather heavy in your hand. Inside is a grainy dust interspersed with small, violet crystals of various shapes. "We found a similar powder on the ground of a number of rooms inside the station. We have not explored the entire complex, of course, but if the pattern repeats we expect there to be something similar around the entire barrel."
units.italian: Dusk ti porge la fiala di prima, che, nonostante le dimensioni, risulta piuttosto pesante in mano. Dentro c'è una polvere granulosa intervallata da piccoli cristalli viola di forme varie. "Abbiamo trovato una polvere simile sul pavimento di numerose stanze dentro la stazione. Non abbiamo esplorato l'intero complesso, naturalmente, ma se lo schema si ripete ci aspettiamo che ci sia qualcosa di simile attorno all'intera canna."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	The particles suspended in the vial remind you of the regolith surrounding the Builder settlement orbiting Patir, but far less compact. "Attempts to learn the dust's composition have been inconclusive. Perhaps the instruments in the lab will give us better results, but our current tools only returned noise. However, we did notice something potentially interesting: the noise aligned with the scans you took in Lathia a few days ago. Whatever it is, it could be made of the same matter that composes those creatures - I can use the scanners on your ship to confirm it without wasting any time while we depart."|2113|0
units.english: The particles suspended in the vial remind you of the regolith surrounding the Builder settlement orbiting Patir, but far less compact. "Attempts to learn the dust's composition have been inconclusive. Perhaps the instruments in the lab will give us better results, but our current tools only returned noise. However, we did notice something potentially interesting: the noise aligned with the scans you took in Lathia a few days ago. Whatever it is, it could be made of the same matter that composes those creatures - I can use the scanners on your ship to confirm it without wasting any time while we depart."
units.italian: Le particelle sospese nella fiala ti ricordano la regolite attorno all'insediamento dei Costruttori in orbita a Patir, ma molto meno compatta. "I tentativi di capire la composizione della polvere non sono stati conclusivi. Forse gli strumenti del laboratorio ci daranno risultati migliori, ma i nostri attuali strumenti hanno restituito solo rumore. Tuttavia abbiamo notato qualcosa di potenzialmente interessante: il rumore coincideva con le scansioni che hai fatto a Lathia qualche giorno fa. Qualunque cosa sia, potrebbe essere fatta della stessa materia che compone quegli esseri; posso usare gli scanner della tua nave per confermarlo senza perdere tempo mentre partiamo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A|	You exit the station and enter your ship, and see most of the scientists have already moved their samples inside your cargo hold, with around two dozen containers scattered on the floor. Soon after, you're back inside the cockpit, preparing for liftoff; discussion about the next mission will have to wait until you're in Patir.|2114|0
units.english: You exit the station and enter your ship, and see most of the scientists have already moved their samples inside your cargo hold, with around two dozen containers scattered on the floor. Soon after, you're back inside the cockpit, preparing for liftoff; discussion about the next mission will have to wait until you're in Patir.
units.italian: Esci dalla stazione ed entri nella nave, e vedi che la maggior parte degli scienziati ha già trasferito i campioni nella stiva, con una ventina di contenitori sparsi sul pavimento. Poco dopo sei di nuovo in cabina, pronto al decollo; la discussione sulla prossima missione dovrà aspettare che siate a Patir.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|name|2118|0
units.english: Return to <system>
units.italian: Torna su <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|description|2119|0
units.english: Return to the <destination> to figure out the next step.
units.italian: Torna al <destination> per capire il passo successivo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|blocked|2123|0
units.english: Right as you touch down, you notice a message coming in from Dusk. "<first>, we will need at least five free bunks for the mission we are preparing."
units.italian: Appena atterri, noti un messaggio in arrivo da Dusk. "<first>, ci serviranno almeno cinque cuccette libere per la missione che stiamo preparando."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|As you accompany the Remnant team back to the lab, they confirm Dusk's theories on the dust. From the way they speak about it, they seem to have reached a consensus on the source of the regolith, though they don't go into details.|2130|0
units.english: As you accompany the Remnant team back to the lab, they confirm Dusk's theories on the dust. From the way they speak about it, they seem to have reached a consensus on the source of the regolith, though they don't go into details.
units.italian: Mentre accompagni la squadra Remnant al laboratorio, confermano le teorie di Dusk sulla polvere. Da come ne parlano, sembrano aver raggiunto un consenso sull'origine della regolite, anche se non entrano nei dettagli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	The module was never particularly inviting, but over the last few weeks, a thin layer of dust coming from outside the asteroid has covered the floor, with just the surfaces needed for the research kept clean. Tiredness plagues the faces of the scientists: they must not have slept much in the past days to keep up with the amount of incoming data, and neither have you. As you try to remember the last time you stepped outside without a suit - at least a month, most likely - your thoughts are interrupted by the arrival of Dusk, carrying on his back the last few samples.|2131|0
units.english: The module was never particularly inviting, but over the last few weeks, a thin layer of dust coming from outside the asteroid has covered the floor, with just the surfaces needed for the research kept clean. Tiredness plagues the faces of the scientists: they must not have slept much in the past days to keep up with the amount of incoming data, and neither have you. As you try to remember the last time you stepped outside without a suit - at least a month, most likely - your thoughts are interrupted by the arrival of Dusk, carrying on his back the last few samples.
units.italian: Il modulo non è mai stato particolarmente accogliente, ma nelle ultime settimane uno strato sottile di polvere proveniente dall'esterno dell'asteroide ha coperto il pavimento, lasciando pulite solo le superfici necessarie alla ricerca. La stanchezza segna i volti degli scienziati: non devono aver dormito molto negli ultimi giorni per stare dietro alla quantità di dati in arrivo, e nemmeno tu. Mentre cerchi di ricordare l'ultima volta che sei uscito senza tuta, almeno un mese, probabilmente, i tuoi pensieri vengono interrotti dall'arrivo di Dusk, che porta sulla schiena gli ultimi campioni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Sounds like this expedition was more productive than the last."|2133|0
units.english: "Sounds like this expedition was more productive than the last."
units.italian: "Sembra che questa spedizione sia stata più produttiva dell'ultima."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Now that this is done, what are you going for next?"|2134|0
units.english: "Now that this is done, what are you going for next?"
units.italian: "Ora che è fatto, a cosa puntate adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Oh, definitely! While the data we could gather was not as much as I hoped, we now have a rather clear connection between Patir and Chanai, as well as between the station and those peculiar beings. That, alone, is invaluable for our mission.|2136|0
units.english: "Oh, definitely! While the data we could gather was not as much as I hoped, we now have a rather clear connection between Patir and Chanai, as well as between the station and those peculiar beings. That, alone, is invaluable for our mission.
units.italian: "Oh, decisamente! Anche se i dati che abbiamo potuto raccogliere non sono stati quanti speravo, ora abbiamo un legame piuttosto chiaro tra Patir e Chanai, così come tra la stazione e quegli esseri peculiari. Solo questo è inestimabile per la nostra missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"During the trip back, we evaluated the options at our disposal. As you may guess, the most obvious one would be to explore further into the station; however, it was not as attractive as previously thought. While it may have been used to influence Patir, it is clear that it now sits silent and powerless, as if missing something that can bring it back to life. We could find more about its design, perhaps, but the chances of using it on our own within a reasonable time scale are low.|2138|0
units.english: "During the trip back, we evaluated the options at our disposal. As you may guess, the most obvious one would be to explore further into the station; however, it was not as attractive as previously thought. While it may have been used to influence Patir, it is clear that it now sits silent and powerless, as if missing something that can bring it back to life. We could find more about its design, perhaps, but the chances of using it on our own within a reasonable time scale are low.
units.italian: "Durante il viaggio di ritorno, abbiamo valutato le opzioni a nostra disposizione. Come puoi immaginare, la più ovvia sarebbe esplorare più a fondo la stazione; tuttavia non era attraente come pensavamo. Anche se potrebbe essere stata usata per influenzare Patir, è chiaro che ora giace silenziosa e senza energia, come se le mancasse qualcosa che possa riportarla in vita. Potremmo scoprire di più sul suo design, forse, ma le probabilità di usarla da soli entro tempi ragionevoli sono basse.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"We have enough consumables to last for many weeks still; we started rationing as soon as we arrived in this sector, and we are prepared to reduce them further if necessary. Nevertheless, we need to take a more direct approach if we want results. Approaching the species that inhabits this cluster is essential at this point, and doing so as soon as possible would be advisable."|2139|0
units.english: "We have enough consumables to last for many weeks still; we started rationing as soon as we arrived in this sector, and we are prepared to reduce them further if necessary. Nevertheless, we need to take a more direct approach if we want results. Approaching the species that inhabits this cluster is essential at this point, and doing so as soon as possible would be advisable."
units.italian: "Abbiamo consumabili sufficienti per molte settimane; abbiamo iniziato a razionarli appena arrivati in questo settore, e siamo pronti a ridurli ulteriormente se necessario. Tuttavia, ci serve un approccio più diretto se vogliamo risultati. Avvicinarsi alla specie che abita questo ammasso è essenziale a questo punto, e sarebbe consigliabile farlo il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"What do you suggest?"|2141|0
units.english: "What do you suggest?"
units.italian: "Che cosa suggerisci?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Are you proposing a first contact of some sort?"|2143|0
units.english: "Are you proposing a first contact of some sort?"
units.italian: "Stai proponendo un primo contatto di qualche tipo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Are they behind the Chanai station?"|2145|0
units.english: "Are they behind the Chanai station?"
units.italian: "Sono loro dietro la stazione di Chanai?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Maybe, maybe not. The internal design of the station is an odd fit for the asteroids' size and characteristics, but we do know for certain they have been there in the past, and you have seen for yourself how difficult it is to find a way in.|2146|0
units.english: "Maybe, maybe not. The internal design of the station is an odd fit for the asteroids' size and characteristics, but we do know for certain they have been there in the past, and you have seen for yourself how difficult it is to find a way in.
units.italian: "Forse, forse no. Il design interno della stazione è un adattamento strano per le dimensioni e le caratteristiche degli asteroidi, ma sappiamo per certo che in passato sono stati lì, e hai visto tu stesso quanto sia difficile trovare un modo per entrare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"In a way. We have been considering a close approach to one of those beings ever since we first saw them, and your discovery of the planetoid in Lathia opens up the opportunity for a surface expedition - gathering samples, analyzing its reaction, and perhaps yes, if they are intelligent and the conditions are right, a true first contact between our two species could happen.|2150|0
units.english: "In a way. We have been considering a close approach to one of those beings ever since we first saw them, and your discovery of the planetoid in Lathia opens up the opportunity for a surface expedition - gathering samples, analyzing its reaction, and perhaps yes, if they are intelligent and the conditions are right, a true first contact between our two species could happen.
units.italian: "In un certo senso. Stiamo considerando un avvicinamento ravvicinato a uno di quegli esseri fin da quando li abbiamo visti per la prima volta, e la tua scoperta del planetoide a Lathia apre l'opportunità per una spedizione di superficie: raccogliere campioni, analizzare la sua reazione, e forse sì, se sono intelligenti e le condizioni sono giuste, potrebbe avvenire un vero primo contatto tra le nostre due specie.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"We have been considering a close approach to one of those beings ever since we first saw them, and your discovery of the planetoid in Lathia opens up the possibility for a surface expedition. Thanks to its size, landing with the <ship> should be possible, and we could even explore the planetoid in our suits if the surface is safe. Perhaps, if these beings are truly intelligent, this could be the first contact between our two species.|2153|0
units.english: "We have been considering a close approach to one of those beings ever since we first saw them, and your discovery of the planetoid in Lathia opens up the possibility for a surface expedition. Thanks to its size, landing with the <ship> should be possible, and we could even explore the planetoid in our suits if the surface is safe. Perhaps, if these beings are truly intelligent, this could be the first contact between our two species.
units.italian: "Stiamo considerando un avvicinamento ravvicinato a uno di quegli esseri fin da quando li abbiamo visti per la prima volta, e la tua scoperta del planetoide a Lathia apre la possibilità di una spedizione di superficie. Grazie alle sue dimensioni, atterrare con la <ship> dovrebbe essere possibile, e potremmo persino esplorare il planetoide con le nostre tute se la superficie è sicura. Forse, se questi esseri sono davvero intelligenti, questo potrebbe essere il primo contatto tra le nostre due specie.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B|	"Meet us in the lab in a few hours, and we will have everything ready for the trip. With a bit of luck, most of the instruments we used on Chanai will be a good fit for this mission as well."|2155|0
units.english: "Meet us in the lab in a few hours, and we will have everything ready for the trip. With a bit of luck, most of the instruments we used on Chanai will be a good fit for this mission as well."
units.italian: "Incontraci nel laboratorio tra qualche ora, e avremo tutto pronto per il viaggio. Con un po' di fortuna, la maggior parte degli strumenti che abbiamo usato su Chanai andrà bene anche per questa missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|name|2158|0
units.english: Satellite deployment
units.italian: Schieramento di satelliti

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|description|2159|0
units.english: Deploy two probes in <waypoints> to keep an eye on incoming space rocks.
units.italian: Schiera due sonde in <waypoints> per tenere d'occhio le rocce spaziali in arrivo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|blocked|2165|0
units.english: Right as you touch down, you notice a message coming in from Dusk. "<first>, we will need at least five free bunks and 3 tons of cargo for the mission we are preparing."
units.italian: Appena atterri, noti un messaggio in arrivo da Dusk. "<first>, ci serviranno almeno cinque cuccette libere e 3 tonnellate di carico per la missione che stiamo preparando."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|You find the team waiting for you in the lab. Next to them are two mechanical crates, roughly the size of a person. Most of the clutter around the room has been cut down considerably; these satellites alone must have used the larger part of their reserves. "Here they are, Captain," Dusk states proudly. "Two autonomous surveillance probes, capable of scanning an entire system without any input and slowly beaming the results back to us. Their capabilities are far from what our main fleet is capable of back home, but, considering our situation, they should be more than enough.|2173|0
units.english: You find the team waiting for you in the lab. Next to them are two mechanical crates, roughly the size of a person. Most of the clutter around the room has been cut down considerably; these satellites alone must have used the larger part of their reserves. "Here they are, Captain," Dusk states proudly. "Two autonomous surveillance probes, capable of scanning an entire system without any input and slowly beaming the results back to us. Their capabilities are far from what our main fleet is capable of back home, but, considering our situation, they should be more than enough.
units.italian: Trovi la squadra che ti aspetta nel laboratorio. Accanto a loro ci sono due casse meccaniche, grosso modo della dimensione di una persona. Gran parte del disordine nella stanza è stato ridotto considerevolmente; solo questi satelliti devono aver usato la maggior parte delle loro riserve. "Eccole, capitano," dichiara Dusk con orgoglio. "Due sonde di sorveglianza autonome, in grado di scansionare un intero sistema senza alcun input e trasmetterci lentamente i risultati. Le loro capacità sono ben lontane da quelle della nostra flotta principale a casa, ma, considerata la nostra situazione, dovrebbero essere più che sufficienti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|	"We have settled on their destinations: the stellar black holes of <waypoints>. Once there, they will be far enough to give us appropriate warning, but close enough to only pick up asteroids heading towards Patir. If they do, that will be our signal to depart and intercept them right as they come in."|2174|0
units.english: "We have settled on their destinations: the stellar black holes of <waypoints>. Once there, they will be far enough to give us appropriate warning, but close enough to only pick up asteroids heading towards Patir. If they do, that will be our signal to depart and intercept them right as they come in."
units.italian: "Abbiamo stabilito le loro destinazioni: i buchi neri stellari di <waypoints>. Una volta lì, saranno abbastanza lontane per darci un preavviso adeguato, ma abbastanza vicine per rilevare solo gli asteroidi diretti verso Patir. Se lo faranno, sarà il nostro segnale per partire e intercettarli proprio mentre arrivano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|	"Understood."|2176|0
units.english: "Understood."
units.italian: "Capito."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|	"Is there a specific orbit I should deploy these probes in?"|2178|0
units.english: "Is there a specific orbit I should deploy these probes in?"
units.italian: "C'è un'orbita specifica in cui dovrei schierare queste sonde?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|	"Oh, there is no need to worry about that. Their scanners are easily powerful enough to cover the whole system. Their power and communication capabilities are far more limited, but for the time we need them to last, this should not be an issue. Bring me to those systems, and I will handle the rest."|2179|0
units.english: "Oh, there is no need to worry about that. Their scanners are easily powerful enough to cover the whole system. Their power and communication capabilities are far more limited, but for the time we need them to last, this should not be an issue. Bring me to those systems, and I will handle the rest."
units.italian: "Oh, non c'è bisogno di preoccuparsene. I loro scanner sono facilmente abbastanza potenti da coprire l'intero sistema. Le loro capacità di energia e comunicazione sono molto più limitate, ma per il tempo che ci serve che durino non dovrebbe essere un problema. Portami in quei sistemi, e al resto penserò io."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|As the satellite leaves your ship, you watch it move further away and unfurl its solar arrays. The probe quickly disappears in the blackness of space.|2183|0
units.english: As the satellite leaves your ship, you watch it move further away and unfurl its solar arrays. The probe quickly disappears in the blackness of space.
units.italian: Mentre il satellite lascia la nave, lo guardi allontanarsi e dispiegare i pannelli solari. La sonda scompare rapidamente nel nero dello spazio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A|Dusk quickly reaches for the console, initiating the satellite deployment procedure you've become accustomed to. It doesn't take long for it to complete, and in a few minutes you're ready to leave the system once again.|2186|0
units.english: Dusk quickly reaches for the console, initiating the satellite deployment procedure you've become accustomed to. It doesn't take long for it to complete, and in a few minutes you're ready to leave the system once again.
units.italian: Dusk si precipita verso la console, avviando la procedura di schieramento del satellite a cui ormai sei abituato. Non ci vuole molto perché si completi, e in pochi minuti siete pronti a lasciare di nuovo il sistema.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|name|2227|0
units.english: Ka'sei hacking
units.italian: Hackeraggio dei Ka'sei

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|description|2228|0
units.english: Taking advantage of the arrival of one of the asteroids, dock with a disabled Ka'sei to gather data from its internal computers.
units.italian: Approfittando dell'arrivo di uno degli asteroidi, agganciati a un Ka'sei disattivato per raccogliere dati dai suoi computer interni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|Dusk seems busier than usual as you descend towards the settlement, constantly communicating with the team on the ground while simultaneously checking the incoming telemetry. When you're hovering right above the landing pad, he turns to your console. "Keep the thrusters in standby, Captain," he signs hastily. "We are not here to stay. The satellites are working very well; in fact, the Thepa probe has just detected one of those beings jumping right in our direction. We have only a few hours to return to orbit, or we will waste this opportunity."|2237|0
units.english: Dusk seems busier than usual as you descend towards the settlement, constantly communicating with the team on the ground while simultaneously checking the incoming telemetry. When you're hovering right above the landing pad, he turns to your console. "Keep the thrusters in standby, Captain," he signs hastily. "We are not here to stay. The satellites are working very well; in fact, the Thepa probe has just detected one of those beings jumping right in our direction. We have only a few hours to return to orbit, or we will waste this opportunity."
units.italian: Dusk sembra più indaffarato del solito mentre scendi verso l'insediamento, comunicando continuamente con la squadra a terra mentre allo stesso tempo controlla la telemetria in arrivo. Quando siete proprio sopra la piazzola di atterraggio, si volta verso la tua console. "Tieni i propulsori in attesa, capitano," accenna in fretta. "Non siamo qui per restare. I satelliti funzionano molto bene; anzi, la sonda Thepa ha appena rilevato uno di quegli esseri che salta proprio verso di noi. Abbiamo solo poche ore per tornare in orbita, o sprecheremo questa occasione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	On the ground, the whole team rushes out of your ship toward the lab, soon returning with their hands full of strange equipment and unwieldy machinery. You quickly prepare your ship's cargo bay for the new payloads and walk down to Dusk so you can help them carry the instruments aboard. "The approaching asteroid is of the small or medium kind, as far as I can tell. Considering your past interactions, or lack thereof, it is unlikely to cause any issue."|2238|0
units.english: On the ground, the whole team rushes out of your ship toward the lab, soon returning with their hands full of strange equipment and unwieldy machinery. You quickly prepare your ship's cargo bay for the new payloads and walk down to Dusk so you can help them carry the instruments aboard. "The approaching asteroid is of the small or medium kind, as far as I can tell. Considering your past interactions, or lack thereof, it is unlikely to cause any issue."
units.italian: A terra, l'intera squadra si precipita fuori dalla nave verso il laboratorio, tornando presto con le mani piene di attrezzatura strana e macchinari ingombranti. Prepari in fretta la stiva della nave per i nuovi carichi e scendi da Dusk per aiutarli a portare gli strumenti a bordo. "L'asteroide in avvicinamento è di tipo piccolo o medio, per quanto posso dire. Considerate le tue interazioni passate, o la loro assenza, è improbabile che causi problemi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"What should I do once in orbit?" you ask.|2239|0
units.english: "What should I do once in orbit?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa devo fare una volta in orbita?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"First, we will verify that all identifiable Ka'sei have entered a dormant state after the creature's arrival. Once that is confirmed, you will rendezvous with one of the deactivated Fetri'sei so that we can spacewalk to it. We will handle the rest from there.|2240|0
units.english: "First, we will verify that all identifiable Ka'sei have entered a dormant state after the creature's arrival. Once that is confirmed, you will rendezvous with one of the deactivated Fetri'sei so that we can spacewalk to it. We will handle the rest from there.
units.italian: "Prima verificheremo che tutti i Ka'sei identificabili siano entrati in stato di dormienza dopo l'arrivo della creatura. Una volta confermato, ti aggancerai a uno dei Fetri'sei disattivati così che possiamo raggiungerlo in passeggiata spaziale. Al resto penseremo noi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Of course, this will be the first time in Remnant history that one of us boards a Ka'sei; after all, it wasn't too long ago we learned of their existence.
