But we have explored many kinds of Ka'het over the years with varying results, and with that experience I am confident we should be able to complete our mission."|2241|0
units.english: "Of course, this will be the first time in Remnant history that one of us boards a Ka'sei; after all, it wasn't too long ago we learned of their existence. But we have explored many kinds of Ka'het over the years with varying results, and with that experience I am confident we should be able to complete our mission."
units.italian: "Naturalmente, questa sarà la prima volta nella storia dei Remnant che uno di noi abborda un Ka'sei; dopo tutto, non è passato molto tempo da quando abbiamo scoperto la loro esistenza. Ma negli anni abbiamo esplorato molti tipi di Ka'het con risultati vari, e con quell'esperienza sono fiducioso che riusciremo a completare la missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Are you sure this will be safe?"|2243|0
units.english: "Are you sure this will be safe?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che sarà sicuro?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Let's go then."|2244|0
units.english: "Let's go then."
units.italian: "Allora andiamo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Trust me, <first>," Dusk replies, "it will be incredibly risky. None of us would be doing this if we could say for certain there was a better way, but here we are. Help me with this crate now; we are almost ready to go."|2246|0
units.english: "Trust me, <first>," Dusk replies, "it will be incredibly risky. None of us would be doing this if we could say for certain there was a better way, but here we are. Help me with this crate now; we are almost ready to go."
units.italian: "Fidati di me, <first>," risponde Dusk, "sarà incredibilmente rischioso. Nessuno di noi lo farebbe se potessimo affermare con certezza che esiste un modo migliore, ma eccoci qui. Aiutami con questa cassa ora; siamo quasi pronti a partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	As the last container is brought inside, the cargo ramp moves back, and the exit door follows suit. Glancing at the scanner telemetry, you realize the alien being has already started to exit hyperspace; with a button press, the engines roar back to life, and the ship starts gaining altitude.|2248|0
units.english: As the last container is brought inside, the cargo ramp moves back, and the exit door follows suit. Glancing at the scanner telemetry, you realize the alien being has already started to exit hyperspace; with a button press, the engines roar back to life, and the ship starts gaining altitude.
units.italian: Quando l'ultimo contenitore viene portato dentro, la rampa di carico si ritrae, e la porta d'uscita fa lo stesso. Dando un'occhiata alla telemetria dello scanner, capisci che l'essere alieno ha già cominciato a uscire dall'iperspazio; con una pressione di un pulsante, i motori ruggiscono di nuovo, e la nave comincia a guadagnare quota.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|The giant creature floats a few meters away from your cockpit, silent and motionless, but you know that inside the shell, the slug remains alive and well, ready to kill. Compared to some of the Ka'het back in the Graveyard, this is one of the Builders' smaller creations, but its size is still impressive for what is, in essence, a single organism.|2261|0
units.english: The giant creature floats a few meters away from your cockpit, silent and motionless, but you know that inside the shell, the slug remains alive and well, ready to kill. Compared to some of the Ka'het back in the Graveyard, this is one of the Builders' smaller creations, but its size is still impressive for what is, in essence, a single organism.
units.italian: La creatura gigantesca fluttua a qualche metro dalla tua cabina, silenziosa e immobile, ma sai che dentro il guscio la lumaca resta viva e vegeta, pronta a uccidere. Rispetto ad alcuni Ka'het del Cimitero, questa è una delle creazioni più piccole dei Costruttori, ma le sue dimensioni sono comunque impressionanti per quello che è, in sostanza, un singolo organismo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	Before setting the <flagship> to automatic station-keeping, you move your ship so that the main hatch is as close as possible to the Fetri'sei. The Remnant are already in the airlock donning their extravehicular suits, and you join them shortly after.|2262|0
units.english: Before setting the <flagship> to automatic station-keeping, you move your ship so that the main hatch is as close as possible to the Fetri'sei. The Remnant are already in the airlock donning their extravehicular suits, and you join them shortly after.
units.italian: Prima di impostare la <flagship> sul mantenimento automatico della posizione, sposti la nave in modo che il portello principale sia il più vicino possibile al Fetri'sei. I Remnant sono già nella camera di equilibrio a indossare le tute extraveicolari, e li raggiungi poco dopo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"When we are inside, there is a high probability we will not be able to communicate," advises Dusk. "Normally, the walls of the armored shell are too thick and dense for our signals to pass through, and the spaces we need to navigate prevent us from using a physical tether. This does not mean we will be unprotected, however. May I see your sidearm?"|2263|0
units.english: "When we are inside, there is a high probability we will not be able to communicate," advises Dusk. "Normally, the walls of the armored shell are too thick and dense for our signals to pass through, and the spaces we need to navigate prevent us from using a physical tether. This does not mean we will be unprotected, however. May I see your sidearm?"
units.italian: "Quando saremo dentro, c'è un'alta probabilità che non riusciremo a comunicare," avverte Dusk. "Normalmente le pareti del guscio corazzato sono troppo spesse e dense perché i nostri segnali passino, e gli spazi che dobbiamo attraversare ci impediscono di usare una fune fisica. Questo non significa però che saremo senza protezione. Posso vedere la tua arma da fianco?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	You draw your weapon out of the holster and hand it to him. After a quick examination, he nods and gives it back before continuing. "Once inside, one of our first operations will be connecting to the downlink of the Fetri's telemetry: it is not protected, in our experience, and it is easy to access. From there, we will be able to monitor the vessel's shields.|2264|0
units.english: You draw your weapon out of the holster and hand it to him. After a quick examination, he nods and gives it back before continuing. "Once inside, one of our first operations will be connecting to the downlink of the Fetri's telemetry: it is not protected, in our experience, and it is easy to access. From there, we will be able to monitor the vessel's shields.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma dalla fondina e gliela porgi. Dopo un rapido esame, annuisce e te la restituisce prima di continuare. "Una volta dentro, una delle nostre prime operazioni sarà collegarci al downlink della telemetria del Fetri: non è protetto, secondo la nostra esperienza, ed è facile da accedere. Da lì potremo monitorare gli scudi della nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Many things could go wrong during this mission: the unknown creature could leave the system early, or maybe we could inadvertently awaken the Ka'sei with our actions. If you notice anything out of the ordinary, no matter how minor, take out this gun, point at an empty spot on the shell, and shoot. Our terminals will let us know even the smallest variation in its shield integrity, and we will run back to safety as soon as this happens."|2265|0
units.english: "Many things could go wrong during this mission: the unknown creature could leave the system early, or maybe we could inadvertently awaken the Ka'sei with our actions. If you notice anything out of the ordinary, no matter how minor, take out this gun, point at an empty spot on the shell, and shoot. Our terminals will let us know even the smallest variation in its shield integrity, and we will run back to safety as soon as this happens."
units.italian: "Molte cose potrebbero andare storte durante questa missione: la creatura sconosciuta potrebbe lasciare il sistema in anticipo, o potremmo risvegliare inavvertitamente i Ka'sei con le nostre azioni. Se noti qualcosa fuori dall'ordinario, per quanto piccolo, tira fuori questa pistola, punta un punto vuoto del guscio e spara. I nostri terminali ci segnaleranno anche la minima variazione nell'integrità dei suoi scudi, e correremo al sicuro appena accadrà."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Will this not anger the Ka'sei?"|2267|0
units.english: "Will this not anger the Ka'sei?"
units.italian: "Questo non farà arrabbiare i Ka'sei?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"What if you cannot access the shield levels?"|2269|0
units.english: "What if you cannot access the shield levels?"
units.italian: "E se non riuscite ad accedere ai livelli degli scudi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Then we will abandon the mission. Without that safety net, it would be too dangerous to continue. However, since they were both created by the Builders, it should be similar enough to the Ka'het design language.|2270|0
units.english: "Then we will abandon the mission. Without that safety net, it would be too dangerous to continue. However, since they were both created by the Builders, it should be similar enough to the Ka'het design language.
units.italian: "Allora abbandoneremo la missione. Senza quella rete di sicurezza, sarebbe troppo pericoloso continuare. Tuttavia, dato che entrambi sono stati creati dai Costruttori, dovrebbe essere abbastanza simile al linguaggio di progettazione dei Ka'het.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Almost certainly not, given how negligible the damage should be. A sidearm would not make a scratch in its armor, let alone a dent; and even in the small chance it does activate its defenses, you should have enough time to leave the system and let it calm down.|2274|0
units.english: "Almost certainly not, given how negligible the damage should be. A sidearm would not make a scratch in its armor, let alone a dent; and even in the small chance it does activate its defenses, you should have enough time to leave the system and let it calm down.
units.italian: "Quasi certamente no, visto quanto dovrebbe essere trascurabile il danno. Un'arma da fianco non graffierebbe la sua corazza, figuriamoci ammaccarla; e anche nella piccola possibilità che attivi le sue difese, dovresti avere abbastanza tempo per lasciare il sistema e lasciarla calmare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Inside, we will search for the memory banks of the spacecraft. After a quick selection based on the data we can scrape, we will take the few that contain information concerning our research and extract their contents. Understood?"|2276|0
units.english: "Inside, we will search for the memory banks of the spacecraft. After a quick selection based on the data we can scrape, we will take the few that contain information concerning our research and extract their contents. Understood?"
units.italian: "Dentro, cercheremo i banchi di memoria della nave. Dopo una rapida selezione basata sui dati che riusciremo a estrarre, prenderemo i pochi che contengono informazioni riguardanti la nostra ricerca ed estrarremo il loro contenuto. Capito?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Nod.)|2278|0
units.english: (Nod.)
units.italian: (Annuisco.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"What about me?"|2280|0
units.english: "What about me?"
units.italian: "E che cosa faccio io?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Given that you need to be able to fire as quick as possible, you cannot return to the cockpit. So, we took the liberty of creating a small terminal here to keep an eye on the situation." He points to a small desk in the cargo bay filled to the brim with Remnant machinery.|2281|0
units.english: "Given that you need to be able to fire as quick as possible, you cannot return to the cockpit. So, we took the liberty of creating a small terminal here to keep an eye on the situation." He points to a small desk in the cargo bay filled to the brim with Remnant machinery.
units.italian: "Dato che devi essere in grado di sparare il più rapidamente possibile, non puoi tornare in cabina. Così ci siamo presi la libertà di creare qui un piccolo terminale per tenere d'occhio la situazione." Indica una piccola scrivania nella stiva, piena zeppa di macchinari Remnant.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	One by one, the scientists jump from your ship to the Fetri, moving toward a closed, circular hatch in between the two engines. As you watch them start the expedition, you sit down at the makeshift console, monitoring movements in the system as well as any changes to the slug. Though you can't clearly see what they are doing, you distinguish someone inserting a rod inside a small aperture, followed by the hatch opening right after.|2283|0
units.english: One by one, the scientists jump from your ship to the Fetri, moving toward a closed, circular hatch in between the two engines. As you watch them start the expedition, you sit down at the makeshift console, monitoring movements in the system as well as any changes to the slug. Though you can't clearly see what they are doing, you distinguish someone inserting a rod inside a small aperture, followed by the hatch opening right after.
units.italian: Uno alla volta, gli scienziati saltano dalla tua nave al Fetri, muovendosi verso un portello circolare chiuso tra i due motori. Mentre li guardi iniziare la spedizione, ti siedi alla console improvvisata, monitorando i movimenti nel sistema e qualsiasi cambiamento nella lumaca. Anche se non riesci a vedere chiaramente cosa stanno facendo, distingui qualcuno che inserisce un'asta in una piccola apertura, seguita subito dopo dall'apertura del portello.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	As the crew moves beyond your line of sight and communications cease, your unease grows steadily. You split your attention between the various screens in front of you and glancing out of the airlock. The clock on your suit's wrist keeps on ticking slowly.|2284|0
units.english: As the crew moves beyond your line of sight and communications cease, your unease grows steadily. You split your attention between the various screens in front of you and glancing out of the airlock. The clock on your suit's wrist keeps on ticking slowly.
units.italian: Mentre l'equipaggio esce dalla tua linea di vista e le comunicazioni cessano, il tuo disagio cresce costantemente. Dividi l'attenzione tra i vari schermi davanti a te e qualche occhiata fuori dalla camera di equilibrio. L'orologio al polso della tuta continua a scorrere lentamente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	Scanning over the monitors for the umpteenth time, you see that heightened energy levels have been detected inside the unknown creature.|2285|0
units.english: Scanning over the monitors for the umpteenth time, you see that heightened energy levels have been detected inside the unknown creature.
units.italian: Scorrendo i monitor per l'ennesima volta, vedi che sono stati rilevati livelli di energia elevati dentro la creatura sconosciuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Wait and see what happens.)|2287|0
units.english: (Wait and see what happens.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi che succede.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Shoot the Fetri'sei with my sidearm.)|2289|0
units.english: (Shoot the Fetri'sei with my sidearm.)
units.italian: (Sparo al Fetri'sei con l'arma da fianco.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	You take the weapon from the table and shoot the Fetri'sei just as the creature covers itself in rose-tinted sparks. According to Dusk, one shot should be enough to send the message through the impenetrable armor of the spacecraft, but nothing seems to happen after your gun's energy bolt disperses on the surface of the ship.|2290|0
units.english: You take the weapon from the table and shoot the Fetri'sei just as the creature covers itself in rose-tinted sparks. According to Dusk, one shot should be enough to send the message through the impenetrable armor of the spacecraft, but nothing seems to happen after your gun's energy bolt disperses on the surface of the ship.
units.italian: Prendi l'arma dal tavolo e spari al Fetri'sei proprio mentre la creatura si copre di scintille rosate. Secondo Dusk, un colpo dovrebbe bastare per far passare il messaggio attraverso la corazza impenetrabile della nave, ma nulla sembra accadere dopo che il dardo energetico della pistola si disperde sulla superficie.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	A second later, the creature covers itself in a burst of rose-colored sparks: it's about to jump away! You take the weapon from the table and pull the trigger, releasing a bolt of energy that quickly disperses on the surface of the Fetri'sei. According to Dusk's words, it should be enough to send the message through the impenetrable armor of the spacecraft, but nothing seems to happen after the shot.|2293|0
units.english: A second later, the creature covers itself in a burst of rose-colored sparks: it's about to jump away! You take the weapon from the table and pull the trigger, releasing a bolt of energy that quickly disperses on the surface of the Fetri'sei. According to Dusk's words, it should be enough to send the message through the impenetrable armor of the spacecraft, but nothing seems to happen after the shot.
units.italian: Un secondo dopo, la creatura si copre di un'esplosione di scintille rosate: sta per saltare via! Prendi l'arma dal tavolo e premi il grilletto, rilasciando un dardo di energia che si disperde rapidamente sulla superficie del Fetri'sei. Secondo le parole di Dusk, dovrebbe bastare per far passare il messaggio attraverso la corazza impenetrabile della nave, ma nulla sembra accadere dopo lo sparo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	Second after second passes relentlessly, with no reaction whatsoever from the Fetri'sei or its surroundings. As the unknown creature fades behind a violet cloud and jumps away, you can't help but wonder what to do.|2295|0
units.english: Second after second passes relentlessly, with no reaction whatsoever from the Fetri'sei or its surroundings. As the unknown creature fades behind a violet cloud and jumps away, you can't help but wonder what to do.
units.italian: I secondi passano inesorabili, senza alcuna reazione da parte del Fetri'sei o di ciò che lo circonda. Mentre la creatura sconosciuta svanisce dietro una nube viola e salta via, non puoi fare a meno di chiederti cosa fare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Shoot the Fetri'sei a second time.)|2297|0
units.english: (Shoot the Fetri'sei a second time.)
units.italian: (Sparo una seconda volta al Fetri'sei.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Keep waiting.)|2299|0
units.english: (Keep waiting.)
units.italian: (Continuo ad aspettare.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	(Jump on the Ka'sei to call the Remnant aboard.)|2301|0
units.english: (Jump on the Ka'sei to call the Remnant aboard.)
units.italian: (Salto sul Ka'sei per richiamare a bordo i Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	There's no time to waste. Without hesitation, you push yourself off the border of the airlock and toward the Fetri'sei. After remaining airborne for a few instants, you land right next to the leftmost engine nacelle, bouncing off its skin. A timely activation of the thrusters on your wrists helps you move back to its surface, however, and by grabbing a long spike attached to its back, you can finally stabilize and move further ahead.|2302|0
units.english: There's no time to waste. Without hesitation, you push yourself off the border of the airlock and toward the Fetri'sei. After remaining airborne for a few instants, you land right next to the leftmost engine nacelle, bouncing off its skin. A timely activation of the thrusters on your wrists helps you move back to its surface, however, and by grabbing a long spike attached to its back, you can finally stabilize and move further ahead.
units.italian: Non c'è tempo da perdere. Senza esitare, ti spingi dal bordo della camera di equilibrio verso il Fetri'sei. Dopo essere rimasto in volo per qualche istante, atterri proprio accanto alla gondola del motore più a sinistra, rimbalzando sulla sua superficie. Un'attivazione tempestiva dei propulsori ai polsi ti aiuta però a tornare sulla sua superficie, e afferrando un lungo aculeo fissato sul dorso riesci finalmente a stabilizzarti e ad avanzare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	White noise starts coming from your communicator; moving your head up, you finally see the Remnant leaping out of the hatch, carrying a dozen faintly glowing cylindrical tubes under their arms. They notice you right when communication returns to normal, and their message arrives loud and clear: "Jump!"|2303|0
units.english: White noise starts coming from your communicator; moving your head up, you finally see the Remnant leaping out of the hatch, carrying a dozen faintly glowing cylindrical tubes under their arms. They notice you right when communication returns to normal, and their message arrives loud and clear: "Jump!"
units.italian: Dalla radio comincia ad arrivare un fruscio bianco; alzando la testa, vedi finalmente i Remnant balzare fuori dal portello, con una dozzina di tubi cilindrici debolmente luminosi sottobraccio. Ti notano proprio quando le comunicazioni tornano normali, e il loro messaggio arriva forte e chiaro: "Salta!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	You leave the handles and use your feet to give you a good push away from the spacecraft. At the last second, you move to the right to avoid ending up behind one of its thrusters just as they roar to life. The Fetri'sei has awakened, and for an instant you see all of its systems activate at once - the engines, the steering, even the Ravagers.|2304|0
units.english: You leave the handles and use your feet to give you a good push away from the spacecraft. At the last second, you move to the right to avoid ending up behind one of its thrusters just as they roar to life. The Fetri'sei has awakened, and for an instant you see all of its systems activate at once - the engines, the steering, even the Ravagers.
units.italian: Lasci le maniglie e usi i piedi per darti una buona spinta via dalla nave. All'ultimo secondo ti sposti a destra per evitare di finire dietro uno dei suoi propulsori proprio mentre si riaccendono. Il Fetri'sei si è risvegliato, e per un istante vedi tutti i suoi sistemi attivarsi insieme: i motori, lo sterzo, persino i Devastatori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	You press the trigger once more, and the projectile again dissolves in the shield protecting the back of the Fetri'sei. For a few seconds still nothing seems to happen, but then, slowly, white noise starts coming from the communicator. Watching the spacecraft, you finally see the Remnant leaping out of the hatch, carrying a dozen faintly glowing cylindrical tubes under their arms.|2308|0
units.english: You press the trigger once more, and the projectile again dissolves in the shield protecting the back of the Fetri'sei. For a few seconds still nothing seems to happen, but then, slowly, white noise starts coming from the communicator. Watching the spacecraft, you finally see the Remnant leaping out of the hatch, carrying a dozen faintly glowing cylindrical tubes under their arms.
units.italian: Premi di nuovo il grilletto, e il proiettile si dissolve ancora nello scudo che protegge il retro del Fetri'sei. Per qualche secondo non sembra accadere nulla, ma poi, lentamente, dalla radio comincia ad arrivare un fruscio bianco. Guardando la nave, vedi finalmente i Remnant balzare fuori dal portello, con una dozzina di tubi cilindrici debolmente luminosi sottobraccio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	The wait is excruciating, but after a few seconds, you start hearing white noise coming from your headphones. Right as you start recognizing some words, one of the Remnant leaps out of the hatch, followed closely by the other four. Under their arms, you can distinguish a dozen cylindrical tubes, a faint glow surrounding them.|2311|0
units.english: The wait is excruciating, but after a few seconds, you start hearing white noise coming from your headphones. Right as you start recognizing some words, one of the Remnant leaps out of the hatch, followed closely by the other four. Under their arms, you can distinguish a dozen cylindrical tubes, a faint glow surrounding them.
units.italian: L'attesa è straziante, ma dopo qualche secondo cominci a sentire un fruscio bianco dalle cuffie. Proprio mentre cominci a riconoscere qualche parola, uno dei Remnant balza fuori dal portello, seguito da vicino dagli altri quattro. Sotto le loro braccia riesci a distinguere una dozzina di tubi cilindrici, avvolti da un debole bagliore.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	A flashing warning appears on the console: the energy readings of the other spacecraft are rising quickly. Right as you try to warn the rest of the group, the Ka'sei comes back to life, and for an instant you see all of its systems returning online at once - the engines, the steering, even the Ravagers.|2313|0
units.english: A flashing warning appears on the console: the energy readings of the other spacecraft are rising quickly. Right as you try to warn the rest of the group, the Ka'sei comes back to life, and for an instant you see all of its systems returning online at once - the engines, the steering, even the Ravagers.
units.italian: Sulla console appare un avviso lampeggiante: le letture energetiche dell'altra nave stanno salendo rapidamente. Proprio mentre cerchi di avvisare il resto del gruppo, il Ka'sei torna in vita, e per un istante vedi tutti i suoi sistemi tornare online insieme: i motori, lo sterzo, persino i Devastatori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	Amidst the chaos, you count that all five of them made it out of the hatch, still carrying some of the cylinders with them. They were able to leave before the spacecraft's thrusters started firing, and they seem to have remained relatively unharmed by the event. The Ka'sei moves further and further away.|2315|0
units.english: Amidst the chaos, you count that all five of them made it out of the hatch, still carrying some of the cylinders with them. They were able to leave before the spacecraft's thrusters started firing, and they seem to have remained relatively unharmed by the event. The Ka'sei moves further and further away.
units.italian: In mezzo al caos, conti che tutti e cinque sono usciti dal portello, portando ancora con sé alcuni dei cilindri. Sono riusciti a uscire prima che i propulsori della nave iniziassero a sparare, e sembrano essere rimasti relativamente illesi dall'evento. Il Ka'sei si allontana sempre di più.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	One at a time, they move back into the airlock, leaving their cargo attached to one of the instruments they carried with them. As you close the door and pressurize the compartment, Dusk approaches you about the mission.|2316|0
units.english: One at a time, they move back into the airlock, leaving their cargo attached to one of the instruments they carried with them. As you close the door and pressurize the compartment, Dusk approaches you about the mission.
units.italian: Uno alla volta, rientrano nella camera di equilibrio, lasciando il loro carico attaccato a uno degli strumenti che portavano con sé. Mentre chiudi la porta e pressurizzi il vano, Dusk si avvicina per parlarti della missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"Thank you for that, <first>. We had to cut short the exploration when we saw your message, before we had the chance to retrieve the specific data we were looking for. As a compromise, we decided to take some memory banks - these cylinders - with us, so we could search through the data later. It was dangerous, but it worked.|2317|0
units.english: "Thank you for that, <first>. We had to cut short the exploration when we saw your message, before we had the chance to retrieve the specific data we were looking for. As a compromise, we decided to take some memory banks - these cylinders - with us, so we could search through the data later. It was dangerous, but it worked.
units.italian: "Grazie per questo, <first>. Abbiamo dovuto interrompere l'esplorazione quando abbiamo visto il tuo messaggio, prima di avere la possibilità di recuperare i dati specifici che cercavamo. Come compromesso, abbiamo deciso di portare con noi alcuni banchi di memoria, questi cilindri, così da poter cercare tra i dati più tardi. È stato pericoloso, ma ha funzionato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	"That said, I suggest returning to the outpost as soon as possible. The Ka'sei we have boarded may start acting erratically after this, or it may even attack us; we have removed part of its brain, after all. Hopefully this mission will not backfire against us."|2318|0
units.english: "That said, I suggest returning to the outpost as soon as possible. The Ka'sei we have boarded may start acting erratically after this, or it may even attack us; we have removed part of its brain, after all. Hopefully this mission will not backfire against us."
units.italian: "Detto questo, suggerisco di tornare all'avamposto il prima possibile. Il Ka'sei che abbiamo abbordato potrebbe cominciare ad agire in modo irregolare dopo questo, o potrebbe persino attaccarci; dopo tutto gli abbiamo rimosso parte del cervello. Speriamo che questa missione non si ritorca contro di noi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2B|	You sit back in the cockpit, starting the engines once again.|2319|0
units.english: You sit back in the cockpit, starting the engines once again.
units.italian: Ti rimetti a sedere nella cabina, avviando di nuovo i motori.

units.id: event:Patir spaceport returns and Fetri spawn|spaceport|2341|0
units.context: event:Patir spaceport returns and Fetri spawn
units.english: The Remnant laboratory merges oddly well with the rest of the environment, similar in color and design to the Builder structures around here. The spaceport amounts to only a flat strip of regolith near the settlement, hastily cleaned of the debris that covers most of the terrain.
units.italian: Il laboratorio dei Remnant si fonde stranamente bene con il resto dell'ambiente, simile per colore e design alle strutture dei Costruttori qui intorno. Lo spazioporto si riduce a una striscia piatta di regolite vicino all'insediamento, ripulita in fretta dai detriti che coprono la maggior parte del terreno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2C|The giant creature stands before you, slowly pulsating in a pale pink halo. The bubbles that interrupt the asteroid-like surface are slightly semitransparent, giving you a brief look at the crystalline structure inside, but your mind soon returns to your time-limited mission, and you decide to move ahead before it's too late.|2359|0
units.english: The giant creature stands before you, slowly pulsating in a pale pink halo. The bubbles that interrupt the asteroid-like surface are slightly semitransparent, giving you a brief look at the crystalline structure inside, but your mind soon returns to your time-limited mission, and you decide to move ahead before it's too late.
units.italian: La creatura gigantesca ti sta davanti, pulsando lentamente in un alone rosa pallido. Le bolle che interrompono la superficie simile a un asteroide sono leggermente semitrasparenti, dandoti una breve occhiata alla struttura cristallina all'interno, ma la tua mente torna presto alla missione a tempo, e decidi di avanzare prima che sia troppo tardi.

units.id: ship:Fetri'sei|plural|2388|0
units.english: Fetri'seia
units.italian: Fetri'seia

units.id: ship:Fetri'sei|description|2440|0
units.english: The Fetri is a self replicating probe, built to harvest iridium away from the Graveyard and transport it back to the Builders.
units.italian: Il Fetri è una sonda autoreplicante, costruita per raccogliere iridio lontano dal Cimitero e trasportarlo ai Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|name|2484|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|description|2485|0
units.english: Now that the Patir black hole appears to have returned to the Milky Way, return to <planet> together with Dusk.
units.italian: Ora che il buco nero di Patir sembra essere tornato nella Via Lattea, torna su <planet> insieme a Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|The time has come: the walk toward the lab is quick and straightforward, and you cover the whole distance in a matter of minutes. Peeking through the hatch's window, you see the rest of the group preparing their backpacks, with prepacked toolboxes surrounding them in every direction. You wave through the glass, and they return the greeting.|2494|0
units.english: The time has come: the walk toward the lab is quick and straightforward, and you cover the whole distance in a matter of minutes. Peeking through the hatch's window, you see the rest of the group preparing their backpacks, with prepacked toolboxes surrounding them in every direction. You wave through the glass, and they return the greeting.
units.italian: È arrivato il momento: la camminata verso il laboratorio è rapida e diretta, e coprite l'intera distanza in pochi minuti. Dando un'occhiata dal finestrino del portello, vedi il resto del gruppo che prepara gli zaini, circondato in ogni direzione da casse di attrezzi già pronte. Saluti con la mano attraverso il vetro, e loro ricambiano.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	You move the airlock's heavy door to pass through, and wait for the room to be re-pressurized before walking in. By the time the hatch unlocks, however, the Remnant are gone, hastily leaving their bags on the floor.|2495|0
units.english: You move the airlock's heavy door to pass through, and wait for the room to be re-pressurized before walking in. By the time the hatch unlocks, however, the Remnant are gone, hastily leaving their bags on the floor.
units.italian: Sposti la pesante porta della camera di equilibrio per passare, e aspetti che la stanza sia ri-pressurizzata prima di entrare. Quando però il portello si sblocca, i Remnant sono spariti, lasciando in fretta le loro borse sul pavimento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	As you take a few steps inside the lab, you turn around to find them all glued to the windows with an awestruck gaze. The sky has again turned black, and a few dim lines are already starting to appear in the distance.|2496|0
units.english: As you take a few steps inside the lab, you turn around to find them all glued to the windows with an awestruck gaze. The sky has again turned black, and a few dim lines are already starting to appear in the distance.
units.italian: Mentre fai qualche passo dentro il laboratorio, ti volti e li trovi tutti incollati ai finestrini con lo sguardo stupefatto. Il cielo è tornato nero, e qualche linea debole comincia già ad apparire in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	While stars and galaxies zoom in the night sky, a few of the Remnant run around the lab, turning on various instruments. However, most of them remain with their faces stuck to the glass. The lights start converging toward a single point, forming a large, but rapidly shrinking mass in the background.|2497|0
units.english: While stars and galaxies zoom in the night sky, a few of the Remnant run around the lab, turning on various instruments. However, most of them remain with their faces stuck to the glass. The lights start converging toward a single point, forming a large, but rapidly shrinking mass in the background.
units.italian: Mentre stelle e galassie sfrecciano nel cielo notturno, alcuni dei Remnant corrono per il laboratorio, accendendo vari strumenti. Tuttavia la maggior parte resta con il viso incollato al vetro. Le luci cominciano a convergere verso un unico punto, formando una massa grande ma in rapido restringimento sullo sfondo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	The stars begin to slow down before settling into their final positions. After all the time you have spent here, it isn't difficult to recognize that the sky has changed again. Next to you, the rest of the team is already analyzing the data gathered; Dusk seems to be writing down something from a chronometer.|2498|0
units.english: The stars begin to slow down before settling into their final positions. After all the time you have spent here, it isn't difficult to recognize that the sky has changed again. Next to you, the rest of the team is already analyzing the data gathered; Dusk seems to be writing down something from a chronometer.
units.italian: Le stelle cominciano a rallentare prima di fermarsi nelle loro posizioni finali. Dopo tutto il tempo passato qui, non è difficile riconoscere che il cielo è cambiato di nuovo. Accanto a te, il resto della squadra sta già analizzando i dati raccolti; Dusk sembra annotare qualcosa da un cronometro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	"Are we back in the Milky Way?"|2500|0
units.english: "Are we back in the Milky Way?"
units.italian: "Siamo tornati nella Via Lattea?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	"How long was that?"|2501|0
units.english: "How long was that?"
units.italian: "Quanto è durato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	"Where are we now?"|2503|0
units.english: "Where are we now?"
units.italian: "Dove siamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	"I cannot say yet," Dusk replies hurriedly. "Quick, put your EVA suit back on. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.|2504|0
units.english: "I cannot say yet," Dusk replies hurriedly. "Quick, put your EVA suit back on. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.
units.italian: "Non posso ancora dirlo," risponde Dusk in fretta. "Presto, rimettiti la tuta EVA. Dobbiamo partire il prima possibile, tutti insieme. Non so quanto tempo abbiamo." Ricolleghi in fretta il casco al supporto vitale e li segui fuori dalla camera di equilibrio, cercando di stare al passo come puoi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	"Around four minutes," Dusk replies hurriedly. "But we will talk about that another time. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.|2508|0
units.english: "Around four minutes," Dusk replies hurriedly. "But we will talk about that another time. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.
units.italian: "Circa quattro minuti," risponde Dusk in fretta. "Ma ne parleremo un'altra volta. Dobbiamo partire il prima possibile, tutti insieme. Non so quanto tempo abbiamo." Ricolleghi in fretta il casco al supporto vitale e li segui fuori dalla camera di equilibrio, cercando di stare al passo come puoi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.1|	It takes only a few minutes to launch the <ship>, the six of you standing in the cockpit with trepidation. "We will take care of the necessary analysis while you bring us to orbit. Hopefully we have been sent to the Milky Way, and not to yet another unreachable galaxy."|2510|0
units.english: It takes only a few minutes to launch the <ship>, the six of you standing in the cockpit with trepidation. "We will take care of the necessary analysis while you bring us to orbit. Hopefully we have been sent to the Milky Way, and not to yet another unreachable galaxy."
units.italian: Ci vogliono solo pochi minuti per lanciare la <ship>, voi sei in piedi nella cabina con trepidazione. "Noi ci occuperemo delle analisi necessarie mentre tu ci porti in orbita. Speriamo che siamo stati inviati nella Via Lattea, e non in un'altra galassia irraggiungibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|name|2525|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|description|2526|0
units.english: Now that the Patir black hole appears to have returned to the Milky Way, return to <planet> together with Dusk.
units.italian: Ora che il buco nero di Patir sembra essere tornato nella Via Lattea, torna su <planet> insieme a Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|Back down on the surface, you complete the post-landing checklist while keeping an eye on the movements of the Ka'sei. The research station has been a safe place to retreat during past expeditions, but it seems doubtful that it could last against a prolonged attack from one of the Fetri'sei.|2534|0
units.english: Back down on the surface, you complete the post-landing checklist while keeping an eye on the movements of the Ka'sei. The research station has been a safe place to retreat during past expeditions, but it seems doubtful that it could last against a prolonged attack from one of the Fetri'sei.
units.italian: Di nuovo sulla superficie, completi la lista di controllo post-atterraggio tenendo d'occhio i movimenti dei Ka'sei. La stazione di ricerca è stata un luogo sicuro in cui ritirarsi durante le spedizioni passate, ma sembra dubbio che possa resistere a un attacco prolungato da parte di uno dei Fetri'sei.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	When the scientists finish unloading their cargo, Dusk calls you with the communicator. Now that the immediate danger is over, a hint of frustration creeps into his voice.|2535|0
units.english: When the scientists finish unloading their cargo, Dusk calls you with the communicator. Now that the immediate danger is over, a hint of frustration creeps into his voice.
units.italian: Quando gli scienziati finiscono di scaricare il loro carico, Dusk ti chiama al comunicatore. Ora che il pericolo immediato è passato, una punta di frustrazione si insinua nella sua voce.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"The cells we have taken from the Fetri are only a few out of multiple hundreds. We did our best to choose those that were recorded at times when those beings were present, but we will still need some luck to get the results we wanted.|2536|0
units.english: "The cells we have taken from the Fetri are only a few out of multiple hundreds. We did our best to choose those that were recorded at times when those beings were present, but we will still need some luck to get the results we wanted.
units.italian: "Le celle che abbiamo preso dal Fetri sono solo poche rispetto a diverse centinaia. Abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scegliere quelle registrate nei momenti in cui quegli esseri erano presenti, ma ci servirà comunque un po' di fortuna per ottenere i risultati che volevamo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"Our calculators have been crunching numbers for hours now, ever since we cracked open the first canister. By the time you have reached the lab, we should have the analysis ready." You close the hatch behind you to join the rest of the crew.|2537|0
units.english: "Our calculators have been crunching numbers for hours now, ever since we cracked open the first canister. By the time you have reached the lab, we should have the analysis ready." You close the hatch behind you to join the rest of the crew.
units.italian: "I nostri calcolatori stanno macinando numeri da ore, da quando abbiamo aperto il primo contenitore. Quando avrai raggiunto il laboratorio, dovremmo avere l'analisi pronta." Chiudi il portello alle tue spalle per unirti al resto dell'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	As the asteroid continues its nearly imperceptible spin, Patir emerges from behind the giant dome, allowing its rays to pass through. You take the last steps towards the outpost with the sunshade lowered and walk into the lab once more.|2538|0
units.english: As the asteroid continues its nearly imperceptible spin, Patir emerges from behind the giant dome, allowing its rays to pass through. You take the last steps towards the outpost with the sunshade lowered and walk into the lab once more.
units.italian: Mentre l'asteroide continua la sua rotazione quasi impercettibile, Patir emerge da dietro la cupola gigantesca, lasciando passare i suoi raggi. Fai gli ultimi passi verso l'avamposto con la visiera abbassata ed entri di nuovo nel laboratorio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	The module was never particularly inviting, but over the last few weeks, a thin layer of dust coming from outside the asteroid has covered the floor, with just the surfaces needed for the research kept clean. Tiredness plagues the faces of the scientists: they must not have slept much in the past days to keep up with the amount of incoming data, and neither have you. As you try to remember the last time you stepped outside without a suit - at least a month, most likely - your stream of thoughts is interrupted by the arrival of Dusk, carrying in his hands a ream of papers.|2539|0
units.english: The module was never particularly inviting, but over the last few weeks, a thin layer of dust coming from outside the asteroid has covered the floor, with just the surfaces needed for the research kept clean. Tiredness plagues the faces of the scientists: they must not have slept much in the past days to keep up with the amount of incoming data, and neither have you. As you try to remember the last time you stepped outside without a suit - at least a month, most likely - your stream of thoughts is interrupted by the arrival of Dusk, carrying in his hands a ream of papers.
units.italian: Il modulo non è mai stato particolarmente accogliente, ma nelle ultime settimane uno strato sottile di polvere proveniente dall'esterno dell'asteroide ha coperto il pavimento, lasciando pulite solo le superfici necessarie alla ricerca. La stanchezza segna i volti degli scienziati: non devono aver dormito molto negli ultimi giorni per stare dietro alla quantità di dati in arrivo, e nemmeno tu. Mentre cerchi di ricordare l'ultima volta che sei uscito senza tuta, almeno un mese, probabilmente, il flusso dei tuoi pensieri viene interrotto dall'arrivo di Dusk, con in mano una risma di fogli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"The information in the memory containers is indeed from when one of those beings was in the system, and the data recorded was far more comprehensive than our own scans. However, the memory containers we extracted only contain records from the middle of the phenomenon, without showing how it begun or ended. Additionally, understanding their contents is going to take longer than we hoped for. We knew that the exact relationship between the being and the Fetri'sei would be beyond our knowledge, but we cannot even make preliminary guesses as to how they are able to communicate.|2540|0
units.english: "The information in the memory containers is indeed from when one of those beings was in the system, and the data recorded was far more comprehensive than our own scans. However, the memory containers we extracted only contain records from the middle of the phenomenon, without showing how it begun or ended. Additionally, understanding their contents is going to take longer than we hoped for. We knew that the exact relationship between the being and the Fetri'sei would be beyond our knowledge, but we cannot even make preliminary guesses as to how they are able to communicate.
units.italian: "Le informazioni nei contenitori di memoria provengono effettivamente da quando uno di quegli esseri era nel sistema, e i dati registrati erano molto più completi delle nostre scansioni. Tuttavia i contenitori di memoria che abbiamo estratto contengono solo registrazioni dalla metà del fenomeno, senza mostrare come è iniziato o finito. Inoltre, capirne il contenuto richiederà più tempo di quanto sperassimo. Sapevamo che l'esatta relazione tra l'essere e i Fetri'sei sarebbe stata al di là delle nostre conoscenze, ma non possiamo nemmeno fare ipotesi preliminari su come riescano a comunicare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"We have enough consumables to last for many weeks still; we started rationing as soon as we arrived in this sector, and we are prepared to reduce them further if necessary. Despite this, the time and manpower needed to crack this code would go far beyond what we could feasibly achieve. We have hit a roadblock that, for now, we cannot overcome."|2541|0
units.english: "We have enough consumables to last for many weeks still; we started rationing as soon as we arrived in this sector, and we are prepared to reduce them further if necessary. Despite this, the time and manpower needed to crack this code would go far beyond what we could feasibly achieve. We have hit a roadblock that, for now, we cannot overcome."
units.italian: "Abbiamo consumabili sufficienti per molte settimane; abbiamo iniziato a razionarli appena arrivati in questo settore, e siamo pronti a ridurli ulteriormente se necessario. Nonostante questo, il tempo e la manodopera necessari per decifrare questo codice andrebbero ben oltre ciò che potremmo realisticamente ottenere. Abbiamo incontrato un ostacolo che, per ora, non possiamo superare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"Does this mean we need to repeat the mission?"|2543|0
units.english: "Does this mean we need to repeat the mission?"
units.italian: "Questo significa che dobbiamo ripetere la missione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"What are our options?"|2544|0
units.english: "What are our options?"
units.italian: "Quali sono le nostre opzioni?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"We considered it briefly, but it would be quite ineffective. Our blocker is understanding the data itself, and having even more would do little to help us with that. On top of that, the risk would be extremely high, as we have seen. All things considered, we are at the same point we were a week ago.|2546|0
units.english: "We considered it briefly, but it would be quite ineffective. Our blocker is understanding the data itself, and having even more would do little to help us with that. On top of that, the risk would be extremely high, as we have seen. All things considered, we are at the same point we were a week ago.
units.italian: "L'abbiamo considerato brevemente, ma sarebbe piuttosto inefficace. Il nostro ostacolo è capire i dati stessi, e averne ancora di più aiuterebbe poco. In più, il rischio sarebbe estremamente alto, come abbiamo visto. Tutto considerato, siamo nello stesso punto di una settimana fa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"We are left with few alternatives. As I told you previously, the Chanai station is an interesting possibility, and could have influenced Patir's erratic behavior. At the same time, exploring the asteroid around Lathia may put us closer to understanding the inner workings of the beings and how they interact with the Ka'sei. It is quite dangerous, but visiting the space station is also an unknown, and maybe a more direct approach is what we need to accomplish our objective. Neither mission prevails over the other in a definite way, and our votes within the team are split evenly between the two, so if y-"|2548|0
units.english: "We are left with few alternatives. As I told you previously, the Chanai station is an interesting possibility, and could have influenced Patir's erratic behavior. At the same time, exploring the asteroid around Lathia may put us closer to understanding the inner workings of the beings and how they interact with the Ka'sei. It is quite dangerous, but visiting the space station is also an unknown, and maybe a more direct approach is what we need to accomplish our objective. Neither mission prevails over the other in a definite way, and our votes within the team are split evenly between the two, so if y-"
units.italian: "Ci restano poche alternative. Come ti ho detto prima, la stazione di Chanai è una possibilità interessante, e potrebbe aver influenzato il comportamento irregolare di Patir. Allo stesso tempo, esplorare l'asteroide attorno a Lathia potrebbe avvicinarci alla comprensione del funzionamento interno degli esseri e di come interagiscono con i Ka'sei. È piuttosto pericoloso, ma visitare la stazione spaziale è anch'esso un'incognita, e forse un approccio più diretto è ciò che ci serve per raggiungere il nostro obiettivo. Nessuna delle due missioni prevale chiaramente sull'altra, e i voti nella squadra sono equamente divisi tra le due, quindi se t-"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	Dusk halts mid phrase, looking behind you with an awestruck gaze. The sky has again turned black, and a few dim lines are already starting to appear in the distance. The whole team jumps to the windows, watching as the light show begins.|2549|0
units.english: Dusk halts mid phrase, looking behind you with an awestruck gaze. The sky has again turned black, and a few dim lines are already starting to appear in the distance. The whole team jumps to the windows, watching as the light show begins.
units.italian: Dusk si interrompe a metà frase, guardando dietro di te con lo sguardo stupefatto. Il cielo è tornato nero, e qualche linea debole comincia già ad apparire in lontananza. L'intera squadra salta ai finestrini, guardando mentre lo spettacolo di luci comincia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	While stars and galaxies zoom in the night sky, two Remnant keep running around the lab, turning on various instruments. However, the rest of them remain with their faces stuck to the glass with you. The lights start converging toward a single point, forming a large, but rapidly shrinking mass in the background.|2550|0
units.english: While stars and galaxies zoom in the night sky, two Remnant keep running around the lab, turning on various instruments. However, the rest of them remain with their faces stuck to the glass with you. The lights start converging toward a single point, forming a large, but rapidly shrinking mass in the background.
units.italian: Mentre stelle e galassie sfrecciano nel cielo notturno, due Remnant continuano a correre per il laboratorio, accendendo vari strumenti. Tuttavia gli altri restano con il viso incollato al vetro insieme a te. Le luci cominciano a convergere verso un unico punto, formando una massa grande ma in rapido restringimento sullo sfondo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	The stars begin to slow down before settling into their final positions. After all the time you have spent here, it isn't difficult to recognize that the sky has changed again. Next to you, the rest of the team is already analyzing the data gathered; Dusk seems to be writing down something from a chronometer.|2551|0
units.english: The stars begin to slow down before settling into their final positions. After all the time you have spent here, it isn't difficult to recognize that the sky has changed again. Next to you, the rest of the team is already analyzing the data gathered; Dusk seems to be writing down something from a chronometer.
units.italian: Le stelle cominciano a rallentare prima di fermarsi nelle loro posizioni finali. Dopo tutto il tempo passato qui, non è difficile riconoscere che il cielo è cambiato di nuovo. Accanto a te, il resto della squadra sta già analizzando i dati raccolti; Dusk sembra annotare qualcosa da un cronometro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"Are we back in the Milky Way?"|2555|0
units.english: "Are we back in the Milky Way?"
units.italian: "Siamo tornati nella Via Lattea?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"How long was that?"|2556|0
units.english: "How long was that?"
units.italian: "Quanto è durato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"Where are we now?"|2558|0
units.english: "Where are we now?"
units.italian: "Dove siamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"I cannot say yet," Dusk replies hurriedly. "Quick, put your EVA suit back on. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.|2559|0
units.english: "I cannot say yet," Dusk replies hurriedly. "Quick, put your EVA suit back on. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.
units.italian: "Non posso ancora dirlo," risponde Dusk in fretta. "Presto, rimettiti la tuta EVA. Dobbiamo partire il prima possibile, tutti insieme. Non so quanto tempo abbiamo." Ricolleghi in fretta il casco al supporto vitale e li segui fuori dalla camera di equilibrio, cercando di stare al passo come puoi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	"Around four minutes," Dusk replies hurriedly. "But we will talk about that another time. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.|2563|0
units.english: "Around four minutes," Dusk replies hurriedly. "But we will talk about that another time. We need to depart as soon as possible, all of us together. I do not know how much time we have." You hastily connect your helmet back to the life support and follow them out of the airlock, trying to keep up as best as you can.
units.italian: "Circa quattro minuti," risponde Dusk in fretta. "Ma ne parleremo un'altra volta. Dobbiamo partire il prima possibile, tutti insieme. Non so quanto tempo abbiamo." Ricolleghi in fretta il casco al supporto vitale e li segui fuori dalla camera di equilibrio, cercando di stare al passo come puoi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 13.2|	It takes only a few minutes to launch the <ship>, the six of you standing in the cockpit with trepidation. "We will take care of the necessary analysis while you bring us to orbit. Hopefully we have been sent to the Milky Way, and not to yet another unreachable galaxy."|2565|0
units.english: It takes only a few minutes to launch the <ship>, the six of you standing in the cockpit with trepidation. "We will take care of the necessary analysis while you bring us to orbit. Hopefully we have been sent to the Milky Way, and not to yet another unreachable galaxy."
units.italian: Ci vogliono solo pochi minuti per lanciare la <ship>, voi sei in piedi nella cabina con trepidazione. "Noi ci occuperemo delle analisi necessarie mentre tu ci porti in orbita. Speriamo che siamo stati inviati nella Via Lattea, e non in un'altra galassia irraggiungibile."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on enter|The cockpit has become quite chaotic: the instruments the team brought with them keep buzzing and beeping. After shutting down the main engines, someone taps on your shoulder to call your attention. "<first>, could you pitch the ship down a few degrees?" Dusk asks, with a calmer look than during liftoff. You reply with a nod, and move the stick forward slightly.|2588|0
units.english: The cockpit has become quite chaotic: the instruments the team brought with them keep buzzing and beeping. After shutting down the main engines, someone taps on your shoulder to call your attention. "<first>, could you pitch the ship down a few degrees?" Dusk asks, with a calmer look than during liftoff. You reply with a nod, and move the stick forward slightly.
units.italian: La cabina è diventata piuttosto caotica: gli strumenti che la squadra ha portato con sé continuano a ronzare e bippare. Dopo aver spento i motori principali, qualcuno ti tocca la spalla per attirare la tua attenzione. "<first>, potresti inclinare la nave verso il basso di qualche grado?" chiede Dusk, con uno sguardo più calmo che al decollo. Rispondi con un cenno, e sposti leggermente la cloche in avanti.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on enter|	"There! Do you see it?" he continues, pointing at a spot in the sky with his hand. Between the mass of stars in front of you, a pattern leaps to the eye: two sets of three stars, right next to each other, forming a prism-like structure. "We are back."|2589|0
units.english: "There! Do you see it?" he continues, pointing at a spot in the sky with his hand. Between the mass of stars in front of you, a pattern leaps to the eye: two sets of three stars, right next to each other, forming a prism-like structure. "We are back."
units.italian: "Ecco! Lo vedi?" continua, indicando un punto nel cielo con la mano. Tra la massa di stelle davanti a te, un disegno salta all'occhio: due gruppi di tre stelle, uno accanto all'altro, che formano una struttura simile a un prisma. "Siamo tornati."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|A large crowd quickly gathers around your landing pad, eagerly awaiting your arrival. After all this time between the stars, setting foot on a planet with an actual atmosphere is incredibly refreshing. Ignoring the cold weather for a moment, you take the biggest breath you can to make up for the past weeks of recycled air.|2593|0
units.english: A large crowd quickly gathers around your landing pad, eagerly awaiting your arrival. After all this time between the stars, setting foot on a planet with an actual atmosphere is incredibly refreshing. Ignoring the cold weather for a moment, you take the biggest breath you can to make up for the past weeks of recycled air.
units.italian: Una grande folla si raduna rapidamente attorno alla tua piazzola di atterraggio, in attesa impaziente del tuo arrivo. Dopo tutto questo tempo tra le stelle, posare il piede su un pianeta con un'atmosfera vera è incredibilmente ristoratore. Ignorando per un momento il freddo, fai il respiro più profondo che puoi per recuperare dalle settimane di aria riciclata.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	Before you've even reached the end of the ramp, the people on the ground are already signing questions to you and the rest of the team about your journey. You do your best to reply, but in the overall mix of confusion and excitement you aren't sure anyone understood what you just said.|2594|0
units.english: Before you've even reached the end of the ramp, the people on the ground are already signing questions to you and the rest of the team about your journey. You do your best to reply, but in the overall mix of confusion and excitement you aren't sure anyone understood what you just said.
units.italian: Prima ancora che tu abbia raggiunto la fine della rampa, le persone a terra ti stanno già accennando domande a te e al resto della squadra sul vostro viaggio. Fai del tuo meglio per rispondere, ma nella confusione e nell'eccitazione generale non sei sicuro che qualcuno abbia capito quello che hai appena detto.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	Between the chaos, you hear a familiar voice singing your name: a few meters on your left, you notice Chilia with his arm raised and a large grin greeting you back. Moving across the crowd not without some difficulty, you follow him through a narrow door inside a cramped room right next to the pad.|2595|0
units.english: Between the chaos, you hear a familiar voice singing your name: a few meters on your left, you notice Chilia with his arm raised and a large grin greeting you back. Moving across the crowd not without some difficulty, you follow him through a narrow door inside a cramped room right next to the pad.
units.italian: Tra il caos, senti una voce familiare che canta il tuo nome: a qualche metro alla tua sinistra, noti Chilia con il braccio alzato e un gran sorriso che ti saluta. Muovendoti tra la folla non senza qualche difficoltà, lo segui attraverso una porta stretta in una stanza angusta proprio accanto alla piazzola.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"I prefer this spaceport when it is more hushed," he remarks with a sigh, "but after the past weeks some frenzy is understandable. We will have to make do with this warehouse for now." He invites you to take a seat. "So, <first>, would you tell me about your journey?"|2596|0
units.english: "I prefer this spaceport when it is more hushed," he remarks with a sigh, "but after the past weeks some frenzy is understandable. We will have to make do with this warehouse for now." He invites you to take a seat. "So, <first>, would you tell me about your journey?"
units.italian: "Preferisco questo spazioporto quando è più tranquillo," osserva con un sospiro, "ma dopo le ultime settimane un po' di frenesia è comprensibile. Per ora dovremo accontentarci di questo magazzino." Ti invita a sederti. "Allora, <first>, mi racconti del tuo viaggio?"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	By the time you're done, more than an hour must have passed. Chilia paces aimlessly around the room, reflecting on your recounting of the events. As silence falls, you notice that calm seems to have returned on the pad as well.|2597|0
units.english: By the time you're done, more than an hour must have passed. Chilia paces aimlessly around the room, reflecting on your recounting of the events. As silence falls, you notice that calm seems to have returned on the pad as well.
units.italian: Quando hai finito, sarà passata più di un'ora. Chilia va avanti e indietro senza meta per la stanza, riflettendo sul tuo racconto degli eventi. Mentre cala il silenzio, noti che anche sulla piazzola sembra essere tornata la calma.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	(Wait for him to speak.)|2599|0
units.english: (Wait for him to speak.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che parli.)

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"Do you know how we came back to this galaxy?"|2601|0
units.english: "Do you know how we came back to this galaxy?"
units.italian: "Sai come siamo tornati in questa galassia?"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"What happened while we were gone?"|2602|0
units.english: "What happened while we were gone?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo mentre eravamo via?"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"Oh. I thought you had been told already." He sits down in front of you. "It was us that brought Patir back here. After your departure, it did not take long for our long-range sensors to pick up that the black hole had disappeared, along with you and the team. Our data was scarce, but we knew one, very important thing: if Patir had appeared here once, there must have been a way to do that again.|2603|0
units.english: "Oh. I thought you had been told already." He sits down in front of you. "It was us that brought Patir back here. After your departure, it did not take long for our long-range sensors to pick up that the black hole had disappeared, along with you and the team. Our data was scarce, but we knew one, very important thing: if Patir had appeared here once, there must have been a way to do that again.
units.italian: "Oh. Pensavo che te l'avessero già detto." Si siede davanti a te. "Siamo stati noi a riportare Patir qui. Dopo la vostra partenza, non ci è voluto molto perché i nostri sensori a lungo raggio rilevassero che il buco nero era sparito, insieme a voi e alla squadra. I nostri dati erano scarsi, ma sapevamo una cosa molto importante: se Patir era apparso qui una volta, doveva esserci un modo per farlo di nuovo.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"If your description is accurate, it means Patir is not another mouth to a pocket universe, but instead a transporter to another galaxy. Or universe, for all we know. In retrospect, there were enough reasons to doubt that first theory, but we were far too busy trying to save you to look into it seriously." Seeing your confused expression, he continues. "<first>, it was us who brought Patir back here.|2606|0
units.english: "If your description is accurate, it means Patir is not another mouth to a pocket universe, but instead a transporter to another galaxy. Or universe, for all we know. In retrospect, there were enough reasons to doubt that first theory, but we were far too busy trying to save you to look into it seriously." Seeing your confused expression, he continues. "<first>, it was us who brought Patir back here.
units.italian: "Se la tua descrizione è accurata, significa che Patir non è un'altra bocca di un universo tascabile, ma un trasportatore verso un'altra galassia. O universo, per quanto ne sappiamo. Ripensandoci, c'erano abbastanza motivi per dubitare di quella prima teoria, ma eravamo troppo impegnati a cercare di salvarvi per approfondirla seriamente." Vedendo la tua espressione confusa, continua. "<first>, siamo stati noi a riportare Patir qui.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"We knew Postverta was involved with Patir's initial arrival, and together with the team there, we discovered that the energy burst that had been released when Ssil Vida first appeared had no relation to the systems controlling its pocket universe. So, its activation or deactivation would have no effect on Patir, and we had to start looking somewhere else.|2608|0
units.english: "We knew Postverta was involved with Patir's initial arrival, and together with the team there, we discovered that the energy burst that had been released when Ssil Vida first appeared had no relation to the systems controlling its pocket universe. So, its activation or deactivation would have no effect on Patir, and we had to start looking somewhere else.
units.italian: "Sapevamo che Postverta era coinvolta nell'arrivo iniziale di Patir, e insieme alla squadra laggiù abbiamo scoperto che l'esplosione di energia rilasciata quando Ssil Vida è apparso per la prima volta non aveva alcun rapporto con i sistemi che controllano il suo universo tascabile. Quindi la sua attivazione o disattivazione non avrebbe avuto alcun effetto su Patir, e abbiamo dovuto cominciare a cercare altrove.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"Our research up to this point had mostly focused on the pocket universe; most of Postverta is still obscure to us. As we evaluated our options, we determined that, by the time we could understand the station's systems enough to use them for our purposes, your crew would have already run out of supplies and perished. Instead, we attempted to replicate the energy burst using just our technology, augmented by the transmission systems of Ssil Vida.|2609|0
units.english: "Our research up to this point had mostly focused on the pocket universe; most of Postverta is still obscure to us. As we evaluated our options, we determined that, by the time we could understand the station's systems enough to use them for our purposes, your crew would have already run out of supplies and perished. Instead, we attempted to replicate the energy burst using just our technology, augmented by the transmission systems of Ssil Vida.
units.italian: "La nostra ricerca fino a questo punto si era concentrata soprattutto sull'universo tascabile; gran parte di Postverta ci è ancora oscura. Mentre valutavamo le opzioni, abbiamo stabilito che, per quando avessimo capito i sistemi della stazione abbastanza da usarli per i nostri scopi, il tuo equipaggio avrebbe già esaurito le scorte e sarebbe perito. Invece, abbiamo tentato di replicare l'esplosione di energia usando solo la nostra tecnologia, potenziata dai sistemi di trasmissione di Ssil Vida.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"The project took most of our workforce, as well as several weeks to complete, no thanks to a number of setbacks almost making us start over from scratch. But with the full power of the onboard reactors and an array of calculators rivaling that of our largest outposts, its giant antennae came back to life, and released a wave as strong as when Ssil Vida appeared. Two weeks later, Patir returned, and now you are here, safe and sound."|2610|0
units.english: "The project took most of our workforce, as well as several weeks to complete, no thanks to a number of setbacks almost making us start over from scratch. But with the full power of the onboard reactors and an array of calculators rivaling that of our largest outposts, its giant antennae came back to life, and released a wave as strong as when Ssil Vida appeared. Two weeks later, Patir returned, and now you are here, safe and sound."
units.italian: "Il progetto ha impegnato la maggior parte della nostra forza lavoro, oltre a diverse settimane, e non certo grazie a una serie di contrattempi che ci hanno quasi costretto a ricominciare da zero. Ma con tutta la potenza dei reattori di bordo e una serie di calcolatori paragonabile a quella dei nostri avamposti più grandi, le sue antenne gigantesche sono tornate in vita e hanno rilasciato un'onda forte quanto quella di quando Ssil Vida è apparso. Due settimane dopo, Patir è tornato, e ora eccoti qui, sano e salvo."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	Finally, a tired Dusk reaches the two of you in the storage room, sitting down after greeting Chilia and you. From a brief exchange between them, you infer that he has also been told of the circumstances around your return.|2611|0
units.english: Finally, a tired Dusk reaches the two of you in the storage room, sitting down after greeting Chilia and you. From a brief exchange between them, you infer that he has also been told of the circumstances around your return.
units.italian: Alla fine, un Dusk stanco vi raggiunge nella stanza di stoccaggio, sedendosi dopo aver salutato Chilia e te. Da un breve scambio tra loro, deduci che anche a lui sono state raccontate le circostanze del tuo ritorno.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"What is going to happen to Patir now?"|2613|0
units.english: "What is going to happen to Patir now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa succederà a Patir adesso?"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"Wait, what if we were not around Patir when it came back?"|2615|0
units.english: "Wait, what if we were not around Patir when it came back?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, e se non fossimo stati vicini a Patir quando è tornato?"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"The black hole would have departed without us, and we would have been still stuck in that sector - only this time without a laboratory to support us, nor most of our consumables. The people down here perhaps could have been able to send Patir back there to pick us up, but by then we would have run out of supplies long before, and perished between the stars. We were lucky that things went the way they did, all things considered. Our research in those systems was supposed to bring us back, and yet we were just chasing rainbows, endangering ourselves further every step we took.|2616|0
units.english: "The black hole would have departed without us, and we would have been still stuck in that sector - only this time without a laboratory to support us, nor most of our consumables. The people down here perhaps could have been able to send Patir back there to pick us up, but by then we would have run out of supplies long before, and perished between the stars. We were lucky that things went the way they did, all things considered. Our research in those systems was supposed to bring us back, and yet we were just chasing rainbows, endangering ourselves further every step we took.
units.italian: "Il buco nero se ne sarebbe andato senza di noi, e saremmo rimasti bloccati in quel settore, solo questa volta senza un laboratorio a sostenerci, né la maggior parte dei nostri consumabili. Le persone quaggiù forse sarebbero riuscite a rimandare Patir là a prenderci, ma ormai avremmo esaurito le scorte molto prima, e saremmo periti tra le stelle. Tutto considerato, siamo stati fortunati che le cose siano andate come sono andate. La nostra ricerca in quei sistemi doveva riportarci indietro, eppure stavamo solo inseguendo chimere, mettendo noi stessi in pericolo a ogni passo.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"It is difficult to say. Given what we have observed, it will probably disappear once again after the effects of our energy burst; when that will happen or where it will go is beyond our current knowledge. Those same systems we were stuck in could now be inaccessible, and our data might be the only information we will ever gather on them.|2620|0
units.english: "It is difficult to say. Given what we have observed, it will probably disappear once again after the effects of our energy burst; when that will happen or where it will go is beyond our current knowledge. Those same systems we were stuck in could now be inaccessible, and our data might be the only information we will ever gather on them.
units.italian: "È difficile dirlo. Da quello che abbiamo osservato, probabilmente sparirà di nuovo dopo gli effetti della nostra esplosione di energia; quando accadrà o dove andrà è oltre le nostre conoscenze attuali. Quegli stessi sistemi in cui eravamo bloccati potrebbero ora essere inaccessibili, e i nostri dati potrebbero essere le uniche informazioni che riusciremo mai a raccogliere su di essi.

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"At this point in time, exploring Patir would be a gamble, and an extremely risky one at that. The next phase will have to be operated from a distance, in order to fully understand the way that system works and how Ssil Vida controls it. How much time that will take, I cannot say; maybe weeks, or months, or even years. But then, and only then, will we go back there and start digging deeper."|2622|0
units.english: "At this point in time, exploring Patir would be a gamble, and an extremely risky one at that. The next phase will have to be operated from a distance, in order to fully understand the way that system works and how Ssil Vida controls it. How much time that will take, I cannot say; maybe weeks, or months, or even years. But then, and only then, will we go back there and start digging deeper."
units.italian: "A questo punto, esplorare Patir sarebbe un azzardo, e estremamente rischioso per giunta. La fase successiva dovrà essere condotta a distanza, per capire a fondo come funziona quel sistema e come Ssil Vida lo controlla. Quanto tempo richiederà non posso dirlo; forse settimane, o mesi, o persino anni. Ma poi, e solo allora, torneremo là e cominceremo a scavare più a fondo."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"I understand."|2624|0
units.english: "I understand."
units.italian: "Ho capito."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	"You want to return there?!"|2626|0
units.english: "You want to return there?!"
