units.italian: "Vuoi tornarci?!"

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	Dusk smiles. "It is my job, after all. The danger of the unknown is always a part of it, even in the simplest of missions. I do admit the risk in these past weeks was far beyond an acceptable level, but one day, we will know enough about the mess in which we have become tangled in to unravel it."|2627|0
units.english: Dusk smiles. "It is my job, after all. The danger of the unknown is always a part of it, even in the simplest of missions. I do admit the risk in these past weeks was far beyond an acceptable level, but one day, we will know enough about the mess in which we have become tangled in to unravel it."
units.italian: Dusk sorride. "Dopo tutto è il mio lavoro. Il pericolo dell'ignoto ne fa sempre parte, anche nelle missioni più semplici. Ammetto che il rischio delle ultime settimane è andato ben oltre un livello accettabile, ma un giorno sapremo abbastanza del pasticcio in cui ci siamo cacciati da districarlo."

units.id: conversation:end of Patir 2 - on complete|	The two of them accompany you to the <ship>, sitting alone in the now-quiet spaceport of <planet>. The cargo bay has been emptied of the vast array of instruments that had been lying in it for a while, and you guess the same has been done with the cockpit. As you walk once again up the stairway, the Remnant bid you farewell. "We have transferred <payment> as a way to express our gratitude," Dusk signs with a smile. "Of course, their worth is incomparable with the value of what you have done for us; without you, we would have never made it out alive. Goodbye for now, and may the Embers aid in your pursuits."|2629|0
units.english: The two of them accompany you to the <ship>, sitting alone in the now-quiet spaceport of <planet>. The cargo bay has been emptied of the vast array of instruments that had been lying in it for a while, and you guess the same has been done with the cockpit. As you walk once again up the stairway, the Remnant bid you farewell. "We have transferred <payment> as a way to express our gratitude," Dusk signs with a smile. "Of course, their worth is incomparable with the value of what you have done for us; without you, we would have never made it out alive. Goodbye for now, and may the Embers aid in your pursuits."
units.italian: I due ti accompagnano alla <ship>, nella piazzola ormai silenziosa di <planet>. La stiva è stata svuotata della vasta gamma di strumenti che vi erano rimasti per un po', e immagini che lo stesso sia stato fatto con la cabina. Mentre risali ancora una volta la scaletta, i Remnant ti salutano. "Abbiamo trasferito <payment> come segno della nostra gratitudine," accenna Dusk con un sorriso. "Naturalmente il loro valore è incomparabile con quello di ciò che hai fatto per noi; senza di te non saremmo mai riusciti a uscirne vivi. Arrivederci per ora, e che le Braci aiutino le tue imprese."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|name|2656|0
units.english: Back in action
units.italian: Di nuovo in azione

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|description|2657|0
units.english: The situation in <waypoints> is again under control. Return there to gather additional data from the Remnant satellite for Prefect Chilia, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: La situazione in <waypoints> è di nuovo sotto controllo. Torna lì per raccogliere altri dati dal satellite dei Remnant per il prefetto Chilia, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|Although its architecture still feels wildly alien, time has helped you become familiar with the way <planet>'s main starport is organized. By now, it's not difficult for you to notice when something changes. Some are subtler than others - it wasn't long ago that additional barriers were placed between the rows of landing pads, much to your inconvenience.|2670|0
units.english: Although its architecture still feels wildly alien, time has helped you become familiar with the way <planet>'s main starport is organized. By now, it's not difficult for you to notice when something changes. Some are subtler than others - it wasn't long ago that additional barriers were placed between the rows of landing pads, much to your inconvenience.
units.italian: Anche se la sua architettura sembra ancora selvaggiamente aliena, il tempo ti ha aiutato a familiarizzare con il modo in cui è organizzato lo spazioporto principale di <planet>. Ormai non ti è difficile notare quando qualcosa cambia. Alcune cose sono più sottili di altre: non molto tempo fa sono state messe barriere aggiuntive tra le file di piazzole, con grande tuo disagio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	Passing the arch that connects to the northern shipyards reveals a curious sight. A group of hangars that, until now, were marked as off-limits are now open, and crowds of construction workers are walking in and out of the area. Among the crowd, pairs of camels tow sections of Remnant spacecraft of all kinds; you step aside to let a convoy pass with some of the longest wings you have ever seen.|2671|0
units.english: Passing the arch that connects to the northern shipyards reveals a curious sight. A group of hangars that, until now, were marked as off-limits are now open, and crowds of construction workers are walking in and out of the area. Among the crowd, pairs of camels tow sections of Remnant spacecraft of all kinds; you step aside to let a convoy pass with some of the longest wings you have ever seen.
units.italian: Passando sotto l'arco che collega ai cantieri settentrionali, scopri una scena curiosa. Un gruppo di hangar che finora era segnato come off-limits è ora aperto, e frotte di operai edili entrano ed escono dall'area. Tra la folla, coppie di cammelli trainano sezioni di navi spaziali Remnant di ogni tipo; ti fai da parte per lasciare passare un convoglio con alcune delle ali più lunghe che tu abbia mai visto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"What a show, don't you think?" a familiar voice chants as you turn around. Taely smiles, making a gesture of welcome with her hands. "If you were looking for Prefect Chilia, he should be upstairs right now."|2672|0
units.english: "What a show, don't you think?" a familiar voice chants as you turn around. Taely smiles, making a gesture of welcome with her hands. "If you were looking for Prefect Chilia, he should be upstairs right now."
units.italian: "Che spettacolo, non credi?" canta una voce familiare mentre ti volti. Taely sorride, facendo un gesto di benvenuto con le mani. "Se stavi cercando il prefetto Chilia, dovrebbe essere di sopra adesso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Why should I be looking for Chilia?"|2674|0
units.english: "Why should I be looking for Chilia?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei cercare Chilia?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Are you working on a new ship?"|2676|0
units.english: "Are you working on a new ship?"
units.italian: "Stai lavorando a una nave nuova?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"On a rather old one, in reality," she replies, "but the last time this yard was active was years before your arrival, so for you it should make little difference."|2677|0
units.english: "On a rather old one, in reality," she replies, "but the last time this yard was active was years before your arrival, so for you it should make little difference."
units.italian: "A una piuttosto vecchia, in realtà," risponde, "ma l'ultima volta che questo cantiere è stato attivo è stato anni prima del tuo arrivo, quindi per te dovrebbe fare poca differenza."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	Suddenly, your communicator buzzes with a message - from Prefect Chilia, of course - telling you to meet him in <planet> as soon as possible. Taely looks amused. "He wants to speak with you about Patir," she explains. "A lot of resources have been redirected to that project since your last expedition, including some from older projects. And I am helping where I can too," she concludes, carefully slipping a tool bag under the enormous wing being transported. "If everything goes to plan, you will see the results in a matter of weeks."|2679|0
units.english: Suddenly, your communicator buzzes with a message - from Prefect Chilia, of course - telling you to meet him in <planet> as soon as possible. Taely looks amused. "He wants to speak with you about Patir," she explains. "A lot of resources have been redirected to that project since your last expedition, including some from older projects. And I am helping where I can too," she concludes, carefully slipping a tool bag under the enormous wing being transported. "If everything goes to plan, you will see the results in a matter of weeks."
units.italian: All'improvviso il tuo comunicatore ronza con un messaggio, dal prefetto Chilia, naturalmente, che ti dice di incontrarlo su <planet> il prima possibile. Taely sembra divertita. "Vuole parlarti di Patir," spiega. "Da quando è iniziata la tua ultima spedizione sono state reindirizzate molte risorse a quel progetto, incluse alcune di progetti più vecchi. E anch'io do una mano dove posso," conclude, infilando con cura una borsa di attrezzi sotto l'enorme ala in trasporto. "Se tutto va come previsto, vedrai i risultati nel giro di qualche settimana."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	You bid her farewell and look for Chilia in the upper floors. "<first>!" he signs with surprise when you find him. "That is some great timing. I have just prepared a new assignment for you."|2680|0
units.english: You bid her farewell and look for Chilia in the upper floors. "<first>!" he signs with surprise when you find him. "That is some great timing. I have just prepared a new assignment for you."
units.italian: La saluti e cerchi Chilia ai piani superiori. "<first>!" accenna sorpreso quando lo trovi. "Che tempismo. Ho appena preparato un nuovo incarico per te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"About Patir, right?"|2682|0
units.english: "About Patir, right?"
units.italian: "Su Patir, giusto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	(Let him talk.)|2683|0
units.english: (Let him talk.)
units.italian: (Lascialo parlare.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	He smiles. "I assume you must have spoken with Taely. Yes, that is correct. What had started as a lower priority project has been taking up more and more resources recently, for good reason.|2685|0
units.english: He smiles. "I assume you must have spoken with Taely. Yes, that is correct. What had started as a lower priority project has been taking up more and more resources recently, for good reason.
units.italian: Sorride. "Immagino che tu abbia parlato con Taely. Sì, esatto. Quello che era iniziato come un progetto a bassa priorità ha assorbito sempre più risorse di recente, e a buon diritto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Advances in our understanding of Ssil Vida have allowed us to experiment with Patir in the past months; you might have noticed it flicker in and out of your stellar map recently. We are now confident that we have gained near total control of Patir's state, and we know how to make it stay in this galaxy, or the other.|2687|0
units.english: "Advances in our understanding of Ssil Vida have allowed us to experiment with Patir in the past months; you might have noticed it flicker in and out of your stellar map recently. We are now confident that we have gained near total control of Patir's state, and we know how to make it stay in this galaxy, or the other.
units.italian: "I progressi nella nostra comprensione di Ssil Vida ci hanno permesso di sperimentare con Patir negli ultimi mesi; forse avrai notato che è apparso e scomparso dalla tua mappa stellare di recente. Ora siamo fiduciosi di aver ottenuto un controllo quasi totale dello stato di Patir, e sappiamo come farlo restare in questa galassia, o nell'altra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Our interest in the project is not purely academic," he continues, grabbing a datapad. "The creatures that inhabit that region can be both a potential threat, and an interesting resource. Look here." The screen shows a recording of radar data, taken on the day you returned from Patir based on the timestamp.|2688|0
units.english: "Our interest in the project is not purely academic," he continues, grabbing a datapad. "The creatures that inhabit that region can be both a potential threat, and an interesting resource. Look here." The screen shows a recording of radar data, taken on the day you returned from Patir based on the timestamp.
units.italian: "Il nostro interesse nel progetto non è puramente accademico," continua, afferrando un tablet. "Le creature che abitano quella regione possono essere sia una potenziale minaccia sia una risorsa interessante. Guarda qui." Lo schermo mostra una registrazione di dati radar, presa il giorno del tuo ritorno da Patir secondo la marca temporale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"We believe that one of those beings was in Patir when you returned back in the Milky Way. As you know, we have a satellite around the black hole, but we have been unable to contact it since your return. If you board it and take its data, it might tell us more."|2689|0
units.english: "We believe that one of those beings was in Patir when you returned back in the Milky Way. As you know, we have a satellite around the black hole, but we have been unable to contact it since your return. If you board it and take its data, it might tell us more."
units.italian: "Crediamo che uno di quegli esseri fosse a Patir quando sei tornato nella Via Lattea. Come sai, abbiamo un satellite attorno al buco nero, ma non siamo riusciti a contattarlo dal tuo ritorno. Se lo abbordi e ne prendi i dati, potrebbe dirci di più."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Alright then."|2691|0
units.english: "Alright then."
units.italian: "Va bene allora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"How do you know Patir will not move while I am there?"|2693|0
units.english: "How do you know Patir will not move while I am there?"
units.italian: "Come sai che Patir non si sposterà mentre sono lì?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"We have conducted a wide variety of tests during this period," he boasts. "We have established a relation between Ssil Vida's signal and Patir's behavior, to an extent. At the moment, we are sending a continuous signal out of the station. Once the signal stops the time it takes for Patir to disappear varies, but we are reasonably certain that for as long as it continues Patir will stay there - it is just a one-day mission, after all. And even in the very worst case, this time we have the knowledge and the tools to bring you back rapidly."|2694|0
units.english: "We have conducted a wide variety of tests during this period," he boasts. "We have established a relation between Ssil Vida's signal and Patir's behavior, to an extent. At the moment, we are sending a continuous signal out of the station. Once the signal stops the time it takes for Patir to disappear varies, but we are reasonably certain that for as long as it continues Patir will stay there - it is just a one-day mission, after all. And even in the very worst case, this time we have the knowledge and the tools to bring you back rapidly."
units.italian: "Abbiamo condotto una vasta gamma di test in questo periodo," si vanta. "Abbiamo stabilito una relazione tra il segnale di Ssil Vida e il comportamento di Patir, in una certa misura. Al momento stiamo inviando un segnale continuo dalla stazione. Quando il segnale si interrompe, il tempo che Patir impiega a sparire varia, ma siamo ragionevolmente certi che finché continua Patir resterà lì; dopo tutto è solo una missione di un giorno. E anche nel peggiore dei casi, questa volta abbiamo le conoscenze e gli strumenti per riportarti indietro rapidamente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Alright, I am convinced."|2696|0
units.english: "Alright, I am convinced."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi hai convinto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"Sorry, but I cannot return there after what happened last time."|2697|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I cannot return there after what happened last time."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso tornarci dopo quello che è successo l'ultima volta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"I would come with you if I could," he signs with trepidation, "but I am required here at the moment, and it is a task that can be easily done by a single person. Follow the procedure Dusk showed you, and you will be done in no time."|2702|0
units.english: "I would come with you if I could," he signs with trepidation, "but I am required here at the moment, and it is a task that can be easily done by a single person. Follow the procedure Dusk showed you, and you will be done in no time."
units.italian: "Verrei con te se potessi," accenna con trepidazione, "ma al momento devo restare qui, ed è un compito che una sola persona può svolgere facilmente. Segui la procedura che ti ha mostrato Dusk, e avrai finito in men che non si dica."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|	"I would come with you if I could," he signs with trepidation, "but I am required here at the moment, and it is a task that can be easily done by a single person. Follow the procedure Dusk showed you, and you will be done in no time."|2707|0
units.english: "I would come with you if I could," he signs with trepidation, "but I am required here at the moment, and it is a task that can be easily done by a single person. Follow the procedure Dusk showed you, and you will be done in no time."
units.italian: "Verrei con te se potessi," accenna con trepidazione, "ma al momento devo restare qui, ed è un compito che una sola persona può svolgere facilmente. Segui la procedura che ti ha mostrato Dusk, e avrai finito in men che non si dica."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|dialog|2715|0
units.english: The satellite floats into your payload bay, and after a quick checkout you download its data. It only takes a few minutes before you can release it once again.
units.italian: Il satellite entra nella tua stiva, e dopo un rapido controllo scarichi i suoi dati. Ci vogliono solo pochi minuti prima che tu possa rilasciarlo di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 14|You meet with Chilia in front of the landing pad. "Thank you for the help," he chants as you hand him the data. "If you are interested in continuing the Patir research project, meet me in the spaceport in a few hours - I might have good news for you."|2720|0
units.english: You meet with Chilia in front of the landing pad. "Thank you for the help," he chants as you hand him the data. "If you are interested in continuing the Patir research project, meet me in the spaceport in a few hours - I might have good news for you."
units.italian: Ti incontri con Chilia davanti alla piazzola di atterraggio. "Grazie per l'aiuto," canta mentre gli consegni i dati. "Se ti interessa continuare il progetto di ricerca su Patir, incontrami allo spazioporto tra qualche ora; potrei avere buone notizie per te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|name|2761|0
units.english: Remnant scientists
units.italian: Scienziati Remnant

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|description|2762|0
units.english: Visit <planet> to gather three Remnant scientists who want to return to Patir.
units.italian: Visita <planet> per raccogliere tre scienziati Remnant che vogliono tornare a Patir.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|The flurry of activity around the same hangars you visited previously has not died down. Hordes of technicians work together to move machinery of all kinds in and out of the construction site, much of which ends up somewhere underground beyond your sight. You don't see Taely among the crew this time, but you recognize some of the engineers that often work with her - and eventually, you stumble upon Chilia, looking for you inside the crowd.|2770|0
units.english: The flurry of activity around the same hangars you visited previously has not died down. Hordes of technicians work together to move machinery of all kinds in and out of the construction site, much of which ends up somewhere underground beyond your sight. You don't see Taely among the crew this time, but you recognize some of the engineers that often work with her - and eventually, you stumble upon Chilia, looking for you inside the crowd.
units.italian: Il fermento attorno agli stessi hangar che hai visitato prima non si è placato. Orde di tecnici lavorano insieme per spostare macchinari di ogni tipo dentro e fuori dal cantiere, gran parte dei quali finisce da qualche parte sottoterra fuori dalla tua vista. Questa volta non vedi Taely tra la squadra, ma riconosci alcuni degli ingegneri che lavorano spesso con lei; e alla fine ti imbatti in Chilia, che ti sta cercando tra la folla.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	"Ah, Captain. We feel confident enough in our results to move on with the next phase. We are readying a team aboard <planet> for an initial expedition, with a relatively simple mission: reactivating our outpost next to the Builder settlement."|2771|0
units.english: "Ah, Captain. We feel confident enough in our results to move on with the next phase. We are readying a team aboard <planet> for an initial expedition, with a relatively simple mission: reactivating our outpost next to the Builder settlement."
units.italian: "Ah, capitano. Siamo abbastanza fiduciosi nei nostri risultati da passare alla fase successiva. Stiamo preparando una squadra a bordo di <planet> per una spedizione iniziale, con una missione relativamente semplice: riattivare il nostro avamposto accanto all'insediamento dei Costruttori."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	"What about the data I gave you?"|2773|0
units.english: "What about the data I gave you?"
units.italian: "E i dati che ti ho dato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	"Is there nobody here on <origin> that could do the same?"|2775|0
units.english: "Is there nobody here on <origin> that could do the same?"
units.italian: "Non c'è nessuno qui su <origin> che potrebbe fare lo stesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	He gives you an odd look. "Not with the same training. We found that much of the preparations for <planet> were easily applicable to Patir as well, which allowed us to prepare for it fairly quickly. And plus," he continues authoritatively, "it would be good practice for you to see the machines that will make your future expeditions possible directly, so as to gain more confidence in them.|2776|0
units.english: He gives you an odd look. "Not with the same training. We found that much of the preparations for <planet> were easily applicable to Patir as well, which allowed us to prepare for it fairly quickly. And plus," he continues authoritatively, "it would be good practice for you to see the machines that will make your future expeditions possible directly, so as to gain more confidence in them.
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo strano. "Non con la stessa preparazione. Abbiamo scoperto che gran parte dei preparativi per <planet> erano facilmente applicabili anche a Patir, il che ci ha permesso di prepararci abbastanza in fretta. E inoltre," continua con autorevolezza, "ti farebbe bene vedere direttamente le macchine che renderanno possibili le tue spedizioni future, così da acquisire più fiducia in esse.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	"The analysis of the data is still ongoing - we know that it appeared not long before Patir moved, and disappeared shortly after, but figuring out what happened in between is proving to be more complicated than expected. Still, we should know more soon enough, and there is no reason for it to block our progress.|2779|0
units.english: "The analysis of the data is still ongoing - we know that it appeared not long before Patir moved, and disappeared shortly after, but figuring out what happened in between is proving to be more complicated than expected. Still, we should know more soon enough, and there is no reason for it to block our progress.
units.italian: "L'analisi dei dati è ancora in corso; sappiamo che è apparso poco prima che Patir si spostasse, ed è sparito poco dopo, ma capire cosa è successo nel mezzo si sta rivelando più complicato del previsto. Tuttavia dovremmo saperne di più presto, e non c'è motivo perché questo blocchi i nostri progressi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 15|	"Make sure to leave space for a team of three when you get there. This expedition will just use the resources that you left around Patir when you were last there, so there should be no need to use your cargo hold this time."|2781|0
units.english: "Make sure to leave space for a team of three when you get there. This expedition will just use the resources that you left around Patir when you were last there, so there should be no need to use your cargo hold this time."
units.italian: "Assicurati di lasciare spazio per una squadra di tre quando arrivi. Questa spedizione userà solo le risorse che hai lasciato attorno a Patir l'ultima volta che sei stato lì, quindi questa volta non dovrebbe servire usare la stiva."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|name|2786|0
units.english: Stop by <planet>
units.italian: Passa da <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|description|2787|0
units.english: Before bringing the Remnant to the Builder settlement around Patir, stop by <destination> to meet up with Chilia.
units.italian: Prima di portare i Remnant all'insediamento dei Costruttori attorno a Patir, passa da <destination> per incontrare Chilia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|blocked|2788|0
units.english: You dock with Ssil Vida, but despite Chilia's advice, you are still lacking the <bunks> bunks necessary for the job.
units.italian: Ti agganci a Ssil Vida, ma nonostante il consiglio di Chilia ti mancano ancora le <bunks> cuccette necessarie per il lavoro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|After these past months, Ssil Vida's docking section has become unrecognizable: it is now distinctly Remnant, with tall arches and curved, segmented walls separating it into a variety of smaller rooms. Walking further inside the station reveals that at least the main chambers have kept most of their previous features, but you feel that this is unlikely to last for long. You meet there with the new group and realize Dusk is not with them.|2796|0
units.english: After these past months, Ssil Vida's docking section has become unrecognizable: it is now distinctly Remnant, with tall arches and curved, segmented walls separating it into a variety of smaller rooms. Walking further inside the station reveals that at least the main chambers have kept most of their previous features, but you feel that this is unlikely to last for long. You meet there with the new group and realize Dusk is not with them.
units.italian: Dopo questi mesi, la sezione di attracco di Ssil Vida è diventata irriconoscibile: ora è decisamente Remnant, con archi alti e pareti curve e segmentate che la dividono in varie stanze più piccole. Addentrandoti nella stazione scopri che almeno le camere principali hanno mantenuto la maggior parte delle loro caratteristiche precedenti, ma senti che è improbabile che duri a lungo. Ti incontri lì con il nuovo gruppo e ti accorgi che Dusk non è con loro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|	The three Remnant escort you on a quick tour of some of the modifications made recently. You walk through a control room with at least two dozen people sitting at their consoles, carefully managing the power of the station. They explain that many of the people there are focused solely on the emitter at the core of Ssil Vida: many of the modulators they have built around the station have the purpose of simplifying its control, but it's still very much an ongoing project.|2797|0
units.english: The three Remnant escort you on a quick tour of some of the modifications made recently. You walk through a control room with at least two dozen people sitting at their consoles, carefully managing the power of the station. They explain that many of the people there are focused solely on the emitter at the core of Ssil Vida: many of the modulators they have built around the station have the purpose of simplifying its control, but it's still very much an ongoing project.
units.italian: I tre Remnant ti accompagnano in un breve giro di alcune delle modifiche fatte di recente. Attraversi una sala di controllo con almeno due dozzine di persone sedute alle loro console, che gestiscono con cura l'energia della stazione. Spiegano che molte delle persone lì si dedicano esclusivamente all'emettitore al centro di Ssil Vida: molti dei modulatori che hanno costruito attorno alla stazione hanno lo scopo di semplificarne il controllo, ma è ancora un progetto in corso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|	While they accompany you through a large corridor, filled only with Remnant terminals and closed doors, your attention is drawn to some cargo being transported by a pair of workers. It is mostly contained inside an opaque container, but you think you can see the outline of some of the human outfits you brought to the Remnant some time ago. They are not sold in the nearby outfitter from what you have seen; you are left to wonder what their purpose here might be.|2798|0
units.english: While they accompany you through a large corridor, filled only with Remnant terminals and closed doors, your attention is drawn to some cargo being transported by a pair of workers. It is mostly contained inside an opaque container, but you think you can see the outline of some of the human outfits you brought to the Remnant some time ago. They are not sold in the nearby outfitter from what you have seen; you are left to wonder what their purpose here might be.
units.italian: Mentre ti accompagnano lungo un grande corridoio, pieno solo di terminali Remnant e porte chiuse, la tua attenzione viene attirata da del carico trasportato da una coppia di operai. È per lo più contenuto in un contenitore opaco, ma credi di riuscire a vedere il profilo di alcuni degli abiti umani che hai portato ai Remnant tempo fa. Da quello che hai visto non sono venduti nel fornitore di equipaggiamento qui vicino; resti a chiederti quale possa essere il loro scopo qui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 16|	Before you can think much of it, however, a short message from Chilia reaches your commlink. It instructs you to urgently meet him with the other three Remnant at a specific location on <planet>, and to come with a free bunk and at least 65 tons free in your cargo - the plan, apparently, has changed.|2799|0
units.english: Before you can think much of it, however, a short message from Chilia reaches your commlink. It instructs you to urgently meet him with the other three Remnant at a specific location on <planet>, and to come with a free bunk and at least 65 tons free in your cargo - the plan, apparently, has changed.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa pensarci troppo, però, un breve messaggio di Chilia raggiunge il tuo communicatore. Ti ordina di incontrarlo urgentemente con gli altri tre Remnant in un punto specifico di <planet>, e di presentarti con una cuccetta libera e almeno 65 tonnellate libere nel carico: il piano, a quanto pare, è cambiato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|name|2806|0
units.english: Return to <system>
units.italian: Torna su <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|description|2807|0
units.english: Bring the three Remnant archaeologists and Prefect Chilia to <destination>, together with the new equipment.
units.italian: Porta i tre archeologi Remnant e il prefetto Chilia su <destination>, insieme alla nuova attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|blocked|2808|0
units.english: You start to follow Chilia's directions, but you soon realize you won't have enough space: you need <tons> of cargo and <bunks> bunks.
units.italian: Cominci a seguire le indicazioni di Chilia, ma ti accorgi presto che non avrai abbastanza spazio: ti servono <tons> di carico e <bunks> cuccette.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|You overfly <origin>'s starport and stay at a high altitude; based on the coordinates Chilia gave you, the flight is far from over. As minutes pass, the city transforms into more and more sparse buildings deep in the desert, with barely visible roads in the sands connecting each. The more distant of these are organized in a circular fashion: a central building, of a sand-like ocher similar to some outposts in the Rim, and rings of buildings of a more alien-like Remnant design surrounding it.|2817|0
units.english: You overfly <origin>'s starport and stay at a high altitude; based on the coordinates Chilia gave you, the flight is far from over. As minutes pass, the city transforms into more and more sparse buildings deep in the desert, with barely visible roads in the sands connecting each. The more distant of these are organized in a circular fashion: a central building, of a sand-like ocher similar to some outposts in the Rim, and rings of buildings of a more alien-like Remnant design surrounding it.
units.italian: Sorvoli lo spazioporto di <origin> e resti a quota alta; in base alle coordinate che ti ha dato Chilia, il volo è lungi dall'essere finito. Col passare dei minuti, la città si trasforma in edifici sempre più radi nel profondo del deserto, con strade a malapena visibili nella sabbia che li collegano. I più lontani sono organizzati in modo circolare: un edificio centrale, di un ocra sabbioso simile ad alcuni avamposti del Bordo, e anelli di edifici di design Remnant più alieno attorno a esso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	As you soon find out, your destination is one of these settlements. You follow Chilia's instructions and touch down in an unsigned spot on a dune, kicking up loads of sand in the process. The three Remnant, busy discussing something you don't fully understand about Ssil Vida's design progression, stay in your ship's bridge while you meet up with Chilia.|2818|0
units.english: As you soon find out, your destination is one of these settlements. You follow Chilia's instructions and touch down in an unsigned spot on a dune, kicking up loads of sand in the process. The three Remnant, busy discussing something you don't fully understand about Ssil Vida's design progression, stay in your ship's bridge while you meet up with Chilia.
units.italian: Come scopri presto, la tua destinazione è uno di questi insediamenti. Segui le istruzioni di Chilia e atterri in un punto non segnalato su una duna, sollevando mucchi di sabbia. I tre Remnant, impegnati a discutere qualcosa che non capisci del tutto sull'evoluzione del design di Ssil Vida, restano nella plancia della nave mentre tu ti incontri con Chilia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Come here, Captain!" he gestures from behind a short barrier which mostly blocks the blowing sand. You follow him until stopping in front of the entrance of a large elevator in the central building. He writes on his commlink, and the elevator starts rising toward your floor. While Remnant numerals still escape you, it must have started deep below the ground for how long it takes.|2819|0
units.english: "Come here, Captain!" he gestures from behind a short barrier which mostly blocks the blowing sand. You follow him until stopping in front of the entrance of a large elevator in the central building. He writes on his commlink, and the elevator starts rising toward your floor. While Remnant numerals still escape you, it must have started deep below the ground for how long it takes.
units.italian: "Vieni qui, capitano!" ti fa cenno da dietro una bassa barriera che blocca in gran parte la sabbia soffiata. Lo segui finché non ti fermi davanti all'ingresso di un grande ascensore nell'edificio centrale. Scrive sul suo communicatore, e l'ascensore comincia a salire verso il tuo piano. Anche se i numeri dei Remnant ti sfuggono ancora, deve essere partito da molto sottoterra, a giudicare da quanto ci mette.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Why did you message me?"|2821|0
units.english: "Why did you message me?"
units.italian: "Perché mi hai mandato un messaggio?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"What is this place?"|2823|0
units.english: "What is this place?"
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Oh, just an older facility of ours. For the longest time we built our outposts like bunkers, even trying to make them difficult to spot from orbit. Ever since we have relaxed our standards, most of these have been relegated to the role of storage. But it is not just for a history lesson that I have called you here today.|2824|0
units.english: "Oh, just an older facility of ours. For the longest time we built our outposts like bunkers, even trying to make them difficult to spot from orbit. Ever since we have relaxed our standards, most of these have been relegated to the role of storage. But it is not just for a history lesson that I have called you here today.
units.italian: "Oh, solo una nostra vecchia struttura. Per molto tempo abbiamo costruito i nostri avamposti come bunker, cercando persino di renderli difficili da individuare dall'orbita. Da quando abbiamo allentato gli standard, la maggior parte è stata relegata al ruolo di deposito. Ma non ti ho chiamato qui oggi solo per una lezione di storia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"We have made a new discovery in your data. After Patir moved, the creature that came with it did not simply disappear: a Ka'sei approached it, mined it, and harvested its pieces. This has important implications - these beings were fully capable of inhibiting the Ka'sei while in the other galaxy, so they either died when Patir moved or their abilities could not work anymore. Either possibility is equally interesting, and it is imperative that we investigate this sooner rather than later."|2826|0
units.english: "We have made a new discovery in your data. After Patir moved, the creature that came with it did not simply disappear: a Ka'sei approached it, mined it, and harvested its pieces. This has important implications - these beings were fully capable of inhibiting the Ka'sei while in the other galaxy, so they either died when Patir moved or their abilities could not work anymore. Either possibility is equally interesting, and it is imperative that we investigate this sooner rather than later."
units.italian: "Abbiamo fatto una nuova scoperta nei tuoi dati. Dopo che Patir si è spostato, la creatura che è arrivata con esso non è semplicemente sparita: un Ka'sei le si è avvicinato, l'ha estratta e ne ha raccolto i pezzi. Questo ha implicazioni importanti: questi esseri erano pienamente in grado di inibire i Ka'sei mentre erano nell'altra galassia, quindi o sono morti quando Patir si è spostato, o le loro capacità non potevano più funzionare. Entrambe le possibilità sono ugualmente interessanti, ed è imperativo che indaghiamo al più presto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	The doors of the elevator open, and a few workers come out of it with a large piece of Remnant machinery. Though most of its components are hidden inside featureless boxes and standard pipes, it is topped by a segmented, cruciform antenna. You also notice its small size - the chances of something like that taking up the 65 tons that Chilia had asked you to set aside are nil.|2827|0
units.english: The doors of the elevator open, and a few workers come out of it with a large piece of Remnant machinery. Though most of its components are hidden inside featureless boxes and standard pipes, it is topped by a segmented, cruciform antenna. You also notice its small size - the chances of something like that taking up the 65 tons that Chilia had asked you to set aside are nil.
units.italian: Le porte dell'ascensore si aprono, e alcuni operai ne escono con un grosso pezzo di macchinario Remnant. Anche se la maggior parte dei componenti è nascosta dentro casse anonime e tubi standard, in cima c'è un'antenna segmentata a forma di croce. Noti anche le sue piccole dimensioni: le probabilità che una cosa del genere occupi le 65 tonnellate che Chilia ti aveva chiesto di riservare sono nulle.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"What does that do?"|2829|0
units.english: "What does that do?"
units.italian: "A che cosa serve?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Is that a communicator of some sort?"|2831|0
units.english: "Is that a communicator of some sort?"
units.italian: "È una specie di comunicatore?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Where is the rest of it?"|2833|0
units.english: "Where is the rest of it?"
units.italian: "Dov'è il resto?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	He doesn't seem to understand your question, so you explain your doubt further. "Oh, that is unrelated to this payload - it is just 3 tons, all here in front of you. But you will understand my request shortly.|2834|0
units.english: He doesn't seem to understand your question, so you explain your doubt further. "Oh, that is unrelated to this payload - it is just 3 tons, all here in front of you. But you will understand my request shortly.
units.italian: Non sembra capire la tua domanda, così spieghi meglio il tuo dubbio. "Oh, quello non c'entra con questo carico: sono solo 3 tonnellate, tutte qui davanti a te. Ma capirai presto la mia richiesta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Good intuition. Not in the sense of two-way communication, but its function is based on reliably transmitting a particular signal to the Ka'het. Let me explain.|2837|0
units.english: "Good intuition. Not in the sense of two-way communication, but its function is based on reliably transmitting a particular signal to the Ka'het. Let me explain.
units.italian: "Intuizione buona. Non nel senso di una comunicazione bidirezionale, ma la sua funzione si basa sulla trasmissione affidabile di un segnale particolare ai Ka'het. Lascia che ti spieghi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"It was not long after we started translating the Builder language that we tried to put some of that effort into hacking their technology. Given their destructive potential, the Ka'het were the natural target for this electronic warfare operation." The technicians carefully load the payload into your ship, trying to connect it to the <ship>'s electrical system.|2839|0
units.english: "It was not long after we started translating the Builder language that we tried to put some of that effort into hacking their technology. Given their destructive potential, the Ka'het were the natural target for this electronic warfare operation." The technicians carefully load the payload into your ship, trying to connect it to the <ship>'s electrical system.
units.italian: "Non molto dopo aver iniziato a tradurre la lingua dei Costruttori abbiamo provato a dedicare parte di quello sforzo a violare la loro tecnologia. Dato il loro potenziale distruttivo, i Ka'het erano il bersaglio naturale di questa operazione di guerra elettronica." I tecnici caricano con cura il carico sulla tua nave, cercando di collegarlo all'impianto elettrico della <ship>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Our understanding of Ka'het systems was quite poor at the time, but despite this, we discovered a backdoor left by their designers. A unique signal that instructs the slug to dump its cargo and not retake it, perhaps to avoid damage from ingesting hazardous material. As long as it has not digested it yet, this could let us access the parts of the creature inside the Ka'sei without having to kill most of them. That is the reason I asked you for 65 tons free: 3 for this weapon, and 62 for the maximum cargo capacity of a Ka'sei."|2840|0
units.english: "Our understanding of Ka'het systems was quite poor at the time, but despite this, we discovered a backdoor left by their designers. A unique signal that instructs the slug to dump its cargo and not retake it, perhaps to avoid damage from ingesting hazardous material. As long as it has not digested it yet, this could let us access the parts of the creature inside the Ka'sei without having to kill most of them. That is the reason I asked you for 65 tons free: 3 for this weapon, and 62 for the maximum cargo capacity of a Ka'sei."
units.italian: "All'epoca la nostra comprensione dei sistemi dei Ka'het era piuttosto scarsa, ma nonostante questo scoprimmo una backdoor lasciata dai loro progettisti. Un segnale unico che ordina alla lumaca di scaricare il carico e di non riprenderlo, forse per evitare danni dall'ingerimento di materiale pericoloso. Finché non l'ha ancora digerito, questo potrebbe permetterci di accedere alle parti della creatura dentro il Ka'sei senza doverne uccidere la maggior parte. È per questo che ti ho chiesto 65 tonnellate libere: 3 per quest'arma, e 62 per la capacità di carico massima di un Ka'sei."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"How do I use it?"|2842|0
units.english: "How do I use it?"
units.italian: "Come si usa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Why is it not used anymore?"|2844|0
units.english: "Why is it not used anymore?"
units.italian: "Perché non si usa più?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	"Shamefully, we could never make it small or reliable enough to justify the investment," he replies disappointed. "Most of its components have to be replaced after less than a dozen uses, for a capability that is not too useful in the first place. In fact, the most important lesson from the study was of how little use the typical Ka'het cargo was; there are much easier ways to get our hands on metallic asteroids."|2845|0
units.english: "Shamefully, we could never make it small or reliable enough to justify the investment," he replies disappointed. "Most of its components have to be replaced after less than a dozen uses, for a capability that is not too useful in the first place. In fact, the most important lesson from the study was of how little use the typical Ka'het cargo was; there are much easier ways to get our hands on metallic asteroids."
units.italian: "Con vergogna, non siamo mai riusciti a renderlo abbastanza piccolo o affidabile da giustificare l'investimento," risponde deluso. "La maggior parte dei suoi componenti va sostituita dopo meno di una dozzina di usi, per una capacità che in fondo non è troppo utile. Anzi, la lezione più importante dello studio è stata quanto poco utile fosse il tipico carico dei Ka'het; ci sono modi molto più semplici per mettere le mani su asteroidi metallici."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|	The workers signal that they are done with the installation. "I will come with you to operate it, Captain. Your previous mission will take precedence," he continues, "but as soon as they are done, I will direct you on the procedure to follow."|2847|0
units.english: The workers signal that they are done with the installation. "I will come with you to operate it, Captain. Your previous mission will take precedence," he continues, "but as soon as they are done, I will direct you on the procedure to follow."
units.italian: Gli operai segnalano che hanno finito l'installazione. "Verrò con te a usarlo, capitano. La tua missione precedente avrà la precedenza," continua, "ma appena avranno finito, ti indicherò la procedura da seguire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 17|The three suited-up Remnant leave your ship toward the outpost, while Chilia stays aboard to prepare the electronic warfare system for its mission. You try your best to aid Chilia and to support the team on their EVA, but it will take at least a few hours before either of them are ready for the next phase in the spaceport.|2853|0
units.english: The three suited-up Remnant leave your ship toward the outpost, while Chilia stays aboard to prepare the electronic warfare system for its mission. You try your best to aid Chilia and to support the team on their EVA, but it will take at least a few hours before either of them are ready for the next phase in the spaceport.
units.italian: I tre Remnant in tuta lasciano la nave verso l'avamposto, mentre Chilia resta a bordo per preparare il sistema di guerra elettronica alla sua missione. Fai del tuo meglio per aiutare Chilia e sostenere la squadra nella loro EVA, ma ci vorranno almeno qualche ora prima che uno dei due sia pronto per la fase successiva allo spazioporto.

units.id: outfit:Asteroid Jump Drive (Patir 18)|display name|2901|0
outfit:Asteroid Jump Drive (Patir 18)|description|2937|0
units.english: Whatever the mechanism that hides beneath the translucent orb may be, it functions similarly to a jump drive, bridging different parts of the universe together for the cost of merely 200 units of fuel.
units.italian: Whatever the mechanism that hides beneath the translucent orb may be, it functions similarly to a jump drive, bridging different parts of the universe together for the cost of merely 200 units of fuel.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|name|2940|0
units.english: Rogue Ka'sei
units.italian: Ka'sei solitario

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|description|2941|0
units.english: Find a way to take away from the target Ka'sei the asteroid components it ingested, and return to <destination> once you're done.
units.italian: Trova un modo per togliere al Ka'sei bersaglio i componenti asteroidali che ha ingerito, e torna su <destination> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|It has been at least half an hour since Chilia finished setting up for the mission. Despite the occasional updates from the exploration team on the commlink, he is getting more visibly impatient as time passes, compulsively tapping over his console in a musical rhythm. Most of what they relay is about the status of the machinery and the samples left in the lab, and your mind soon trails off to other thoughts.|2951|0
units.english: It has been at least half an hour since Chilia finished setting up for the mission. Despite the occasional updates from the exploration team on the commlink, he is getting more visibly impatient as time passes, compulsively tapping over his console in a musical rhythm. Most of what they relay is about the status of the machinery and the samples left in the lab, and your mind soon trails off to other thoughts.
units.italian: È passata almeno mezz'ora da quando Chilia ha finito di preparare la missione. Nonostante gli aggiornamenti occasionali della squadra di esplorazione al communicatore, diventa sempre più visibilmente impaziente col passare del tempo, tamburellando compulsivamente sulla console con un ritmo musicale. Gran parte di quello che riferiscono riguarda lo stato dei macchinari e dei campioni lasciati nel laboratorio, e la tua mente presto vaga verso altri pensieri.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	At last, they make their way back to your ship. "The outpost and its consumables are in a fairly good state. After we completed our tasks, we took the opportunity to check out what was left in the pantry. We have brought some of it with us, if you wish to share a meal before the mission," he concludes with a smile and a gesture toward their handbags.|2952|0
units.english: At last, they make their way back to your ship. "The outpost and its consumables are in a fairly good state. After we completed our tasks, we took the opportunity to check out what was left in the pantry. We have brought some of it with us, if you wish to share a meal before the mission," he concludes with a smile and a gesture toward their handbags.
units.italian: Alla fine tornano verso la tua nave. "L'avamposto e i suoi consumabili sono in condizioni discretamente buone. Dopo aver completato i nostri compiti, abbiamo colto l'occasione per controllare cosa era rimasto nella dispensa. Ne abbiamo portato un po' con noi, se ti va di condividere un pasto prima della missione," conclude con un sorriso e un gesto verso le loro borse.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	(Accept it.)|2954|0
units.english: (Accept it.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	"This is not the moment to eat."|2956|0
units.english: "This is not the moment to eat."
units.italian: "Non è il momento di mangiare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	Chilia nods. "This time it is best to leave them for the return trip. Captain," he continues, turning to you. "If you are ready to leave, so am I. I will activate the weapon as soon as we are in orbit - our target should be well within its range."|2957|0
units.english: Chilia nods. "This time it is best to leave them for the return trip. Captain," he continues, turning to you. "If you are ready to leave, so am I. I will activate the weapon as soon as we are in orbit - our target should be well within its range."
units.italian: Chilia annuisce. "Questa volta è meglio lasciarli per il viaggio di ritorno. Capitano," continua, voltandosi verso di te. "Se sei pronto a partire, lo sono anch'io. Attiverò l'arma appena saremo in orbita: il nostro bersaglio dovrebbe essere ben dentro la sua portata."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	The meals you are shown have become rather familiar, but not particularly appetizing. Unlike most times, you notice that the Remnant expedition does not eat much more than you - perhaps they don't use symbionts, or maybe they ate while inside the lab. Chilia, still in anticipation for the mission (and perhaps hoping to accelerate things), limits himself to drinking some water.|2960|0
units.english: The meals you are shown have become rather familiar, but not particularly appetizing. Unlike most times, you notice that the Remnant expedition does not eat much more than you - perhaps they don't use symbionts, or maybe they ate while inside the lab. Chilia, still in anticipation for the mission (and perhaps hoping to accelerate things), limits himself to drinking some water.
units.italian: I pasti che ti mostrano sono diventati piuttosto familiari, ma non particolarmente appetitosi. A differenza della maggior parte delle volte, noti che la spedizione Remnant non mangia molto più di te; forse non usano simbionti, o forse hanno mangiato mentre erano nel laboratorio. Chilia, ancora in attesa della missione (e forse sperando di accelerare le cose), si limita a bere un po' d'acqua.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	Once you are done, Chilia signals you that he is ready to go when you are - the target is within range, and he should be able to activate it as soon as you reach orbit.|2961|0
units.english: Once you are done, Chilia signals you that he is ready to go when you are - the target is within range, and he should be able to activate it as soon as you reach orbit.
units.italian: Quando hai finito, Chilia ti segnala che è pronto a partire quando lo sei tu: il bersaglio è a portata, e dovrebbe riuscire ad attivarlo appena raggiungi l'orbita.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|	Back inside your ship, you notice Chilia telling the three researchers that it would be better for them to stay locked in their bunks for the rest of the mission. Evidently they don't have the same authorization level as Prefect Chilia - or you, for that matter.|2963|0
units.english: Back inside your ship, you notice Chilia telling the three researchers that it would be better for them to stay locked in their bunks for the rest of the mission. Evidently they don't have the same authorization level as Prefect Chilia - or you, for that matter.
units.italian: Di nuovo dentro la nave, noti che Chilia dice ai tre ricercatori che sarebbe meglio per loro restare chiusi nelle cuccette per il resto della missione. Evidentemente non hanno lo stesso livello di autorizzazione del prefetto Chilia, né di te, a quanto pare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|dialog|2967|0
units.english: As soon as you give him the go-ahead, Chilia calmly sits at his console and starts fiddling with the controls. The antenna atop your ship moves to track the chosen Fetri'sei, and the signal starts; but right after, instead of cargo being ejected, you detect an energy spike coming from the Ka'sei. It's activating a Jump Drive! Taken aback, Chilia signs you to try to follow it.
units.italian: Appena gli dai il via, Chilia si siede con calma alla sua console e comincia ad armeggiare con i comandi. L'antenna in cima alla nave si muove per seguire il Fetri'sei scelto, e il segnale parte; ma subito dopo, invece del carico espulso, rilevi un picco di energia proveniente dal Ka'sei. Sta attivando un motore di salto! Colto di sorpresa, Chilia ti fa cenno di provare a seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|You dock with the stranded Ka'sei, and Chilia signals you to take the foreign outfits in it - or at least, the ones that have not been fully digested yet. "The Fetri appears to have overheated beyond what it could survive," he signs. "Realistically, there is nothing we can do for it. Take the unknown outfits into your cargo hold, and we will figure out the next move back on the <planet>."|2974|0
units.english: You dock with the stranded Ka'sei, and Chilia signals you to take the foreign outfits in it - or at least, the ones that have not been fully digested yet. "The Fetri appears to have overheated beyond what it could survive," he signs. "Realistically, there is nothing we can do for it. Take the unknown outfits into your cargo hold, and we will figure out the next move back on the <planet>."
units.italian: Ti agganci al Ka'sei rimasto in panne, e Chilia ti segnala di prendere gli equipaggiamenti sconosciuti che ci sono dentro, o almeno quelli che non sono stati ancora del tutto digeriti. "Il Fetri sembra essersi surriscaldato oltre ciò che poteva sopportare," accenna. "Realisticamente non c'è nulla che possiamo fare per lui. Porta gli equipaggiamenti sconosciuti nella stiva, e capiremo la mossa successiva tornati su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|"There it is!" signs the thrilled Chilia. "As long as it does not jump further away, this can work for us. Don't let any Ka'het in the system damage it before you loot those outfits directly from its cargo hold."|2984|0
units.english: "There it is!" signs the thrilled Chilia. "As long as it does not jump further away, this can work for us. Don't let any Ka'het in the system damage it before you loot those outfits directly from its cargo hold."
units.italian: "Eccolo!" accenna Chilia entusiasta. "Finché non salta più lontano, questo può funzionare per noi. Non lasciare che qualche Ka'het nel sistema lo danneggi prima che tu saccheggi quegli equipaggiamenti direttamente dalla sua stiva."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 18|dialog|2986|0
units.english: You've arrived at <planet>, but either your passengers, your cargo, or the outfits taken from the asteroid remains are not with you!
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma i tuoi passeggeri, il tuo carico o gli equipaggiamenti presi dai resti dell'asteroide non sono con te!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|name|2994|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|description|2995|0
units.english: Bring Chilia and the other Remnant back to Caelian together with the material gathered from the Fetri'sei.
units.italian: Riporta Chilia e gli altri Remnant su Caelian insieme al materiale raccolto dal Fetri'sei.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|Despite the hiccups in the mission, the Remnant seem ecstatic. Chilia has been careful to hide the outfits you looted into nondescript containers, but when the other Remnant come out of their bunks, it is clear that they have been able to gather some of what has happened. For his part, Chilia does not seem to mind them, limiting himself to sipping from a colorful drink with a sly face.|3004|0
units.english: Despite the hiccups in the mission, the Remnant seem ecstatic. Chilia has been careful to hide the outfits you looted into nondescript containers, but when the other Remnant come out of their bunks, it is clear that they have been able to gather some of what has happened. For his part, Chilia does not seem to mind them, limiting himself to sipping from a colorful drink with a sly face.
units.italian: Nonostante gli intoppi della missione, i Remnant sembrano estasiati. Chilia ha avuto cura di nascondere gli equipaggiamenti saccheggiati in contenitori anonimi, ma quando gli altri Remnant escono dalle cuccette è chiaro che sono riusciti a capire parte di quello che è successo. Da parte sua, Chilia non sembra curarsene, limitandosi a sorseggiare una bevanda colorata con un'espressione furba.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	(Join Chilia.)|3006|0
units.english: (Join Chilia.)
units.italian: (Unisciti a Chilia.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	(Speak with the Remnant researchers.)|3008|0
units.english: (Speak with the Remnant researchers.)
units.italian: (Parla con i ricercatori Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	After some chitchat, one of them catches the opportunity to ask you about your own mission, but you follow what you have seen Chilia do and dodge the questions with vague answers. Soon enough, the conversation veers back to Patir and its surroundings. They sign a bit too fast for your abilities, but you're able to follow most of it.|3009|0
units.english: After some chitchat, one of them catches the opportunity to ask you about your own mission, but you follow what you have seen Chilia do and dodge the questions with vague answers. Soon enough, the conversation veers back to Patir and its surroundings. They sign a bit too fast for your abilities, but you're able to follow most of it.
units.italian: Dopo qualche chiacchiera, uno di loro coglie l'occasione per chiederti della tua missione, ma tu segui quello che hai visto fare da Chilia e schivi le domande con risposte vaghe. Ben presto la conversazione torna su Patir e sui suoi dintorni. Accennano un po' troppo in fretta per le tue capacità, ma riesci a seguirne la maggior parte.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	What catches your attention is their description of the structure of the Builder settlement: according to them, the living quarters are extremely limited compared to the size of the outpost, suggesting that there must have been a separate vehicle to house them at some point. While unlikely to be of much use, you take note of it just as Chilia joins the table.|3010|0
units.english: What catches your attention is their description of the structure of the Builder settlement: according to them, the living quarters are extremely limited compared to the size of the outpost, suggesting that there must have been a separate vehicle to house them at some point. While unlikely to be of much use, you take note of it just as Chilia joins the table.
units.italian: Quello che attira la tua attenzione è la loro descrizione della struttura dell'insediamento dei Costruttori: secondo loro, gli alloggi sono estremamente limitati rispetto alle dimensioni dell'avamposto, il che suggerisce che a un certo punto deve esserci stato un veicolo separato per ospitarli. Anche se è improbabile che sia molto utile, lo annoti mentalmente proprio mentre Chilia si unisce al tavolo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	Sharing a drink with the rest of you, he commends all of you for your efforts, careful not to go into any specifics. "Given the results obtained, I say we can classify this as mission accomplished on both sides," he concludes. "Once our glasses are empty, it is time to move back to <destination> for the analysis of our data."|3011|0
units.english: Sharing a drink with the rest of you, he commends all of you for your efforts, careful not to go into any specifics. "Given the results obtained, I say we can classify this as mission accomplished on both sides," he concludes. "Once our glasses are empty, it is time to move back to <destination> for the analysis of our data."
units.italian: Bevendo con il resto di voi, elogia tutti per i vostri sforzi, attento a non entrare nei dettagli. "Visti i risultati ottenuti, direi che possiamo classificare questa come missione compiuta da entrambe le parti," conclude. "Una volta svuotati i bicchieri, è ora di tornare su <destination> per l'analisi dei nostri dati."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"Nicely done, Captain. With the items secured, I say we can easily classify this as mission accomplished." He accompanies you somewhere more private, and continues. "It seems that, in some way, the Ka'sei gained the ability to activate some of these outfits while digesting them. It must have been by accident, but it is still good news for us - it means that there is a way for us to use this technology on our own ships.|3014|0
units.english: "Nicely done, Captain. With the items secured, I say we can easily classify this as mission accomplished." He accompanies you somewhere more private, and continues. "It seems that, in some way, the Ka'sei gained the ability to activate some of these outfits while digesting them. It must have been by accident, but it is still good news for us - it means that there is a way for us to use this technology on our own ships.
units.italian: "Ben fatto, capitano. Con gli oggetti al sicuro, direi che possiamo tranquillamente classificarla come missione compiuta." Ti accompagna in un posto più riservato, e continua. "Sembra che, in qualche modo, il Ka'sei abbia acquisito la capacità di attivare alcuni di questi equipaggiamenti mentre li digeriva. Dev'essere stato un caso, ma è comunque una buona notizia per noi: significa che esiste un modo per usare questa tecnologia sulle nostre navi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"I caught the opportunity to transfer some of the data the Ka'sei had gathered, in case it helps our efforts. Naturally, it will take a while to decrypt and translate; better move to <destination> so that the analysis of that data, and even more so of the items, can commence."|3015|0
units.english: "I caught the opportunity to transfer some of the data the Ka'sei had gathered, in case it helps our efforts. Naturally, it will take a while to decrypt and translate; better move to <destination> so that the analysis of that data, and even more so of the items, can commence."
units.italian: "Ho colto l'occasione per trasferire parte dei dati raccolti dal Ka'sei, nel caso possano aiutare i nostri sforzi. Naturalmente ci vorrà un po' per decrittarli e tradurli; meglio andare su <destination> così che l'analisi di quei dati, e ancor più degli oggetti, possa cominciare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|dialog|3018|0
units.english: You've arrived at <planet>, but either your passengers, your cargo, or the outfits taken from the asteroid remains are not with you!
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma i tuoi passeggeri, il tuo carico o gli equipaggiamenti presi dai resti dell'asteroide non sono con te!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|The first to leave your ship are the three researchers, who make you various gestures of farewell as they disappear into the spaceport. Chilia hangs around for a while longer, but after your cargo gets unloaded, still hidden inside standard packages, he signs that it is time for him to leave as well.|3024|0
units.english: The first to leave your ship are the three researchers, who make you various gestures of farewell as they disappear into the spaceport. Chilia hangs around for a while longer, but after your cargo gets unloaded, still hidden inside standard packages, he signs that it is time for him to leave as well.
units.italian: I primi a lasciare la nave sono i tre ricercatori, che ti fanno vari gesti di saluto mentre spariscono nello spazioporto. Chilia si trattiene ancora un po', ma dopo che il tuo carico è stato scaricato, ancora nascosto in pacchi standard, accenna che è ora di andare anche per lui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"As you might have figured out, our next objective is to study these items and their technology in depth, hoping to reverse engineer them or, at least, figure out their inner workings." You offer to give him a hand, but he shakes his head. "Your help has been inestimable, but you cannot follow me where these, and I, are going. You have seen for yourself how complicated maintaining proper secrecy around this project is proving to be."|3025|0
units.english: "As you might have figured out, our next objective is to study these items and their technology in depth, hoping to reverse engineer them or, at least, figure out their inner workings." You offer to give him a hand, but he shakes his head. "Your help has been inestimable, but you cannot follow me where these, and I, are going. You have seen for yourself how complicated maintaining proper secrecy around this project is proving to be."
units.italian: "Come avrai capito, il nostro prossimo obiettivo è studiare questi oggetti e la loro tecnologia a fondo, sperando di ricostruirli o, almeno, di capirne il funzionamento interno." Ti offri di dargli una mano, ma scuote la testa. "Il tuo aiuto è stato inestimabile, ma non puoi seguirmi dove vanno questi, e io. Hai visto tu stesso quanto si stia rivelando complicato mantenere un'adeguata segretezza attorno a questo progetto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"Is there nothing I can do then?"|3027|0
units.english: "Is there nothing I can do then?"
units.italian: "Non c'è proprio niente che io possa fare?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"I understand."|3029|0
units.english: "I understand."
units.italian: "Va bene, capisco."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"I was hoping to keep those for myself."|3031|0
units.english: "I was hoping to keep those for myself."
units.italian: "Speravo di tenermeli per me."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	He grins. "Do not feel too conflicted. Activating these outfits is going to be more complicated than connecting some wires and pressing a button. Even if I have just begun studying them. I have a hard time believing you - or anyone, for that matter - could get them to fire easily.|3032|0
units.english: He grins. "Do not feel too conflicted. Activating these outfits is going to be more complicated than connecting some wires and pressing a button. Even if I have just begun studying them. I have a hard time believing you - or anyone, for that matter - could get them to fire easily.
units.italian: Sorride. "Non sentirti troppo in conflitto. Attivare questi equipaggiamenti sarà più complicato che collegare qualche filo e premere un pulsante. Anche se ho appena iniziato a studiarli. Faccio fatica a credere che tu, o chiunque altro, possa farli funzionare facilmente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"Still, it should not take you too long to get the authorizations for this project, if you continue like this," he gestures with a pleased look on his face. "It has come to my attention that even right now there are other projects about Patir that desire your participation. During our return, I have informed Dusk that you are free from your obligations with my research; if you would like to meet him, he should be here shortly." He bows, and you return it as he follows the cargo deeper into the starport. You catch the opportunity to clean up the cockpit and the empty bunks. Some Remnant nearby soon notice you taking out the trash, and offer you a hand.|3034|0
units.english: "Still, it should not take you too long to get the authorizations for this project, if you continue like this," he gestures with a pleased look on his face. "It has come to my attention that even right now there are other projects about Patir that desire your participation. During our return, I have informed Dusk that you are free from your obligations with my research; if you would like to meet him, he should be here shortly." He bows, and you return it as he follows the cargo deeper into the starport. You catch the opportunity to clean up the cockpit and the empty bunks. Some Remnant nearby soon notice you taking out the trash, and offer you a hand.
units.italian: "Tuttavia, non dovrebbe volerci troppo per ottenere le autorizzazioni per questo progetto, se continui così," gesticola con un'espressione soddisfatta. "Mi è stato riferito che anche in questo momento ci sono altri progetti su Patir che desiderano la tua partecipazione. Durante il nostro ritorno ho informato Dusk che sei libero dai tuoi obblighi con la mia ricerca; se vuoi incontrarlo, dovrebbe essere qui a breve." Si inchina, e tu ricambi mentre segue il carico più a fondo nello spazioporto. Cogli l'occasione per pulire la cabina e le cuccette vuote. Alcuni Remnant lì vicino ti notano mentre porti fuori la spazzatura, e ti offrono una mano.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	By the time Dusk arrives, your ship's interior looks as good as new. You greet and invite him to take a seat, which he warmly accepts. "It is nice to see you again, <first>. I heard your travels in Patir with Chilia went... well, at least better than ours," he quips.|3035|0
units.english: By the time Dusk arrives, your ship's interior looks as good as new. You greet and invite him to take a seat, which he warmly accepts. "It is nice to see you again, <first>. I heard your travels in Patir with Chilia went... well, at least better than ours," he quips.
units.italian: Quando Dusk arriva, l'interno della tua nave sembra nuovo di zecca. Lo saluti e lo inviti a sedersi, cosa che accetta calorosamente. "È bello rivederti, <first>. Ho sentito che i tuoi viaggi a Patir con Chilia sono andati... bene, almeno meglio dei nostri," scherza.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"What do you know about it?"|3037|0
units.english: "What do you know about it?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ne sai?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"All things considered, quite well."|3038|0
units.english: "All things considered, quite well."
units.italian: "Tutto considerato, piuttosto bene."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"It could have gone better."|3040|0
units.english: "It could have gone better."
units.italian: "Poteva andare meglio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"What about you?"|3042|0
units.english: "What about you?"
units.italian: "E tu che mi racconti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"About the same as you, I imagine. Right now, you and I have the same level of authorization, at least for what concerns Patir and the related systems. Prefect Chilia, of course, is going to be far more involved than us in the matters related to its military potential."|3044|0
units.english: "About the same as you, I imagine. Right now, you and I have the same level of authorization, at least for what concerns Patir and the related systems. Prefect Chilia, of course, is going to be far more involved than us in the matters related to its military potential."
units.italian: "Più o meno come te, immagino. Al momento tu e io abbiamo lo stesso livello di autorizzazione, almeno per quanto riguarda Patir e i sistemi collegati. Il prefetto Chilia, naturalmente, sarà molto più coinvolto di noi nelle questioni legate al suo potenziale militare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	Your chat with Dusk goes on for some time, discussing with him the details of your previous trips. For his part, he describes his progress over the past months: his focus expanded from Patir itself to the worlds that lie beyond it, and on how to use Ssil Vida to reach them.|3046|0
units.english: Your chat with Dusk goes on for some time, discussing with him the details of your previous trips. For his part, he describes his progress over the past months: his focus expanded from Patir itself to the worlds that lie beyond it, and on how to use Ssil Vida to reach them.
units.italian: La tua chiacchierata con Dusk va avanti per un po', discutendo con lui i dettagli dei tuoi viaggi precedenti. Da parte sua, descrive i suoi progressi negli ultimi mesi: la sua attenzione si è ampliata da Patir stesso ai mondi che si trovano oltre, e a come usare Ssil Vida per raggiungerli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"Given our progress, we now feel ready for a new expedition. At first, a short, single-day one, to test our systems in a practical scenario. If all goes well, after that we will be able to progressively increase our stay to any length of time," he asserts. You follow him out of your ship as he prepares to leave. "I need you to prepare a ship capable of carrying a fighter to Patir. One of our Ibises should more than suffice, if you do not have one already.|3047|0
units.english: "Given our progress, we now feel ready for a new expedition. At first, a short, single-day one, to test our systems in a practical scenario. If all goes well, after that we will be able to progressively increase our stay to any length of time," he asserts. You follow him out of your ship as he prepares to leave. "I need you to prepare a ship capable of carrying a fighter to Patir. One of our Ibises should more than suffice, if you do not have one already.
units.italian: "Visti i nostri progressi, ora ci sentiamo pronti per una nuova spedizione. All'inizio breve, di un solo giorno, per testare i nostri sistemi in uno scenario pratico. Se tutto va bene, dopo potremo aumentare progressivamente la durata del soggiorno a qualsiasi lunghezza," afferma. Lo segui fuori dalla nave mentre si prepara a partire. "Ho bisogno che tu prepari una nave capace di trasportare un caccia su Patir. Uno dei nostri Ibis dovrebbe essere più che sufficiente, se non ne hai già uno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 19|	"We will be fairly time-limited once we depart, so feel free to wait until you are ready for the mission before you search for me in this planet's spaceport. It is more important to do things right than to do them quickly," he concludes stoically.|3048|0
units.english: "We will be fairly time-limited once we depart, so feel free to wait until you are ready for the mission before you search for me in this planet's spaceport. It is more important to do things right than to do them quickly," he concludes stoically.
units.italian: "Una volta partiti avremo tempo piuttosto limitato, quindi sentiti libero di aspettare di essere pronto per la missione prima di cercarmi nello spazioporto di questo pianeta. È più importante fare le cose bene che farle in fretta," conclude stoicamente.
